名动江湖的天下第一暗器大家。几朝老派，门人有入室、外姓之别。外姓弟子拜入门下需服劳役，累积功德，假以时日方可蒙师长垂青，改宗入室，随师门姓唐，进而学习不外传的高深武功。十数年前唐门遭逢大变，上代高手尽皆散尽死绝，独留现任掌门撑门拄户。然而任凭掌门殚精竭虑，亦难力挽狂澜。唐门人丁凋零，经已式微，昔日威风不再，而今又强敌环伺，实可谓危如累卵。=Renowned as the top masters of hidden weapon under heaven.\nAn old sect spanning several dynasties, its disciples are divided into inner-sect and outer-sect members.\nOuter-sect disciples must perform labor services and accumulate merits after joining the sect. Over time, they may gain the favor of their masters, change their lineage to inner-sect status, adopt the Tang surname of the sect, and then learn advanced, secret martial arts.\nOver a decade ago, the Tang Sect underwent a great upheaval, with the previous generation of masters scattered or deceased, leaving only the current Sect Leader to uphold it's legacy.\nHowever, despite the Sect Leader's exhaustive efforts, reversing the decline remains elusive.\nThe Tang Sect's members have dwindled, and its influence has declined. The prestige of the past is gone, and now, surrounded by powerful enemies, its situation is truly as precarious as a pile of eggs.

唐门曾与南宫、上官并列江湖三大世家，行事作风却大相径庭。唐门不似南宫谨守家训不收外徒，亦不像上官世家野心勃勃广收帮众。虽收弟子，却有有入室、外姓之别。外姓弟子拜入门下需服劳役，累积功德，假以时日方可蒙师长垂青，改宗入室，随师门姓唐，方能得传艰深的武功要诀。这条门规由祖师立下，早已不合时宜，后人一味墨守成规，累得今日落魄。=The Tang Sect was once ranked among the Three Great Martial Families of the jianghu, alongside the Nangong and Shangguan, yet their ways and conduct differed greatly.\nUnlike the Nangong, who strictly adhered to family traditions and did not accept outside disciples, and unlike the ambitious Shangguan Family, who widely recruited followers, the Tang Sect accepted disciples but enforced a rigid inner-sect and outer-sect divide.\nOuter-sect disciples had to perform labor services and accumulate merits after joining the sect. Only after a certain period could they gain the favor of their masters, change their lineage to inner-sect status, adopt the Tang surname of the sect, and then be taught the profound secrets of martial arts.\nThis sect rule, established by the founding master, has long been out of step with the times. Blind adherence to outdated conventions by successors now shackles the sect to its decline.

一度潦倒的唐门，多亏当代弟子的活跃，颇有起死回生的迹象。慕名而来拜师的弟子众多，门人心有灵犀，均不再提内外姓制度，使新入门弟子得以即刻拜师习练武艺，补充门派实力。虽犹不及全盛时期那般人才济济，声势却已不容小觑。你成为了本门最后一位外姓弟子，反成了珍稀人物。=The once-declining Tang Sect has shown signs of revival, through the active efforts of its current disciples.\nMany have come to seek apprenticeship, drawn by its reputation. The sect members, as if by tacit understanding, no longer emphasize the distinction between inner and outer-sect, allowing new disciples to immediately begin learning martial arts and bolstering the sect's strength.\nThough not yet at its peak, its influence can no longer be underestimated.\nYou, its last outer-sect disciple, have become a rare relic.

如今唐门风光，已直逼当年全盛之时。新入弟子之中资质上佳者，武功已成，使本门行走江湖不致教人瞧轻。有唐门坐镇，无有外敌敢犯，是为蜀中地区最受官府瞩目的武装暴力团体。=The Tang Sec's prestige now nears its former zenith.\nGifted new disciples with exceptional talent have already mastered their martial skills, ensuring the sect commands respect when venturing into the martial world.\nWith the Tang Sect holding its ground, no external enemy dares to invade, making it the most notorious armed group in the Shu region that has caught the attention of the authorities.

唐门以一介世家，几乎能与大派分庭抗礼。门中能人辈出，声名鹊起者不绝，其中便有你在列。外姓弟子的印记已从世人脑海淡忘，你不再是某某人，而是你自己。你的身后则跟随着许多望着你背影的人。=The Tang Sect, as a single prominent family, now almost rivals Major Martial Sects.\nWithin the sect, talents emerge one after another, and those who have risen to fame are countless, including you.\nThe stigma of outer-sect disciple fades from people's memory, you are no longer defined by it, but by your own name.\nBehind you, many now follow in your footsteps, watching your every move.

唐门的威望，空前绝后，傲视群豪。俨然已成当朝武林的第一大派，泥教既衰，已不能与抗。能与唐门争雄者，天下唯有武林盟。时代的分水岭就在眼前，你的名字已成为不朽传说。=The Tang Sect's prestige reaches unprecedented heights, surpassing all other rivals.\nIt now dominates as the foremost sect of the martial world. The declining Mud Cult offers no contest.\nOnly the Wulin Alliance remains capable to challenge its supremacy. A new era dawns, and your name is forever etched into legend.

Though she knew no martial arts, she was exceptionally bright and unconstrained by convention. In that brief moment, she grasped something, though too young to fully understand. \nOnly at this farewell did she taste the sorrow of parting, memories flooding her heart, leading to sudden enlightenment, thus she wrote this technique.\nThough only one move, its lingering essence is boundless. This sword technique is the Sword Sage's fourth ultimate move,「Soul Wanders Homeland, Sleeves Filled with Fragrance; Spring Cries at Dawn, do not hold back」.

点苍棒法=Diancang Staff Technique
叶云裳擅自涂改点苍剑谱所创的棒法。没有杀伤力可言，但是补完了点苍剑法中不尽人意的缺憾之处，料敌所不料，单论招数变化，不失为妙着，就是卑鄙了一点，正常人不会这样。=A staff technique created by Ye Yunshang by arbitrarily altering the Diancang Sword Manual.\nIt has no lethal power but fills the unsatisfactory gaps in the Diancang sword techniques, catching opponents off guard. In terms of variation alone, it is a clever move—just a bit underhanded, something a normal person wouldn't do.

太白仙迹=Taibai Immortal Traces
李白中年将侍于翰林院，封剑退隐之前留下的剑法，一共三十六式。这套剑法只在弟子武谔面前使过仅仅一次，那时李白还喝醉了。起似随兴挥洒，偏生处处神来一笔，妙到颠毫，似剑而非剑，破千古窠臼，辟未有之奇。一套剑法使完，独立树梢，衣袂飘飘，宛如神仙。而坐观的武谔却全身大汗淋漓。相传武谔有艰涩难解处，欲请教师父，李白却道：「莫问我，问了你便学不会。」武谔猛然顿悟，欢天喜地而去，殊不知李白只是宿醉推搪而已。=A sword technique left by Li Bai in his middle years before he entered the Hanlin Academy and retired from the sword, comprising thirty-six forms in total.\nThis set was demonstrated only once in front of his disciple Wu E, and Li Bai was drunk at the time.\nIt began as if improvised, yet every move was divinely inspired, exquisite to the extreme, resembling a sword yet transcending it, breaking ancient conventions and pioneering the unprecedented.\nAfter completing the set, he stood alone on a treetop, sleeves fluttering like an immortal. Meanwhile, Wu E, who had been observing, was drenched in sweat.\nLegend says Wu E encountered difficult points and wanted to ask his Master, but Li Bai said,「Don't ask me. If you ask, you won't learn it.」Wu E had a sudden enlightenment and left overjoyed, unaware that Li Bai was merely brushing him off due to a hangover.

全真天遁剑法=Quanzhen Heavenly Evasion Sword Technique
太古道人郝大通于华山创设全真华山派时携去的原始全真剑法，此书由王喆亲笔写就，丹阳子马钰抄录成七册分予师弟留作纪念，以缅怀师尊。气、剑双修，难学难精，深奥非常。=The original Quanzhen sword technique brought by the ancient Daoist Hao Datong when he founded the Huashan Sect of Quanzhen on Mount Hua. This text was written by Wang Zhe himself, and Dan Yangzi Ma Yu copied it into seven volumes as mementos for his junior brothers, in remembrance of their Master.\nIt cultivates both energy and sword, difficult to learn and Master, profoundly abstruse.

酩酊玄剑掌=Drunken Mystic Sword Palm
一门神奇的武功，作者姓名已经失佚。既是掌法，也是剑法，手中无剑，心中却有剑。招数精妙，却无半分杀气，似乎只为自娱，舞来有如清辉明月，酣畅淋漓。=A mystical martial art whose creator's name is lost to time.\nIt is both palm technique and sword art, no blade in hand, yet a sword in the heart.\nThe moves are exquisite but devoid of killing intent, seemingly for self-delight, flowing like clear moonlight, utterly exhilarating.

五毒秘录=Five Poisons Secret Record
苗疆五毒教中的用毒法门，与唐门毒经可谓各擅胜场，药理亦不相同。它山之石，可以为错。=The poison arts of the Miaojiang Five Poisons Sect, rivaling the Tang Sect's Poison Classic with distinct pharmacology.\nStones from other hills may polish the jade.

四平枪谱=Siping Spear Manual
四平枪谱=Siping Spear Manual

金刚腿=Vajra Leg
嵩山派名扬天下的硬功之一，由踢桩功为根基，习练者双腿系沙袋，轮流踢踹木桩百次为一趟，初习者分早午晚日踢三趟，随着功力日深，一日踢上十趟、二十趟都是日常。及至百日，除却沙袋，脚腿轻灵而势猛如昔，根基已成，再练技巧，弹、蹬、踹、砸、摆、点、撩、扫，八字腿诀，无一不是脚到擒来。=One of Songshan Sect's hard skills renowned under heaven, rooted in stump-kicking practice. Practitioners wear sandbags and kick stumps 100 times per set—beginners do three sets daily (morning/noon/night), advancing to ten or twenty sets as skill deepens.\nAfter 100 days, removing sandbags, the legs gain agility and retained power. Foundations set, techniques follow: snap, push, thrust, smash, swing, point, lift, sweep—the eight leg principles mastered effortlessly.

很是用力踢=Kicking Really Hard
原名为「风雷神脚」，是善使腿法闻名的英俊侠客「风神」解无尘的成名绝技。可惜在挑战饿鬼道法王刘颚之时，惨遭「犯剑」当众羞辱，解无尘急怒攻心，呕血饮败，被迫依约将「风雷神腿」更名为「很是用力踢」。很是用力踢使起来极为凌厉，速度迅猛，宛如风雷引至，能蹴裂山岩，所向披靡，端的是厉害无比。=Originally「Divine Wind and Thunder Kick」, the signature technique of dashing hero「Wind God」Xie Wuchen, renowned for leg arts. Sadly, when challenging Hungry Ghost Dharma King Liu E, he was publicly humiliated by「Offending Sword」. Overwhelmed with rage, Xie vomited blood in defeat and was forced to rename「Divine Wind and Thunder Kick」to「Kicking Really Hard」as per agreement.\nThe kick remains fiercely sharp and swift, summoning wind and thunder—shattering rocks, unstoppable, utterly formidable.

蛇兔鹰猿搏=Snake-Rabbit-Eagle-Ape Combat
相传峨嵋派白猿祖师一日得闲，又去寻他山间猿友游戏，却不意撞见令他震惊至永生难以忘怀的奇葩场面。山猿手抓小白兔，蛇缠住了猿猴的身体，老鹰从天而降扑击蛇，小白兔飞脱踩了老鹰的眼睛。这画面转瞬即逝，四兽均受了偌大惊吓，四散逃亡，唯独白猿祖师怔然半晌，返屋后不思茶饭，终于第三日融会贯通，于早饭时拍案而起，当众弟子之面演示了这套蛇兔鹰猿搏。众弟子各自印证，依资质高低领悟有多寡之别，却唯有一人参悟了兔形拳。=Legend says the Emei Sect's White Ape Ancestor, idle one day, went to play with mountain ape friends and witnessed a shocking scene he never forgot:\nA mountain ape held a white rabbit, a snake coiled around the ape, an eagle swooped down to strike the snake, and the rabbit broke free to stomp the eagle's eye.\nThe moment vanished, all four beasts fled in terror. Only the Patriarch stood dazed, then returned home, skipping meals until the third day when it clicked. At breakfast, he slammed the table and demonstrated this combat before disciples.\nEach disciple grasped varying insights based on aptitude, but only one comprehended the Rabbit Form Fist.

玄玄如意指=Mystical Mysterious Wish-Fulfilling Finger
武林盟主大侠龙渊七种成名绝技之一。玄玄如意，妙手空空，能以素手接人兵器，探人衣囊，无往不利。龙渊少年时没少用这招扒人钱财，直到他醒悟茁壮，一肩扛起武林命运，才将秘籍中窃物的手法删除。=One of Alliance Leader Great Hero Long Yuan's seven famed skills.\nMystical Mysterious Wish-Fulfilling Finger implies deft hands, catching blades barehanded or picking pockets with ease.\nYoung Long Yuan often used it to steal, but upon maturing and shouldering Jianghu's fate, he deleted the thieving techniques from the manual.

那由它劫指=Nayuta Kalpa Finger
一本古老的指谱，由梵文写成，深藏于藏经阁之下，若非地震，恐怕永世不见天日。那由他是为佛教数字概念，意为「多不胜数」。劫则是天竺的时间通称，历经成、住、坏、空之后，即为一大劫，故行此功须参悟禅机，不生不灭，以色身历劫无尽，方始证悟大道。=An ancient finger manual in Sanskrit, buried under the scripture library, unearthed only by an earthquake.\nNayuta is a Buddhist numerical unit meaning「Innumerable」.\nKalpa is an Indian time unit, a great kalpa spans formation, stability, decay, and void. Thus, practicing this requires Chan insight into imperishability, enduring kalpas with the physical body to attain enlightenment.

雷神脚=Divine Thunder Kick
峨嵋派腿法之最，腾跃上天，潜卧于云波诡谲之间，吞吐无定，不鸣则已，一鸣惊人，动如九天神雷轰破云霄，似雷公降下天谴，威力万钧。此腿法没有固定套路，有招无式，是为形意拳的究极型态，所象者乃天雷之形，是为雷神脚。=The pinnacle of Emei leg techniques—leaping skyward, hiding in turbulent clouds, unpredictable. Silent until striking like ninth heaven thunder, as if the Thunder God metes divine punishment.\nIt has no fixed patterns—moves without forms, the ultimate expression of Xingyi Quan, embodying lightning's shape: the Divine Thunder Kick.

蛇形拳=Snake Form Fist
丐帮善牧蛇，丐帮的蛇形拳不只模仿蛇形，而是货真价实地与爱蛇共斗，出拳、出腿全都需与蛇相配合，除了啄击、缠绕擒拿以外还藏着一记隐形杀招，招数使老的时候，就是必杀之时－－蛇会猝不及防冲出袖子咬人一口！=The Beggars' Sect excels in snake handling. Their Snake Form Fist not only mimics snakes but genuinely coordinates with pet snakes in combat—fists and legs synced with the snake. Beyond pecking and constricting grabs, it hides a stealth kill: when techniques age, the snake suddenly darts from the sleeve to bite!

清峰三十六路=Thirty-Six Realms of the Clear Peak
青城天下幽，有山阴阳三十六峰，背靠雪岭，林木森森，四季常青。相传唐时有富贾，畏死而求仙，山下问童子，曰：「在林间。」林间问童子：「在山涧。」山涧问童子：「在峦颠。」一路连问三十六峰，又见童子。贾遂知神异，拜于地，童子笑曰：「孺子可教。清修何须苦烦恼，心谦不躁可问道。」富贾清修多年，接任掌门，写下此书，字里行间都是闲游三十六峰的快活心境，初入山时的怕心，早已不知不觉遗落在路上了。=Qingcheng is known as the most serene place under heaven, with thirty-six peaks of yin and yang, backed by snow-capped ridges, lush forests, and evergreen foliage throughout the four seasons.\nLegend has it that during the Tang Dynasty, a wealthy merchant, fearing death, sought immortality. At the foot of the mountain, he asked a young boy, who said,「In the woods.」In the woods, he asked another boy, who replied,「In the mountain stream.」At the mountain stream, he asked yet another boy, who answered,「On the peak.」After asking across thirty-six peaks, ach time encountering a boy. The merchant, realizing this was divine, knelt to the ground. The child laughed:「You are teachable. Cultivation needs no anguish, a humble, calm heart finds the Way.」\nThe merchant cultivated in serenity for many years and eventually became the Sect Leader. He wrote this book, its words brimming with the joy of wandering the thirty-six peaks. The fear he felt upon first entering the mountains had long been unknowingly left behind on the path.

历战血书=Blood-Stained War Chronicle
修罗道法王军旅生涯中随笔的手记，所载内容与其说是武功，不如说是沙场见闻。=Casual notes from the Asura Realm Dharma King's military career.\nThe content resembles battlefield anecdotes more than martial techniques.

逍遥游腿法=Carefree Wandering Leg Technique
全真派的轻功兼腿法，逍遥游出自庄子一书，亦是古琴曲。全真派弟子每日练功时会由传功师父奏曲，鲲化为鹏、翼若垂云、将徙天地、上干青霄、扶摇万里、御风冷然、气适北溟、磅礡万物、翱翔广和九段奏完，方始收功。=A Quanzhen Sect lightness skill and leg technique. Carefree Wandering originates from Zhuangzi and is also a guqin melody. During daily practice, a Master plays the tune—nine segments: "Whale transforms into roc", "Wings like hanging clouds", "Migrating across heavens", "Touching the azure", "Soaring miles", "Riding wind coolly", "Qi reaching northern abyss", "Vast and myriad things", "Soaring broad harmony", before concluding.

八荒夺路逃=Eight Directions Escape Technique
丐帮中人约定成俗的逃跑技巧，人多时使出非常壮观，一哄而散，四面八方夺路而出，如有心有灵犀般指东跑西，教敌人难以一网打尽，最终总会有落网之鱼可以回家通风报信。这逃法以歌诀形式传唱，歌云：「眼看东边走西边，无处可逃上树颠，三五成群铁没命，生死有数莫拖牵。」词虽俗俚浅白，却不单有诡道、还提前做了万一落网的心理建设。=An escape technique conventionally adopted by the Beggars' Sect. A spectacular scene when used by a large group, everyone scatters in all directions as if in tacit agreement, feinting east while fleeing west, making it difficult for the enemy to capture them all at once. In the end, there are always those who slip through the net and manage to report back.\nThis escape method is passed down in the form of a rhyming song:「Eyes look east but run to the west; nowhere to flee, climb the treetops rest; groups of three or five, flee for life; life and death a are fated, don't hold back.」Though the words are crude, they encompass not only cunning tactics but also mental preparation for the possibility of being caught.

阿摩搪墙拳=Amo's Wall-Breaking Fist
阿摩二字，究竟是甚么意思，根本没有人知道。就连丐帮传功长老、耕阳读书斋那群活书包都不知道。但是搪墙的意思，则被解读成「涂抹」，换言之这套拳法，是在极狭小的空间里才能发挥最大功效的武功：将敌人推到墙上死命地打，打成肉酱涂抹在墙上。虽说理念单纯，可这套武功若无外功底子根本无法成立、寸劲、顿肘、铁山靠，全都是实打实的实战功夫。=No one knows what "Amo" means, not even the legacy elders of the Beggars' Sect and the scholarly experts of the Gengyang Study Hall\nBut the phrase "wall-breaking" is interpreted as「smearing」, meaning this fist technique is a martial art that reaches its maximum effectiveness in extremely confined spaces: pinning enemies to walls and relentlessly pounding them into paste, smearing them across the wall.\nThough the concept is straightforward, this martial art cannot be executed without a solid foundation in external techniques. Inch power, sudden elbow strikes, and Iron Mountain Shoulder, all are practical combat skills.

罗汉拳谱=Arhat Fist Manual
嵩山寺中被盗出的拳经，是嵩山武功之根本，易学难精。流转民间的罗汉拳谱在数百年间衍生出诸多套路，各领风骚，每本都不太一样，你也不知手里这本是否原版，你既然捡到了这本拳谱，你就有佛缘，练它。=A fist scripture stolen from Songshan Temple, the foundation of Songshan martial arts, easy to learn but hard to Master.\nOver centuries, the Arhat Fist manuals circulating among the people have spawned numerous variations, each with its own flair, and no two are exactly alike. You have no way of knowing if the one you hold is the original version. Since you've come across this manual, it means you have a connection with Buddhism, practice it.

飞天脚=Flying Heaven Kick
崆峒派‧飞天门的秘籍。是先掌派人将《仙鹤迷踪拳》简化以传授弟子的入门版本。略去迷踪与拳路，仅就下盘轻功锻炼，浅显易懂。=The secret manual of the Kongtong's Flying Heaven Gate.\nIt is an introductory version simplified by the former Sect Leader from the《Immortal Crane Tracing Fist》to teach disciples. It omits the tracing techniques and fist forms, focusing only on lower-body lightness skills, making it straightforward and easy to understand.

仙鹤迷踪拳=Immortal Crane Tracing Fist
崆峒派．飞天门的传世武学。身法轻灵，拳快步松，最是敏捷多变。时而漫步闲游，时而振翅急袭，叫人捉摸不透，防不胜防。只是这路拳法过于复杂，共有三十六路、七十二变、百零八种后着，甚难熟练，因此飞天门中反倒鲜少有人深入钻研。=A legacy art of Kongtong's Flying Heaven Gate.\nLight footwork, loose fists, agile and unpredictable—sometimes leisurely strolls, sometimes sudden strikes, baffling and indefensible.\nBut it's overly complex: 36 forms, 72 variations, 108 follow-ups—so hard to Master that few in Flying Heaven delve deep.

无影爪=Shadowless Claw
曾经名动一时的怪盗铁面人所独创的爪功。不循正理，而是剑走偏锋，潜于昏冥，化身为影，遁入黑夜，施以致命一击。铁面人受命于庞太师，意欲袭杀包拯，反心折于包公铁面无私的气魄，不愿以私戕害青天，亦不敢背信，遂自舍优势，暗中行出，向南侠展昭请战，败得光明正大，自断十指，包拯遂赦免死罪。铁面人归隐于崆峒，请人铸造铁爪义手，写就此书。=A claw art独创 by the once-famous mysterious thief Iron Mask.\nIt defies convention—lurking in darkness, becoming shadow, striking lethally from night.\nHired by Grand Tutor Pang to assassinate Bao Zheng, Iron Mask was moved by Bao's integrity. Unwilling to harm justice yet bound by duty, he forfeited his advantage, challenged Hero Zhan Zhao openly, lost fairly, severed his own fingers, and was pardoned by Bao.\nHe retired to Kongtong, had iron claw prosthetics made, and wrote this manual.

铁臂神拳=Iron Arm Divine Fist
相传是陷空岛五义之一，排行老三的「穿山鼠徐庆」所擅长的武功。徐庆是铁匠出身，力大无穷，有异术能钻地，故称穿山鼠，五鼠归顺开封府，辅佐包拯。嘉佑七年，包公病逝，次年归葬合肥，五鼠一路相送，叩首拜别，各奔东西。及后徐庆归隐崆峒，传下铁臂神拳与铁匠技术，逝于铁拳巷大铁铺。修练者须双臂涂油，穿入铁环，运功令双臂充血坚硬，再使劲抡打木桩；抡断了木桩以后，抡石桩；抡断了石桩，抡铁桩。万一断的是手臂，就涂药膏待好了继续抡，久而久之，双手就会变得像铁一样。=Allegedly mastered by Xu Qing,「Mountain-Piercing Rat」, third of the Five Heroes on the trapped Island.\nA blacksmith by trade, immensely strong with earth-piercing skills, he and the Five Rats served Bao Zheng in Kaifeng.\nAfter Bao's death in Jiayou 7(1062 CE), they escorted his coffin to Hefei, then parted ways.\nXu Qing retired to Kongtong, passing down this fist and blacksmithing, dying in Iron Fist Alley's forge.\nPractitioners oil their arms, thread iron rings, use energy to swell and harden them, then pound stakes—wood, then stone, then iron. If arms break, heal with ointment and resume—over time, hands become like iron.

白猿通臂拳=White Ape Through-Arm Fist
峨嵋派白猿祖师的成名绝技，严格来说也算是一种猴拳，却与民间所传的猴拳南辕北辙。劲由背发，经肩过肘通达手指，是为通臂。=Emei's White Ape Ancestor's signature technique—technically a monkey fist, but unlike folk versions. Force starts from the back, through shoulder and elbow to fingers—hence called through-arm.\nIt entangles on contact, circles defenses, closes in swiftly, dodges and seizes—a highly agile fist art.

夺魄幽灵爪=Soul-Snatching Phantom Claw
江湖第一美人夺魄幽兰的成名绝技。揉合夺魄门暗袭之术与雪山派内功，身法如鬼魅，能勾人魂魄。摧心、蚀骨、销魂、夺魄四式，一招狠似一招，极其毒辣，习之恐怕有伤天和。=The signature skill of Jianghu's top beauty, Soul-Snatching Ghost Orchid.\nBlends Soul-Snatching Sect stealth with Snow Mountain internal energy—movements ghostly, soul-hooking.\nFour forms: heart-crushing, bone-eroding, soul-dissolving, spirit-seizing—each deadlier than the last. Learning it may defy natural harmony.

登云踏．望月=Ascending Clouds: Moon Gaze
你唐门大师兄登徒子行径中自创的武功，收录于登云梯续集。为了求见美人，可以登云上楼台，其中踏月式是由这路轻功衍生出的攻招，「月」指光辉，暗喻所有加诸于己的兵刃。故而踏月式的真义是专门踏到别人兵刃上，居高临下踩人脸面。=Created by your Tang Sect's First Senior Brother during his womanizing, recorded in *Cloud-Ladder Sequel*. To reach beauties in high places, he developed this qinggong, "Moon Gaze" is an offensive derivative where「Moon」symbolizes blades aimed at him. Thus, it means stepping onto weapons to stomp faces from above.

雪山飞鸿爪=Snow Mountain Soaring Swan Claw
你恩师夏侯兰集夺魄、雪山两家之神髓，去芜存菁，又揉合了控鹤气功，终于创制出的神技。旨不在杀伤，乃是专门对付高手用的武功，就算是天下最高明的轻功，也捉得到。发力恰似飞鸿踏雪泥，泥上偶然留指爪，鸿飞那复计东西？轻描淡写抓出，力使三分藏七分，后着隐于无形。破坏敌人架势，而我迅速回气，施以夺命猛袭。=Your Master Xiahou Lan's masterpiece, refining Soul-Snatching and Snow Mountain arts with crane-control qigong.\nIt aims not to kill but to counter masters, catching even those with the most brilliant qinggong under heaven.\nForce application mimics swans stepping on snow, leaving brief marks, then soaring unpredictably. Strikes seem light (30% force, 70% hidden), follow-ups are concealed. It breaks stances while allowing quick recovery for lethal assaults.

千刀万剐杀=Thousand Cuts Execution
极度疯狂的刀法，乃是一名身负夺妻之恨的三流刀客所创。受冤下狱13年间，在心中揣想过几千次敌人的武功路子，在脑海中将夺妻的仇敌凌迟几万次。他出狱后不久，惊动江湖的血案「碧血狂杀」案件旋即爆发。=An insane blade art created by a third-rate swordsman robbed of his wife.\nDuring 13 years of wrongful imprisonment, he envisioned thousands of enemy moves and mentally lingchi'd his rival tens of thousands of times.\nSoon after his release, the Jianghu-shocking「Bloodstained Fury」erupted.

赤脚神通=Barefoot Divine Ability
与夺魄《镇魂功》、铁拳《伤拳》、玄功《铁琵琶功》同出《南岳真经》的飞天门失传神通。飞天脚、仙鹤迷踪步的原始之型。功成者可以一趾立地，无须屈膝使力，仅凭内力驱使，便能滑行疾飙。出脚时劲由身通腿，腿通脚，脚通趾，将万钧威力收束于一点，视乎意念，可刚可柔，刚能一趾点破金钟罩，柔能以趾劲封人穴道。=A lost Flying Heaven Gate divine skill from the《Southern Peak True Classic》, like Soul-Snatching's《Soul-Calming Art》, Iron Fist's《Wounding Fist》, and Mystic Art's《Iron Pipa Technique》.\nThe fusion of Flying Heaven Kick and Immortal Crane Tracing Steps.\nMasters can balance on one toe, glide swiftly with internal energy alone. Force flows from body to leg, foot, toe—condensing immense power into a point. It can be as hard as Golden Bell Shield or soft (sealing acupoints).

八仙指=Eight Immortals Finger
唐门女侠唐芬基于青城《八仙剑法》五行学说，以五毒替代之，创成的独门武功。论招式至多二流，却隐含唐门医、毒二术，十分艰涩难读，读了也未必能有多大成就。=A unique art by Tang Sect heroine Tang Fen, adapting Qingcheng's《Eight Immortals Sword》five-element theory with five poisons.\nThe moves are at best second-rate, but it contains medical and poison techniques of the Tang Clan, extremely abstruse. Reading it may not lead to great achievement.

龟息功=Turtle Breath Skill
经典江湖鬼蜮伎俩，很多小人都会用。敌人太强，不敌之时，便抓准时机，自行运功封阻体内经脉，使气血凝滞，脉搏暂时停止，便好似死了一般。待敌人离去后，再藉由预先藏于掌心的石灰发热将自身唤醒。不过使用这套内功风险颇高，万一唤醒的机关不太灵验，醒来后也会因为脑缺氧从此变得痴痴呆呆；又万一招惹了狠角色，见你倒下了二话不说便先补个两刀子，假死就便真死了。=A classic Jianghu trick—many villains use it.\nWhen overpowered, one seizes the moment to block meridians, stagnate qi and blood, and halt the pulse, feigning death.\nAfter the enemy leaves, pre-hidden lime in the palm generates heat to awaken the user.\nBut it's risky: if the trigger fails, brain hypoxia may cause permanent dementia; if the enemy is ruthless, they might stab the corpse; turning a fake death into real.

莲花落=Lotus Fall
丐帮人人都会唱的帮歌莲花落，其实是讲究求生技巧的一部内功歌诀。每夜收工以后，由辈分较老的乞丐带着小辈齐唱，边唱边以筷敲碗，以此掌握节拍，配合歌曲换气，吐纳习惯自然养成。只不过歌词往往粗鄙不堪，有辱斯文，有些对着姑娘家唱还会被报官。=The Beggars' Sect's anthem, sung by all—actually an internal energy rhyme teaching survival.\nEach night, elders lead juniors in singing while tapping bowls with chopsticks, mastering rhythm and breath control through the tune.\nBut the lyrics are often crude and vulgar; singing them to women might get you reported.

全真剑法=Quanzhen Sword Technique
全真教为了推广教义，开民智，而刻意外传的养气内功。将剑诀删减，杂以养命之道，以浅白口语重新编译过，浅显易懂，可以初窥道学，延年益命。乡亲父老人手一本，人人有功练，堪称国民健康操，但想要以此克敌制胜，恐怕是行不通的。=A Qi-nurturing internal art deliberately spread by Quanzhen Sect to promote doctrine and enlighten the people.\nSimplified sword principles mixed with life-preserving methods, rewritten in plain language—easy to grasp, offering a glimpse into Daoism and longevity.\nEvery villager has a copy; it's a National Health Exercise, but actually useless for defeating enemies.

全真教为了推广教义，开民智，而刻意外传的养气内功。将剑诀删减，杂以养命之道，以浅白口语重新编译过，浅显易懂，可以初窥道学，延年益寿。乡亲父老人手一本，人人有功练，堪称国民健康操，但想要以此克敌制胜，恐怕是行不通的。=A Qi-nurturing internal art deliberately spread by Quanzhen Sect to promote doctrine and enlighten the people.\nSimplified sword principles mixed with life-preserving methods, rewritten in plain language, easy to grasp, offering a glimpse into Daoism and longevity.\nEvery villager has a copy; it's a National Health Exercise, but actually useless for defeating enemies.

烈火禅=Blazing Fire Chan
传自西域密宗的神秘禅功，习练方法与中原武术截然不同，不单姿势古怪，遣词亦十分晦涩，最终二章译得牛头不对马嘴，难以阅读。练此禅功讲究身体力行，需点燃炭木，铺以尖锐碎石，再于石上练功，练功者必须潜运内功，将热力排出体外，否则必将引火烧身。据闻修练至最高境界可以打坐浮空、手脚关节脱臼伸长打人、口吐烈火。但不知最后二章的内容，这个境界是无论如何难以得见的。=A mysterious Zen art from Western Esoteric Buddhism—practice methods differ vastly from Central Plains martial arts. Poses are odd, wording obscure, and the final chapters are poorly translated.\nIt requires literal immersion: light charcoal, spread sharp stones, and practice atop them. One must channel internal energy to expel heat or risk burning.\nAt its peak, one can meditate mid-air, dislocate joints to strike, and breathe fire.\nBut without the final chapters, this realm is unattainable.

杨家练兵操=Yang Family Military Training Drill
北宋杨门忠烈的练兵体操。号称体操，然而为了确实提高沙场生还率，本操的锻炼强度不仅远超朝廷正规军，甚至比武林中小门派的功法还要严格，杂以棍操、一百零八阵操、铜锤十八打，这套体操即令是武林中人，怕也没几个受得了。=Northern Song Yang Family's loyalist training exercises. Although it's called Calisthenics, but to ensure battlefield survival, its intensity surpasses imperial troops and even minor sects' methods—mixing staff drills, 108 formation exercises, and 18 copper hammer strikes. Few in Jianghu can endure it.

龙吟功=Dragon Roar Technique
道门苍龙吟，是以九霄龙吟为譬，形容得道之人飞升清啸，有如龙吟破空般清亮。此功须由丹田内气外发，与人交手之际，发功呼啸，声如雷霆疾泻千里，使人心魄为之所夺，甚至还能造成内伤。=Daoist "Azure Dragon's Roar"—compared to ninth heaven dragon cries, describing an enlightened one's ascendant clear shout, piercing like dragon roar.\nIt projects internal energy from the dantian. In combat, the roar thunders for miles, stunning foes and causing internal injuries.

混元童子气=Primordial Youth Qi
虽然效果强大、流传亦广，却没人要练的气功。这是因为此功乃是一门童子的缘故，殊为可惜。听说一旦成亲，苦练而来的功力就会散去，任谁都不想孤独终老，所以没人愿意修练这套武功，然则这是世人的误解。所谓童子功，是指留守先天之气以养后天，故而由儿童时期起练最有效果的意思。若打娘胎出生便开始练，不出十二年即可大成。若志学之年起练，筋骨已成，先天之气逸散，则效果半减，而立之年再学，已无用处。跟成亲与否其实没有关系。=A powerful, widely known yet rarely practiced Qigong because of a misunderstanding.\nRumors say that once one marries, the power gained through arduous practice will dissipate, but no one wants to die alone, so no one wants to practice this martial art. But "Youth qi" means preserving innate qi to nourish acquired qi; it's best started during one's childhood. If one begins practicing when they are of school age, their muscles and bones are already formed, and their innate energy dissipates, so the effect is halved. If one continues to practice after the age of thirty, it will be of no use.\nIt actually has nothing to do with whether one is married or not.

巫山洞府九宝图=Wushan Cave's Nine Treasures Map
藏于巫山与长江流域交会的钟乳洞中，绘于壁上的神秘武功，不知来历为何，亦不知历时几朝，以九张连环图画演示修练法门，似乎亦正亦邪，绝非寻常练功法门，然则言简意赅，有发聋振聩之效。被一名失足落水的渔夫发现以后，誊拓下来，上交朝廷换得奖赏，而朝廷亦不重视，这套武功就此被埋没于达官贵人的书架之上。而那钟乳洞亦因水位上升，已被彻底淹没。=A mysterious martial art painted on walls in a stalactite cave where Wushan meets the Yangtze—origin unknown, spanning dynasties. Nine连环 pictures depict practice methods, seemingly ambiguous yet profound—far from ordinary.\nA drowning fisherman found it, copied it, traded it to the court for reward. The court ignored it, and the art was buried on nobles' shelves.\nThe cave is now submerged by rising water.

铁琵琶功=Iron Pipa Technique
习练者需单脚立桩，以腿托琵琶，这是飞天门「鹤桩」的轻功；若要掀动铁琴弦，需先习练夺魄门「霜刀破竹指」；再来要鼓动音箱，便须运使玄功门内力，使其共振；御敌时，更能抄起琵琶作为武器，施展铁拳奇门「如意砸」的招数，打爆敌人脑袋瓜。功成心念一动，百脉齐鸣，动如响弦，历久不衰，是为崆峒第一神功。=Practitioners stand on one leg, Flying Heaven's『Crane Stance』to support the pipa; to pluck iron strings, one must learn Soul-Snatching's『Frost Blade Bamboo-Split Finger』; to resonate the soundbox, use Mystic Sect's internal energy; in combat, wield the pipa as a weapon with Iron Fist's「Wishful Smash」to crush heads.\nAt mastery, a thought sets meridians humming like strings—Kongtong's top divine skill.

焚心火印=Heart-Burning Fire Seal
飞天门和夺魄门角逐崆峒门面之选，为求速成，不惜饮鸩止渴，以火蝎毒助长内力，强行突破瓶颈。运使焚心火印，能够暂时加速心搏，推动血流、以燃烧余寿为代价，全面提升肉体能力。但是代价不只这些，火毒囤积在体内，每达鼎盛就会溢于表征，轻则口干舌燥、牙龈渗血、失眠易怒，重则火气冲脑，不是痴呆就是暴毙。每年端午阳气最盛之时尤为凶险，不可不慎。=Flying Heaven and Soul-Snatching Sects vied for Kongtong's reputation, using fire scorpion poison to force breakthroughs—a desperate shortcut.\nThe Heart-Burning Fire Seal temporarily accelerates heartbeat and blood flow, enhancing physicality at the cost of lifespan.\nBut fire toxin accumulates—peaking with symptoms: dry mouth, bleeding gums, insomnia, irritability; severe cases cause brain fire leading to dementia or death.\nEspecially dangerous during Duanwu Festival (peak yang)—caution urged.

雪山心法=Snow Mountain Heart Method
现今已不存在的雪山派心法，修练方法非常特殊。需吸足真气，赤身裸体、头下脚上插进雪中，只将脚掌露在外边，再由旁人以艾炙足底涌泉穴，使修练者运使心法借艾炙的热力温经通络，调适体温、抵御冰雪。没有雪水的话，就近找条清凉的溪流，也可以替代。=The lost Heart Method of the extinct Snow Mountain Sect. Practice uniquely: inhale qi, bury oneself upside-down in snow (feet exposed), while a partner moxa-burns Yongquan acupoints—using the heat to warm meridians, regulate temperature, and resist cold.\nIf no snow, use a cool stream.

玄烛心经=Mystic Candle Heart Scripture
锦香宫主费煞苦心创制，由南宫心法演化而来，旨在助人心意宁定，不致因为悲切而伤身。玄烛意指月亮，故而此功又名望月心经。人有悲欢离合，月有阴晴圆缺，此事古难全，可即使天各一方，照的都是同一片月光。每当恸动之时，当行此功，收敛心神，化悲伤为力量，好好活着。=Created painstakingly by Jinxiang Palace's Master, evolved from Nangong Heart Method, to calm the mind and prevent grief from harming the body.\n"Mystic Candle" means the moon; hence the Moon-Gazing Heart Scripture.\n"Joy and sorrow part and meet; moon waxes and wanes; never perfect since antiquity. Yet even apart, we share the same moonlight".\nIn moments of grief, practice this to focus the mind, turn sorrow into strength, and live well.

南宫心法=Nangong Heart Method 
南宫家世代承传的家学心法，人手一本，歌诀大方的抄录在书本内页。揉合道家思想，万变犹定，神怡气静，意守玄关，降伏邪气，虚怀若谷，心神清明。以守心为本，而后护身、保家、卫国，是南宫家学的根基。=The Nangong Family's hereditary Heart Method—each member has a copy with rhymes openly inscribed.\nBlends Daoist thought: calm amidst change, serene spirit, focused on the mystic gate, subduing evil, humble and clear-minded.\nFoundation: guard the heart, then protect body, family, and nation.

龙渊七绝=Long Yuan Seven Ultimates
传奇一般的前任武林盟主龙渊的成名功夫，其实并不是一套武功，而是龙渊曾使过的七种绝技。刀剑：斩落星辰纲；拳掌：割山掌；腿法：射日腿；枪棍：小霸王枪；长索：离奇点穴绳；暗器：如意指；内功：玄玄造化功。当年龙渊号令群雄，攻入旧魔教天堂总坛，独斗极乐教主，斩星射日、霸王割山连番使出，震骇当世正邪两派高手，不约而同都想：「这便是当今天下第一了。」=The famed skills of legendary former Alliance Leader Long Yuan, not one style but seven techniques:\nSword: Star-Severing Net; Fist: Mountain-Cutting Palm; Leg: Sun-Shooting Kick; Spear: Little Overlord Spear; Rope: Bizarre Acupoint Cord; Hidden Weapon: Wishful Finger; Internal: Mystic Creation Skill.\nLong Yuan once led heroes to assault the old demon cult's headquarters, soloing the Blissful Sect Cult Leader, shocking everyone with "Star-Severing" and "Mountain-Cutting". Everyone thought:「This is the number one skill under heaven.」

逐浪诀=Wave-Chasing Method
武林三大世家上官一脉承传的心法，翻浪刀法的真髓。需借汹涌激流练刀，练到能在惊涛之中屹立不摇，挥刀斩浪的地步。招数有如沧浪一波未平、一波又起，咄咄逼人，内力到处，更是威力大增，教人便招架住了，也得踉跄几步。=The Heart Method of the Shangguan lineage, one of Three Great Martial Families' essence of Wave-Turning Blade technique.\nPractice in raging currents until standing firm in waves, slicing through them.\nMoves like endless tides—relentless. With internal energy, power multiplies, forcing defenders to stagger.

无为丹法=Non-Action Elixir Method
青城派的内功心法，主张无为持修，守无致虚。心性清净无为，便是有为，无心无念是为大成，切忌一切意象存想，然道自生。难学难精，但是功成之日，非同小可。=A Qingcheng Heart Method advocating non-action cultivation—guard emptiness to reach void.\nSerene inaction is action; no-mind is mastery. Avoid all imagery—Dao arises naturally.\nHard to learn and Master, but upon success, it's extraordinary.

虎啸功=Tiger Roar Skill
道门虎啸功，是以猛虎咆啸为譬，形容修道之人勇猛精进，有如猛虎一般威猛，使群邪辟易。此功须由丹田内气外发，与人交手之际，发功呼啸，声如雷霆疾泻千里，使人心魄为之所夺，甚至还能造成内伤。=Daoist "Tiger Roar", compared to a fierce tiger's roar, describing a cultivator's vigor, repelling all evil.\nIt projects internal energy from the dantian. In combat, the roar thunders for miles, stunning foes and causing internal injuries.

枯荣神功上卷=Withering and Flourishing Divine Skill: Upper Volume
枯荣神功上卷=Withering and Flourishing Divine Skill: Upper Volume

阴阳夺=Yin-Yang Seizer
青城派的神妙武功，融会太极之理，气敛入骨，内固精神，于掌心造化万物，一收一放，一阴一阳，一静一动。无论来者劲道是阴是阳，均能化收，犹如泥牛入海，消散无形。=A miraculous Qingcheng art fusing Taiji principles—qi condensed into bones, spirit fortified, creating all in the palm: Release, yin-yang, stillness-motion.\nIt neutralizes any incoming force (yin or yang) like mud牛入海—vanishing without trace.

论语=Analects
以春秋思想家孔子的言论汇编，为儒家最重要的经典之一。这是三师兄当私塾先生时，为了教授不识字学童而编辑的简单白话本。=A compilation of Spring and Autumn philosopher Confucius' sayings,\none of Confucianism's most important classics.\nThis is a simplified vernacular edition edited by Third Senior Brother during his time as a tutor,\nto teach illiterate children.

孙子兵法=Art of War
春秋兵圣孙武所著，是为中原最早的兵书，被兵家奉为经典。一共十三篇，论述军事，总结战争经验，对后世军策影响极其深远。=Written by Spring and Autumn military sage Sun Wu,\nit is the earliest Central Plains treatise on warfare, revered by strategists as a classic.\nThirteen chapters discuss military affairs, summarizing war experience,\nwith profound influence on later generations' strategies.

雪球教战守则=Snowball Combat Manual
作者叶云裳，字迹很娟秀，笔锋有些稚趣，就像她的人一般。这书写了她的雪仗技巧，煞有其事分了《正攻》、《奇袭》两篇，此书中的招数，多数是她想象出来的。包含了在雪球里藏石头、毛虫或者雪球塞裤管等等无所不用其极的残忍伎俩。=Author: Ye Yunshang. Her handwriting is elegant yet playful, much like herself.\nThe book details her snowball fight techniques, solemnly divided into《Direct Attack》and《Surprise Raid》sections—most moves are imagined.\nIt includes ruthless tricks like hiding stones or caterpillars in snowballs, or stuffing them into trouser legs.

十八种奇兵锻法杂记=Eighteen Unique Weapons Forging Notes
崆峒铁拳门当代掌门雷谦所书的杂记。他自知资质愚钝，唯恐先代巧艺失佚，虽无能开创新局，却发偌大宏愿，将诸般奇兵铸法整汇于此书之中。这是一部写给凡人的书。=Notes by Kongtong Iron Fist Gate's current Sect Leader Lei Qian.\nKnowing his own dull aptitude, he feared losing ancestral crafts. Though unable to innovate,\nhe vowed to compile various exotic weapon forging methods in this book.\nIt is a book for ordinary people.

江湖鬼蜮录=Jianghu Realm of Ghosts Record
记载了种种江湖伎俩的醒世录，撰书人本意是提醒无辜百姓，莫受人欺，须知人心隔肚皮，害人之心不可有，防人之心亦不可无。奈何此书落到坏人手里，登时就变成诈骗宝典，怎么带劲怎么来。=A wake-up call recording various Jianghu tricks. The author intended to warn innocent people against deception:\n"Guard against others' hearts, though harm none yourself".\nBut in a villains' hands, it instantly becomes a bible of scams; exploited to the extreme.

江湖鬼蜮录．续=Jianghu Realm of Ghosts Record: Continuation
江湖鬼域录不具名受害者以口代手，咬笔所写的陈情录。书中陈述他如何从一个天真无邪、四肢健全的孩童，被诈骗得家破人亡，流落异乡，自食其力却又被人构陷盗窃，获罪入狱，斩去双臂。最终他逃出生天，以狱中苦练的核枣钉报仇雪恨。=An anonymous victim's plea, written by mouth holding a pen.\nIt recounts how a naive, whole-bodied child was scammed into losing family and home, exiled, self-reliant yet framed for theft, imprisoned, and arms severed.\nHe eventually escaped, avenging himself with Jujube-Pit Darts honed in prison.

战神语录=War God Quotations
儒家战神孟子周游列国之时舌战群雄、以唇枪舌剑嘴诛口伐，平定中原的语录。来源不可考，不过在乡野传说中，象棋里的「炮」指的其实就是孟子的嘴，可以隔空杀人，而且恐怖之处在于方位拿准了，谁都杀得了。无论对方地位如何尊崇、请教的态度如何谦恭，都会惨被孟子教训，他甚至在吵架时甚至用上了孙子兵法和内功，让人被骂时都回不了嘴，被活活骂死都不奇怪。骂遍诸子百家，却不许旁人非议他，怒驳：「予岂好辩哉！？予不得已也！！」乃成千古绝响。=Quotations from Confucian War God Mencius, who debated heroes during his travels, pacifying Central Plains with verbal battles. Source unknown, but folklore claims the「cannon」in Chinese Chess(The game of Go) represents Mencius' mouth—killing remotely, terrifyingly accurate.\nRegardless of status or humility, all were lectured harshly. He even used Art of War and internal energy in arguments, leaving no retort—victims might be cursed to death.\nHe criticized all schools but brooked no dissent, roaring:「Do I love debate? I have no choice!!"; an eternal echo.

南宫风流扇=Nangong Elegant Fan
名闻天下的南宫家学，莫看纸扇摇摇，一派儒雅若不经风，实则非同小可。扇法攻防一体，扇柄能打穴，扇面翩飞更藏后手，实为虚，虚为实，内力强者光凭搧风即可憾人，脱手飞旋来去，更是难防难闪。难得的是深有儒风，不骄不馁，谦逊致和。=The Nangong Family technique renowned under heaven. Though the fan seems elegant and frail, it is formidable.\nIt combines offense and defense: the handle strikes acupoints, the fluttering fan hides follow-ups, real feints, feints real. With strong internal energy, even fanning wind can shake foes; thrown, it spins unpredictably. Remarkably Confucian—humble and harmonious.

崆峒玄兵锻法=Kongtong Mystic Weapon Forging Method
记载了崆峒四门秘传奇兵的锻造方法，其中颇有机巧之术，鬼斧神工。子母鸳鸯钺、机关锯、钩绳飞爪均有所载。你虽不使这些兵器，但造出来琢磨研究，精进自身技艺却是可以。=Documents forging methods for Kongtong's four sects' secret weapons—full of ingenious, divine craftsmanship.\nCovers mother-child mandarin duck hooks, mechanical saws, hook ropes, and flying claws.\nThough you don't use these, crafting them for study can advance your skills.

南宫武备论=Nangong Treatise on Military Preparation
南宫高祖，武林盟主南宫智的手书抄本。笔力雄健，一撇一捺宛若横扫千军，常为南宫族人习帖练字所临摹。虽不记载武功，却杂记了南宫智生平所悟，有兵法、学问、医术、心路历程、当代流行穿搭、笑话。其实这书还满好看的。=A handwritten copy by Nangong ancestor and Alliance Leader Nangong Zhi.\nHis brushstrokes are powerful—each sweep like routing armies—often copied by Nangong members for calligraphy practice.\nThough not martial, it mixes his life insights: strategy, scholarship, medicine, personal journeys, fashion, and jokes.\nQuite an enjoyable read.

火炎山锻谱=Flame Mountain Forging Manual
不仅是火炎山剑阁各式兵器、铁器的型录，也涵盖了秘而不宣的锻冶奥秘。书中记录了不同金属与合金的特性、配方，利用火炎山地热进行退火、淬火和回火等工艺。与你所熟知的唐门锻法相较，更为正宗严谨。=Not just a catalog of Flame Mountain Sword Pavilion's weapons and ironware, but also secret forging mysteries.\nIt records properties and formulas of metals and alloys, using geothermal heat for annealing, quenching, and tempering.\nCompared to Tang Sect methods, it is more orthodox and rigorous.

当世词选=Contemporary Ci Poetry Anthology
一本很新的书，几经波折才流转到你手里。前半篇收录了近代词家的名词佳句，包含晏殊、范仲淹、欧阳修、柳永、三苏等才子的杰作。后半篇则收录了当世文人的作品，最末数页被人刻意抹黑破坏，已不可读，隐约可见作者姓魏。=A very new book, reaching you after many twists.\nThe first half collects famous lines from recent ci poets: Yan Shu, Fan Zhongyan, Ouyang Xiu, Liu Yong, the Three Sus, etc.\nThe latter half features contemporary works, but the last pages are deliberately blackened and unreadable—faintly revealing an author surnamed Wei.

温阳活血符=Warm Yang Activate Blood Talisman
泥教天道的魔教心法。一部由医书演变出来的养生气功，以中医「温法」为基础，用有温、辛性质的药物艾炙穴道，驱散寒气，亦能补气养血，十分灵验，有回阳就逆之效。=A demonic sect Heart Method from the Mud Cult's Heavenly Path.\nEvolved from medical texts, this wellness Qigong is based on Traditional Chinese Medicine's「Warming methods」; using warm/pungent herbs and moxibustion on acupoints to dispel cold, replenish qi and blood. Highly effective, it can revive yang and reverse decline.

备急千金要方=Essential Formulas for Emergencies [Worth a Thousand Gold]
药王孙思邈所著，验方经方俱备的医学巨著。此书基于《黄帝内经》脏腑学说，搜罗医论、医方、用药、针灸，共有二百三十门，药方五千三百首。开卷《大医精诚》一文，首论医德，仁怀天下，影响后世深远。=By Medicine King Sun Simiao, a monumental medical work containing empirical and classical formulas.\nBased on《Yellow Emperor's Inner Classic》organ theory, it compiles medical theories, prescriptions, herb usage, and acupuncture, 230 categories, 5,300 formulas.\nThe opening essay《Great Physician's Sincerity》first discusses medical ethics and compassion, profoundly influencing the world and future generations.

伤寒杂病论=Treatise on Cold Damage and Miscellaneous Diseases
东汉医国手张仲景所著，是汉医学经典。原典因战火辗转而失佚，此书是后人集《伤寒论》与《金匮要略》所编撰而成。此书博采众方，创设六经辨证，被后世誉为「方书之祖」。=Written by Zhang Zhongjing, a master of medicine in the Eastern Han Dynasty, it is a classic of Han medicine. The original was lost due to war; this version was later compiled from《Treatise on Cold Damage》and《Essential Prescriptions of the Golden Cabinet》.\nIt collects numerous formulas, establishing the six-meridian pattern identification system, and is hailed as the「Origin of Formula Books」.

东汉医国手张仲景所著，是汉医学经典。原典因战火辗转而失佚，此书是后人集《伤寒论》与《金匮要略》所编撰而成。=Written by Zhang Zhongjing, a master of medicine in the Eastern Han Dynasty, it is a classic of Han medicine. The original was lost due to war; this version was later compiled from《Treatise on Cold Damage》and《Essential Prescriptions of the Golden Cabinet》.

唐门药典=Tang Sect Pharmacopoeia
唐门祖传医书，当世唯一以毒用药的医书。揉合苗疆、佛家学说，观一碗水有八万四千虫，虫即为毒，亦分五行六合，对应五脏六腑，多则害，少则病，尽则虚，错则狂。人非不害于五毒，实乃毒性未发而已，唯得用药养之，使其顺心不逆，躯毒为己用，则百病难侵。=The Tang Sect's ancestral medical text—the only text using poisons as medicine. It blends Miaojiang and Buddhist theories: "A bowl of water holds 84,000 insects" (insects as poisons), classified into the five elements and six combinations, corresponding to the five internal organs. Excess harms, deficiency causes illness, exhaustion leads to weakness, imbalance to madness.\nHumans are not immune to poisons—they simply lie dormant. Only by nurturing with medicine, guiding them to obey rather than rebel, and harnessing poisons for oneself can all diseases be repelled.

宋词选集=Song Ci Poetry Anthology
魏菊精选的当代杰出文人词集，节录宋词一百阙，平理若衡，照辞如镜。所录未必皆是名家手笔，但必为杰作。此书是魏菊手抄，字迹娟秀，有如美女簪花，又似鸾飘凤泊，郁郁不能得志，但凡文人雅士，见此册无不欣喜若狂，唯独赠了你这江湖中人。她谨守誓约，却藏了一点私心，以「佚名」身份，私心收录了自己旧时著作。=Curated by Wei Ju, this anthology features 100 outstanding Song ci poems by contemporary literati—balanced in reasoning, mirror-like in diction.\nNot all are by famous masters, but all are masterpieces.\nHand-copied by Wei Ju, her handwriting is elegant—like a beauty adorning flowers or a phoenix alighting—yet tinged with unfulfilled ambition. Any scholar would cherish it, but she gifted it to you, a Jianghu outsider.\nShe kept her vow but hid selfishness: anonymously including her own past works.

太平圣惠方=Taiping Holy Benevolence Formulas
翰林医官奉太宗皇帝诏令所编纂的医书。包括诊法、处方用药、五脏诸病、内、外、妇、儿、服食、丹药、外益、针炙等内容。原典足有一百册，你所得者仅为纲目，因为二师兄认为略去的内容是常识，你应该要知道。=Compiled by imperial physicians under Emperor Taizong's decree.\nCovers diagnostics, prescriptions, organ diseases, internal/external medicine, gynecology, pediatrics, dietetics, alchemy, external therapies, and acupuncture.\nThe original had 100 volumes; you only have the outline—Second Senior Brother deemed the omitted content common knowledge you should know.

难经=Classic of Difficulties
全名为《黄帝八十一难经》，乃著名医学著作，旨为阐发《黄帝内经》的疑难与要旨。传为名医扁鹊所著，强调「五邪相干」、「十变」理论，解释五脏生克关系，论脉学、经络、脏腑乃至针法的论述，对后世医学影响深远。=Full title:《Yellow Emperor's Eighty-One Difficulties》, a famous medical work explicating puzzles and essentials of《Yellow Emperor's Inner Classic》.\nAttributed to physician Bian Que, it emphasizes「Five Evils Interaction」and「Ten Changes」theories, explaining organ generation-restraint relationships.\nIts discussions on pulse studies, meridians, organs, and acupuncture deeply influenced later medicine.

折纸集=Paper-Folding Collection
收录了古今流行的折纸方案，纸盒、纸船、纸蛙、纸鹤、纸鱼、纸花、纸剑到纸登云梯。画工细腻，解说清晰，有了这本书，谁都能够成为折纸战士。=Collects popular paper-folding designs across ages: boxes, boats, frogs, cranes, fish, flowers, swords, and even cloud-ladders.\nWith delicate illustrations and clear instructions, anyone can become a paper-folding warrior with this book.

九转残篇=Nine Revolutions Fragment
记载了极乐教镇教三宝之一《九转轮回大法》的秘籍残篇。此册仅为上半卷，旨在讲述心法，而运功法门并不完全。=A fragmentary manual documenting the《Nine Revolutions of Samsara Great Method》, one of the Blissful Sect's three treasures.\nThis is only the first half, focusing on the Heart Method, the energy application techniques are incomplete.

证类本草=Classified Materia Medica
宋代重要医书，记载了多种本草植物的图录。=An important medical text from the Song Dynasty, containing illustrated records of various medicinal plants.

太祖长拳=Taizu Long Fist
因宋太祖赵匡胤而得名，讲究实战攻防，套路严谨，脚步灵活。囚身似猫，抖身如虎，行似尤龙，动如闪电。虽然冠以太祖之名，但其实是嵩山拳法。=Named after Emperor Taizu of Song Dynasty, Zhao Kuangyin, it emphasizes practical offense and defense, with rigorous routines and agile footwork.\nThe body crouches like a cat, trembles like a tiger, moves like a wandering dragon, and strikes like lightning.\nThough it bears the name "Taizu", it is actually a Fist and Palm style of the Songshan tradition.

嵩山寺中僧人禅修苦行，需得戒断三不善根，贪、嗔、痴是世间一切烦恼的根本，烦恼会驱使人造下种种恶业。若要得解脱，须了知五蕴，远离颠倒梦想，方能究竟涅盘。然而大道在此，世上又有几人能够办到？这时，苦恼拳就是一个良善的治标方案，透过练拳挥洒汗水，累瘫了，自然就没力气胡思乱想了。=The monks at the Songshan Temple practice ascetic meditation and must sever the three unwholesome roots, greed, hatred, and delusion, which are the fundamental sources of all worldly afflictions. These afflictions drive people to commit all kinds of unwholesome deeds.\nTo attain liberation, one must fully understand the five aggregates and transcend inverted perceptions and dreams, only then can one achieve ultimate Nirvana.\nYet, though the path is clear, how many in this world can truly accomplish it? \nAt such times, the Troubled Fist serves as a wholesome temporary remedy. Through practicing the fist, sweating it out, and exhausting the body, one naturally loses the energy to entertain restless thoughts.

《道德经》云：「天地不仁，以万物为刍狗。」\n揍狗拳指称的狗，并非真狗，而是世间所有敌人。无论是谁都一视同仁，将他当狗毒打。区区狗仔，何足惧哉？只要认定自己会赢，气势压过对方，那怕是狼、是虎也得在你面前夹着尾巴逃跑。=《Dao De Jing》 says:「Heaven and Earth are ruthless, and treat the myriad creatures as stray dogs.」\nThe Dog Beating Fist does not refer to actual dogs, but to all enemies in the world. It treats everyone equally, beating them down like dogs. What is there to fear from mere curs? As long as you believe you will win and overpower them with your presence, even wolves or tigers will tuck their tails and flee before you.

唐门小剑=Tang Sect Small Sword
唐门弟子人手一柄的标准配备。外型看似与脱手标相去不远，实则是柄机关剑，剑身中空，内有钢球。若非习练暗器总纲，等闲难以驾驭。=A standard weapon issued to every Tang Sect disciple.\nIts appearance is not far from that of a throwing dart,\nbut it is actually a mechanical sword,\nwith a hollow blade containing steel balls inside.\nWithout mastering the *Hidden Weapons Compendium*, it is difficult for an ordinary person to wield effectively.

唐门菁英小剑=Tang Sect Elite Small Sword
根据图谱改良的新型武器，取消钢球设计，将刃身打造得极薄，平时收纳起来，临阵时以软鞭手法打出，出其不意，这也是一种暗器。=An improved weapon based on blueprints—\nno steel ball, with an ultra-thin blade.\nStored normally, it is deployed in battle with soft-whip techniques,\nstriking unpredictably; another form of hidden weapon.

切鱼刀=Fish-Cleaving Knife
造型奇特、却极其锋利的东洋杀鱼刀。=An oddly shaped yet extremely sharp Japanese fish-cleaving blade.

金钱剑=Coin Sword
道士驱邪用的法器，没人会拿来与人搏斗，除了你。倒持的时候，是一柄出人意料的凶残钝器。=A Daoist ritual tool for exorcism—\nno one would use it in combat except you.\nReversed, it becomes a surprisingly brutal blunt weapon.

唐门传承小剑=Tang Sect Heritage Small Sword
唐门承传至今的古老小剑，以现今弃用的方法铸造。将剑中钢球灌注水银，使重心无时不刻变动，须以内力制驭。如果能够熟练使用，可谓其变无穷。=An ancient small sword passed down in the Tang Sect,\nforged by obsolete methods.\nA steel ball filled with mercury shifts its center of gravity constantly,\nrequiring internal energy to control.\nMastery allows infinite variations.

玉霄神匕=Jade Sky Divine Dagger
小梅爱用的匕首，乃是铁拳前掌门手把手带着小竹，为小梅打造的兵器。玉霄神是对梅花高洁品行的至高赞赏。=Xiaomei's beloved dagger,\ncrafted by the former Iron Fist Leader guiding Xiao Zhu's hands.\n"Jade Sky Divine" is the highest praise for the plum blossom's noble character.

沥泉小剑=Liquan Small Sword
岳王爷生前爱用的名枪，浇过英雄碧血，可昭浩然正气，破虏光复河山。天命会指引它，来到下一个英雄手中。=A famed spear beloved by Lord Yue in life,\ntempered with hero's blood—\nit embodies righteous energy,\ncapable of crushing invaders and restoring lands.\nDestiny will guide it to the next Hero.

唐门祖师剑=Tang Sect Ancestral Sword
按造失传图谱重铸的祖师短剑，此剑是唐门小剑的祖宗，形无虚实，势无刚柔，执在掌中似剑而非剑，脱手可飞旋来去。江湖讹传御剑仙术之说，便是由此而生。=A reforged Ancestral short sword based on lost blueprints—\nthe ancestor of Tang small swords.\nForm without solidity, force without hardness—\nin hand it seems a sword yet not,\nwhen released, it flies and spins.\nJianghu rumors of Sword Immortals stem from this.

脱手镖=Throwing Dart
江湖中人最常用的暗器，唐门弟子使飞镖时，常往镖身涂毒，纵使一镖射不死人，也可制伏敌人。=The most common hidden weapon in Jianghu.\nTang disciples often poison their darts; even if it's not lethal,\nthey can subdue foes.

铁橄榄=Iron Olive
形似橄榄的暗器，又称核子钉、枣核箭，通常以手投掷伤人，亦有高手可以含入口中，以内力呵气发射。=An olive-shaped hidden weapon,\nalso called the Nucleus Nail or the Date Pit Arrow.\nUsually thrown by hand, but masters can hold it in the mouth\nand launch it with internal energy.

飞梭=Flying Shuttle
打造得极为扁薄的银梭，唐门打造的飞梭尤其细小，不以杀伤力为目标，而是淬以毒药，威胁性丝毫不逊于利刃。=An extremely thin silver shuttle.\nTang-made shuttles are especially tiny—\nnot meant for raw damage but poison damage,\nmaking them as threatening as blades.

袖里箭=Sleeve Arrow
藏在护腕里，掀动机关发射的暗器，为了掩饰护腕秘密，唐门中人使用袖箭时还是会假作挥掷姿势。=Hidden in a bracer, launched by a mechanism.\nTo conceal the bracer's secret,\nTang users still mimic throwing motions.

飞煌石=Flying Glow Stone

无形箭=Invisible Arrow
无影无形，无声无兆，乍见锋芒，人已封喉。是唐门暗器总纲之中的终极暗器，真面目是近乎完全透明的琉璃玉镖，造价极其昂贵，其威力亦冠绝天下。=Shadowless, formless, soundless, and traceless.\nA glimpse of its gleam, and the throat is sealed.\nThe ultimate hidden weapon in the Tang Sect's Hidden Weapons Compendium.\nIts true form is a nearly transparent glass jade dart,\nextremely costly to produce, yet its power stands unrivaled under heaven.

鞭炮=Firecracker

神奇球=Magic Ball

流星箭=Meteor Arrow

雷火弹=Thunderfire Pellet
硫磺、焰硝、麻茹、黄蜡、松脂……等诸多种材料揉成的黑色药粉，一旦触地摩擦，就会瞬间引爆，威力强大，绝非闹着玩的。=Black powder blended from sulfur, saltpeter, hemp, yellow wax, pine resin, etc.\nExplodes instantly upon impact or friction.\nThese are very powerful and no joke.

似草针=Grass-Like Needles
锻造成草状，涂成绿色的毒针，置于地面，使人难以辨识，惊觉的时候，往往便已着了道。此陷阱在我方近战弟子阵亡时原地安装。=A poison needle forged to resemble grass and painted green.\nPlaced on the ground, it is hard to detect—\noften noticed only after triggering.\nThis trap is deployed where our melee disciples fall.

地鸣雷=Earth-Rumbling Mine
以机关制造的小型机雷，中有雷火弹，置于地面，一旦踩中，便会爆炸。此陷阱在我方弟子阵亡时原地安装。=A small mine crafted with mechanisms,\ncontaining a thunderfire pellet. Placed on the ground,\nit explodes when stepped on.\nThis trap is deployed where our disciples fall in battle.

赤炼砂=Red Refined Sand

乌水仙=Black Daffodil

三阴虫草胶=Triple Yin Insect Grass Glue

彼岸仙香=Other Shore Immortal Incense
唐门一位医毒双绝的女前辈所研发的毒香，此香对常人有剧毒，却对身具胡椒粉的唐门中人有补益效果，甚是神妙，正心堂里所焚即为此香。=A toxic incense developed by a female Elder of the Tang Sect skilled in both medicine and poison.\nDeadly to ordinary people,\nbut it benefits members of the Tang Sect who have built their immunity with Pepper Powder Pills—\nhighly mystical. 穿心龙胆汤=Piercing Heart Gentian Decoction

胡椒粉丸=Pepper Powder Pill

唐门药典残方，出门必备灵药。气味清凉，嗅之可提神醒脑，夏可解暑、冬可点燃取暖，兑水喝可以治腹泻，抹在腕上可防蛇虺蚊蚋。天下疑难，此方解得十之八九。=A remnant formula from the Tang Sect pharmacopoeia, essential for travel.\nCooling scent refreshes the mind, relieves heat in summer, burned for warmth in winter, diluted in water to treat diarrhea, applied on wrists to repel snakes and mosquitoes.\nIt solves ninety percent of all troublesome ailemnts under heaven.

唐门制服=Tang Sect uniform
唐门弟子的旧款制服，含护腕，但可动性很差，大家都不爱戴。制服里刻意缝了沙包，令弟子习惯负重，以此锻炼体魄。=The old-style uniform of the Tang Sect disciples, includes wrist guards but with very poor mobility,\nwhich is why no one likes to wear them.\nThe uniform intentionally has sandbags sewn into it to accustom disciples to carrying weight,\nthereby building their physical strength.

Heart-Protecting Mirror
往制服内里缝进铜镜，保护心脏要害，进一步变重了，与此同时，防护的效果也大幅上升了。=Sewing a bronze mirror into the inner lining of the uniform,\nprotects the vital area of the heart, making it even heavier,\nbut at the same time, the defensive effectiveness is greatly enhanced.

Lightweight
舍弃了沙包这等不人道设计的新型制服，大伙儿的步伐顿时轻快了许多，但是防御性能也趋近没有了。=The new uniform, which abandoned inhumane designs like sandbags,\nhas made everyone's steps much lighter,\nbut it's defensive capabilities was also almost gone.

嘴攻：出口伤人的控制手段，可挫敌锐气，降低绝招伤害，使人投鼠忌器不敢轻举妄动，有时会激怒对方。=Trash Talk:\nA control method using hurtful words. Can blunt enemy morale, reduce Ultimate damage,\nmake them hesitate to act rashly, and sometimes enrage them.
捅人：使用兵刃造成伤害，可强行压制嘴攻行动。根据性情，有时会因为把人捅出了血来，导致自己陷入恐慌。=Stab:\nUse a weapon to deal damage. Can forcefully suppress Trash Talk actions.\nDepending on temperament, may sometimes cause panic in oneself upon drawing blood.
暗器：唐门拿手绝活，投掷暗器造成伤害，累积异常状态，可中断嘴攻、捅人行动。=Hidden Weapon:\nA Tang Sect specialty. Throw hidden weapons to deal damage,\naccumulate status ailments, and interrupt Trash Talk or Stab actions.
绝招：消耗大量的气力，造成强大的伤害。<color=#FF0000>可中断捅人、暗器行动</color>=Ultimate:\nConsumes a large amount of Qi to deal powerful damage.\n<color=#FF0000>Can interrupt Stab and Hidden Weapon actions</color>

////-------------Character Intro////-------------

名唤布衣，掌门座下第一大弟子。天资聪颖，爽朗不羁，江湖人称「飞侠」，暗器、轻功造诣俱臻当世第一流境界。=His name is Buyi, the first and foremost disciple under the Sect Leader.\nEndowed with brilliant natural talent, forthright and uninhibited, he is known in the martial world as the「The Flying Hero」. His mastery of hidden weapons and Qinggong has reached the pinnacle, ranking among the top-tier in the contemporary era.

唐门掌门座下第一大弟子。武林中声望最高的年轻侠客之一，为人放荡不羁，爽朗豪迈，不拘小节。曾经听闻不平事，下山越省杀贪官，开仓济民，事了拂衣而去；亦曾慕美人芳名，不远千里争见，片面之缘后，又消失无踪，徒惹薄幸名声。来去如风，江湖人称之飞侠。对于唐门区分内外弟子的陋习嗤之以鼻，经常怂恿外姓师弟们一块偷懒玩耍，非常擅长惹师父生气。=The first and foremost disciple under Sect Leader Tang.\nOne of the most prestigious young heroes in the martial world,\nHe is unrestrained, forthright, bold, and unconstrained by trivialities.\nHaving once heard of an injustice, he went down the mountain and crossed provinces to kill a corrupt official,\nOpened the granary to aid the people, and when the matter was done, he brushed his robes and departed;\nHe also once, admiring a beauty's reputation, traveled a thousand miles without hesitation to compete for a glance,\nAfter a brief encounter, he vanished without a trace, earning only a reputation for fickleness.\nComing and going like the wind, the martial world calls him The Flying Hero.\nHe scorns the Tang Sect's outdated practice of distinguishing between inner and outer disciples,\nOften egging on his junior fellows with different surnames to be lazy and play together,\nExceptionally skilled at angering his Master.

经常出入花月楼，大把银子如流水般撒将出去，被花月楼的姑娘戏称为楼主，连老鸨也爱煞了他。侠名远播，同时恶名昭彰。江湖人都怕了这位少年英雄，偏生又没名分治他，只得把自家妻女看管得严严实实的，就怕这人会偷心。对于小师妹向来是当成亲生妹妹一般疼爱，没别的想法。=Frequently visits the Flower Moon Pavilion, spending vast amounts of silver like flowing water, and is playfully called "Pavilion Master" by the courtesans there; even the madam adores him immensely.\nHis heroic reputation is widespread, yet his notoriety is equally infamous.\nThe martial world fears this Young Hero, but having no rightful means to restrain him, they can only keep their wives and daughters closely guarded, fearing he might steal their hearts.\nHe has always treated his junior female sect-sister as a beloved blood sister,\nWith no other intentions whatsoever.

看似逍遥，万事不萦挂于怀的飒爽模样，其实本性十分叛逆固执。少时曾千方百计逃出唐门，逃回家中，父母无可奈何，方始告知他身世，指点他去见亲生母亲。他在花月楼，见到了身染梅毒，已经神智不清的生母，从旁人那里得知，母亲是散尽了积蓄，才托人收养他，为他洗白身世，再送入唐门拜师。图的便是不让爱子似自己这般，一生由人摆布，受人轻贱。那一日后，唐布衣洗心革面，决心为天下女子撑腰。=He appears carefree and unfettered, with a dashing demeanor untouched by worldly concerns, yet his nature is profoundly rebellious and stubborn.\nIn his youth, he once tried every means to escape the Tang Sect and return home. His adoptive parents, left with no alternative, finally revealed his origins and directed him to meet his birth mother.\nAt the Flower Moon Pavilion, he encountered his birth mother, who was suffering from syphilis and had already lost her sanity. From others, he learned that she had exhausted all her savings to arrange for his adoption, cleanse his background, and secure his entry into the Tang Sect as a disciple.\nHer aim was to prevent her beloved son from ending up like herself—a life controlled by others and looked down upon.\nFrom that day on, Tang Buyi turned over a new leaf, determined to stand up for all women under heaven.

单名一字铮，唐门掌门座下第二弟子。善使毒药，于药毒之术的钻研尤胜业师，心思缜密，孤僻深沉，鲜少下山走动，故而名声远不及师兄，向有「辣手相公」、「辣手公子」之称，人人敬而远之。=His name is Zheng, the second disciple under Sect Leader Tang.\nHe excels in using poisons, and his mastery of pharmaceutical and toxic arts surpasses even his own teacher's. Meticulous in thought, solitary and deep-natured, he rarely ventures down the mountain. Thus, his reputation is far less prominent than his senior brother's. He has been called「Ruthless Gentleman」and「Ruthless Young Master」, and everyone keeps a respectful distance from him.

唐门掌门座下第二弟子。善使毒药，毒学造诣尤胜乃师。为人心思缜密，孤僻深沉，律人律己皆严，受师命司掌戒律，深为同门所忌惮。平素等闲不出炼丹房，鲜少涉足江湖，故而名声远不及师兄，但与之交手过的对头思及其人，尽皆不寒而栗。对于胡椒粉似乎有着异常的执着，非但自己喜欢，还会强迫大家一起吃。=The second disciple under the Sect Leader Tang.\nHe excels in using poisons, and his mastery of toxicology surpasses even his own teacher.\nAs a person, he is meticulous in thought, solitary and deep-natured,\nstrict with both others and himself, tasked by his Master with enforcing discipline,\nand is deeply feared by his sect brothers.\nHe ordinarily seldom leaves the alchemy room and rarely involves himself in Jianghu affairs,\nhence his reputation is far less prominent than his senior brother's.\nHowever, opponents who have crossed him shudder at the mere thought of him.\nHe seems to have an unusual obsession with pepper powder,\nnot only enjoying it himself but also forcing everyone else to eat it.

其真实身份是来自泥教人间道的卧底。受命于魔教，自小拜入唐门，以策应泥教。博得掌门信任，获传「胡椒粉」秘方，本应以此挟制唐门弟子，供泥教驱策，却因掌门废止门人以胡椒粉毒练功的习俗而未能成逞。=His true identity is that of a spy sent from the Human Realm Path of the Mud Sect.\nUnder orders from the Demon Cult, he joined the Tang Sect in his youth to serve as an inside agent for the Mud Sect.\nHe gained the Sect Leader's trust and was bestowed the secret formula for「Pepper Powder Poison」,\nwith which he was supposed to control the Tang Sect disciples and make them serve the Mud Sect's purposes.\nHowever, this plan was thwarted when the Sect Leader abolished the sect's tradition of using pepper powder for poison-training exercises.

比起幼时诀别的亲生父亲，更敬爱师父唐中翎。比起泥教，唐门更像是家。他未曾忘却使命，心念却早不在此，对泥教特使阳奉阴违，想方设法守护唐门。为掌门的旧患翻遍古今典籍，对大师兄得掌门偏爱深感忌妒。和小师妹默铃是同母的兄妹关系，即使说话刻薄，却十分宠溺这个异父妹妹。=He holds more reverence and love for his Master, Tang Zhongling, than for his biological father from whom he parted in childhood.\nTo him, the Tang Sect feels more like home than the Mud Sect ever did.\nThough he never forgot his mission, his heart was no longer in it; he paid lip service to the Mud Sect's emissaries while secretly working to protect the Tang Sect.\nHe scoured ancient and modern texts to find a cure for his Master's old ailment, and deeply envied First Senior Brother who received the Master's favor.\nHe shares a maternal sibling relationship with Little Junior Sister Moling, and though his words to her are sharp, he is exceedingly indulgent toward this half-sister.

单名一字升，唐门掌门第三亲传弟子。带艺投师，因此年纪较二位师兄为长，从前是志向远大的读书人，只因开罪权贵，远避江湖。兴趣是说书，教化英才，笑谈天下事。=His name is Sheng, the third personal disciple of Sect Leader Tang.\nHe joined the sect already possessing martial skills, making him older than his two senior brothers. Formerly an ambitious scholar, he was forced to flee into the Jianghu after offending powerful officials. His passions are storytelling, educating talented individuals, and humorously discussing all affairs under heaven.

唐门掌门第三位亲传弟子。少时满腔热血，寒窗苦读十数载，立誓考取功名，将才学见识用以造福社稷。岂料却因开罪权贵而致名落孙山，引来杀身之祸。万幸者是，他曾与犹未接任掌门的唐中翎有过同一个亭下避雨的缘分。危难之中，为唐中翎所救，鬼门关前走一遭，万念俱灰，遂绝了报效朝廷的念头，拜入唐门。兴趣是说书，闲来笑谈江湖事，不问生杀，自也豁达。=The third personal disciple of Sect Leader Tang.\nIn his youth, filled with passion, he studied diligently for over a decade by cold window light,\nvowing to attain an official rank and use his talents and knowledge to benefit the state.\nUnexpectedly, after offending powerful nobles, he failed the imperial exams and incurred a death warrant.\nFortunately, he had once shared shelter from the rain under a pavilion with Tang Zhongling, who had not yet become Sect Leader.\nRescued by Tang Zhongling during this crisis,\nhe brushed with death and, disillusioned with all worldly ambitions, abandoned his desire to serve the court and joined the Tang Sect.\nHis passion is storytelling, casually amusing others with tales of Jianghu affairs;\nhe stays clear of lethal conflicts and maintains a carefree openness.

那一年的大雨凉亭中，与唐中翎相逢忘机，畅谈天下事，好不快哉。一个寒窗穷书生，一个落拓江湖人。一文一武，纵然见地相左，也互生了敬重之意。纵然拜入唐门习武，二人相处却更似忘年知己，经常一块品茶话春秋。大师兄、二师兄都在他眼皮子底下长大，虽然位份高，却从来不敢以兄长自居。只可惜起步习武太晚，要与天下英雄争高低，终究是迟了。话虽如此，他天性也不爱逞强斗狠便是，孙子兵法有云，上兵伐谋。不打架的才是赢家。=In that year's heavy rain, within the cool pavilion, he met Tang Zhongling in carefree joy, discussing worldly affairs with great delight.\nOne a poor scholar studying by cold window, one a free-spirited wanderer of the Jianghu.\nOne scholarly, one martial—though their viewpoints often differed,\nthey mutually developed deep respect for one another.\nEven after joining the Tang Sect to learn martial arts, their relationship remained more like that of ageless confidants, often sharing tea and discussing the affairs of the world.\nThe eldest and second senior brothers grew up under his watchful eyes;\nthough his rank is higher, he never dares to act as an elder brother figure.\nIt is only a pity that he started learning martial arts too late—to compete with all the heroes under heaven, he was ultimately behind.\nThat said, by nature he has never been one for fierce competition or violence.\nAs Sun Tzu's Art of War says: "The supreme art of war is to subdue the enemy without fighting".\nThe true victor is the one who avoids battle altogether.

他曾见过大宋的皇帝。「我有安国策、定邦略、养生方、破敌计，惟清君侧可以为之。」金榜题名，朝见天颜时如是敢谏，却得罪了随侍皇帝的当权者。由此，因莫须有罪名下狱，家乡老父母、发妻尽皆死于非命。狱中痛哭数十日，押送刑场时，却为唐中翎率二名少年弟子所劫。「乡亲父老都给我听着，此人乃是为了天下百姓安生，才受囹圄之灾，这才是天下第一等的大侠，给我牢牢记住了！」唐中翎如是道，那番话语深刻在心底，至今难忘。=He once met the Emperor of the Great Song Dynasty.\n「I have strategies to secure the state, plans to stabilize the realm, methods to nourish the people, and tactics to defeat enemies; all achievable by purging the corrupt officials around Your Majesty」.\nHaving earned top honors in the imperial exams, he dared to offer this bold counsel during his audience with the Emperor, but offended the powerful attendants beside the throne.\nThus, he was imprisoned on false charges, and his elderly parents and wife back home all met untimely deaths.\nAfter weeping for dozens of days in prison, as he was being transported to the execution ground, Tang Zhongling led two young disciples to rescue him.\n「Fellow villagers, hear me! This man suffered imprisonment for the sake of all common people under heaven, this is what a True Great Hero under heaven looks like. Remember this well!」 Tang Zhongling declared. Those words were carved deep into his heart and remain unforgettable to this day.

本名惟元，唐门掌门的关门弟子。被委以往返山下兜售药品、采购生活用品的任务，乐此不疲，经常钻门规的空子，夹带私货抬价卖给同门师兄弟赚取差价。=His original name is Weiyuan, the last inner-sect disciple of the Sect Leader Tang.\nEntrusted with the task of travelling down the mountain to sell medicine and purchase daily supplies, he delights in this duty. He often exploits loopholes in sect rules, smuggling in personal goods and selling them at inflated prices to his fellow disciples to profit from the price difference.

唐门掌门的关门弟子。身世不详，在采买上山的一箱水果中被发现，还在襁褓中就特别能吃。其为人表面上安分守己，笃信诚实，尤善卖乖，颇受掌门信赖，委以管帐重责。经常趁着采购柴米油盐等生活用品之际，收购各式珍奇物品，高价转售门内弟子，牟取私利。你若出得起钱，他自然会乐于帮你夹带私货。=The last inner-sect disciple of the Sect Leader Tang.\nHis origins are unknown; he was discovered in a crate of fruit purchased for the mountain, and even as an infant in swaddling clothes, he had a remarkable appetite.\nOutwardly, he appears well-behaved and law-abiding,\nfervently professing honesty, and excels at ingratiating himself,\nearning the deep trust of the Sect Leader, who entrusts him with the important responsibility of managing accounts.\nHe often takes advantage of purchasing daily necessities like firewood, rice, oil, and salt,\nto acquire various rare and exotic items,\nreselling them at high prices to disciples within the sect for personal profit.\nIf you can afford it, he will gladly help you smuggle in contraband.

经常走南闯北，作行脚商人。年纪虽轻，江湖阅历却十分丰富，消息灵通，人面极广。什么地方都去得到，什么东西都卖得了，有个不大好听的外号，叫『无孔不入』。他总会在关键时候，若无其事出现在按理说不应该出现的地方，兜售你需要的商品，极端可疑。=He often travels north and south, working as an itinerant merchant.\nThough young, his experience in the Jianghu is vast; he is well-informed and has extensive connections.\nThere is no place he cannot reach, nothing he cannot sell. He has a rather unflattering nickname:『Omnipresent』.\nHe always appears at critical moments, nonchalantly showing up in places where he logically shouldn't be, peddling exactly the goods you need—extremely suspicious.

四师兄虽赚了不少黑心钱，但也帮助了不少需要帮助的人。向即将赴死的勇士贩卖宝剑灵丹；向身怀血仇的少年贩卖秘籍；替人万里送家书。只要谈成买卖，便会善尽人事。虽说贪财，但对于贫困的人却不以为鄙，颇愿施以援手，说是投资，从不笑话你没有将来，他和每个人打交道，都假设你能长命百岁。包办没人愿作的走商使命，是为了尽可能结识更多的人，打响名声，寻找或许已不在世的亲人。=Although Fourth Senior Brother earned quite a bit of ill-gotten wealth, he also helped many people in need.\nHe sold treasured swords and divine elixirs to warriors about to face death; he sold secret manuals to youths carrying deep-seated vendettas; he delivered letters for others across thousands of miles.\nOnce a deal was struck, he would see his responsibilities through to the end.\nAlthough he is greedy for money, he does not look down upon the poor and is quite willing to lend a helping hand, calling it an investment. He never laughs anyone for having no future. In all his dealings, he assumed everyone would live a long and healthy life.\nHe took on all the merchant missions no one else wanted, all to meet as many people as possible, build his reputation, and search for a family member who might no longer be in this world.

四师兄知道了自己的生世，得知父母健在，家有兄弟姊妹十人，都在温饱环境下长大，既感妒忌，又觉不甘，可心头的大石始终放了下来。踌躇了好多年的怨言，见了有血缘关系的双亲，却说不出口，究竟是怎么回事，也说不清楚，总觉得那些人似乎不是可以撒娇的对象。最终他婉拒了亲生父母的慰留，回到了唐门。有大鱼大肉不吃，还是死皮赖脸跟师兄弟们抢粗茶淡饭。为人一样奸滑贪财，对掌门依然孝顺。四师兄也有他的家人，就在唐门。=The fourth senior brother learned about his own life and found out that his parents were still alive and that there were ten brothers and sisters in his family. They all grew up in a subsistence environment. He felt both envy and resentment, yet the heavy burden in his heart finally lifted.\nAfter harboring grievances for so many years, when he finally met his biological parents, he found he couldn't voice them. He couldn't quite explain why, only felt that these people didn't seem to be the kind he could act spoiled with.\nIn the end, he politely declined his birth parents' plea to stay and returned to the Tang Sect.\nEven if there is big fish and meat, he will not eat it, but he will remain shameless and fight for simple meals with his fellow martial brothers.\nHe remained just as cunning and greedy, yet as filial as ever to the Sect Leader.\nFourth Senior Brother also had his family; right here in the Tang Sect.

本名唐中翎，当任唐门掌门人。性情刚烈，嫉恶如仇，曾列名武林十大高手的传奇人物，可惜中年过后，身体已然大不如前，飞燕流星翎成为绝响。=His original name is Tang Zhongling, the current Leader of the Tang Sect.\nOf fiery temperament and intolerant of evil, he was once listed among the Jianghu's Top Ten Masters—a legendary figure. Unfortunately, after middle age, his health has declined significantly, and his famed technique, The Flying Swallow Meteor Feathers has become a lost art.

唐门第二十七代掌门。年轻时性情刚烈，嫉恶如仇。任侠四方，以独门绝招「飞燕流星翎」打遍天下未逢敌手。唐门威名远播，同时也得罪不少江湖好汉。直至与同门师妹结缡，接任掌门后方始内敛。操心门派经营十数年来，苍老了不少。近年因压力而患病，遂将俗务交由膝下第三弟子代为操持。=The 27th generation Leader of the Tang Sect.\nIn his youth, he was of fiery temperament and hated evil with a passion.\nRoaming the land as a Great Hero, he used his unique ultimate technique「Flying Swallow Meteor Feathers」\nto challenge everyone under heaven unrivaled.\nThe Tang Sect's fame spread far and wide, but this also earned him many enemies among Jianghu warriors.\nIt wasn't until he married his junior sect sister and assumed the role of Sect Leader that he began to become more reserved.\nAfter over a decade of worrying about sect management, he has aged significantly.\nIn recent years, he fell ill due to stress and has delegated mundane affairs to his third disciple to handle on his behalf.

曾率门人，参与过剿灭旧魔教的大战役。与嵩山寺方丈合斗极乐七仙，大破万仙阵，使极乐教主入主中原的野心受挫于秦州。巅峰对决中，任为正派五员代表之一，出战极乐教右护法，不惜吞服毒药强行催谷功力，终得险胜而诛此巨恶，却也因此落下了难以痊愈的病根。经此一役之后，唐门与嵩山俱元气大伤，然而嵩山依然为世人敬重，唐门却成了人人喊打的落水狗。=He once led his sect members in the great campaign to eradicate the former demon cult.\nJoining forces with the abbot of Songshan Temple, they battled the Seven Blissful Immortals and shattered the Ten Thousand Immortals Formation,\nthwarting the Blissful Sect Cult Leader's ambition to conquer the Central Plains at Qinzhou.\nIn the climactic duel, serving as one of the five righteous faction representatives, he faced the Blissful Cult's Right Emissary. Willing to ingest poison to forcibly boost his power, he narrowly achieved victory and eliminated this great evil, but consequently suffered lasting health damage that never fully healed.\nAfter this battle, both the Tang Sect and Songshan were severely weakened. Yet while Songshan continued to be revered by the world, the Tang Sect became a despised outcast that everyone condemned.

他救回了暗恋多年的师妹，却赎不回她的泪水。大错已经铸成，当事者一生都无法释怀。即令如此，他仍向师妹求亲，许诺她终生。婚后数年喜得明珠，爱妻却始终默默寡欢，饶他能够纵横江湖，却难以安定家室。最终妻子抑郁投崖，唐中翎的病也越发沉了。=He rescued the junior sister he had secretly loved for years, but could never redeem her tears.\nA grave mistake had been made, and those involved could never find peace in their lifetime.\nEven so, he still proposed to his junior sister, promising her a lifetime together.\nSeveral years into their marriage, they joyfully had a daughter, but his beloved wife remained silently sorrowful. Though he could dominate the Jianghu, he could not bring stability to his own household.\nIn the end, his wife succumbed to depression and leaped from a cliff, and Tang Zhongling's illness grew increasingly severe.

芳名默铃，掌门独生爱女，宛如森林小动物般的少女，性情淡漠，身系七串从来不响的铃铛。兴趣是折纸。=Her name is Moling, the Sect Leader's only beloved daughter. A young girl akin to a forest creature, she has an aloof temperament and always wears seven strings of bells that never ring.\nHer interest is paper folding.

唐门掌门独生爱女。掌门忧其身娇体弱，故闭关苦思三年，立基于独门武功，另辟蹊径，创制出「天地无声势」授予爱女。修练者必须全身系上七串铃铛，苦练至急奔纵跃、投掷暗器皆不激响的境界，方使大功告成。受此心诀影响，生性淡漠，不常表露感情，不喜言语，亦不苟言笑。兴趣是折纸。=The only beloved daughter of the Sect Leader Tang.\nWorried about her delicate health, the Leader secluded himself for three years of intense contemplation.\nBuilding upon the sect's unique martial arts, he pioneered a new path,\ncreating the「Heaven and Earth Silent Stance」especially for his daughter.\nTo Master this technique, the practitioner must wear seven strings of bells all over their body and train relentlessly until they can run, leap, and throw hidden weapons without making a single sound, at which point the mastery is complete. Influenced by this mental art, she has an aloof nature, rarely shows emotion, dislikes speech, and seldom smiles. Her interest is paper folding.

虽然练功不辍，但其实不喜欢练功。起初时常哭出来。练功很辛苦，又怕父亲责打，每当难过便逃奔母亲怀抱，否则便是求庇于大师兄、二师兄。母亲辞世以后，便不再逃跑了。不知不觉，已经练到出完一套拳收功，连一滴汗也不会流的地步。连眼泪也一并忘记该怎么流了。她将感情深锁在心底，谁也见不到她的真实面容。=Although she practiced her martial arts diligently, she never truly enjoyed it.\nIn the beginning, she often cried.\nThe training was arduous, and she feared her father's reprimands. Whenever she felt sad, she would flee to her mother's embrace, or else seek protection from her eldest or Second Senior Brother. After her mother passed away, she stopped running away.\nWithout realizing it, she had reached a level where she could complete an entire fist form and finish without shedding a single drop of sweat.\nShe even forgot how to shed tears along the way.\nShe locked her emotions deep within her heart, and no one could see her true face.

掌门师娘辞世前，曾哄骗女儿道：「我要下到唐门幽谷中闭关十年，若你想我了，便折一只纸鹤，送到谷底，我见了，便知道你在思念娘亲。」因此小师妹十年来一日不绝，每夜都会在窗边折纸鹤，写满对母亲的思念之情。她畏惧着人间，害怕认识的人一个接一个离开，每夜都怕得不能自已。=Before the Sect Leader's wife passed away, she deceived her daughter, saying:「I am going into seclusion for ten years deep in the Tang Sect's secluded valley. If you miss me, fold a paper crane and send it down to the valley floor. When I see it, I will know you are thinking of your mother」. Because of this, for ten years without a single day's interruption, Little Junior Sister would fold paper cranes by her window every night, filling them with her longing for her mother. She fears the mortal world, terrified that the people she knows will leave her one after another, and every night she is overcome with this fear.

唐门里姓唐的全是家人，只有你不姓唐，偏生又那么熟稔，不知该怎么归类。默铃变得非常的关注你。无时不刻想要靠近你，安静地在你附近待着。她纯真的眼里见不到皮相的美丑，只是单纯地贪恋着安心的感觉。对江湖事不太上心，连下山的路都认不清，却十分清楚自己倾慕着你。面无表情的少女像花一样绽放着，与你相偕的平凡岁月，每一天都无与伦比。=In the Tang Sect, those with the surname Tang are all family—only you, without the Tang name, are somehow so familiar that she doesn't know how to categorize you.\nMoling has become intensely focused on you.\nShe constantly wants to be near you, quietly staying in your presence.\nHer innocent eyes perceive no superficial beauty or ugliness; she simply craves the feeling of safety she finds with you.\nShe pays little mind to Jianghu affairs and can't even clearly remember the path down the mountain, yet she is utterly certain of her admiration for you.\nThe expressionless girl blooms like a flower, and every ordinary day spent with you feels incomparably precious.

最为江湖人津津乐道的武林传奇之一。在他的诸般传奇事迹之中，尤以决战极乐教主为最。其后旧魔教覆灭，而正邪两道最强高手亦销声匿迹，完结了一个时代。=One of the most celebrated legends in the Jianghu. Among his many legendary deeds, his climactic battle with the Blissful Sect Cult Leader stands above all. Following this, the old demon cult was eradicated, and the strongest masters of both the righteous and evil paths vanished from the world, bringing an era to its end.

身穿点苍派服饰的年轻剑客。好像在哪儿听过这个名字，不过你记不得了。不知为何要以斗笠掩藏面目，观其面目俊美，似乎也不像江洋大盗。=A young swordsman dressed in Diancang Sect attire.\nYou feel like you've heard this name somewhere before, but can't quite recall. It's unclear why he hides his face with a bamboo hat; his features are handsome, and he doesn't seem like a notorious outlaw.
点苍派第一快剑手，当今武林最负盛名的年轻侠客之一。称谓之来，是世人赞他有骨气，如松柏般苍劲有力，迎风而不曳。剑术才华出类拔萃，自十来岁拜入点苍山门以来，短短几年之间即阅遍点苍山松云阁中所藏一十七部剑谱。莫说同辈弟子望尘莫及，即便是其业师亦自叹弗如。=The number one swift swordsman of the Diancang Sect,\nand one of the most renowned young heroes in the current martial world.\nThis title comes from the people's praise of his integrity—like a pine tree, robust and unyielding even in the wind.\nHis talent in swordsmanship is exceptional. Since joining the Diancang Sect in his teens, he mastered all seventeen sword manuals stored in the Songyun Pavilion of Diancang Mountain within just a few years.\nNot only are his peers far behind him, but even his own Master admits he falls short compared to his disciple.

纵使身负绝艺，他为人处世始终兢兢业业，不骄不躁。从不轻易与人相斗，听云宝剑出鞘，当者必杀不留。下山闯荡以来，从未有过例外，饶是如此，不怕死的家伙依然前仆后继拥上来送死。也许是因为这趟旅程带着妹妹的缘故，他格外的小心，连同门师兄弟亦避不见面。高超的武艺，冷静的头脑，谨慎的个性，俊美的容貌，使叶云舟成为了一名传奇剑客。各式各样花巧的头衔开始不顾当事人感受擅自戴到他顶上，但他个人还是比较中意「苍松剑客」。在认识你之前，他对唐门的印象并不好。=Despite his extraordinary skills, he remains diligent and humble in how he conducts himself, neither arrogant nor impatient.\nHe never engages in duels lightly; when his Tingyun Sword is drawn, it leaves no survivors.\nSince coming down the mountain to make his way in the world, there has never been an exception to this rule. Yet despite this,\ndaredevils still throw themselves at him one after another, seeking death.\nPerhaps because he is travelling with his younger sister this time, he is especially cautious, even avoiding meetings with his fellow sect members.\nHis superior martial skill, calm mind, cautious nature,\nand handsome appearance have made Ye Yunzhou a legendary swordsman.\nAll sorts of elaborate titles have been thrust upon him without regard for his feelings, but he personally still prefers「Azure Pine Swordsman」.\nBefore meeting you, his impression of the Tang Sect was not favorable.

纵使身负绝艺，他为人处世始终兢兢业业，不骄不燥。从不轻易与人相斗，听云宝剑出鞘，当者必杀不留。下山闯荡以来，从未有过例外，饶是如此，不怕死的家伙依然前仆后继拥上来送死。也许是因为这趟旅程带着妹妹的缘故，他格外的小心，连同门师兄弟亦避不见面。高超的武艺，冷静的头脑，谨慎的个性，俊美的容貌，使叶云舟成为了一名传奇剑客。各式各样花巧的头衔开始不顾当事人感受擅自戴到他顶上，但他个人还是比较中意「苍松剑客」。在认识你之前，他对唐门的印象并不好。=Despite his extraordinary skills, he remains diligent and humble in how he conducts himself, neither arrogant nor impatient.\nHe never engages in duels lightly; when his Tingyun Sword is drawn, it leaves no survivors.\nSince coming down the mountain to make his way in the world, there has never been an exception to this rule. 他的心中秘藏着沸腾的热血，握紧着宝剑，在心中演练数千万次出鞘的时刻。「叶」其实不是他家的姓氏。就为了信守一个恐怕永远没有实现之日的诺言，他们家族放弃了自己的姓氏。他们兄妹的「叶云」二字，则是为了纪念曾祖所侍之主岳云而取。身为叶家第三代男丁，犹未出世就被安排了人生，要作船舟，为国尽忠，死而后已。世人皆云，点苍叶云舟乃是用剑的奇才，他本人深不以为然，世上哪有什么天才呢？那是日以继夜勤练不辍，苦心孤诣修得的成果。=Burning passion is hidden within his heart; he grips his treasured sword, mentally rehearsing the moment it leaves its sheath tens of millions of times.\n「Ye」is not actually his family's original surname. To keep a promise that may never be fulfilled, his family abandoned their own name.\nThe two characters「Ye Yun」in the names of him and his sister was chosen to commemorate Yue Yun, the Master their great-grandfather served.\nAs the third-generation male heir of the Ye family, his life was planned even before he was born—to be a vessel (舟, Zhou), to devote himself loyalty to the state until his dying breath.\nThe world says that Diancang's Ye Yunzhou is a prodigious genius with the sword, but he himself deeply disagrees. What genius exists in this world? It is the result of day and night, relentless practice, and painstaking dedication.

他无时不刻在试探着你，寄与厚望，同时也等着你背叛他。当你露出贪婪面孔的那一刻，他便会一剑捅死你，同时灭绝自己最后一丝良心，化为复仇的恶鬼，扑杀所有仇敌。然而你似乎令他的期望落空了，你并非圣人，只是对人情的执着远超于宝藏吸引，从而使他相信「义」确实存于天地之间。隐约变得能够体谅曾祖自私的决定了。你救活了他唯一亲人的性命，也救活了他的心，使他不再是一个为复仇而行动、无法想象未来的行尸走肉。此刻他方始作为自己活着。=He constantly tests you, placing great hopes on you while simultaneously waiting for your betrayal.\nThe moment you reveal a greedy face, he would thrust his sword through you, extinguishing his last shred of conscience in that instant, transforming into an avenging demon to hunt down all his enemies.\nYet you seem to have defied his expectations. You are no saint, but your commitment to human connection far outweighs the lure of treasure, making him believe that「Righteousness」truly exists in this world.\nHe has begun, faintly, to understand his great-grandfather's selfish decision.\nYou saved the life of his only remaining family, and in doing so, you saved his heart. You freed him from being a walking corpse driven solely by revenge, unable to imagine a future. Only now has he begun to live as himself.

来自丐帮的江湖后起新秀。人称「狂犬」，莫欺他个头矮小，但凡动起手来就是拼命，不仅外人怕他，就连丐帮中人亦不敢随意招惹这疯狂小子。=A rising newcomer from the Beggars' Sect. \nKnown as the「Mad Dog」, don't be fooled by his small stature—once he starts fighting, he goes all out with a desperate ferocity. Not only do outsiders fear him, but even members of the Beggars' Sect dare not provoke this crazed youngster.

来自丐帮，近年来崛起的江湖新秀。他坚信弱肉强食的道理，弱者注定受人欺压，唯有强者才能在这世道生存。莫欺他个头矮小，打起架来却有如狂犬一般，拳爪膝肘牙样样皆来，端的是天不怕地不怕，狠的要命。不知打哪学来的一套《揍狗拳》，命名粗俗，却拙中有巧，讲究一字心诀：「狠」，招招都把人往死里揍。曾经趁一名年迈的八袋长老半夜起身如厕时尾行其后，将其狂殴透扁，打断四肢推进粪坑。此后帮中即令是老资历的多袋长老，也不敢在他面前倚老卖老，因为这人是疯的。别说不管男女老少，只怕这人连大宋皇帝都敢打。=Coming from the Beggars' Sect, a rising Jianghu star in recent years. He firmly believes in the law of the jungle—that the weak are destined to be oppressed, and only the strong can survive in this world. Don't be fooled by his small stature; when he fights, he is like a rabid dog, using fists, claws, knees, elbows, and even teeth—utterly fearless and ruthlessly vicious. No one knows where he learned a set of "Beating-Dog Fist". The name is crude, but its simplicity hides cunning, revolving around a single mantra:「Ruthlessness」. Every move aims to beat opponents to death. He once followed an elderly eight-bag elder to the outhouse in the middle of the night, savagely beat him to a pulp, broke all his limbs, and pushed him into a cesspit. Since then, even senior multi-bag elders in the sect dare not act condescendingly around him, because this person is insane. It's not just that he doesn't care about age or gender—it's likely he wouldn't hesitate to attack even the Emperor of the Great Song Dynasty.

自丐帮，近年来崛起的江湖新秀。他坚信弱肉强食的道理，弱者注定受人欺压，唯有强者才能在这世道生存。莫欺他个头矮小，打起架来却有如狂犬一般，拳爪膝肘牙样样皆来，端的是天不怕地不怕，狠的要命。不知打哪学来的一套《揍狗拳》，命名粗俗，却拙中有巧，讲究一字心诀：「狠」，招招都把人往死里揍。曾经趁一名年迈的八袋长老半夜起身如厕时尾行其后，将其狂殴透扁，打断四肢推进粪坑。此后帮中即令是老资历的多袋长老，也不敢在他面前倚老卖老，因为这人是疯的。别说不管男女老少，只怕这人连大宋皇帝都敢打。=Coming from the Beggars' Sect, a rising Jianghu star in recent years.
