他在丐帮之中，也是格格不入的，没有特别亲近的同辈人，劝得住他的人也屈指可数。因为自小唱不好莲花落，行乞总是失败收场，若无老丐「阿叔」照料，只怕早已饿死。兴许是此故，从来只肯听从阿叔说话，人前是狂犬，在阿叔身侧就很老实。虽然和人不相亲，但是似乎喜欢小动物，时常有人看见他将得来不易的食物分给流浪动物吃。=Even within the Beggars' Sect, he is an outsider without any particularly close peers, and those who can persuade him are few and far between.\nBecause he could never sing the "Lianhualao" (beggar's song) well since childhood, his begging attempts often ended in failure. Were it not for the care of an old beggar called「Uncle」, he would likely have starved to death long ago.\nPerhaps because of this, he only ever listens to Uncle. In front of others, he is a rabid dog, but by Uncle's side, he is remarkably docile.\nThough he doesn't get along with people, he seems to have a soft spot for small animals. He is often seen sharing his hard-earned food with stray creatures.

从前毒打八袋长老的那件事，是有原因的。他是百年前灭国的契丹辽人后裔，打从出生以来，就只记得跟随父母流浪中原，而今那些记忆也已经很模糊了。双亲亡故后，只留下一只老狗「阿花」给他。阿花很有灵性，为年幼的他驱蚊赶蛇，朝夕相伴，就像家人一样。有一日他夜里冷醒来，不见了阿花，却见到老乞丐们捧着碗分食狗肉汤。他茫然若失，很久很久才落下泪来。自那一日起，他便举目无亲了，再没什么舍不得的。=There was a reason for that incident where he brutally beat the eight-bag elder.\nHe is a descendant of the Khitan Liao people, whose nation fell a century ago. Since birth, his only memories are of wandering the Central Plains with his parents, though those recollections have now grown hazy.\nAfter his parents passed away, all they left him was an old dog named「A-Hua」. A-Hua was remarkably intelligent—chasing away mosquitoes and snakes for the young boy, keeping him company day and night, just like family.\nOne night, he woke up cold and found Ah Hua missing. Instead, he saw the old beggars holding bowls and sharing a pot of dog meat soup. He stood there lost and empty, and it was a long, long time before tears finally fell.\nFrom that day on, he had no one left in the world. There was nothing left he couldn't bear to lose.

她的芳名叫做「樊咲嫣」，是她母亲学了汉语后，希望她生活无忧，能够巧笑嫣然。然则，却不幸碰上了专干采生折割阴损事的恶丐，将年幼的她拐了去，本欲将她制成「人狗」，却可惜她天生丽质，转念便将她收为禁脔，藏于乞丐窝取乐戏弄，只待她身骨长成就下手。因王帮主介入，没有成真，饶是如此，被当狗养也让她的身心体无完肤。这人间兴许有乐土，纵使边疆兵争不断，也有一隅偏安；天黑了也有夜市，有光，有家可归，可是哪里都没有该她回的地方。直至你的出现。她信仰你，对你忠心耿耿，唯有你才是家。=Her beautiful name is「Fán Xiàoyān」, given by her mother after learning Chinese, hoping she would live a carefree life and always wear a radiant smile.\nHowever, she tragically encountered evil beggars who specialized in the vile practice of cǎishēngzhégē (abducting and mutilating people), who kidnapped her as a child. They originally intended to turn her into a「human dog」,\nbut due to her innate beauty, they changed their minds and kept her as a private concubine, hiding her in their beggar den for amusement and torment, waiting until she grew older to carry out their plans.\nThanks to the intervention of Sect Leader Wang, this never came to pass. Even so, being raised like a dog left her physically and mentally scarred beyond recognition.\nThis world may have peaceful lands; even with constant warfare on the borders, there might be pockets of safety. When night falls, there are night markets, light, and homes to return to—but nowhere was there a place for *her* to return to.\nUntil you appeared.\nShe believes in you, is utterly loyal to you, and only with you does she have a home.

身披鹰羽破蓑衣的精悍老者。虽然形貌怪异，其武功路数却博大精深，气度非凡，显是名家风范。却不知为何到了这把年纪仍是名不见经传。=A lean and tough old man clad in a tattered eagle-feather cloak.\nThough his appearance is peculiar, his martial arts are profound and vast, with an extraordinary demeanor that clearly reflects the style of a Master. Yet for some reason, even at this age, he remains obscure and unknown.

他曾是故事中人，位嵩山寺达摩院首席，法名觉空。觉空禅师身兼七十二武技之七，尤以外功龙爪手最为拿手。武功之高，不下于身有易筋经功力的方丈师兄。位高而德重，等闲不在江湖中行走，及至天命之年后，辞退首座一席，远赴襄阳六道峡挑战泥教天王，及后不知所踪。再出没时已然还俗，改号自称鹰人。=He was once a figure of legend, the chief of the Songshan Temple's Dharma Hall on Songshan, with the monastic name Juekong. Master Juekong mastered seven of the seventy-two martial arts, excelling particularly in the external skill "Dragon Claw Hand". His martial prowess was no less than that of his abbot brother, who possessed the power of the Yi Jin Jing. Holding a high position and profound virtue, he rarely ventured into the Jianghu. Upon reaching his fifties, he resigned from his chief seat and journeyed to Six Realms Gorge in Xiangyang to challenge the Heavenly King of the Mud Sect, after which he vanished without a trace. When he reappeared, he had already returned to secular life and renamed himself as the Eagle Man.

为求名而入世涉江湖，可任他如何积极走动，鹰人的名号都传不开来。他仍不绝游走于宋金两国交界，时有耳闻他会助纣为虐，给零星战役后得胜宋兵泼冷水说教惹人嫌。年纪虽大，行事却颇具血性，中原群侠虽不与之结交，在两国百姓之间却很受欢迎。嗜酒，但是酒量却不太行。=He entered the Jianghu seeking fame, but no matter how actively he traveled, the name Eagle Man never spread.\nHe still constantly roams the border between the Song and Jin territories. There are occasional hearsay accounts of him "aiding the wicked", dampening the morale of victorious Song soldiers after sporadic battles with unwelcome lectures, earning their dislike.\nThough advanced in age, his actions are full of fiery spirit. While the heroes of the Central Plains do not befriend him, he is quite popular among the common people of both nations.\nHe is fond of wine, but his alcohol tolerance is rather poor.

许多年前，有人在藏经阁中，偷塞了一部传奇小说《虬髯客传》。少年僧人觉空偶然读之，心潮澎湃，对书中所描述的豪情心生向往，醉心学武。无奈他自少便在少林寺出家，对世事一窍不通，耳濡目染又都是戒杀远离贪嗔痴、爱憎会的佛法，纵想入世游历，亦难过得了自个儿设下的那道坎，心痒难搔之际，只得下打几套烦恼拳排解。身在世外，心却落在人间，他忍过了几度春秋，即使身任达摩院首座，亦只有换得空虚。直至旧魔教极乐教猖獗之时，少年英雄龙渊号召群雄，少林随即响应，他躬逢其盛，在那一役中打响了偌大名声，达摩院首座技惊四座。=Many years ago, someone secretly slipped a copy of the legendary novel《The Tale of the Bearded Stranger》into the scripture depository.\nThe young monk Juekong stumbled upon it and was deeply stirred, yearning for the heroic spirit described in the book and becoming devoted to martial arts.\nHowever, having entered Songshan Temple as a child, he was utterly ignorant of worldly affairs. Surrounded by Buddhist teachings that warned against killing and urged detachment from desire, hatred, and obsession, even if he wished to travel the world, he couldn't overcome the barriers he had set for himself. Tormented by restless longing, he could only vent his frustrations by practicing a few sets of fist techniques.\nThough his body remained in seclusion, his heart lingered in the mortal world. He endured this for years, and even after becoming the chief of the Dharma Hall, he found only emptiness.\nIt wasn't until the old demon sect, the Blissful Cult, ran rampant that the Young Hero Long Yuan rallied the champions. Songshan promptly responded, and he found himself at the center of this great event. In that battle, he made a tremendous name for himself, and the chief of the Dharma Hall astonished everyone with his skill.

那一役后嵩山元气大伤，方丈一身功力散尽，无有执着，反更加虔心向佛。余下僧人得其感召，纷纷回归初心，弃了武学等强身小技，在佛法大学问之上勇猛精进。只剩下他一人，依然为那一役后的余温坐立难安。勘不破执着，他毅然辞退首座之席，远赴六道峡泥教总坛，与天王座车轩辕并席论理比武，不曾想，一生修佛的他劝不下人，反受这凡人所点化，澈悟心底偏执。呆坐数日，终决心还俗，只可惜想要留长发，却已秃了大半。他想起当年所读的《虬髯客传》，将搜集多年的老鹰羽毛织成一件蓑衣，武林新人万里鹏程，开始闯荡江湖，补完他的青春。=After that battle, Songshan was severely weakened. The abbot's lifelong cultivation was spent, but freed from attachment, he instead devoted himself more devoutly to Buddhism.\nThe remaining monks, inspired by him, returned to their original aspirations, abandoning martial arts and other minor skills of physical cultivation to advance courageously in the great study of Buddhist doctrine.\nOnly he remained, still restless from the lingering heat of that conflict.\nUnable to see through his attachments, he resolutely resigned his position as chief and traveled far to the Mud Sect's main altar at Six Realms Gorge. There, he sat alongside the Heavenly King's charioteer, Xuanyuan, debating principles and competing in martial arts. Unexpectedly, a lifetime of Buddhist practice had not equipped him to persuade others; instead, he was enlightened by this ordinary man, gaining clear insight into his own inner obsessions.\nHe sat in a daze for several days, finally resolving to return to secular life. The only regret was that when he wanted to grow his hair out, he found he was already mostly bald.\nRemembering the《The Tale of the Bearded Stranger》he had read in his youth, he wove the eagle feathers he had collected over the years into a cloak. Like a fledgling in the martial world named Wanli Pengcheng (Ten-Thousand-Mile Journey), he began wandering the Jianghu, seeking to complete the youth he had missed.

飞石帮主，形貌剽悍的豪杰。起初是落草于茂州的土匪，成亲后金盆洗手，不再滋扰民生，转而租赁人力包揽粗活，飞石帮名声渐响，隐然能与三大帮派分庭抗礼。=The Leader of the Flying Stone Gang, a fierce and imposing hero.\nHe started as a bandit operating in Mao Prefecture, but after getting married, he washed his hands of that life and ceased troubling the common people. Instead, he shifted to renting labor and taking on manual work contracts. The Flying Stone Gang's reputation gradually grew, quietly reaching a level where it could rival the three major gangs.

石公远少年时，曾投身军旅，为名将毕再遇军中小卒。及后逃兵，落草于茂州茂湿山，成为山贼。石公远胸无大志，过得一日是一日，与帮众成日饮酒吃肉，醉生梦死，以逞凶为勇，横练外功有成，生得孔武有力，更加肆无忌惮。更曾大胆劫持徒步上任的新知州，强娶知州千金为压寨夫人。=In his youth, Shi Gongyuan once joined the army,\nserving as a common soldier under the famous general Bi Zaiyu.\nLater, he deserted and became a bandit on Maoshi Mountain in Mao Prefecture.\nShi Gongyuan had no grand ambitions, living day by day, drinking and eating meat with his gang members in a drunken stupor, considering brutality as bravery.\nHaving mastered hardened external martial arts, he was born strong and powerful,\nwhich made him even more reckless.\nHe even boldly ambushed a newly appointed prefect travelling on foot to his post and forcibly married the prefect's daughter as his fortress bride.

知州千金成了压寨夫人后，石公远的浪荡生活也到头了。谁也不知那位娇滴滴的千金，竟是个母老虎，凶得过这彪形大汉，可怜山贼头领沦为妻管严。在妻子温言劝谏下，负荆至衙门请罪，下狱刑求，只道此番必死，却是他的年轻妻子求情纵放了他。知州引入内堂，赦免从前罪衍，令其拜地，总算是认了这个女婿。=After the prefect's daughter became the fortress bride,\nShi Gongyuan's reckless life came to an end.\nNo one could have guessed that delicate young lady\nwould turn out to be a fierce tigress, even more formidable than the burly bandit himself.\nThe pitiful bandit Leader was reduced to a henpecked husband.\nFollowing his wife's gentle persuasion, he carried thorns on his back to the magistrate's office to confess his crimes.\nImprisoned and tortured, he believed he would surely die this time,\nbut it was his young wife who pleaded for mercy and secured his release.\nThe prefect brought him into the inner hall, pardoned his past offenses, and had him kneel in respect,\nfinally acknowledging him as a son-in-law.

在贤内助的辅佐下，召集从前匪众，另起炉灶，是为飞石帮。专门出租人力，包揽粗工杂活，做外包生意。招人无论品行好坏，却得谨记帮规，不得滋扰民生，石公远亦洗心革面，变成了急公好义的善人。飞石帮崛起极快，不到二十年间，已有数百帮众，隐能与江湖三大帮分庭抗礼。=With the support of his capable wife, he gathered his former bandit followers and started anew, establishing the Flying Stone Gang.\nThey specialized in renting out labor, taking on manual and miscellaneous tasks, operating as an outsourcing business.\nThey recruited regardless of past conduct, but all members had to strictly follow the gang's rule: do not disturb the livelihood of the people. Shi Gongyuan also turned over a new leaf, becoming a public-spirited and righteous man.\nThe Flying Stone Gang rose extremely quickly. In less than twenty years, it had grown to hundreds of members, quietly reaching a position where it could rival the three major gangs of the Jianghu.

一切起因于误会，然而大错铸成，谁也不甘低头。终归得你插手，方始化干戈为玉帛，破镜重圆，从前种种，亦如过眼烟云。石公远如今虽已金盆洗手，偕爱妻退隐江湖，心底却仍记挂着唐门的恩情。暗中起誓，有朝唐门若有难时，总不能袖手旁观。=It all began with a misunderstanding, yet once the grave mistake was made, neither side was willing to back down.\nIt was only through your intervention that weapons were turned into gifts of jade, the broken mirror was made whole again, and past grievances vanished like fleeting clouds.\nThough Shi Gongyuan has now washed his hands of the Jianghu and retired with his beloved wife, he still holds the Tang Sect's kindness close to his heart.\nHe secretly vowed that if the Tang Sect ever faces trouble, he would never stand idly by.





南宫世家的嫡长大公子。集万千瞩目于一身，承袭家学，儒雅翩翩，四艺皆全，不止江湖人面广阔，在文人雅士圈中亦颇有人脉。=The eldest legitimate son of the Nangong Family.\nThe focus of countless eyes, he inherits his family's teachings, elegant and refined, accomplished in the four arts (qin, Go, Calligraphy, Painting). Not only does he have broad connections in the Jianghu, but he also maintains significant networks among literati and scholars.

Nangong Family  的嫡长大公子。集万千瞩目于一身，承袭家学，儒雅翩翩，四艺皆全，不止江湖人面广阔，在文人雅士圈中亦颇有人脉。=The Eldest legitimate son of the Nangong Family.\nThe focus of countless eyes, he inherits his family's teachings, elegant and refined, accomplished in the four arts (qin, Go, Calligraphy, Painting). Not only does he have broad connections in the Jianghu, but he also maintains significant networks among literati and scholars.

Nangong Family的嫡长大公子。集万千瞩目于一身，承袭家学，儒雅翩翩，四艺皆全，不止江湖人面广阔，在文人雅士圈中亦颇有人脉。=The Eldest legitimate son of the Nangong Family.\nThe focus of countless eyes, he inherits his family's teachings, elegant and refined, accomplished in the four arts (qin, Go, Calligraphy, Painting). Not only does he have broad connections in the Jianghu, but he also maintains significant networks among literati and scholars.

从小耳濡目染，而又聪敏机灵，善用家族财产与人脉，习武有家主亲授，练字有名家点拨，吃穿用度无一不是比照临安贵冑，虽无功名在身，日子过的却比秀才都滋润。以人上人自居，处世颇有纨绔之嫌。与上官独女上官萤有婚约，但二人见面不是吵架就是大打出手。=Having been immersed in this environment since childhood and being clever and quick-witted, he skillfully utilizes his family's wealth and connections. He learns martial arts through personal instruction from the Family Head and practices calligraphy under the guidance of masters. His food, clothing, and daily expenses all mirror those of Lin'an's nobility. Though he holds no official rank, his life is more comfortable than that of any scholar.\nHe considers himself superior to others and carries himself with a somewhat spoiled, dandyish air.\nHe is engaged to the only daughter of the Shangguan Family, Shangguan Ying, but whenever they meet, they either argue or come to blows.

有感于楚霸王烏江自刎，引以为惕，认为光凭武勇不能成事，试问古来哪位开国君王是自己武功高强？逞匹夫之勇者，枉送性命而已。为此诸事都仅浅尝即止，大公子四艺皆全，也都不求甚解。学文学武的态度也都得过且过，善以巧舌敷衍。他认为自己真正的课题，应该是知人善用，能使唤最强的武人，驱策最博学的文人，方为真正的人上之人。虽然颇有才略，但也免不了公子哥的习性，贪花好色，与三五好友并称花城四少，是烟花柳巷的常客。要不是上官萤脸皮薄、拳头硬，保不定未过门就得出乱子。=Reflecting on the tragedy of Xiang Yu's suicide at the Wu River, he took it as a warning, believing that martial prowess alone cannot achieve great deeds. After all, which founding Emperor in history was personally a martial arts Master? Those who rely on brute courage only throw their lives away.\nThus, he only dabbles superficially in everything. The young Master is accomplished in the four arts but never seeks deep mastery.\nHis attitude toward learning, both literary and martial, is perfunctory, and he is skilled at glossing over things with clever words.\nHe believes his true calling is to recognize talent and deploy it effectively—to command the strongest warriors and direct the most learned scholars, thus becoming a truly superior ruler among men.\nThough quite strategic, he cannot shake the habits of a pampered noble: he is fond of wine and women, and along with a few friends, is known as one of the "Four Young Masters of Flower City", frequenting brothels and pleasure quarters.\nIf it weren't for Shangguan Ying's thin skin (shyness) and hard fists (fierce temper), trouble would likely have arisen even before the marriage.

南宫世家的庶子。他的出生并非人所期望，他娘亲更为南宫远所深恶痛绝。连带南宫浅也不受人待见，虽是二公子，在家待遇却还不如家丁下人。=The illegitimate son of the Nangong Family.\nHis birth was unwanted, and his mother was deeply detested by Nangong Yuan.\nAs a result, Nangong Qian is also disliked. Though he is the Second Young Master, his treatment at home is worse than that of the servants.
Nangong Family  的庶子。他的出生并非人所期望，他娘亲更为南宫远所深恶痛绝。连带南宫浅也不受人待见，虽是二公子，在家待遇却还不如家丁下人。=The illegitimate son of the Nangong Family.\nHis birth was unwanted, and his mother was deeply detested by Nangong Yuan.\nAs a result, Nangong Qian is also disliked. Though he is the Second Young Master, his treatment at home is worse than that of the servants.

Nangong Family的庶子。他的出生并非人所期望，他娘亲更为南宫远所深恶痛绝。连带南宫浅也不受人待见，虽是二公子，在家待遇却还不如家丁下人。=The illegitimate son of the Nangong Family.\nHis birth was unwanted, and his mother was deeply detested by Nangong Yuan.\nAs a result, Nangong Qian is also disliked. Though he is the Second Young Master, his treatment at home is worse than that of the servants.

懵懂记事之初，就跟着母亲。那时不知贫穷为何物，日子单纯而美好，他相貌长得好，又活泼聪明，心地善良，人见人爱，乡里孩子都爱跟他玩。那时他不叫南宫浅，似乎有别的乳名，如今已经不记得了。某天他玩得一身泥回家，好奇问了母亲一句：「为何我没有爹爹？我爹爹上哪儿去了？」他美好的童年就此戛然而止。=From his earliest memories, he was with his mother.\nBack then, he didn't know what poverty was; life was simple and beautiful. He had good looks, was lively and clever, kind-hearted, and beloved by everyone. The village children all loved to play with him.\nAt that time, he wasn't called Nangong Qian—he seemed to have had another childhood name, now long forgotten.\nOne day, he returned home covered in mud and curiously asked his mother:「Why don't I have a father? Where did my father go?」\nHis beautiful childhood came to an abrupt end at that moment.

第一眼见到南宫世家那堂皇气派的五进大院时，南宫浅两眼放光，这些人身上的衣料都那么好，肩膀还有金子，想来王孙公子也不过如此。爹爹比想象中更潇洒、威风，便是官府中人，见了都得客客气气。哥哥知书达理，刚见面那会儿，还给了自己糖吃。自己居然能成为他们家人，以为好日子要来了。然而并非如此。家主对谁都和气，唯独对他母子的嫌恶之情藏也藏不住，族人、下人见此，日渐轻蔑。母亲辞世以后，没人护着，更是每况愈下，就连下人都能任意欺凌。在南宫世家的日子不愁吃穿，但南宫家连狗都不愁吃穿呀。从前无忧无虑的孩子，变得畏畏缩缩，终日看人脸色度日。=When he first laid eyes on the Nangong Family's magnificent five-courtyard mansion, Nangong Qian's eyes sparkled. The fabrics these people wore were so fine, and they even had gold on their shoulders—he imagined even princes and nobles couldn't live much better.\nHis father was more dashing and imposing than he had imagined; even government officials treated him with respect.\nHis older brother was cultured and reasonable—during their first meeting, he even gave him candy to eat.\nHe actually got to become part of their family, and he thought good days were ahead.\nBut that wasn't the case.\nThe Family Head was kind to everyone except him and his mother; his disgust toward them was barely concealed. Seeing this, family members and servants grew increasingly contemptuous.\nAfter his mother passed away, with no one left to protect him, things went from bad to worse. Even the servants could bully him at will.\nLife in the Nangong Family meant no worries about food or clothing, but even the dogs in the Nangong household didn't worry about food or clothing.\nThe once carefree child became timid and withdrawn, spending his days trying to read people's expressions and survive.

全真「清和子」尹志平全真派「天下第一人」丘处机的得意弟子。恩师云游期间，代理终南山全真龙门观诸般事物，有传闻可能会在不久将来接任掌教之位。=Yin Zhiping, known by his Daoist name「Qinghezi」,\nis the esteemed disciple of Qiu Chuji, the「Number One Under Heaven」of the Quanzhen Sect.\nDuring his Master's travels, he handles all affairs of the Longmen Temple on Zhongnan Mountain. There are rumors he may succeed to the position of Sect Leader in the near future.

少时曾先后拜马钰、刘处玄为师，但都被父母抓回家锁在柴房里，家人见他求道之心迫切，才终于放生。=In his youth, he attempted to become a disciple of both Ma Yu and Liu Chuxuan, but each time his parents dragged him back home and locked him in the woodshed. It was only when his family saw his desperate determination to pursue the Dao that they finally relented and let him go.
为人诙谐友善，武功高强又博学，却因为长相经常被当作坏人，明明没干什么事但大家都怀疑他是幕后黑手。=He is witty and friendly, possessing great martial prowess and vast knowledge, but due to his appearance, he is often mistaken for a villain. Even when he hasn't done anything, everyone suspects he is the mastermind behind the scenes.

嵩山派的年轻弟子，云游大宋，弘扬佛法，筹措善款以期修缮败破的嵩山寺。=A young disciple of the Songshan Sect, travelling throughout the Great Song to spread Buddhist teachings and raise funds for the restoration of the dilapidated Songshan Temple.

Songshan  派的年轻弟子，云游大宋，弘扬佛法，筹措善款以期修缮败破的嵩山寺。=A young disciple of the Songshan Sect, travelling throughout the Great Song to spread Buddhist teachings and raise funds for the restoration of the dilapidated Songshan Temple.

Songshan派的年轻弟子，云游大宋，弘扬佛法，筹措善款以期修缮败破的嵩山寺。=A young disciple of the Songshan Sect, travelling throughout the Great Song to spread Buddhist teachings and raise funds for the restoration of the dilapidated Songshan Temple.

天资聪颖，嘴力惊人，常在峨嵋、崆峒之间来回游走，一边弘扬佛法，一边筹募善款修建嵩山宝剎。与良善之人相处抱持敬意，对顽劣之辈却咄咄逼人。他对待的你的态度，取决于你的人品，一样不免要唠叨，差别在于用词遣字气不气人。=Gifted with natural talent and remarkable eloquence, he often travels between Emei and Kongtong, promoting Buddhist teachings while raising funds to rebuild the treasured Songshan Temple.\nHe treats kind-hearted people with respect, but is assertive and confrontational with those who are stubborn and wicked.\nHis attitude toward you depends entirely on your character. He will inevitably lecture you regardless, but the difference lies in whether his choice of words is provoking or not.

天下第一大帮，丐帮的帮主。一就任即雷厉风行，提拔新派弟子，架空旧派长老，以侠义精神诓骗帮中子弟重拾尊严，令他们相信当乞丐是种选择。=The Leader of the largest gang under heaven, the Beggars' Sect.\nUpon taking office, he acted decisively: promoting new-generation disciples, sidelining senior elders, and using the rhetoric of chivalry to inspire sect members to regain their dignity—making them believe that being a beggar is a conscious choice.

眼神慵懒，消极颓废，嗜好是钓鱼。自称不爱喝酒，但是经常烂醉如泥。王二壮是丐帮由黑转白的关键，统帅丐帮以来，大力宣扬侠义，令年轻丐帮弟子眼里重新有光，愿意相信自己身陷泥泞，仍能出淤泥而不染。只要心怀侠义，便是鹑衣百结也能自豪，那些最清廉的官儿，可不就是两袖清风吗？新派崛起，一扫丐帮从前恶习，所行无不光明正大，再也不干偷鸡摸狗的事，恨不能行侠仗义。老派依然势众，一边斥骂新派不伦不类，沦为乞丐还自命清高，一边又坐享新派挣来的美名。=His eyes are lazy, his demeanor消极颓废 (negative and decadent), and his hobby is fishing.\nHe claims to dislike alcohol, but is often found dead drunk.\nWang Erzhuang is the key figure in transforming the Beggars' Sect from a dark to a righteous path. Since leading the sect, he has vigorously promoted chivalry, making young disciples believe in themselves again—that even while trapped in the mud, they can remain unstained.\nAs long as one upholds chivalry, even in tattered clothing, they can take pride. Aren't the most honest officials also those with "two sleeves clean of corruption"?\nThe New Faction has risen, sweeping away the sect's past vices. Their actions are now open and honorable—no more sneaky deeds—and they are eager to perform acts of justice.\nThe Old Faction remains influential, criticizing the New Faction as neither fish nor fowl—beggars putting on airs—while simultaneously enjoying the reputation earned by the New Faction's efforts.

本名王春晓，祖上世代是武官，王春晓也得了余荫，被封定远郎。但他文质彬彬，比起武功，更爱吟诗下棋，至于兵书读是读了，可一想到要上战场保家卫国，就直打哆嗦。直到认识南宫远、邂逅苏迎香，为了博得美人青睐，才勉为其难入江湖闯荡。他样样都比南宫远行，可是苏迎香眼里，就只偏袒南宫远，王春晓为此伤心不已，哭哭啼啼，自暴自弃，还曾泪奔东林寺，想要剃度出家，因此得遇改变一生的契机。他拜于春眠大师膝下，只想学佛，春眠大师却非要逼他习武，王春晓很久以后才知道他师父便是东十三州武霸王，传说中的红蓬王。=His original name is Wang Chunxiao. His ancestors served as military officials for generations, and Wang Chunxiao also benefited from this legacy, being granted the title "Dingyuan Lang".\nHowever, he is refined and scholarly, preferring poetry and chess over martial arts. As for military strategy books, he read them, but the thought of going to the battlefield to defend his country made him tremble with fear.\nIt wasn't until he met Nangong Yuan and encountered Su Yingxiang that he reluctantly ventured into the Jianghu to win the beauty's favor.\nHe excelled at everything compared to Nangong Yuan, yet Su Yingxiang only showed favoritism toward Nangong Yuan. Wang Chunxiao was heartbroken, weeping and wallowing in self-pity. He even fled in tears to Donglin Temple, seeking to become a monk, which led him to the opportunity that changed his life.\nHe became a disciple of Master Chunmian, hoping only to study Buddhism, but Master Chunmian insisted on forcing him to learn martial arts. It was only much later that Wang Chunxiao learned his Master was the "Martial Overlord of the Eastern Thirteen Provinces", the legendary Red Lotus King.

崆峒派·飞天门掌门火龙仙君座下的大弟子。亦是襄阳战场声名赫赫的「道法将军」，百战不殆，为宋国军民仰仗，为金国兵马忌惮。=The Head Disciple under the Fire Dragon Immortal Lord, Leader of the Flying Heaven Gate of the Kongtong School.\nHe is also the renowned「General of Daoist Methods」on the Xiangyang battlefield, undefeated in countless battles. Relied upon by the Song military and civilians, and feared by the Jin forces.

Kongtong派·飞天门掌门火龙仙君座下的大弟子。亦是襄阳战场声名赫赫的「道法将军」，百战不殆，为宋国军民仰仗，为金国兵马忌惮。=The Head Disciple under the Fire Dragon Immortal Lord, Leader of the Flying Heaven Gate of the Kongtong School.\nHe is also the renowned「General of Daoist Methods」on the Xiangyang battlefield, undefeated in countless battles. Relied upon by the Song military and civilians, and feared by the Jin forces.

Kongtong 派·飞天门掌门火龙仙君座下的大弟子。亦是襄阳战场声名赫赫的「道法将军」，百战不殆，为宋国军民仰仗，为金国兵马忌惮。=The Head Disciple under the Fire Dragon Immortal Lord, Leader of the Flying Heaven Gate of the Kongtong School.\nHe is also the renowned「General of Daoist Methods」on the Xiangyang battlefield, undefeated in countless battles. Relied upon by the Song military and civilians, and feared by the Jin forces.

Kongtong  派·飞天门掌门火龙仙君座下的大弟子。亦是襄阳战场声名赫赫的「道法将军」，百战不殆，为宋国军民仰仗，为金国兵马忌惮。=The Head Disciple under the Fire Dragon Immortal Lord, Leader of the Flying Heaven Gate of the Kongtong School.\nHe is also the renowned「General of Daoist Methods」on the Xiangyang battlefield, undefeated in countless battles. Relied upon by the Song military and civilians, and feared by the Jin forces.

豪爽而憨厚老实，一心求仙，跟随火龙仙君修真，对于自己修练多年始终不能喷火感到十分羞愧。虽然修练仙法不成，实则是福缘深厚之人，机缘巧合习得风刀火剑，为业师所妒，遂以「要突破大乘期就必须累积功德」、「最快累积功德的办法就是上战场救国」为由，骗到宋金战场去送死。但他常住战场，始终没死，反而深受官兵将士信赖，被誉为「道法将军」，战功彪炳，连襄阳守将赵方老将军都破格礼遇。=Generous, simple, and honest, he wholeheartedly seeks immortality, studying cultivation under the Fire Dragon Immortal Lord. He feels deeply ashamed that after years of training, he still cannot breathe fire.\nThough he failed to Master immortal arts, he is actually a man of profound fortune. By chance, he learned the「Wind Blade Fire Sword」technique, which made his Master jealous. His Master then deceived him by claiming that「To break through to the Mahayana stage, one must accumulate merit」and「The fastest way to accumulate merit is to go to the battlefield and save the nation」, sending him to the Song-Jin battlefield to die.\nBut he remained on the battlefield, never dying. Instead, he gained the deep trust of officers and soldiers, earning the title「General of Daoist Methods」. With outstanding military achievements, even General Zhao Fang, the defender of Xiangyang, treated him with exceptional respect.

青城「逸尘道子」申屠龙青城派的修真道士，年纪虽轻，辈份却高，是青城前任掌门的关门弟子。面目清俊，随和儒雅，不修道法时多在山中闲游，不太理会江湖事，极少与人争执，只在青城派自家月考时显露武功，饶是如此，名声依然默默的传开。=Shentu Long, known as the「Daoist Priest Yichen」(Transcending Dust) of Qingcheng.\nA cultivator from the Qingcheng Sect, he is young but holds a high seniority as the inner-sect disciple of the former Qingcheng Sect Leader.\nWith refined and handsome features, he is gentle and scholarly. When not practicing Daoist arts, he often wanders the mountains, pays little attention to Jianghu affairs, and rarely engages in disputes. He only displays his martial prowess during the sect's monthly exams. Despite this, his reputation has quietly spread.

常有女香客为了争睹他的英俊面容，佯称被妖魔缠身，上青城求他施法解救，申屠龙明知是假，却照顾大家的心情从不拆穿。青城道士以降妖除魔为己任，但申屠龙压根不信世上有妖怪。要说世上真有什么称得上邪恶，那便是人。=Female devotees often pretend to be haunted by demons just to catch a glimpse of his handsome face, journeying to Qingcheng to seek his help. Though Shentu Long knows it's false, he never exposes them, respecting their feelings.\nQingcheng Daoists see exorcising demons as their duty, but Shentu Long doesn't believe demons exist at all.\nIf there is anything truly evil in this world, he would say it is people.

大宋神捕，御赐银鱼袋、御前带刀。天下捕役总指挥使，可以越州拿缉人犯。行于江湖之间，算是半个武林人。=A renowned arrest officer of the Great Song, granted the Silver Fish Pouch and the privilege of bearing arms before the Emperor by imperial decree.\nHe serves as the Chief Commander of all arrest officers under heaven, authorized to apprehend criminals across provincial borders.\nOperating within the Jianghu, he is considered half a martial arts figure.

官拜和安至保安郎，虽是从七品，但加个御前带刀的头衔，便是当朝一品大员也不能对他任意辱骂，他可是官家的刀，也以此为豪。除非天子，否则对谁都不亢不卑，这既是官家的期许，也是他自江湖熬来的胆气。要是查明贪官污吏，王爷都敢捉拿，反之也极富人情味，宋刑统倒背如流，可遇着于法难容，但情有可原的情况，也常睁一只眼闭一只眼，或求情请从宽发落。=Holding the official rank of He'an to Bao'an Lang, though only a seventh-grade position, the additional title of "Imperial Blade-Bearer" means even first-ranking officials of the court cannot freely insult him. He is the Emperor's blade and takes pride in this.\nUnless facing the Son of Heaven himself, he remains neither haughty nor humble toward anyone—a demeanor expected by the Emperor and tempered by his own Jianghu-forged courage.\nIf he uncovers corrupt officials, he dares to arrest even princes. Conversely, he is deeply humane, able to recite the Song Penal Code by heart, yet when encountering situations where the law is strict but compassion warranted, he often turns a blind eye or pleads for leniency.

他曾捉拿过一个被人囚于地窖当作禁脔、逃亡之际为了自保而刺死凶徒的稚龄女子。因为心生怜悯，纵放了那无辜的加害者，被兄长的政敌拿住了把柄，向大理寺告发。宋悲凛然辩曰：「刑统立法二百年，民风变移，不宜墨守成规，何况法为先人制订，先人亦人，高居庙堂之上，不知民情，必有疏漏，不近情理，反害天下。我于法不及意处容情，问心无愧。」然而抗辩失败，宋悲被罚俸半年，幽禁府中，幸得其兄宋慈在朝中走动，又有万民请愿，大理寺才收回成命，特赦于他。=He once arrested a young girl who had been imprisoned in a cellar as a captive and, while escaping in self-defense, stabbed her captor to death.\nMoved by compassion, he released the innocent perpetrator. His brother's political opponents seized this as leverage and reported him to the Dali Temple.\nSong Bei argued solemnly:「The penal code has been established for two hundred years, yet public customs have evolved. We should not cling rigidly to old rules. Moreover, the laws were made by our ancestors, who were also human, seated high in the court, unaware of the people's realities. There must be oversights and unreasonable aspects that ultimately harm the world. Where the law fails to capture true intent, I show mercy—with a clear conscience」.\nHowever, his defense failed. Song Bei was sentenced to six months' salary forfeiture and house confinement. Fortunately, due to his brother Song Ci's influence at court and a petition from thousands of citizens, the Dali Temple revoked the order and granted him a special pardon.

峨嵋派当代有名的年轻高手，人称「风神」。与唐门飞侠唐布衣江湖齐名的峨嵋高手，擅长腿法。自诩为你大师兄的生平劲敌，非常烦人，见面就打架，也曾有结伴游戏江湖的美谈。=A renowned young Master of the Emei Sect in this generation, known as the「Wind God」.\nAn Emei expert equally famous in the Jianghu as the Tang Sect's "Flying Hero" Tang Buyi, specializing in leg techniques.\nHe proclaims himself your First Senior Brother's lifelong rival; extremely annoying, he picks a fight every time they meet. When executed, it allows him to kick while leveraging force mid-air, capable of launching lethal aerial assaults.\nThe nickname「Wind God」was spread by paying someone five taels of silver to promote it—otherwise, how could he have such an imposing title?

他爹还没加入丐帮以前，曾有功名在身，只得李富贵一个儿子，所以极其宠腻，李富贵不学无术，不到五岁就会掀姑娘的裙子。后来千金叟散尽家才，加入丐帮，李富贵依然跋扈任性，仗着他爹的脸面狐假虎威，直至王二壮掌毙千金叟，夺权霸占帮主宝座，再也无人撑伞，李富贵才收敛气焰，改名易姓认王二壮作父，意图行刺。殊不知他这点心机，王二壮全都看在眼里，还以为此子能够卧薪尝胆，孺子可教，不想李富贵半点沉不住气，认父当晚就行刺，结果当然是功败垂成。罚当然是要罚的，但不是打骂杀，而是逼他读书、学武，摧残他的心智、煎熬他的肉体。=Before his father joined the Beggars' Sect, he had held an official rank and doted excessively on his only son, Li Fugui. Li Fugui grew up idle and unprincipled—by age five, he was already lifting girls' skirts.\nLater, Qian Jinsou exhausted his family's wealth to join the Beggars' Sect, but Li Fugui remained arrogant and willful, relying on his father's influence to bully others. It wasn't until Wang Erzhuang killed Qian Jinsou, seized power, and took over as Sect Leader that Li Fugui lost his backing and finally toned down his behavior. He changed his name, acknowledged Wang Erzhuang as his father, and plotted assassination.\nUnbeknownst to him, Wang Erzhuang saw through his scheme. Rather than dismissing him, Wang believed the boy might endure humiliation to seek revenge and could be taught. However, Li Fugui lacked all patience—he attempted the assassination on the very night he was supposed to acknowledge his new adoptive father; and of course, he failed completely.\nPunishment was inevitable, but it wasn't through beating, scolding, or execution. Instead, he was forced to study and practice martial arts, tormenting his mind and torturing his body.

瑞笙的红颜知己之一，苗疆巫灵教圣女。还在娘亲腹中便被族中巫婆指作蛟龙妻。瑞笙与三五好友入苗疆，闯越五仙阵，挥剑斩大蛇，揭穿金蟾娘子和银蛇公子的阴谋，喜闻乐见的英雄救美。=One of Rui Sheng's cherished confidantes, she is the Holy Maiden of the Miaojiang Witch Spirit Sect. While still in her mother's womb, she was designated by the tribe's shamaness as the bride of the flood dragon. Rui Sheng, along with a few friends, entered Miaojiang, braved the Five Immortals Array, slew a giant serpent with his sword, and exposed the schemes of the Golden Toad Lady and Silver Snake Prince—culminating in the classic tale of the hero saving the beauty.

瑞笙的红颜知己之一，苗疆巫灵教圣女。还在娘亲腹中便被族中巫婆指作蛟龙妻。瑞笙与三五好友入苗疆，闯越五仙阵，挥剑斩大蛇，揭穿金蟾娘子和银蛇公子的阴谋，喜闻乐见的英雄救美。和其他几位红颜知己镇日争风吃醋，可惜嘴巴坏，心肠却软，终究狠不下心下蛊相害，只得委屈自己终生郁郁。=One of Rui Sheng's cherished confidantes, she is the Holy Maiden of the Miaojiang Witch Spirit Sect. Though sharp-tongued, she is soft-hearted at core, ultimately unable to bring herself to use deadly gu (poison) spells against them. Thus, she resigns herself to a lifetime of quiet melancholy.

初出茅庐，近来名声渐响的年轻剑客。英俊潇洒，磊落君子，处世温文尔雅，胸中亦藏豪情万丈，仗剑行侠，快意恩仇，紧要关头就会出现的家伙。=A young swordsman newly emerged into the world, whose reputation has been growing recently.\nHandsome and graceful, an upright gentleman who carries himself with refined elegance, yet harbors boundless passion within. He roams with his sword, championing justice and settling scores with thrilling resolve—the kind of guy who always appears at critical moments.

年纪轻轻，不知怎地一身武功高得出奇，自言出身孤云山派，可任谁也没曾听闻这名不见经传的小门派。对江湖充满憧憬，背着宝剑四处游历，好管闲事，爱打抱不平，处世谦抑而重情义，人缘绝佳，各派都结识了朋友。出山以来，对他一见倾心的女子大有人在，可他在意的小娘子，全都不是易与之辈，因此备受挫折。=Despite his youth, he possesses inexplicably extraordinary martial skills. He claims to hail from the solitary Cloud Mountain Sect, though no one has ever heard of this obscure minor school.\nFilled with longing for the Jianghu, he travels everywhere with his treasured sword, meddling in others' business and loving to champion the oppressed. Humble in conduct and deeply loyal, he enjoys excellent relationships and has made friends within every sect.\nSince emerging into the world, many women have fallen for him at first sight, but the young ladies who capture his heart are never easy to deal with, leaving him constantly frustrated.

本来个性更加桀傲不驯，颇有轻狂之色，自认剑法已臻大成，放眼当世不见抗手，正意气风发准备下山闯出一番名堂，便被族妹唤去南阳杏花林，以奇门阵法监禁了足有三个月之久，叫天天不应，叫地地不灵，砍了树还会长，飞天遁地都逃不出杏花仙的五指山。被放出来以后，人消瘦了几圈，人也变得谦虚善良了，同时理解了那是他所不能染指的危险人物。也被下令不准引诱魏菊，非常委屈。=Originally, his personality was even more arrogant and unruly, with a somewhat frivolous demeanor. Believing his swordsmanship had reached perfection and that no contemporary could rival him, he was brimming with ambition, ready to descend the mountain and make a name for himself. But then his cousin summoned him to the Xinghua Forest in Nanyang, where he was trapped for a full three months by an esoteric formation—crying to heaven with no response, begging earth with no relief. Trees he cut down would regrow, and neither flight nor escape could free him from Xinghua Immortal's grasp.\nAfter being released, he had thinned considerably and had become humble and kind. He also came to understand that she was a dangerous figure beyond his reach.\nHe was also ordered not to seduce Wei Ju, which left him feeling deeply wronged.

叶云舟的胞妹，我见犹怜的病美人。生来体弱，经常发烧卧病在床，幸而生性达观，不以为意。爱撒娇，点苍上下无不溺爱于她，可谓呼风唤雨。虽然在兄长督促下习练点苍武功心法，但限于体质，纵使记得滚瓜烂熟，亦难有进境，连走得稍微快些都会喘，更遑论舞刀弄剑。没有特别的爱好，但是对于山下的世界充满好奇。讨厌吃苦，讨厌吃药，硬是强喂就会吐，吐完还会一副幸灾乐祸的嘴脸嘲讽人。=Ye Yunzhou's younger sister, a sickly beauty who evokes tenderness in all who see her.\nBorn with a weak constitution, she often falls ill with fevers and remains bedridden.\nFortunately, she is naturally optimistic and unbothered by her condition.\nShe loves to act coy, and everyone in the Diancang Sect dotes on her excessively,\ngiving her virtually unchecked influence.\nThough she practices Diancang's martial arts and Heart Method under her brother's supervision, her physique limits her progress. Even if she memorizes everything perfectly, she can barely walk faster without getting breathless, let alone wield swords or blades.\nShe has no particular hobbies but is intensely curious about the world beyond the mountain.\nShe hates bitterness and detests medicine—if forced to take it, she will vomit,\nafter which she'll smirk with gleeful schadenfreude and mock whoever tried to make her take it.

不知为何与兄长下得山来，却被点苍山派人缉拿。江湖中人觊觎者亦在所多有，为此不得不藏匿行踪。放着无忧无虑的好日子不过，宁可任性地浪迹天涯。旅途艰辛，使她发烧病倒的频率变得更高了，每当意识朦胧，只要捉着兄长的衣襬就能安然睡去。「有哥哥在就好，其他的什么我都不要了，像现在这样相依为命，跟从前一样……」=For some reason, after descending the mountain with her brother,\nshe became a target of pursuit by the Diancang Sect.\nMany in the Jianghu also covet her for unknown reasons,\nforcing them to conceal their whereabouts.\nRather than living a carefree life, she willfully chooses to wander the world. The hardships of travel have made her fevers and collapses more frequent. Whenever her consciousness fades, clutching her brother's sleeve allows her to sleep peacefully.\n「Having my brother here is enough; I don't need anything else.\nRelying on each other like this, just like before......」

不知为何与兄长下得山来，却被点苍山派人缉拿。江湖中人觊觎者亦在所多有，为此不得不藏匿行踪。放着无忧无虑的好日子不过，宁可任性地浪迹天涯。旅途艰辛，使她发烧病倒的频率变得更高了，每当意识朦胧，只要捉着兄长的衣襬就能安然睡去。「有哥哥在就好，其他的什么我都不要了，像现在这样相依为命，跟从前一样......」=I don't know why, but after descending the mountain with her brother,\nshe became a target of pursuit by the Diancang Sect.\nMany in the Jianghu also covet her for unknown reasons,\nforcing them to conceal their whereabouts.\nRather than living a carefree life, she willfully chooses to wander the world. The hardships of travel have made her fevers and collapses more frequent. Whenever her consciousness fades, clutching her brother's sleeve allows her to sleep peacefully.\n「Having my brother here is enough; I don't need anything else.\nRelying on each other like this, just like before......」

她身上藏有重大的秘密。叶氏兄妹的曾祖，乃是抗金名将武穆王之子岳云手下的得力大将之一。相传高宗连下十二道金牌，岳飞为全忠义，自甘赴死，惟叹抗金大业未竟，若兵权被奸佞所夺，大宋势将无力回天。故将岳家军主力支散，并藏宝于山中，铸铁兵符交由长子岳云保管，以期未来能执兵符号令旧部，继承护国之志。岂料岳云竟先于其父身死，危难之中托付兵符于部属，嘱其遁隐江湖，静待武穆后人来取。那名部署就此隐姓埋名，避世隐居山林，实则代代死守兵符。白风峒变乱之时，叶家因言获罪，得咎于当朝天子，惨遭灭门之灾，叶家兄妹就此成为孤儿。=She carries a significant secret.\nThe great-grandfather of the Ye siblings was one of the key generals under Yue Yun, son of the anti-Jin hero Prince Wumu (Yue Fei).\nLegend says that when Emperor Gaozong issued twelve golden summons, Yue Fei chose to die for loyalty, lamenting only that the fight against the Jin remained unfinished. Fearing military power would fall into treacherous hands and the Song would be doomed, he dispersed the main Yue Army, hid treasures in the mountains, and entrusted an iron tally to his eldest son Yue Yun, hoping it could someday rally old troops to continue protecting the nation.\nUnexpectedly, Yue Yun died before his father. In crisis, he passed the tally to a subordinate, instructing them to vanish into the Jianghu and wait for a descendant of Wumu to claim it.\nThat subordinate changed their name, retreating to seclusion in the mountains—but in truth, generations have guarded the tally unto death.\nDuring the White Wind Cave rebellion, the Ye family was condemned for speech crimes against the Emperor, leading to a brutal extermination. The Ye siblings were orphaned from that day.

家破人亡那一日，年幼的云裳被朝廷派遣的武林高手给拍了一掌，丹田破碎，经脉尽断，眼见难活。后来历经千难万险，才勉强保住性命，拜入点苍门下。她貌似天真烂漫，其实一直心怀戒慎，就连救她性命的恩师，也不敢轻信。直到你和默铃出现为止。只恨她身作女儿身，这辈子想娶默铃是指望不上了，好在还能够退而求其次，嫁你为妻。虽说你丑，她本来是宁可死了也不愿以身相许，谁知道你这人当真死心塌地，追到地狱也不肯松手。被这样宠过，试问天底谁能不动心呢？总之她不行。=On the day her family was destroyed, the young Yunshang was struck by a martial arts expert sent by the court—her dantian shattered, meridians severed, left with little hope of survival.\nAfter enduring countless hardships, she barely clung to life and eventually joined the Diancang Sect.\nShe appears innocent and carefree, but in truth, she has always been wary—even of the Master who saved her life, she dared not fully trust.\nThat is, until you and Moling appeared.\nShe regrets being born a woman, knowing she can never hope to marry Moling in this lifetime. Fortunately, she can settle for the next best thing: marrying you.\nThough she'd rather die than pledge herself to someone as unattractive as you, who knew you'd be so utterly devoted, chasing her even into hell without letting go.\nAfter being cherished like that, who in the world wouldn't be moved?\nWell, except her—or so she claims.

师承锦香宫，剑法精绝的清丽佳人。踏着父亲从前的足迹踽踽前行，向往能够承其父志，行侠四方。虽然如此，由于不谙世事，意外地容易受骗上当。=A graceful beauty trained in Jinxiang Palace, with exquisite sword skills.\nShe walks alone in the footsteps her father once left, aspiring to uphold his ideals and roam the world championing justice. However, due to her lack of worldly experience, she is surprisingly easy to deceive.

对父亲的记忆，如今很稀薄了。遥远记忆里那一日，他摸摸她小脑袋瓜，一笑出门去，便再也不曾回来。后来锦香宫温夫人才接了她去，收入门墙。辗转听人传闻，才知道父亲是武林传奇，既悲伤又骄傲，沿着父亲的足迹，造访故人，想搜集更多已故生父的故事，凭此怀念。一身剑法皆得于家传秘籍，龙渊七绝中，尤擅剑法，自小便以鸡腿为剑，悟出人剑合一的奥义而浑不自觉，至今也不太清楚自己究竟算不算高手。不过武功再高，依然会迷路、被骗钱、饿晕在路边，这样都能生存，运气实在不得了。=Memories of her father have grown faint now.\nIn a distant memory, he patted her little head, smiled, walked out the door, and never returned.\nLater, Madam Wen of Jinxiang Palace took her in and accepted her as a disciple.\nThrough scattered rumors, she learned her father was a Jianghu legend. Both sorrowful and proud, she followed his footsteps, visiting old acquaintances to collect more stories about her late father, clinging to them as keepsakes.\nAll her sword skills come from a family manual. Among the "Long Yuan Seven Ultimates", she excels particularly in swordsmanship. Since childhood, she used chicken legs as swords, unconsciously grasping the essence of unity between human and blade—yet to this day, she isn't quite sure if she counts as a Master.\nBut no matter how skilled she becomes, she still gets lost, scammed, and faints from hunger by the roadside. That she survives all this is nothing short of incredible luck.
在实战中逐渐熟练，已经能够不骄不躁，随心所欲驱使剑术，成为了有名的女侠，兼而貌美如花，慕名而来追求者络绎不绝。龙湘情窦初开，亦不免心下窃喜，只是笨拙未解风情，为了遮羞，便以武会友，以剑交心，结果求爱者纷纷败于剑下，灰头土脸而去，就是她好言相慰，亦不能免其挫折，好些心气高者，封剑退隐亦不足为奇。久而久之，便看淡了，见了谁来示好，都下重手，打得对方越惨，越能看出对方心性，江湖男儿到底好面子，谁能容她这般剽悍呢。武功虽然高，但是生活一团糟，没有自理能力，没有人弄她，就可以害死自己。=Through actual combat, she gradually honed her skills, learning to wield her sword with calm mastery. She became a famous heroine, and with her stunning beauty, suitors flocked to her endlessly.\nLong Xiang, experiencing first love, couldn't help but feel secretly delighted. However, being awkward and unaware of romantic cues, she masked her shyness by challenging admirers to spar—using swords to communicate. As a result, suitors were consistently defeated, leaving humiliated. Even her kind words couldn't ease their frustration, and many proud men gave up swordsmanship and retired—no surprise there.\nOver time, she grew indifferent. Whenever someone showed interest, she would respond fiercely. The more brutally she defeated them, the better she could gauge their character. But Jianghu men pride themselves on reputation—who could tolerate such ferocity?\nThough her martial arts are exceptional, her daily life is chaotic. Without self-care skills, left to her own devices, she could easily end up harming herself.

放眼江湖，挨她毒打最多次的人，莫过于你了。怎么打都锲而不舍，反是她越打越不舍得。她厌倦了空有皮相，锦衣华服，卖弄潇洒风流的武林少侠，偏爱你的骨气。『我的心上人，是天下第一的大英雄，大豪杰，铁骨铮铮，顶天立地。』就像父亲一样，如是说道，龙湘事后脸红了三天，见了你就会立刻拔剑相向。但是离不开你的照顾，最终都只能强抑着羞耻心回到你身边。偶尔也想振作起来，干些为人妻子的本份，因此在缝补衣物时撕烂了你的衣衫、在煮菜时烧了房子。你最好别对这人心怀期待。=In all the Jianghu, no one has endured her brutal beatings more than you.\nNo matter how many times she strikes, you persevere relentlessly—yet the more she hits, the more she finds it hard to truly harm you.\nShe has grown tired of those Jianghu young masters who rely on handsome looks, fine robes, and flaunted charm, and instead admires your unyielding spirit.\n『My beloved is the greatest hero under heaven, a magnificent champion with iron resolve who stands tall between heaven and earth』. Comparing you to her father, she said this—and then blushed for three days straight, drawing her sword on you every time she saw you afterward.\nBut she can't live without your care, so she always swallows her shame and returns to you in the end.\nOccasionally, she tries to step up and fulfill her duties as a wife, only to tear your clothes while mending them or burn down the house while cooking.\nYou'd best not hold any expectations for this person.

崆峒派‧飞天门当代的嫡传女弟子，天真烂漫，活泼开朗的妙龄少女。江湖名声不响，在崆峒派却是四门嫡传女弟子之中呼声最高的一位，第一掌派夫人之位，势在必得。=The contemporary direct lineage female disciple of the Kongtong Sect's Flying Heaven Gate. A youthful maiden, innocent and lively, vibrant and cheerful.\nThough her reputation in the Jianghu is not prominent, within the Kongtong Sect, she is the most highly regarded among the four gates' direct lineage female disciples. The position of the Sect's First Lady is virtually within her grasp.

Kongtong派‧飞天门当代的嫡传女弟子，天真烂漫，活泼开朗的妙龄少女。江湖名声不响，在崆峒派却是四门嫡传女弟子之中呼声最高的一位，第一掌派夫人之位，势在必得。=The contemporary direct lineage female disciple of the Kongtong Sect's Flying Heaven Gate. A youthful maiden, innocent and lively, vibrant and cheerful.\nThough her reputation in the Jianghu is not prominent, within the Kongtong Sect, she is the most highly regarded among the four gates' direct lineage female disciples. The position of the Sect's First Lady is virtually within her grasp.

一身红白衣裙，恰似雪里梅花，清丽绝俗。年纪虽轻，位份却高，比飞天门大弟子都要金贵，除却四掌门，当属小梅地位最尊。饶是如此，却没半分臭架子，每日都在崆峒山上下跑窜，热心助人，活泼开朗，爱闹爱笑，擅长结交朋友。豢有仙鹤一只，名曰火闪电。是当代崆峒四姝中声望最高的一位，将来嫁予崆峒掌派人，成为第一夫人，彷佛已是既定之数。=Dressed in red and white robes, like plum blossoms in snow, ethereally elegant beyond worldly norms.\nThough young, her status is high—even more valued than the Head Disciple of the Flying Heaven Gate. Aside from the four Sect Leaders, Xiaomei holds the most respected position.\nYet she carries not a hint of arrogance, bustling up and down Kongtong Mountain every day, eager to help others, lively and cheerful, loving fun and laughter, and skilled at making friends.\nShe keeps a celestial crane named Fire Lightning.\nShe is the most renowned among the contemporary Four Beauties of Kongtong, and it seems almost destined that she will marry the Kongtong Sect Leader and become the Sect Leader's First Wife.

据说，小梅生母是极乐教妖女。其母脱离魔爪以后，嫁人生女，安贫乐道，无奈好景不常，火龙仙君美其名曰刬恶除奸，狠心拆散天伦，强收虞氏孤女为门下弟子，改名小梅，着意培养，欲图第一掌派夫人之位，以此稳固的权势。是以小梅看似天真烂漫，其实对崆峒派揣怀着仇恨，总是笑吟吟的穿针引线，将种种事情往恶劣的局势诱导，作为报复。甚至私下将本门秘籍《仙鹤迷踪拳》传授给火闪电，强迫鸟学武功，都不顾火闪电的感受，简直不可理喻。=Rumors say Xiaomei's biological mother was a demoness from the Blissful Cult.\nAfter escaping the cult, her mother married, had a daughter, and lived contentedly in poverty. But this peace was short-lived. The Fire Dragon Immortal Lord, under the pretext of eradicating evil, heartlessly tore the family apart, forcibly took the orphaned Yu girl as his disciple, renamed her Xiaomei, and meticulously groomed her to become the future Sect's First Lady; all to consolidate his own power.\nThus, beneath her innocent and lively appearance, Xiaomei harbors deep hatred for the Kongtong Sect. She always smiles sweetly while subtly pulling strings, steering situations toward chaos as a form of revenge.\nShe even secretly taught the sect's prized manual,《Immortal Crane Tracing Fist》, to her crane Fire Lightning, forcing the bird to learn martial arts—com disregarding its feelings—which is utterly absurd.

就连可怜身世也是虚假的，不过是为了取信崆峒派而刻意编造、安排的假亲人。其真实身份，乃是神秘组织「千灯楼」精心培养的冷血刺客，新任千面人魔候补，精擅易容、毒术、诡计、话术，甚至能以迷魂大法惑人心智。暗中分化崆峒四门，以美色诱杀崆峒才俊无数，只待时机一至，将偌大崆峒覆灭于己手，以此邀功，承袭千面人魔之名。如是种种，亦为假象，是为取信监视者勾魂叟，骗得尸心蛊解药所布的迷障。小梅深藏的憎恶所向，唯有千灯楼主一人而已，心中无所爱，残喘至今，愿杀一人而已。=Even her pitiable background is fabricated—a carefully constructed lie with arranged false relatives to gain the Kongtong Sect's trust.\nHer true identity is that of a cold-blooded assassin trained by the mysterious organization called the「Thousand Lanterns Tower」, a candidate to succeed the Thousand-Faced Demon. She excels in disguise, poison, deception, persuasion, and even uses soul-hypnotizing techniques to manipulate minds.\nSecretly dividing the four branches of Kongtong, she has lured and killed countless talented members with her beauty, waiting for the moment to destroy the entire sect with her own hands—all to claim merit and inherit the title of Thousand-Faced Demon.\nYet even all of this is an illusion, a facade to deceive her overseer, the Soul-Snatching Elder, and obtain the antidote for the Corpse-Heart Gu poison.\nThe deep-seated hatred Xiaomei harbors is directed solely at the Master of Thousand Lanterns Tower. She holds no love in her heart, clinging to life for one purpose only: to kill that one person.

每当你出现在附近，小梅心中就会萌生一股又爱又恨的矛盾悸动，恨不得捅你几刀，终究不忍；嘴上嫌你难看，偏又爱不释手。好歹你只是卖相不佳，不似其他人都一张嘴脸，淡而乏味，谁是谁都分不清楚。尽管隐藏得很好，但是小梅对你的执着，已经近乎病态。假如你不忠，打算三妻四妾的话，她会笑着答应，再找机会把你推下楼梯，弄个半死不活，以迷魂法软禁，让你哪里也不能去，只能仰仗她过余生。可你若专心无猜，她就是为你舍了性命，也甘之如饴。你目光远眺的方向，就是她的未来，无论天涯海角，都奉陪到底，与你既是生死之交，也是伴侣。=Whenever you appear nearby, Xiaomei feels a conflicted stir of love and hatred—wanting to stab you, yet ultimately holding back. She complains about your looks but can't help being drawn to you.\nAt least you're just unattractive in appearance, unlike others who all wear the same bland, forgettable faces, making it hard to tell them apart.\nThough well hidden, her obsession with you has become almost pathological.\nIf you were unfaithful and planned to take multiple wives, she would agree with a smile, then find a chance to push you down the stairs, leave you half-dead, and confine you with soul-hypnosis—nowhere to go, relying on her for the rest of your life.\nBut if you remain devoted and unwavering, she would gladly give her life for you without hesitation.\nThe direction your gaze reaches is her future. Whether to the ends of the earth, she will follow you to the end, as both your life-and-death companion and your partner.

崆峒派‧夺魄门当代的嫡传女弟子，江湖人称夺魄幽兰，恶名昭彰的女魔头，行事作风狠辣乖戾，幽居在不见天日的夺魄森林中，生人勿近。=The contemporary direct lineage female disciple of the Kongtong Sect's Soul-Snatching Gate. Known in the Jianghu as Soul-Snatching Ghost Orchid, she is a notorious female demon—ruthless and eccentric in her actions, secluded in the sunless Soul-Snatching Forest, where no living soul dares approach.
Kongtong  派‧夺魄门当代的嫡传女弟子，江湖人称夺魄幽兰，恶名昭彰的女魔头，行事作风狠辣乖戾，幽居在不见天日的夺魄森林中，生人勿近。=The contemporary direct lineage female disciple of the Kongtong Sect's Soul-Snatching Gate. 容姿凄艳，武艺高超，令诸多年轻侠客神魂颠倒，曾是最有望成为第一掌派夫人的崆峒女弟子。只可惜昔年那一出悲剧，改写了这位姑娘的人生，那日起她就像失了魂般，再也不曾开怀笑过，不知目视何方，纵使晴天也撑着伞，彷佛她眼中的世界，大雨从未消停过。=With her stunning beauty and exceptional martial arts skills, she captivated the hearts of many young heroes, and was once the most promising female disciple from the Kongtong Sect likely to become the First Lady of the sect.\nUnfortunately, a tragedy in those years altered the course of her life. 夏侯兰是如今已遭灭门的雪山派遗孤。未出世之际，便与上官世家有指腹为婚之谊，她爹娘想让孩儿在温暖的地方落地生根，离此苦寒之地，一世无忧。如今一切都成了梦幻泡影。她走过雨水风霜，见过人情冷暖，挺身力抗过不可抗衡的权威，战过无法战胜的敌人。深爱过某人，把心弄得伤痕累累。渴望的事物求不得，手中仅存的也抓不牢。夏侯兰的故事已经结束了。往后的事，与你相遇的事也不过是味如嚼蜡的余兴而已。=Xiahou Lan is the sole survivor of the now-extinct Snow Mountain Sect. 晚安，唐门。=Goodnight, Tang Sect.

各方豪侠都想染指此刀，为此不惜大打出手、自相残杀。什么同道情谊都罔顾了，盟主的号令也不济事，=Heroes from all sides coveted this blade, willing to fight and kill each other for it.\nAll camaraderie was cast aside, and even the Alliance Leader's commands proved useless.

三十六年后，你功力已臻圆满，携爱妻之手再涉江湖。于合州钓鱼山之战再现唐门暗器神技，掷石击杀蒙古大汗蒙哥，迫使蒙古退兵，技惊当世，事了旋即拂衣而去。=Thirty-six years later, your skills had reached perfection. 第三个三年，她有事耽搁，来迟了一点。=In the third three-year cycle, she was delayed by some matter and arrived a little late.
第四个三年，她迟到两天，走路也一跛一跛的。=In the fourth three-year cycle, she was two days late and walked with a limp.
第五个三年，你日日在阶上坐着等她，在唐门旧址住了大半年，她也没来，你隐约知道，也许再也见不到面了。=In the fifth three-year cycle, you sat on the steps waiting for her day after day.\nYou stayed at the old Tang Sect site for over half a year, but she never came. You vaguely understood, perhaps you would never meet again.

////-------------Story 11////-------------

唐门诸位师弟妹、弟子齐聚在此共证，我唐升以代掌门身份，将要宣告一件至关重大的决策。=All fellow junior disciples and members of the Tang Sect gathered here as witnesses,\nI, Tang Sheng, as acting Sect Leader, am about to announce an extremely important decision.
如诸位所知悉，本门秉持侠义，除非中原浩劫，否则从不结党。所习毒药、暗器，亦常为正道中人所不齿，诟病者在所多有。我们行得正、坐得直，却非世人所云「武林正派」。=As you all know, our sect upholds chivalry and never forms factions unless the Central Plains face a great catastrophe.\nThe poisons and hidden weapons we practice are often despised by the orthodox, attracting much criticism.\nWe walk the path of righteousness and hold ourselves with integrity, yet we are not what the world calls a「Righteous Wulin Sect」.
在官府中人的眼里，所行更是罄竹难书。虽然未被指为反逆，终似芒刺在背。=In the eyes of government officials, our actions are considered too numerous to record.\nThough not accused of rebellion, we are like a thorn in their side.
如今朝廷欲假武林盟之手，排除异己，整肃江湖。泥教首当其冲，其后便是唐门，我等若不投诚，迟早覆灭于武林盟之手。=Now the court intends to use the Wulin Alliance to eliminate dissidents and purge the Jianghu.\nThe Mud Sect bears the brunt first, and the Tang Sect will be next. If we do not surrender, we will eventually be destroyed by the Wulin Alliance.
又或者夹着尾巴逃跑，各奔东西苟活，留得青山在，不怕没柴烧。=Or we could tuck our tails and run, scattering to survive, as long as the green hills remain, we'll never run out of firewood.
──但是我胆子太小，固然怕死，更不敢逃！一走了之聪明，但那就不是唐门风骨。怕逃了去，一生挺不起脊梁，愧对唐家列祖列宗！=—But I am too timid.
