他们讲究的很，不像本门弟子手里抓到什么都能当暗器丢，每日精心保养爱剑，往往一生只用一柄剑。=They are extremely meticulous, unlike our sect's disciples who can throw anything they get their hands on as hidden weapons.\nThey carefully maintain their beloved swords every day, often using only one sword their entire lives.
都说剑在人在，剑毁人亡，实际上剑卷刃了换新的还是大有人在。还有不少人特地到火炎山剑阁求剑的。=They say, "the sword is present when the person is present, the sword is destroyed when the person perishes". But in reality, many still replace their swords when the edges get dull.\nThere are also quite a few who make a special trip to the Flame Mountain Sword Pavilion to seek new swords.
要是以剑为妻的话，相当于再娶吧……。要是一人有很多柄剑，是不是等于三妻四妾呢？=If the sword is considered a wife, then getting a new one is like remarrying...\nIf one person has many swords, does that equal having three wives and four concubines?
但也有一些点苍剑客追求剑道，近乎疯魔。以为不能顿悟，是因尘世牵绊太多，才拌住了出剑的速度。为了参悟天机，挥剑斩情丝亦在所不辞，抛妻弃子的也大有人在。=However, there are also some Diancang swordsmen who pursue the Way of the sword to the point of near madness.\nThey believe that their inability to attain enlightenment is due to too many worldly attachments hindering the speed of their sword strikes.\nIn order to comprehend the secrets of heaven, they would not hesitate to cut ties of affection with a swing of their sword, many have even abandoned their wives and children.
你别不信，还真的有这种人。=Don't think I'm making this up, there really are such people.
其中偏执者甚至提倡「杀亲证道」这种骇人听闻的邪说，想尽办法污蔑亲人，再杀了才心安理得，然后幻想自己了无牵挂、功力更上一层楼。=Among them, the most extreme even advocate the shocking and horrifying heresy of「Killing Kin to Prove the Dao」.\nThey go to great lengths to vilify their family members, then kill them to ease their conscience,\nfantasizing that by being free of attachments, their skills have ascended to a higher level.
这事听起来惊世骇俗，但当局者迷，好一阵子在点苍派蔚为流行。碰到瓶颈的，就会把主意打到自己亲人头上，搞得点苍派乌烟瘴气。=This matter sounds shocking, but those involved were blind to it, and for a good while it became quite popular in the Diancang Sect.\nThose who encountered bottlenecks would set their sights on their own relatives, making the Diancang Sect a foul atmosphere.
点苍双尊费尽心思勘误、制止，带得意弟子白虹剑客、朝阳剑客，加上苍松剑客，将杀亲犯全都斩去手腕，逐出师门，移送官府，这种邪说才终于消失。=The Diancang Two Venerables exhausted efforts to correct errors and stop it, bringing their esteemed disciples White Rainbow Swordsman and Morning Sun Swordsman,\nalong with Azure Pine Swordsman, to sever the wrists of all those who killed their relatives, expel them from the sect, and hand them over to the authorities.\nOnly then did this heresy finally disappear.
每个艺成下山闯荡的点苍弟子，回家都会被恩师赐一个外号。=Every Diancang disciple who completes their training and goes down the mountain to make their way will be bestowed an epithet by their Master upon their return.
好比「白虹剑客」徐光辉、「朝阳剑客」盛鸿年、「苍松剑客」叶云舟，掌门观云客年轻时叫「观云剑客」，听海生叫「听海剑客」。以此推类。=For example,「White Rainbow Swordsman」Xu Guanghui,「Morning Sun Swordsman」Sheng Hongnian,「Azure Pine Swordsman」Ye Yunzhou.\nSect Leader Guan Yunke was called「Cloud-Gazing Swordsman」in his youth, Ting Haisheng was called「Sea-Listening Swordsman」.\nAnd so on.
其中叶云舟更是点苍当代的佼佼者，一出道就以快剑震惊武林。人又谦虚，颇受江湖好评，都说他是点苍第一快剑手。=Among them, Ye Yunzhou stands out as the foremost of the contemporary Diancang disciples. From his debut, he astounded the martial world with his swift sword techniques.\nHe is also humble and quite well-regarded in the jianghu, said to be the fastest swordsman in Diancang.
江湖外号嘛，通常不是武功上别树一格的长处，就是彰显人品特质。点苍派这样取，反而让人不知道他们究竟是怎样的人物，特别容易忘。=Jianghu epithets usually either highlight a unique martial arts strength or showcase a character trait.\nThe way the Diancang Sect assigns them, however, makes it hard to tell what kind of people they really are, and they're especially easy to forget.
点苍派从前曾经出过一位惊世骇俗的奇才，江湖人尊称他为剑圣。=The Diancang Sect once produced a stunningly talented genius, revered by the jianghu as the Sword Sage.
其实剑圣这个外号吧，真是太泛滥了。动不动就会有自称剑圣、剑神的冒出来。但我说的是点苍剑圣。=Actually, the epithet "Sword Sage" is really overused.\nEvery now and then someone claiming to be a Sword Sage or Sword God pops up.\nBut the one I'm talking about is the Diancang Sword Sage.
相传前朝点苍剑圣孤高绝傲，自南来问剑于中原，败尽了当代英雄，又急流勇退，归隐于大理点苍山剑庐之中。=Legend has it that the previous dynasty's Diancang Sword Sage was aloof and supremely arrogant. He came from the south to challenge the Central Plains with his sword, defeating all the contemporary Heroes,\nthen retired at the height of his fame, secluding himself to the Sword Retreat on Mount Diancang in Dali.
听说剑圣故居中藏有三式剑意，唯有天资绝顶、身具剑骨之人能够参悟。唯恐破坏剑圣故居，所以平时都派人严格把守。唯有建了大功劳的点苍弟子，能得允许进入剑庐三日，参悟武功。=I heard that within the Sword Sage's former residence, three profound sword intents are hidden. Only those with peerless talent and a Sword bone(natural aptitude) can comprehend them.\nTo prevent damage to the Sword Sage's former residence, it is strictly guarded at all times.\nOnly Diancang disciples who have made significant contributions are permitted to enter the Sword Retreat for three days to meditate and contemplate the martial secrets.
能够参悟出那三式剑圣遗招的人，就会袭名为当代剑圣。地位比点苍掌门还要崇高，连大理皇帝都会破格礼贤。=Those who can comprehend those three intents left by the Sword Sage will inherit the title of Contemporary Sword Sage.\nTheir status is even higher than the Diancang Sect Leader's, and even the Dali Emperor will break protocol to treat them with respect.
点苍派和本门是怎样结仇的？这个说来话长了。=How did the Diancang Sect and our sect become enemies? That's a long story.
从前从前，有一对江湖侠侣发生了争执，什么由头不打紧，反正各有各的说法，都对，也都不对。=Once upon a time, a Heroic couple in the martial world had a disagreement. The exact reason isn't important,\neach had their own version of the story, both were right, and both were wrong.
这对夫妻各自拉人评理，江湖人嘛，说僵了自然就动武了，也不是什么大不了的事，其中被卷进去的就有本门前辈。=This couple each gathered people to judge their dispute. Jianghu folk, when talks break down, naturally resort to force.\nIt wasn't really a big deal. Among those dragged into it were seniors from our own sect.
这时点苍派当时剑圣路过，扮猪吃老虎，硬是要搅和进去，被人给欺负了，再现出真本领震惊众人，以强大气势震慑当场，让所有人都得听他。=At that time, the Diancang Sword Sage happened to pass by, playing dumb to deceive the tiger, he deliberately involved himself into the conflict,\nallowed himself to be bullied, and then revealed his true skills, astonishing everyone. With his overwhelming presence, he dominated the scene,\nforcing everyone to listen to him.
然后本门前辈大怒若狂，怒道：「万事抬不过个理字，你武功高又怎地？旁人巴结你，唐门却偏不！我们是打不过你，却不想听你的话！」言罢就服毒自尽了。=Then, the senior from our sect flew into a furious rage and shouted:\n「Everything boils down to reason. So what if your martial arts are high? Others may flatter you, but the Tang Sect refuses!\nWe can't defeat you, but we refuse to listen to you!」 After saying this, he took poison and killed himself.
当时唐家掌门听闻此事也怒了，于是下药暗算，废了剑圣的武功，看他没了武功，还怎样用鼻孔看人。结果可想而知，两派就此结了深仇大恨。=The Tang Clan Sect Leader at the time heard about this and also became angry, so he drugged and ambushed the Sword Sage,\nwasting his martial arts, to see how he would look down on people without his skills.\nThe outcome was predictable, the two sects developed a deep-seated grudge from then on.
本门和点苍派大小架打过该有几十回了吧。通常都是点苍派主动杀到蜀中来，偶尔我们也会派人去把他们毒的东倒西歪。=Our sect and the Diancang Sect have probably fought several dozen times, big and small.\nUsually it's the Diancang Sect actively coming to Sichuan to fight, occasionally we also send people to poison them until they're reeling.
点苍派在大理，却以中原六大派自居，也不是没想过迁居中原。但是老被本门恶意阻拦，至今没能如愿。=The Diancang Sect is located in Dali but considers itself one of the Six Major Sects of the Central Plains. It's not that they haven't thought about relocating to the Central Plains,\nbut our sect has consistently and deliberately obstructed them, so they have never been able to fulfill this wish.
二十年前决战旧魔教一役之后，本门元气大伤，不久点苍派又趁机寻衅，挑战咱们掌门。那时掌门已经患病，依然悍不畏死，率门人应战。=Twenty years ago, after the battle against the old demon cult, our sect was severely weakened.\nNot long after, the Diancang Sect took the opportunity to pick a fight, challenging our Sect Leader.\nAt that time, the Sect Leader was already ill, but still fearlessly led the disciples into battle.
这一仗打了意外很久，差点连南宫世家都劝不了。师娘便是在这时丢下小师妹与世长辞的，掌门悲痛至极，隐患深入骨髓，至今依然饱受折磨。=This battle dragged on unexpectedly long, to the point where even the Nangong family struggled to mediate.\nIt was during this time that my Master's wife passed away, leaving behind Little Junior Sister. The Sect Leader was grief-stricken, the hidden trauma penetrating deep into his bones,\nand he still suffers greatly from it to this day.
掌门虽然击败了点苍剑圣，唐门却输了。在南宫家主居中调停下，掌门没取剑圣的性命，只逼他封剑退隐，换取点苍退兵。=Although the Sect Leader defeated the Diancang Sword Sage, the Tang Sect lost.\nUnder the mediation of the Head of the Nangong Family, the Sect Leader did not take the Sword Sage's life, only forced him to seal his sword and retire,\nin exchange for Diancang's withdrawal.
青城派是道家正一盟威之道，奉张天师为尊。会画符念咒，道士也可以娶妻生子，跟全真道不同。他们说的无为丹道，练的其实是内丹，不是吃的那种。=The Qingcheng Sect follows the Daoist Orthodox Unity Covenant with the Powers, revering Celestial Master Zhang as their Supreme Leader.\nThey practice talisman drawing and incantations, and their Daoist priests are allowed to marry and have children, unlike the Quanzhen Daoist priests.\nThe Elixir Path of Non-Action they speak of actually refers to internal alchemy, not the kind you ingest.
但是青城掌门邹博邹道长，昔年与全真七子中的太古真人郝大通，乃是忘机道友，曾有一同讲经论道的美谈，由此引进了全真的外丹术。青城「还虚丹」就是邹掌门和郝道长共研的心血结晶。=However, the Qingcheng Sect Leader, Daoist Master Zou Bo, was once a close friend of Hao Datong, the Primordial Ancient Perfected One of the Quanzhen Seven Sons.\nThey shared the celebrated tradition of discussing scriptures and debating the Dao, which led to the introduction of Quanzhen's external alchemy techniques into Qingcheng.\nThe Qingcheng "Return to Emptiness Elixir" is the culmination of the joint research and efforts of Sect Leader Zou and Daoist Master Hao.
听说极其希罕，掌门在旧魔教战后伤病缠身，邹道长就曾送过一枚。掌门赐给二师兄，拿去化开研究，改良了本门的胡椒粉毒。可惜依然治不好掌门的痼疾，唉。=I heard it's extremely rare. After the war against the former Demon Sect, the Sect Leader was plagued with injuries and illnesses. Daoist Master Zou once gifted him one of these pills.\nThe Sect Leader bestowed it upon the Second Senior Brother, who dissolved it for research and improved our sect's Pepper Powder Poison.\nUnfortunately, it still couldn't cure the Sect Leader's chronic illness. What a pity.
青城派修练讲究守中致和，了一化万，万化归一，一归虚无。所以大抵青城道士都清心寡欲，修养特别好。=The Qingcheng Sect's cultivation emphasizes maintaining balance to achieve harmony, transforming one into ten thousand, and ten thousand back into one, with one ultimately returning to emptiness.\nTherefore, most Qingcheng Daoist priests are clear-minded and desire little, possessing exceptionally refined cultivation.
江湖曾经有句不太礼貌的老话，说的是：「江湖碰得到的青城弟子，都是凡心未泯的半桶水，真正厉害的都在山里，从不争名夺利，只成他的仙。」=There was once a rather impolite old saying in the martial world:\n「The Qingcheng disciples you meet in the martial world are all half-hearted, their mortal desires still lingering.\nThe truly formidable ones remain in the mountains, never striving for fame or gain, only pursuing their path to Immortality.」
青城派用剑，但强项是气功。青城气功难学难精，和全真刚好两个极端，一个深奥，一个亲民没门坎。=The Qingcheng Sect uses swords, but their true strength lies in qigong.\nQingcheng qigong is difficult to learn and even harder to Master, standing in stark contrast to Quanzhen's approach, one is profound and abstruse, while the other is accessible and has no barriers to entry.
青城派气功练到精深处，出剑有雷霆之声，对手兵刃若是凡铁，一交便折，这我是亲眼见过的。甚至不必用动刀剑，拿一柄拂尘灌注真气都能当铁锤砸人，再厉害不过。=When Qingcheng Sect qigong is practiced to a profound level, drawing the sword produces a thunderous sound. If the opponent's weapon is made of ordinary iron,\nit will break upon contact, this is something I have witnessed with my own eyes.\nThey don't even need to use blades; even a horsetail whisk infused with True qi can be wielded like an iron hammer to strike people, it's truly formidable.
邹掌门便是一名气功宗师，玄门正宗参同秘契，当世只有他一人会使。要说有多厉害？我打个比方。大师兄、二师兄、我、四师弟迭在一起跟他比拼内力，恐怕也输多胜少。=Sect Leader Zou is a true Master of qigong, the only one in the current era who comprehends the esoteric art of Orthodox Congruence, rooted in the Secret Kinship of the Three.\nHow powerful is it? Let me give you an example.\nEven if the First Senior Brother, Second Senior Brother, me, and Fourth Junior Brother joined forces to compete with him in internal strength, we would still likely lose more often than win.
虽说内功是本门短处，但相差如此悬殊，你就该知道青城内功有多厉害。大家都知道，只有傻子才去跟青城弟子比拼内力。=Although internal strength is our sect's weakness, such a vast disparity shows just how powerful Qingcheng's internal arts are.\nEveryone knows only a fool would challenge a Qingcheng disciple to an internal strength contest.
……当年旧魔教颠峰决战最末，正邪各出三名绝世高手，决生死、论英雄。盟主大侠龙渊对决极乐教主李仁友、我们掌门对决极乐右使。最后一名人选，便是青城邹掌门的师弟赵逵，对战极乐左使。=...Back then, in the final decisive battle at the peak of the former Demon Sect, both the righteous and evil factions each sent three peerless masters to determine life and death and decide who stood above all.\nAlliance Leader Great Hero Long Yuan faced Blissful Sect Cult Leader Li Renyou, while our Sect Leader faced the Blissful Right Emissary.\nThe final candidate was Qingcheng Sect Leader Zou's junior brother Zhao Kui, who fought the Blissful Left Emissary.
那场传奇决战，龙大侠的天觞剑击碎了极乐教主的鬼莲王刀；掌门服毒催谷功力，险胜一筹，诛杀了右使。但是第三阵却败了下来。=In that legendary battle, Great Hero Long's Tianshang Sword shattered the Blissful Sect Cult Leader's Ghost Lotus King Blade;\nThe Sect Leader, having taken poison to forcibly boost his power, narrowly prevailed and killed the Right Emissary.\nHowever, the third match was lost.
赵逵身受重伤，左使逃逸无踪。之后极乐教覆灭，龙大侠和极乐教主在烈火之中消声匿迹，完结了一个时代。但是故事还有后续。=Zhao Kui was severely injured, and the Left Emissary escaped without a trace.\nAfterward, the Blissful Sect was destroyed, and both Great Hero Long and the Blissful Sect Cult Leader vanished amid the flames, bringing an era to an end.\nBut the story did not end there.
悔恨依然煎熬着赵逵，彷佛被魔教诅咒一般，变得偏执而暴戾。他武功越来越强，面目也变得愈发狰狞，最后他叛出青城，加入了泥教，成为地狱道法王。=Tormented by regret as if cursed by the demonic sect, Zhao Kui grew increasingly paranoid and violent.\nHis martial arts grew stronger, and his appearance became more ferocious. Finally, he betrayed Qingcheng,\nand joined the Mud Sect, becoming the Dharma King of the Hell Realm.
而左使则韬光养晦，密谋东山再起，却因我们大师兄功亏一篑了。这事儿下次有空再说。=As for the Left Emissary, he concealed his ambitions, plotting a comeback, but his plans were thwarted by our First Senior Brother.\nLet's save that story for another time when we have a moment.
峨嵋派是中原六大派之一，大概也是江湖上最古老的门派。最早可以追溯到春秋战国，创自白猿祖师司徒玄空。=The Emei Sect is one of the Six Major Sects of the Central Plains, and probably the oldest sect in the jianghu.\nIt's origins can be traced back to the Spring and Autumn and Warring States periods, founded by White Ape Ancestor, Situ Xuankong.
离我们也很近。我们这儿是眉山，他那是峨嵋山。虽说是邻居，却不怎么亲近。=We're actually quite close by. Our place is in Mount Mei(Meishan), while theirs is on Mount Emei.\nAlthough neighbors, we are not particularly close.
原因无非是他们清高孤僻，而我们桀傲不驯。总算井水不犯河水，大的事多少礼尚往来，平素却没啥交集。=The reason is simply that they are aloof and solitary by nature, while we are unruly and defiant.\nWe manage to keep to our own sides without interfering, maintaining basic courtesy on major matters, but otherwise, we have little interaction.
掌门向无忧算起辈份，该和我们是一辈人。但他鲜少行走江湖，没啥事迹可言。=In terms of seniority, Sect Leader Xiang Wuyou should be of the same generation as us.\nHowever, he rarely ventures into the martial world, so there are few notable deeds associated with him.
倒是他那位师弟「风神」解无尘，与我们大师兄齐名，乃是江湖年轻一辈中的俊杰，他们互许为劲敌，相互砥砺，有时针锋相对，有时结伴同行，不失为江湖美谈。=Instead, his junior brother,「Wind God」Xie Wuchen, is equally famous as our First Senior Brother.\nThey are both outstanding talents among the younger generation in the martial world, acknowledging each other as rivals while pushing one another to improve.\nSometimes they clash fiercely, other times they journey together, a celebrated tale in the martial world.
峨嵋金顶是佛门圣地，派中弟子亦多数信佛，剩下的人则信道。武功路子都得自天然，好比白猿祖师模仿山中灵猴所创的拳剑棍法。拳是峨嵋通臂拳，剑是猿公剑，棍是猿王棍。=Mount Emei's Golden Summit is a sacred Buddhist site, and most of the sect's disciples follow Buddhism, while the rest adhere to Daoism.\nTheir martial arts styles are derived from nature, much like how White Ape Ancestor created fist, sword, and staff techniques by imitating the spiritual monkeys in the mountains.\nThe fist technique is the Emei Tongbiquan (Penetrating Fist), the sword technique is the Yuangongjian (Ape Elder Sword), and the staff technique is the YuanWanggun (Ape King's Staff).
后人追随祖师，又仿其他生灵，创出蛇形、鹤形、虎形种种拳法。讲究耳濡目染，由意得形，故曰形意，与本门的忘形篇思想完全相反。=Later generations followed the Ancestor's example and imitated other creatures, creating various fist techniques such as Snake Form, Crane Form, and Tiger Form.\nThey emphasize learning through immersion and deriving form from intent, hence called Xingyi (Form and Will), which is the complete opposite of our sect's philosophy of Forgetting Form.
说说峨嵋派的事吧。现如今峨嵋派人人都使拳脚功夫，体魄强健、身手敏捷。那你可知道，从前峨嵋派会使剑吗？=Let's talk about the Emei Sect.\nNowadays, everyone in the Emei Sect practices fist and leg techniques, boasting strong physiques and agile movements.\nBut did you know that in the past, the Emei Sect also used swords?
不但使剑，而且还厉害非常。=Not only did they use swords, but they were also extremely skilled.
相传几百年前，更在唐门祖师创派以前，蜀中更无其他门派，只有峨嵋一派独大，那时峨嵋以剑法享誉天下。传自白猿祖师的猿公剑法，历经数朝演化，登峰造极。=Legend has it that several hundred years ago, even before the Tang Sect's founder established our school, there were no other sects in Shu,\nonly the Emei Sect dominated. At that time, Emei was renowned throughout the land for its sword techniques.\nThe Ape Elder Sword Technique, passed down from White Ape Ancestor, evolved over dynasties and reached the pinnacle of mastery.
然而物极必反，有天他们忽然觉得高处不胜寒，就此弃剑不用，藏剑于心，称之为「心剑」，以此磨练身心。=However, when things reach an extreme, they reverse. One day, they suddenly felt that the heights were too lonely and cold, so they abandoned the sword altogether,\nhiding it within their hearts, calling it the「Heart Sword」, using it to temper both body and mind.
我个人呢，觉得器物造出来便是要拿来用的。峨嵋派的心剑太高深了，我这俗人不懂，所以不予置评。=Personally, I believe that tools are made to be used.\nThe Emei Sect's Heart Sword is too profound for a mundane person like me to understand, so I'll refrain from commenting.
峨嵋派相当讲究辈份，弟子拜师的时候，都按字辈改名。比如掌门向无忧、风神解无尘，都是「无」字辈。=The Emei Sect is quite particular about seniority. When disciples take a Master, they change their name according to the generation character.\nFor example, Sect Leader Xiang Wuyou and Wind God Xie Wuchen are both of the「Wu」generation.
他们上一代的前辈则是「乘」字辈，如今几乎都退隐江湖了。和本门前辈凋零的原因不同，他们是出过一个恶名昭彰的叛徒。=The previous generation of seniors belonged to the「Cheng」generation, most of whom have now retired from the jianghu.\nUnlike the reason for the decline of our own sect's seniors, theirs was due to a notorious traitor.
峨嵋叛徒的名字叫袁乘风，江湖外号「风中奇猿」。使的一手猿王棍灵动非常，乃是当年江湖一把好手。掌门曾评价过他：「很难打。」=The Emei traitor's name was Yuan Chengfeng, known in the martial world as the「Strange Ape in the Wind」.\nHe used the Ape King's Staff techniques with extraordinary agility and was a top-tier expert in the martial world back in the day.\nThe Sect Leader once commented on him:「Very difficult to fight.」
很难打这话听着挺微妙的，就是说稳赢，但是不好对付。能让我们家掌门都觉得棘手，可想而知此人武功有多高了。="Very difficult to fight" sounds quite nuanced, it means victory is certain, but dealing with him is troublesome.\nFor our Sect Leader to find him troublesome, one can imagine how high his martial arts were.
此人早年还是行侠仗义的正派侠士，可是旧魔教崛起时，他急于成名立万，拎着棍子去挑战，败于极乐右使，竟然跪地乞命求饶，求取尸心丹吞服，甘为极乐教走狗。=In his early years, this person was a righteous Great Hero who upheld justice.\nBut when the former Demon Sect rose to power, eager to make a name for himself, he took his staff and went to challenge them. After being defeated by the Blissful Right Emissary,\nhe actually knelt and begged for his life, willingly took the Corpse Heart Pill, and became a lackey for the Blissful Sect.
他盗取唐门毒药，回山下毒，欲将峨嵋一网打尽，作投名状。峨嵋前辈因此不是身亡，便是经脉俱损废了武功。袁乘风则凭此功绩，受封为极乐七仙，在峨嵋称王，极尽荒淫之能事。=He stole poison from the Tang Sect, returned to the mountain, and used it to poison his own sect, attempting to wipe out Emei in one fell swoop as a pledge of loyalty.\nAs a result, the Emei seniors either died or had their meridians destroyed, wasting their martial arts.\nYuan Chengfeng was rewarded for this achievement, being enfeoffed as one of the Blissful Seven Immortals. He proclaimed himself king on Emei, indulging in every form of decadence and excess.
后来呢？后来就被我们掌门用飞燕流星翎砍断兵器、指头，一脚踢下峨嵋金顶，摔得粉身碎骨而死。=What happened later? Later, our Sect Leader used the Flying Swallow Meteor Feather to shatter his weapon and fingers,\nthen kicked him off the Golden Summit of Emei, sending him plummeting to his death, smashed to pieces.
全真派是天下武学正宗，中原六大派之一，嵩山衰退以后，迅速崛起。如今大宋、金国都道观林立，隐然已是中原第一大派。=The Quanzhen Sect is recognized as The Orthodox School of Martial Arts under heaven and one of the Six Major Sects of the Central Plains. After the decline of the Songshan Sect, it rapidly rose to prominence.\nNow, in both the Great Song and Jin Kingdom, Daoist temples abound, implicitly making it the number one sect in the Central Plains.
全真派迅速崛起，信众遍布宋金两国，更隐然更胜佛教。除了嵩山高僧泰半都在旧魔教一役中捐躯的缘故，也因为他们强调三教合一，瓦解了教派之间对立。=The Quanzhen Sect rapidly rose, with followers spread across both Song and Jin, even implicitly surpassing Buddhism.\nBesides the reason that most of Mount Song's senior monks perished in the old demon cult battle,\nit's also because they emphasize the unity of the three teachings (Daoism, Buddhism, Confucianism), dissolving opposition between sects.
为了布教而不断简化的全真剑法，被大量印刷送人传阅。别说，这招是真的管用，你直接拿一本道书叫人读，人家还未必理你，说是简单易学、可以强身健体的武功秘籍，那～就不一样了。=The continuously simplified Quanzhen Sword Technique, aimed at spreading their teachings, were mass-printed and distributed for people to read.\nDon't say it, this method is truly effective. If you simply hand someone a Daoist text and ask them to read it, they might not even bother.\nBut if you call it a simple, easy-to-learn martial arts manual that can strengthen the body then~ it's different.
为此全真剑法也被戏称为国民健康操，沦为江湖笑柄。连街边的大婶拿起晒衣竿都能耍两招。=Because of this, the Quanzhen Sword Technique is also jokingly called the National Calisthenics, becoming a laughingstock in the martial world.\nEven the aunties on the street can pick up a clothes-drying pole and perform a few moves.
全真创派祖师，早年曾是金国的秀才，两朝文武双状元。后来入道修行，改名王喆，道号重阳子，故称重阳真人。=The founder of the Quanzhen Sect was originally a scholar in the Jin Kingdom and achieved the top honors in both civil and military examinations across two dynasties.\nLater, he entered Daoist practice, changed his name to Wang Zhe, and took the Daoist name Chongyangzi, hence he is known as Master Chongyang, The Perfected One.
重阳真人是五祖七真中的北五祖之一，那是武林前辈中的前辈，跟岳王爷同时代人。就像我大宋有文盟主、武霸王，他也是金国的武林传奇。=Master Chongyang, The Perfected One is one of the Northern Five Patriarchs among the Five Patriarchs and Seven Realized Ones,\nhe is a predecessor among predecessors in the martial world, a contemporary of Lord Yue.\nJust as we in the Great Song have the Civil Alliance Leader and the Martial Hegemon, he was a legendary figure in the Jin Kingdom's martial world.
重阳真人座下七真，后来都成为一派宗师。丹阳子马钰继任掌教，却遭金朝皇帝所忌，下令送还本乡，将关中事物交给师弟主持。=The Seven Realized Ones under Master Chongyang, The Perfected One all later became masters of their own Sect.\nMaster Dan Yang, Ma Yu succeeded as the Sect Leader but drew the suspicion of the Jin Dynasty Emperor, who ordered him to return to his hometown\nand hand over matters in the Guanzhong region to his junior brother to oversee.
那位师弟，便是江湖无人不知、无人不晓的天下第一人。今日的全真掌教，长春子丘处机。=That junior brother is the number one under heaven known to all in the jianghu.\nToday's Quanzhen Sect Leader, Master Eternal Spring, Qiu Chuji.
只可惜二十年前极乐教与中原正派激战之时，丘道长正受金国皇帝所制，与弟子在栖霞太虚观修道。要是他老人家参战，极乐教主未必能够只手遮天。=It's just a pity that twenty years ago, during the fierce battle between the Blissful Sect and the orthodox factions of the Central Plains,\nDaoist Master Qiu was under the control of the Jin Dynasty Emperor, practicing Daoism with his disciples at the Qixia Taixu Temple.\nIf the Venerable Master had joined the fight, the Blissful Sect Cult Leader might not have been able to dominate so completely.
现在丘真人仍是掌教，却时常外出云游，端的是神龙见首不见尾。不在终南山的时候，都是由座下弟子尹志平道长代掌派中事务。=Now, though Master Qiu, The Perfected One remains the Sect Leader, he often travels abroad, truly like a divine dragon whose head is seen but not its tail.\nWhen he is not on Zhongnan Mountain, sect affairs are managed on his behalf by his disciple, Daoist Master Yin Zhiping.
唉，代掌门的辛酸无人知晓。=Alas, the hardships of an acting Sect Leader are known to none.
严格来说，终南山的全真派，应该称之为全真龙门派。不画符箓、不念咒语，宣扬真功真行，清静不动心，行善助人。迟早修得超脱轮回，飞天成仙。=Strictly speaking, the Quanzhen Sect at Zhongnan Mountain should be called the Quanzhen Sect's Dragon Gate.\nThey do not draw talismans or chant incantations, but advocate true practice and genuine action, maintaining a tranquil and unwavering heart while doing good and helping others.\nSooner or later, they will cultivate to transcend reincarnation and ascend to become immortals.
因为兼含儒道释思想，武功又容易入门，与青城一比，就显得平易近人。不过相对来说，不讲资质，也就难出大器，信徒虽众，高手却很少。=Because it incorporates Confucian, Daoist, and Buddhist philosophies, and its martial arts are easy to start with, it appears much more approachable compared to Qingcheng.\nHowever, precisely because it doesn't emphasize innate talent, it rarely produces true masters; although followers are numerous, experts are few.
不过话又说回来，那全真剑法中藏着一层奥秘，七人一组可以施展北斗七星阵法，七个大婶拿锅铲都能战胜武林高手。=But then again, there is a layer of mystery hidden within that Quanzhen Sword Technique.\nWhen seven people form a group, they can execute the Big Dipper Formation. Even seven aunties wielding spatulas could defeat a martial arts Master with it.
传说中，曾有一位武林怪杰人称玄冥老祖，自号「重阳敌」。=Legend has it that there was once an eccentric martial arts Master known as the Dark Mysterious Ancestor, who called himself「Chongyang's Rival」.
这位老前辈曾在阴山一带布教讲道，融合道家与大漠腾格里信仰，却因国情而不为人所纳，遂迁怒于全真教，认为是全真教蒙蔽民智，于是下中原找重阳真人比武、论道，结果却一败涂地。=This elder once preached and spread his teachings in the Yin Mountains, blending Daoist beliefs with the Tengri faith of the desert.\nHowever, due to national circumstances, his ideas were not widely accepted. He then redirected his anger toward the Quanzhen Sect, believing they had clouded the people's minds.\nSo he went to the Central Plains to challenge Master Chongyang, The Perfected One to a martial contest and debate, but in the end, he suffered a crushing defeat.
为与重阳祖师抗衡，他又入阴山闭关，痛下苦功，运阴符以养先天，直至六阴纯全，阴符功毕，方始出关。=To rival Master Chongyang, he retreated into seclusion in the Yin Mountains, dedicating himself to rigorous training.\nHe cultivated the Yin Talisman to nurture his innate energy until he achieved perfect mastery of the Six Yins and completed the Yin Talisman Art, only then did he emerge from seclusion.
出关第一件要事，便是上终南山找重阳真人麻烦，然而物是人非，原来他闭关三十年间，故敌早已仙逝。=The first thing he did after emerging was to go to Zhongnan Mountain to trouble Master Chongyang, The Perfected One,\nbut things had changed; it turned out during his thirty years of seclusion, his old enemy had already ascended into immortality.
玄冥老祖怅然半晌之后，狂笑不休，竟想火烧活死人墓，逼活重阳真人。七真相继上前挑战，就连掌教马丹阳亦非敌手。=After a long moment of despair, Dark Mysterious Ancestor burst into wild laughter and actually attempted to set fire to the Tomb of the Living Dead to force Master Chongyang, The Perfected One out of seclusion.\nThe Seven Realized Ones stepped forward to challenge him one after another, but even Sect Leader Ma Dan Yang was no match for him.
幸好丘真人深得重阳真传，以「昊天纯阳掌」力拼「六阴破阳符」，与那玄冥老祖对撼九九八十一掌，直到玄冥老祖使完绝招，尽兴了之后，才一笑远去，免了一场大祸。=Fortunately, Master Qiu, the Perfected One had deeply understood Master Chongyang's true teachings. Using「Pure Yang Palm of Vast Heaven」he confronted「Six-Yin Yang-Breaking Talisman」,\nexchanged eighty-one palm strikes with the Dark Mysterious Ancestor, holding his ground until the Ancestor had exhausted his ultimate techniques.\nOnly after satisfying his desire for a fight did the Ancestor depart with a laugh, averting a great disaster.
这是江湖快报连载的小说故事，有几分真、几分杜撰，我也不知道。要是我等世俗庸人有幸见到丘真人，真想问问他当年经过。=This is a serialized novel story from Jianghu Express; how much is true, how much is fabricated, I don't know.\nIf ordinary people like us ever had the chance to meet Master Qiu, The Perfected One, I'd truly love to ask him about what really happened back then.
崆峒派也是中原六大派之一，不过嘛……这说法有种种争议。=The Kongtong Sect is also one of the Central Plains' Six Major Sects, but... this statement has various controversies.
第一，崆峒派究竟算不算中原门派，实属难说。座落在秦州，自古便是兵家必争之地。一会儿属于宋国，一会儿属于金国，一会儿属于西夏，情势复杂得很。=First, whether the Kongtong Sect counts as a Central Plains sect is truly hard to say.\nLocated in Qinzhou, it has been a strategically contested place since ancient times.\nOne moment it belongs to the Song, another to the Jin, another to Western Xia; the situation is very complex.
连年兵马倥偬，当地百姓压根没几日安生。=With years of military urgency, the local people hardly had any peaceful days.
于是没处可逃的，就都躲到崆峒山上去了。因此崆峒不只宋人，也有金人、西夏人，甚至吐蕃人都有。=So those with nowhere else to go all took refuge on Mount Kongtong.\nThus, Kongtong is not only home to Song people but also Jin, Western Xia, and even Tibetan people.
其二，也正是因为这个，山中中小门派林立。「崆峒派」只是一个统称，称的是崆峒山中的所有门派。=Secondly, precisely because of this, small and medium sects abound in the mountain.\n「Kongtong Sect」is just a general term referring to all the sects within Mount Kongtong.
后来飞天、夺魄、铁拳、玄功四门并吞了其他门派，并为四霸。相约决战，胜者为崆峒至尊。=Later, the four sects, Flying Heaven, Soul-Snatching, Iron Fist, and Mystic Art, annexed other sects, becoming the four hegemons.\nThey agreed to a decisive battle, where the winner would be the Supreme Master of Kongtong.
此时崆峒初代掌派人横空出世，传说他乘鹤东来，持仙剑号令天雷，将山壁霹出一个大洞来，乃为崆峒奇景半雨屏。=At that time, the first-generation Sect Master of Kongtong emerged as if descending from the heavens. Legend says he arrived from the east riding a crane,\nwielding an immortal sword to command the heavenly thunder, which struck the mountain wall and blasted out a huge cave, creating Kongtong's wondrous spectacle, the Half Rain Pavilion.
四掌门见这仙人如此神威凛凛，哪里还敢造次？纷纷跪地臣服，奉他为掌派人，从此崆峒风调雨顺，再无纷争。=The four Sect Leaders, seeing this immortal so divinely majestic, how dare they act presumptuously?\nThey all knelt and submitted, honoring him as Sect Master. From then on, Kongtong had favorable weather and no more conflicts.
掌派人辞世以前，甩手将仙剑刺入半雨屏洞顶，乘鹤西去。留下仙旨，预言崆峒每代必有天选之人降临，此人奉天承运而来，是天上仙人以泥塑雕成人躯，下凡游历。=Before passing away, the Sect Master flung the immortal sword into the top of the Half Rain Pavilion cave and rode his crane west.\nHe left behind a divine decree prophesying that in every generation, a chosen one would descend upon Kongtong. This person would come by the mandate of heaven,\na celestial immortal molded from clay into human form, descending to wander the mortal realm.
掌派人在位的时候，崆峒必有天佑，所向无敌……。=When the Sect Master is in position, Kongtong is necessarily heaven-blessed, invincible wherever they go...
没想到崆峒翘首以盼的之人居然是你，真够离谱。=I never expected that the person Kongtong had been eagerly awaiting would turn out to be you, this is truly unbelievable.
啊，我没有丝毫对崆峒传承的不敬喔。=Ah, I have not the slightest disrespect for Kongtong's inheritance.
没想到会是那金乌上人成为了崆峒掌派人，唉。天选之人，也未必是好人。=I never thought it would be that Golden Crow Sage who became the Kongtong Sect Master, alas.\nThe chosen one isn't necessarily a good person.
要是金乌上人真是天选之人，这回唐门不只要跟唐门作对，还要逆天。=If Golden Crow Sage is truly the chosen one, this time the Tang Sect isn't just opposing the Tang Sect, but also defying heaven.
然而据我所知，先掌派人去世以来，崆峒至今都没决出掌派人选。四门分裂，各怀鬼胎，也不知将来如何。=However, from what I know, since the previous Sect Master passed away, Kongtong still hasn't decided on a new Sect Master.\nThe four branches have split, each with their own hidden agendas, and it's hard to say what the future holds.
如今崆峒派有四位掌门。飞天掌门火龙仙君，听说会仙法，额生第三眼，更有三头六臂。能够口吐烈火伤人，也不知真伪。=Now the Kongtong Sect has four Sect Leaders.\nIt is said that the Sect Leader of the Flying Heaven Gate, Fire Dragon Immortal Lord, knows Immortal magic, has a third eye on his forehead, and even possesses three heads and six arms.\nHe can spit fierce fire to harm people, though whether it's true or false is unknown.
夺魄掌门不知名，不是我孤陋寡闻，是他真的自称不知名。夺魄门武功以奇门突袭、刺杀为主，掌门隐匿姓名也非奇事。=Sect Leader of the Soul-Snatching Gate is Unknown, nnot because I'm poorly informed, but because he truly calls himself 'Unknown'.\nSoul-Snatching Gate martial arts focus on unconventional assaults and assassinations, so it's no surprise their Sect Leader conceals their name.
倒是尊师夺魄幽兰夏侯女侠，号称江湖第一美人，很是出名。=However, your respected Master, Soul-Snatching Ghost Orchid Heroine Xiahou, known as the number one beauty in the jianghu, is quite famous.
倒是崆峒派夺魄幽兰夏侯女魔，号称江湖第一美人，可是蛇蝎心肠，心狠手辣，很是出名。=However, the Kongtong Sect's Soul-Snatching Ghost Orchid the Demoness Xiahou, known as the number one beauty in the martial world,\nbut her heart is as venomous as a snake or scorpion, and she is infamous for her ruthlessness.
铁拳掌门雷谦，在江湖不太出名，据说是一位铁匠。对了，铁拳门打造的兵器，也是江湖一绝。听说火炎山剑阁从前就是百年前铁拳门分家出去独立的。=Sect Leader of the Iron Fist Gate, Lei Qian, is not very famous in the jianghu; It's said he was originally a blacksmith.\nBy the way, the weapons forged by the Iron Fist Gate are also considered top-tier in the martial world.\nI've heard that the Flame Mountain Sword Pavilion actually branched off from the Iron Fist Gate a hundred years ago and became independent.
最后一位，就是你夫人了。师弟，你可得对人家尊敬一点，不可失了敬意。=The last one is your wife.\nJunior Brother, you must treat her with respect and not show any lack of courtesy.
最后玄功掌门魏菊，听说是一位内功深湛的女高手。按说江湖快报不该稍微提一提这位女掌门的事迹吗？然而没有。着墨趋近于无，也不知究竟是怎样的人物。=Finally the Sect Leader of the Mystic Art Gate, Wei Ju, is said to be a highly skilled female Master with profound internal energy.\nShouldn't Jianghu Express mention this female leader's deeds a bit? Yet, there's nothing.\nThe description is almost nonexistent; no idea what kind of person she really is.
最后玄功掌门魏才女，这可真是一位奇人。刚听传闻的时候，我还不敢置信，你可知这位是谁？=Finally the Sect Leader of the Mystic Art Gate, the Talented Lady Wei, she is truly a remarkable person.\nWhen I first heard the rumors, I couldn't believe it. Do you know who this is?
啊，对了，你留学崆峒玄功门，都见过庐山真面目了。=Ah, right, you studied abroad at the Kongtong Mystic Art Gate, so you must have seen her true face.
但我还是不吐不快。=But if I don't say it, I won't be satisfied.
这位未涉江湖以前可是临安才女，诗书礼乐无一不精。江湖中人也许不知道她的厉害，读书人听到「魏招弟」可是如雷贯耳！我这么说吧，就像你和易安居士李清照活在同一个时代！=Before entering the jianghu, she was a talented lady of Lin'an, excelling in poetry, books, rites, and music.\nJianghu people might not know her prowess, but scholars hearing「Wei Zhaodi」is like thunder to the ears!\nLet me put it this way—it's like you and Li Qingzhao, the Recluse Scholar of Yi'an, living in the same era!
只可惜魏才女昙花一现，一夕之间便消失了。诗作、画作全都失佚，如今千金难求，我还道是……道是红颜薄命，没想到却入了江湖！=It's just a pity Talented Lady Wei appeared only briefly, vanishing overnight.\nHer poems and paintings were all lost, and now they're priceless treasures. I had thought... thought it was a case of a beauty destined for a tragic life,\nnever expecting she would enter the martial world!
当代崆峒派，还有一位特别有名的奇人。和我们大师兄，那是不一样的有名法。=In the contemporary Kongtong Sect, there is another particularly famous remarkable person.\nFamous in a different way than our First Senior Brother.
那便是火龙仙君座下，飞天门大弟子，人称「道法将军」的丹霞子道长。=That is the great Disciple of the Flying Heaven Gate under the Fire Dragon Immortal Lord, known as the「General of Daoist Methods」Daoist Master Danxiazi.

你不由分说，立马主张自己的清白。然而却立马被四师兄揭穿，教你好生尴尬。=Without waiting for an explanation, you immediately proclaimed your innocence.\nHowever, you were immediately exposed by Fourth Senior Brother, making you quite embarrassed.

你心慌之下自曝了先前失手烧掉字画的秘密。烧了一幅字画本来还不打紧，坏就坏在你自己胡乱画了一幅，还冒名前朝诗人的名义。更惨的是那幅字画还因为无法鉴定，被人用高价买回去考究。这事倘若被掌门知道，你可能会因败坏师门名誉，被打断手脚逐出师门。=In a panic, you revealed the secret of having accidentally burned a calligraphy and painting piece before.\nBurning one piece wouldn't have been a big deal normally; the real problem was that you hastily forged a replacement yourself and fraudulently attributed it to a poet from a previous dynasty.\nEven worse, that piece was bought for a high price by someone for research because its authenticity couldn't be determined.\nIf the Sect Leader found out about this, you might have your limbs broken and be expelled from the Sect for tarnishing its reputation.

却原来不为别的，乃是临时召集的唐门会议。以往都是门中耆老、各有职司的掌令使才能以参与，入室弟子等闲也不得旁听，遑论外姓弟子。你来到唐门这许多年，这还是头一次参与。=\nIt turned out to be nothing else but an urgently convened Tang Sect meeting.\nIn the past, only Senior Elders and appointed decree officers with specific duties could participate; even inner-sect disciples were rarely allowed to observe, let alone outer-sect disciples.\nIn all your years at the Tang Sect, this was the first time you had ever been included.

而今宵掌门要门人齐聚一堂，乃是为了传承衣钵，立新掌门。=And tonight, the Sect Leader gathered the members to pass on the mantle and establish a new Leader.

掌门有意将掌门之位传予膝下大弟子唐布衣，从此由他引领唐门。这事你倒没甚么意见，然而掌门随即又透露要将独生爱女小师妹嫁予大师兄。这你就无法忍受了，当场口吐鲜血，仰天便倒，只差一点便溘然长逝。=The Sect Leader intended to pass the leadership to his eldest disciple, Tang Buyi, henceforth having him lead the Tang Sect.\nYou had no particular opinion on this matter. However, the Sect Leader then revealed he would marry his only beloved daughter, Little Junior Sister, to First Senior Brother.\nThis was more than you could bear. On the spot, you coughed up blood, collapsed face-up, and came within a breath of passing away.

这一日，到了你在唐门无数个年头，经历无数次却徒劳无功的段考日。这一日的表现，究竟会洗刷你在师长心目中的形象，还是为失败纪录再添一笔？=\nThis day arrived—the segment exam day you had experienced countless times over your many years at the Tang Sect, always to no avail.\nWould this day's performance redeem your image in the eyes of your teachers, or add another mark to your record of failures?

抱恙而深居寡出的掌门意外现身，担任考官，弟子均受鼓舞，斗志旺盛。=The Sect Leader, who had been unwell and reclusive, made an unexpected appearance to serve as the examiner.The disciples were greatly inspired, their fighting spirit burning fiercely.

有意在段考中给你难堪的师兄，却因忌惮掌门的目光不得不收敛一些。=The senior brother who intended to embarrass you during the segment exam had to hold back somewhat fearing the Sect Leader's watchful gaze.

由人称唐门大管家的三师兄担任考官，在唐门上一辈英才早逝的今时此刻，这也不是稀罕的事情。=\nWith Third Senior Brother, known as the Tang Sect's Chief Steward, serving as examiner, it was not a rare occurrence in these times when the talented Seniors of the previous generation of the Tang Sect had passed away prematurely.

出乎意料的是，本次段考，竟是由等闲不出炼丹房的二师兄担任考官。在他锐利目光下，无人胆敢掉以轻心，就像上了战场的士兵，视死如归。=Unexpectedly, for this segment exam, it was actually Second Senior Brother, who seldom left the alchemy room, that served as the examiner.\nUnder his sharp gaze, no one dared to let their guard down, as if they were soldiers on the battlefield, ready to face death with equanimity.

本次担任考官的是大师兄。大师兄显然无意尽责，一上台就提议要去山溪捉鱼，幸而三师兄及时介入，阻止大师兄进一步打击众弟子的士气。然而造成的伤害无法弥补，大家此刻都已开始想象烤鱼的滋味。=This time, the examiner was First Senior Brother.\nFirst Senior Brother clearly had no intention of fulfilling his duties; as soon as he took the stage, he suggested going to the mountain stream to catch fish. Fortunately, Third Senior Brother intervened in time to prevent First Senior Brother from further damaging the disciples' morale.\nHowever, the damage done was irreparable; everyone had already started imagining the taste of grilled fish.

弟子两两配对，开始拆招，演示自身武功进境，由考官考核，逐一点评指点。最后，终于轮到你站上了练武场的中央。=Disciples paired in two's, began exchanging moves, demonstrating their martial arts progress, and were assessed by the examiner, who commented and provided guidance one by one.\nFinally, it was your turn to stand in the center of the training ground.

果不其然，那日污辱你的入室弟子，明显将你视为好欺负的对象，瞄准了你同时登台，准备在众人注目之下给你好看。=Sure enough, that inner-sect disciple who had insulted you that day clearly saw you as an easy target. He deliberately stepped onto the stage at the same time as you, intending to humiliate you in front of everyone.

你再一次在段考中败北，入室学武的心愿受挫。然而日子还是要过，那天的向晚黄昏，就像你心灵的写照，永生难忘。=You were once again defeated in the segment exam, thwarting your wish to learn martial arts as an inner-sect disciple.\nYet life had to go on. The dusk of that day, like a portrait of your soul, became unforgettable for life.

经过奋战，你在所有人的见证下击败了对手。=After a hard fight, you defeated your opponent witnessed by everyone.

带着轻蔑的态度上场的霸凌者反被教训，丢尽了脸面，连头也抬不起来，悄然退场。不少门人都暗暗为你拍手叫好。=The bully who took the stage with a disdainful attitude was instead taught a lesson, utterly humiliated, unable to even lift his head, and withdrew quietly.\nMany clan members secretly applauded and cheered for you.

掌门亲口表扬你，许多人从此对你另眼相看，再也不敢将你视为外姓弟子随便役使。可是，就在这当儿，掌门竟突然旧患复发，口吐鲜血，由二师兄扶进炼丹房施救。=The Sect Leader personally praised you. From then on, many people viewed you differently and no longer dared to treat you as an outer-sect disciple to be ordered around arbitrarily.\nHowever, right at this moment, the Sect Leader suddenly suffered a relapse of an old illness, vomited blood, and was supported by Second Senior Brother into the alchemy room for emergency treatment.

三师兄真心为你高兴，这也不是他头一回为你说情，希望掌门将你正式收入门墙。但这一次你用实力证明了自己，三师兄激动得都快涌出眼泪来了。=Third Senior Brother was genuinely happy for you; this wasn't the first time he had pleaded your case, hoping the Sect Leader would formally accept you as a disciple.\nBut this time you had proven yourself with your strength, and Third Senior Brother was so moved he nearly shed tears.

明明是你赢了，却没得到二师兄的赞扬，反而是同门惨被痛骂不长进。大伙的心里都不太好受，从此各自潜下苦功，力求下次表现。=Clearly, you had won, yet you did not receive praise from Second Senior Brother; instead, your fellow disciples were severely scolded for lacking progress.\nEveryone felt quite disheartened, and from then on, each immersed themselves in hard training, striving to perform better next time.

大师兄对于你的胜利似乎感到颇欣慰，邀请你上台发表获胜感言。=First Senior Brother seemed quite pleased with your victory and invited you on stage to give a victory speech.

你还真的忝不知耻的上去了，真有你的。对你而言，今日的胜利兴许就像金榜题名一样，是空前未有的转折点也说不定。=You actually had the shamelessness to go up there; typical of you.\nFor you, today's victory might be like topping the imperial examination list, an unprecedented turning point.

纵使喜难自禁，你仍然谦抑的拒绝了。=Even though joy was hard to contain, you still humbly declined.

你白天的表现，同寝弟子都看在眼里，你发现其实自己似乎没有想象中那么不受人待见的样子。这些你不太记得名字的新人，其实人都满好的。=\nYour performance during the day was seen by your dormmates. You realized that you might not be as unwelcome as you had imagined.\nThese newcomers, whose names you couldn't quite remember, were actually quite nice.

面对昔日作威作福，欺善怕恶的弟子，你和新朋友们不甘示弱还以颜色。你已经变得强大了，你拥有超越自身之外，联系他人的力量。=Facing disciples who once threw their weight around and bullied the weak but feared the strong, you and your new friends gave as good as you got.\nYou had become strong; you possessed power beyond yourself, the power to connect with others.

面对昔日作威作福，欺善怕恶的弟子，你以德报怨，以同门情谊为重。受到你的人格特质所影响，同寝的弟子也决定不再计较旧恶。=Facing disciples who once threw their weight around and bullied the weak but feared the strong, you repaid malice with kindness, prioritizing camaraderie.\nInfluenced by your character, your dormmates also decided to let bygones be bygones.

夜里小师妹来访，却不是携着好消息，从她那里得知了掌门因病重，所以拜师入室的事情必须容后再提。=At night, Little Junior Sister paid you a visit, but not with good news. From her, you learned that due to the Sect Leader's serious illness, the matter of formally becoming an inner-sect disciple had to be postponed.

为了安慰你，小师妹尽她所能的施展了拍拍，她深信自己的小手拥有某种神秘力量，可以疗愈人的心，无论是她的爹娘、大师兄、二师兄都很管用。如果对你不管用，就多拍几下试试。你既感欣慰，又不胜唏嘘的接受了事实。=To comfort you, Little Junior Sister did her best to administer pats, firmly believing her small hands held a mysterious power\nthat they could heal hearts. It worked for her parents, First Senior Brother, and Second Senior Brother.\nIf it didn't work on you, she could try patting a few more times.\nYou accepted the reality, feeling both comforted and deeply sentimental.

为了安慰你，小师妹尽她所能的施展了拍拍，她深信自己的小手拥有某种神秘力量，可以疗愈人的心，无论是她的爹娘、大师兄、二师兄都很管用。对你似乎也非常灵验，她很高兴，既然如此，将来也愿意在你不开心的时候拍一拍你。你既感欣慰，又不胜唏嘘的接受了事实。=To comfort you, Little Junior Sister did her best to administer pats, firmly believing her small hands held a mysterious power\nthat could heal hearts. It worked for her parents, First Senior Brother, and Second Senior Brother.\nIt seemed very effective on you too. She was happy and thus willing to pat you whenever you were unhappy in the future.\nYou accepted the reality, feeling both comforted and deeply sentimental.

为了安慰你，小师妹尽她所能的施展了拍拍，但是被你厉声喝斥。小师妹受到了惊吓，逃跑似的离开现场。而你丝毫没有从中得到快慰，难以接受的事，依然难以接受。=To comfort you, Little Junior Sister did her best to administer pats, but you sharply scolded her.\nLittle Junior Sister was frightened and fled the scene as if running away.\nAnd you derived no solace from it at all; what was hard to accept remained hard to accept.

大师兄心血来潮邀请你设局挑衅地方的小帮派飞石帮，你负责担任诱饵兼沙包。纵令你万分不情愿还是被赶上了战场，拚得九死一生才得以幸免。大师兄将顺手摸来的飞石帮秘籍馈赠予你。=\nFirst Senior Brother, on a whim, invited you to set up a scheme to provoke the local small gang, the Flying Stone Gang, with you serving as both bait and the punching bag.\nDespite your extreme reluctance, you were forced onto the battlefield and only managed to survive by a hair's breadth after a life-and-death struggle.\nFirst Senior Brother gifted you the Flying Stone Gang secret manual he had casually pocketed.

一日，你在唐门练武场参加团练，却被几名资历分明比你更浅，却有幸获师长提拔成为入室弟子的师兄寻衅挑拨。=\nOne day, while participating in group training at the Tang Sect's training ground, you were provoked and picked on by several senior brothers whose seniority was clearly less than yours but who had been fortunate enough to be promoted to inner-sect disciples by the masters.

在他们的恶意挑衅下，你选择正面还击。纵使力有未逮，凭借着进退有度的战术与运气，你以外姓弟子的身分击败了入室弟子，创唐门空前未有之丑闻。然而对手落败后非但没有服输，反而群起围攻，将你打成重伤，扔进粪坑泄愤。还放话要在段考再扁你一次。=Under their malicious provocation, you chose to retaliate head-on.\nDespite your limited strength, through tactical skill and a bit of luck, you, as an outer-sect disciple, defeated an inner-door disciple, creating an unprecedented scandal in the Tang Sect.\nHowever, after their defeat, instead of admitting loss, they ganged up on you, severely injured you, and threw you into a manure pit to vent their anger.\nThey also threatened to beat you up again during the segment exam.

在他们的恶意挑衅下，你选择正面还击。可惜你纵有骨气，从未正式习练武功的你，终究不是身具入室弟子的敌手。惨遭击败污辱，命令你擦去自己溅在地上的血，还放话要在段考再扁你一次。=Under their malicious provocation, you chose to retaliate head-on.\nUnfortunately, though you had spirit, having never formally trained in martial arts, you were ultimately no match for the inner-sect disciples.\nYou were brutally defeated and humiliated, ordered to wipe up your own blood splattered on the ground, and they threatened to beat you up again during the segment exam.

在他们的恶意挑衅下，你选择动心忍性，息事宁人。然而退一步也没有海阔天空，你的未来依然铅云密布。这伙人是打定主意要在段考给你难堪了。=Under their malicious provocation, you chose to exercise patience and forbearance, to settle the matter peacefully.\nHowever, yielding did not bring peace; your future remained clouded.\nThis group was determined to embarrass you during the segment exam.

在他们的恶意挑衅下，你选择据理力争。引用门规，唇枪舌剑一番抢白，搅得对方竟无话可说，只能空自恼火。你说得痛快，却忘了还有来日段考之事，届时这群人想必会挟怨报复。你虽逞了口舌之快，却心下戚惶。=Under their malicious provocation, you chose to argue on the merits.\nQuoting the Sect rules, you retorted with a war of words, leaving them speechless and only able to fume in frustration.\nYou spoke with eloquence, but forgot about the upcoming segment exam, where this group would likely seek revenge bearing a grudge.\nThough you had the satisfaction of a verbal victory, you felt anxious and apprehensive inside.

你心中悲愤，深夜独至唐门后山，一时愤慨，一时心灰，自觉终生难以圆梦。不意竟有神秘高人翩然而至，三言两语的指点，便使你茅塞顿开。=\nFilled with grief and indignation, you went alone to the back hill of the Tang Sect late at night, sometimes enraged, sometimes disheartened, feeling you would never achieve your dream in this lifetime.\nUnexpectedly, a mysterious Master arrived gracefully, and with just a few words of guidance, made everything suddenly clear to you.

那位高人临去之前，馈赠一部秘笈予你，你定睛一看，竟是昔日正派第一大派嵩山寺大名鼎鼎的《金钟罩》！=Before leaving, that Master gifted you a secret manual. Looking closely, you saw it was actually the famous《Golden Bell Shield》from the former leading orthodox sect, Songshan Temple!

那位高人临去之前，馈赠一部秘笈予你，你定睛一看，竟是唐门大敌点苍派的《点苍剑谱》！=Before leaving, that Master gifted you a secret manual. Looking closely, you saw it was actually the《Diancang Sword Manual》from the Tang Sect's great enemy, the Diancang Sect!

那位高人临去之前，馈赠一部秘笈予你，你定睛一看，竟是苗疆五毒教的《五毒秘录》！=Before leaving, that Master gifted you a secret manual. Looking closely, you saw it was actually the《Five Poisons Secret Record》from the Miaojiang Five Poisons Sect!

那位高人临去之前，馈赠一部秘笈予你，你定睛一看，此书来历非凡，甚至不是武功。原来竟是泥教恶名昭彰的六道法王之一，「修罗道法王」前半生手书的日记！持有这种危险的书，真的没问题吗？=Before leaving, that Master gifted you a secret manual. Looking closely, you saw this book had an extraordinary origin. It wasn't even a martial arts manual.\nIt turned out to be the handwritten diary of the first half of the life of one of the Mud Cult's notorious Six Realms Dharma Kings, the「Asura Realm Dharma King」!\nIs it really okay to possess such a dangerous book?

你心中萌生熊熊烈火，决心要令瞧轻过你的人们刮目相看。=A raging fire ignited in your heart, and you resolved to make those who had looked down on you see you in a new light.

连天大雨不绝，四师兄与你觑准了菜市场定要贱价抛售蔬果，见猎心喜，连忙带齐了人马下山。不出意料，与老敌手丐帮大义分舵碰了面，双方为了捡便宜，大战一触即发──=\nThe relentless rain poured for days. Fourth Senior Brother and you anticipated the market would sell vegetables and fruits at throwaway prices. Delighted at the opportunity, you quickly gathered your team and went down the mountain.\nAs expected, you ran into your old rivals, the Dayi Branch of the Beggars' Sect. To snatch the bargains, a major conflict was imminent—

激战结局，由唐门胜出。照例由赢家做东道，请大义分舵的丐帮朋友吃一顿粗饱。你们在破庙三两一堆，席地而坐，生火烧烤。片刻之前还势成水火，此际却又热切的很。=The fierce battle ended with the Tang Sect emerging victorious.\nAs per tradition, the winners played host and treated the friends from the Dayi Branch of the Beggars' Sect to a simple but filling meal.\nGathered in threes and fours in the dilapidated temple, sitting on the ground, lighting fires and grilling food.\nJust moments ago, tensions had run high as fire and water, yet now the atmosphere was warm and lively.

激战结局，唐门惜败。照例由赢家做东道，请你们吃一顿粗饱。你们在破庙三两一堆，席地而坐，生火烧烤。片刻之前还势成水火，此际却又热切的很。=The fierce battle ended with the Tang Sect narrowly defeated.\nAs per tradition, the winners played host and treated you to a simple but filling meal.\nGathered in threes and fours in the dilapidated temple, sitting on the ground, lighting fires, and grilling food.\nJust moments ago, tensions had run high as fire and water, yet now the atmosphere was warm and lively.

和大义分舵的交情，是不打不相识，打得再凶，事后依然能够和好，从没隔夜的仇。但并不是天下乞丐都似大义分舵这般豪气。大局当前，丐帮位列武林盟一席，亦将出征讨罚唐门。大义分舵终究忠义难全。=Your friendship with the Dayi Branch was formed through conflict. No matter how fierce the fight, you could always reconcile afterward, never holding grudges.\nBut not all beggars under heaven are as magnanimous as the Dayi Branch.\nWith the larger situation at hand, the Beggars' Sect holds a seat in the Martial Arts Alliance and will also campaign to punish the Tang Sect.\nThe Dayi Branch ultimately found it difficult to balance loyalty and righteousness.

你深知人在江湖，身不由己的苦处。亦不愿朋友为难，付之一笑。=You deeply understand the bitter truth of being in the martial world, one cannot always do as one pleases.\nNot wanting to put your friends in a difficult position, you simply laughed it off.

你虽离不开唐门，但也并非刻意找死，为了一线生机不择手段，说话时使了点小心眼，动之以情，只盼到时丐帮朋友顾念旧情不致痛下杀手。=Though you cannot leave the Tang Sect, you are not deliberately seeking death either. To grasp a sliver of hope, you would resort to any means.\nWhen speaking, you employed a bit of cunning, appealing to emotions, hoping that when the time comes, your Beggars' Sect friends would remember old ties and not strike to kill.

你深知人在江湖，身不由己，须怪不得他们。想到来日不免要和熟人动真格一决生死，不胜唏嘘。=You deeply understand that in the martial world, one cannot always control their own fate, so you cannot blame them.\nThinking about inevitably having to fight seriously to the death with acquaintances in the future fills you with endless emotion.

岂料现在担心，委实太早。皆因丐帮新任帮主忌惮大义分舵与唐门有私交，唯恐围剿时不肯卖力，甚至叛变。为此不惜将大义分舵杨舵主明升暗贬，架空权力置于眼下监视，更要将大义分舵众丐移迁至江陵府，以作襄阳抗金战线备援。众丐哪里肯服气，均自打着小算盘，只待一有机会，便脱离建制独自消遥去。=Little did you expect that worrying now was truly too early.\nAll because the new Leader of the Beggars' Sect fears the private ties between the Dayi Branch and the Tang Sect, worried that during the siege they would not exert themselves or even rebel.\nTo this end, he did not hesitate to ostensibly promote but secretly demote Dayi Branch Leader Yang, stripping his power and keeping him under close watch. He even plans to relocate the beggars of the Dayi Branch to Jiangling Prefecture as backup for the Xiangyang anti-Jin front.\nThe beggars are hardly willing to accept this; each is making their own small plans, waiting for an opportunity to break away from the organization and go off on their own.

大功告成，你问起此丹来历，二师兄才肯说与你知。原来此丹大有来历，原是二十年前曾经为祸武林的旧魔教右护法所用的奇毒《尸心虫》，用以支配正道武林人士为己所用。如今极乐教覆灭，右护法被掌门击杀，此毒物亦随之消声匿迹，再也无人问津。二师兄却看中此毒的特性，展开研究，将此毒虫炼制成丹。=\nWith the task completed, you asked about the pill's origins, and the Second Senior Brother finally explained.\nIt turned out this pill had a significant history, it was originally the rare poison called《Corpse Heart Gu》, used by the former Demon Cult's Right Emissary two decades ago to control righteous martial artists for his own purposes.\nNow that the Blissful Cult had been destroyed and the Right Emissary killed by the Sect Leader, this poison had vanished into obscurity, mostly forgotten.\nBut Second Senior Brother saw potential in its properties, conducted research, and refined this toxic insect into a pill.

你对二师兄的远见表示激赏。=You expressed great admiration for Second Senior Brother's foresight.

你对二师兄毫不忌讳以此邪物炼丹的作法抱持中立意见。二师兄却不在意世人眼光，甚至远眺后世，只盼此药终有一日能够普惠世人，好教后世皆知唐门的仁心仁术。=You held a neutral opinion about Second Senior Brother's willingness to use such an evil substance in alchemy.\nBut Second Senior Brother didn't care about public perception. 你心直口快，直接说出了二师兄最不愿听到的话语，不出意外激怒了他，对你口出恶言，被抢白了一番，你觉得很受伤害。=You spoke bluntly, directly voicing what Second Senior Brother least wanted to hear. Unsurprisingly, this angered him. He hurled insults and rebuked you sharply, leaving you feeling deeply hurt.

大师兄向来率性，不打算拖泥带水，便欲速战速决，开门见山去质问谭霸刀。为免那谭霸天矢口否认，你便给出了一个计策，好去套他的话。二师兄与你剖析了一番他与大师兄武功的特性，不适合群殴，故此先由大师兄独自出阵，倘若不敌，自己再出手收尾。而你的职责，则在掠阵保护舫上无辜百姓。=\nFirst Senior Brother, always impulsive, had no intention of beating around the bush. 可那谭霸刀毕竟是道上打滚多年的老练人物，惊而不乱，当下脚下一踏，两名暗伏的刺客应声窜出水面。大师兄与二师兄默契绝佳，一人一个引出画舫，独留你与那谭霸刀四目相对。岂料他内功强横，强运一口真气勉力支撑，想将你拿下，令其他二人投鼠忌器，再寻脱身机会。他一提脚步，你转身便逃，堪堪追到，你才将心一横，决定转身相抗。=But Tan the Blade Tyrant was, after all, an experienced figure who had been in the game for many years. 你正想去喝杯茶，却被一位商人装束的陌生人喊住，道了身份，乃是当地漕运行会的行老。=\nYou were just about to go for a cup of tea when you were stopped by a stranger dressed as a merchant. He introduced himself as the Guild Elder of the local Water Transport Guild.

一问才知，是上官萤向他介绍了你。在你所不知道的地方，那姑娘似乎不像表面上那样时时挑剔的样子，反而向人说了不少你的好话，你既觉讶异，又感欣慰。=Only upon asking did you learn that Shangguan Ying had recommended you to him.\nIn places unknown to you, that girl didn't seem to be as constantly critical as she appeared on the surface; instead, she had said many good things about you to others. 那姓江的行老遂娓娓道来：原来是那上官千金在送寿礼前来的路上，碰见了非得亲自操持不可的要事，彼时正吹北风，便将寿礼托付给船会运送。可那分舵通知的信鸽却不知上哪去野了，姗姗来迟，导致同个船会的商船在江上相遇，竟起了冲突。要知船会为了独揽漕运生意，不知花了多少黄金白银打点，才取信朝廷，焉能容旁人假借船会的名义，来分这块饼？水手们登时便狠霸霸的要强行登船，强征过江费。岂料对面船上的，都是上官世家麾下的沧帮中人，虽不是海盗，也不是甚么善茬，哪肯答应，一恼之下，竟反将对面船只上的米粮、药材、干货等等一应都扣押住。这下可不得了，那些米粮、干货，都是南宫世家的姻亲钟家所订，钟家承包官府所派的安济坊生意，他们届时前来讨要米粮，江行老必定拿不出来，只愁的度日如年。只得将主意打到你头上，想借你唐门的余威，压一压这两家人的气焰。看看能否大事化小，小事化无。你好生为难，虽是个容易赚钱的生意，但贸然介入这种生意纠纷，又怕给师门添乱。=The Guild Elder, surnamed Jiang, then explained in detail: It turned out that the young lady of the Shangguan family, on her way to deliver the birthday gifts, encountered an urgent matter she had to handle personally. 亏你习武之人，对付两个弱不经风的儒生，也未能及时震慑，由他们大呼小叫引来街坊、捕快，将你缉拿归案。若非南宫世家出面斡旋，你还不知道要在牢里蹲多久。=For someone trained in martial arts like you, failing to immediately subdue two frail scholars allowed them to scream and shout, drawing the attention of neighbors and constables, who arrested you and brought you to justice.\nIf not for the Nangong Family stepping in to mediate, who knows how long you would have been stuck in jail.

宋总捕头与你也算有交情，信你并非浑不讲理的人，便良言劝了你。=Chief Constable Song, who has some friendship with you, believed you weren't an entirely unreasonable person and thus offered you some earnest advice.

岂知你似笑非笑，说今日这几下子，是为天下百姓打醒那二位书生的。他们将来若真能考取功名，能入朝为官、协助官家治理天下，岂能仅因擦肩而过，便以貌取人，轻言贬低他人？试问如此人品，真能爱民吗？所以要趁当前打得，先教他们记住庶民拳头的滋味，教他们知晓人人皆是血肉之躯。人皆可畏，莫要自视甚高，否则腹中空有诗书，说来头头是道，却不心怀仁善，为官也只会误国。轻描淡写几句话，似有无穷力量，彷佛天下苍生皆在你背后。宋大人哑口无言，只是顾念官身，只能微微颔首表示敬意，他倒不是认同你的手段，却是钦佩你这人。=Who would have thought you'd say, with a faint smile, that today's actions were meant to jolt those two scholars awake for the sake of the common people. If they were to pass the imperial exams in the future, enter court as officials, and assist the emperor in governing the realm, how could they judge others by appearances and speak dismissively after merely brushing past them? With such character, could they truly love the people?\nSo it was necessary to strike while the iron was hot, to make them remember the taste of the commoners' fists, to teach them that everyone is made of flesh and blood. All people are to be respected; they must not hold themselves too high. Otherwise, even with bellies full of poetry and literature, eloquent in speech, if they lack kindness and compassion, their service as officials would only harm the nation.\nYour lightly spoken words carried immense power, as if all the common people under heaven stood behind you.\nOfficial Song was left speechless. Bound by his position, he could only nod slightly in respect. It wasn't that he approved of your methods, but rather that he admired the person you are.

你讪讪一笑，听视听了，下回究竟能不能忍，却是未知数。=You gave an awkward smile, listening as if you'd taken it to heart, but whether you'll truly be able to hold back next time remains unknown.

你依着二师兄的指示，到他从前作过客席大夫的民间医馆见习。=\nFollowing Second Senior Brother's instructions, you went to observe at the local clinic where he once worked as a guest physician.

你从实践中学习，虽只得一个月磨练，已着实获益匪浅。于医道颇有所悟，不只见习，也赚了一些零花钱。=You learned through hands-on practice, and though it was only a month of training, you gained invaluable experience.\nYou developed genuine insights into the medical arts, not only observing but also earning some pocket money along the way.

你于医术略窥门径，最欠火侯。在此问诊，与老大夫切磋，虽只一个月磨练，已着实获益匪浅。增长不少见闻，于药理有了更深一层的理解。=You have glimpsed the gateway to medical arts but still lack refinement.\nDuring your time here, consulting with the experienced physician and engaging in discussions, though only a month of training, has already brought you substantial gains.\nGaining much knowledge and experience, you developed a deeper understanding of medicinal principles.

你于医、毒之术颇有研究，兼之身具内功，号脉精准，眼光毒辣。擅长以毒攻毒，见效神速，颇有昔日名医辣手相公的作派。在千金方坐诊不过一个月，『鬼面郎中』的名声便传遍了江陵府，辗转传入二师兄耳中，就连向来严厉的人都难得莞尔。=You have considerable expertise in both medicine and poisons, complemented by your skill in internal energy, which allows for precise pulse diagnosis and sharp insight.\nYou excel at using toxins to counteract toxins, achieving rapid results; reminiscent of the famed physician, The Ruthless Gentleman of the past.\nAfter only a month practicing at Thousand Gold Prescription, the reputation of the『Ghost-Faced Physician』spread throughout Jiangling Prefecture, eventually reaching Second Senior Brother's ears, drawing a rare smile from the usually stern man.

你一到安济坊，就碰见丐帮弟子在骚扰那钟家少夫人，出言龌龊，浑没将她钟家少爷放在眼里。那钟少爷顽劣不堪，少时好勇斗狠，曾加入丐帮，你师姐未嫁之时，见那钟少爷浑身泼赖劲，似乎颇有几分大师兄的不羁气魄，又感念那人对自己关怀备至，终于答应委身，殊不知她眼光差了远去。同样是玩世不恭，大师兄任侠四方，她夫郎却只是狐假虎威、色厉内荏之辈。在丐帮中不过是给丐头跑腿的喽啰，若非南宫世家出面，连脱离丐帮都办不到，自家媳妇给人欺负仍是唯唯诺诺，既怕恶人，又爱恶人。辛儒师姐再迟钝，也知自己嫁错了人，只是不甘心，逢人便说自己过得好，今日受恶丐所辱，既不能求助于夫家，向南宫世家投诉也只能换得个息事宁人的结果，到头还要反受夫君责难，说她小题大作，扫了钟家颜面。可她不仅是钟家的媳妇，也是从唐门出嫁的女儿。你挺身而出，威风凛凛护在她的身前。=\nAs soon as you arrived at the Anji Clinic, you encountered Beggars' Sect disciples harassing Madame Zhong with foul language, showing no respect for the Zhong family or its young master.\nThe young master of the Zhong family had always been wretched and unruly. In his youth, he was aggressive and loved to fight, and even joined the Beggars' Sect. Before your senior sister married, she saw in him a wild, untamed spirit reminiscent of your First Senior Brother's unbridled spirit, and moved by his attentive care, she eventually agreed to marry him. Little did she know how far off her judgment had been.\nThough both displayed a disregard for convention, First Senior Brother chivalrously roamed the land, while her husband is just a bully who borrows power from others, fierce in appearance but weak within. In the Beggars' Sect, he was merely a lackey running errands for the leaders. Had it not been for the Nangong family's intervention, he wouldn't even have been able to leave the Beggars' Sect. Now, with his own wife being insulted, he could only respond with meek compliance, both fearing and fawning over these ruffians.\nEven someone as slow as Senior Sister Xin Ru knew she had married the wrong man, but unwilling to admit it, she told everyone she was doing well. Today, humiliated by the vicious beggars, she could neither seek help from her husband's family nor get more than a pacifying result from complaining to the Nangong Family. In the end, she was even blamed by her husband for making a fuss and tarnishing the Zhong family's reputation.\nBut she is not just the Zhong family's daughter-in-law; she was also a daughter of the Tang Sect, married out from its gates.\nYou stepped forward, standing tall and imposing, shielding her with unwavering presence.

随即搬出二师兄的名号吓人，管用倒是十分管用，但你师姐的眼神登时便死了。=You immediately invoked Second Senior Brother's name to intimidate them, and it worked perfectly. But in that moment, the light in your senior sister's eyes died inside.

刚吓退那恶丐，你还得理不饶人，竟趁人不备，将刀子抹了口水便毫不留情向人捅去，简直恶得够劲，那恶丐懂得阴损伎俩也不算少，就没见过你这么厚颜无耻的款，当场便给你戳了个半死。=Just after scaring off the evil beggar, you pressed your advantage relentlessly. Taking them by surprise, you even licked your blade and stabbed without mercy, truly vicious enough. That evil beggar knew plenty of dirty tricks himself but had never seen someone as shameless as you, and was promptly stabbed half to death.

你手底功夫如何姑且不说，嘴皮功夫却着实了得，又是几句话迫得那恶丐又怒又怕，斗也不是、退也不是，心下已怯了，却仍拉不下脸，索性跟你拚了。=Leaving aside your actual skill, your persuasion skills are truly impressive. With just a few more words, you made the evil beggar both furious and afraid, unsure whether to fight or retreat. His heart was already timid, but he couldn't back down, so he simply decided to fight you to the death.

你得理不饶人，出言挤兑，要他向师姐道歉，岂知那恶丐也不是吃素的，给逼急了，恶向胆边生，心想你二师兄再可怕，打你一顿便逃之夭夭，他也不见得有兴致为你这厮千里缉凶报仇。=You pressed your advantage, taunting him, demanding he apologize to your senior sister. Who knew this evil beggar was no pushover either? Cornered, his malice overcame his fear. He figured that no matter how scary your Second Senior Brother was, if he beat you up and fled, it was unlikely Second Senior Brother would bother hunting him down across miles for revenge for someone like you.

你胆气豪壮，谁欺了你唐门中人，谁的娘亲就得遭你问候。当场大骂一声，便与那恶丐动起手来。=Your courage is immense. Whoever bullies someone from your Tang Sect will have their mother insulted by you.\nWith a loud curse, you immediately started fighting the evil beggar.

你与师姐二人一时无法拾夺那恶丐，让他搬弄是非，叫了许多帮手出来。眼见势危，你正想思忖退路之际，大师兄突然现身援手，屈指连弹金钱镖，轻易打退了群丐。他来得突然，去得也快，你师姐还想叙旧，大师兄已不见人影了。=\nYou and your senior sister were momentarily unable to handle the vicious beggar, who twisted the truth and called in many reinforcements.\nJust as the situation grew critical and you were contemplating a retreat, First Senior Brother suddenly appeared to assist. With swift flicks of his fingers, he sent coin darts flying, easily driving back the crowd of beggars.\nHis arrival was abrupt, and his departure even quicker. Before your Senior Sister could even catch up with him to reminisce, First Senior Brother had already vanished without a trace.

你打得那恶丐悻悻然而去，师姐好不诧异，几年不见，你武功竟变得如此高强。=You drove that vicious beggar away, seething with resentment. Your senior sister was utterly astonished; in just a few years, your martial skills had advanced to such a formidable level.

总算赶走了恶意滋事的祸源，可是该烦恼的事还远不只如此。那日起，你便日日往返客栈与安济坊，又是掌厨、又是派粥，有啥事就干啥事，忙得不可开交。从前人人追捧的师姐也捋起衣袖，露出皓皓素腕，随你忙里忙外。=Finally, you managed to drive away the malicious troublemakers, but the worries didn't end there.\nFrom that day on, you traveled daily between the inn and Anji Clinic, cooking, serving porridge, doing whatever needed to be done, tirelessly busy. Your once universally admired Senior Sister also rolled up her sleeves, revealing her fair wrists, and worked inside and out alongside you.

你在唐门伙房可不是白混的，一出手便大幅改良了安济坊的饮食。不单节约开支，还能兼顾养生。=Your time in the Tang Sect kitchen wasn't wasted. Your intervention significantly improved the meals at the Anji Clinic.\nNot only did you cut costs, but you also managed to prioritize health and nourishment.

你还无偿为安济坊里鳏寡孤独废疾者看病治伤。他们无不感激涕零，泪眼朦胧望见你的脸，丝毫不觉难看。=You also provided free medical treatment and care for the widowed, orphaned, disabled, and sick at the Anji Clinic.\nThey were all deeply moved to tears, and through their blurred vision as they looked at your face, they found nothing unpleasant about it.

转眼一个月过去，今日是你来安济坊帮忙的最后一日。师姐与你结了帐，客客气气送出门来，忽然又喊住了你，说她鼓起勇气打了丈夫。她只道自己错付了人，这一生就得老实挨着，实际反抗以后，才发现并没想象中的艰难，即使被休了，娘家容不下她，只要唐门还在，她便不会无家可归。=In the blink of an eye, a month has passed. Today was your last day helping at Anji Clinic.\nYour senior sister settled the accounts with you and saw you out politely, but then suddenly called you back. She told you she had mustered the courage to confront her husband.\nShe admitted she had mistaken his character and thought she would have to endure it silently for life. Yet after finally resisting, she realized it wasn't as difficult as she had imagined. Even if he divorced her and her own family wouldn't take her back, as long as the Tang Sect remained, she would never be without a home.

你应邀来到渡口，担任江行老的保镳。他有求于你，将你奉为上宾对待，还专程去茶馆请茶博士来沏热茶。你哪曾受过这般礼遇，眼看渡口水手与受雇的飞石帮众忙进忙出，汗流浃背，你却在此悠闲自得，不禁有点儿心虚，可你也不愿没事找事，遂接受江行老的好意，当真只与他品茶谈天。江行老虽不是文人出身，却有不少生意经，每日教你品鉴瓷器、古玩。几日深谈下来，令你眼界大开。=\nYou accepted the invitation to the docks, serving as Guild Elder Jiang's bodyguard.\nHe had a favor to ask of you, treating you as an honored guest and even specially inviting a tea master from a teahouse to brew hot tea.\nUnaccustomed to such courtesy, you watched as the dockworkers and hired Flying Stone Gang members bustled about, sweating profusely, while you relaxed at your leisure. You couldn't help but feel a bit guilty, yet you had no desire to stir up trouble unnecessarily. So, you accepted Guld Elder Jiang's kindness, simply enjoying tea and conversation with him.\nThough not a scholar by background, Guild Elder Jiang had much business acumen, teaching you daily about appraising porcelain and antiques.\nSeveral days of deep conversation broadened your horizons immensely.

你应邀来到渡口，担任江行老的保镳。他有求于你，将你奉为上宾对待，还专程去茶馆请茶博士来沏热茶。你哪曾受过这般礼遇，眼看渡口水手与受雇的飞石帮众忙进忙出，汗流浃背，你却在此悠闲自得，不禁有点儿心虚，主动请缨去做粗工。飞石帮本来与你唐门颇有嫌隙，可都不是针对你个人。最初几日还对你冷嘲热讽，但他们都不是城府深沉之辈，与你做着一样的苦力活，日日吆喝着挥洒汗水，完事收工后去酒肆沽些便宜黄酒痛饮，要不多久，便与你打成一片了。=You accepted the invitation to the docks, serving as Guild Elder Jiang's bodyguard.\nHe had a favor to ask of you, treating you as an honored guest and even specially inviting a tea master from a teahouse to brew hot tea.\nYou had never received such treatment before. Unaccustomed to such courtesy, you watched as the dockworkers and hired Flying Stone Gang members bustled about, sweating profusely, while you lounged at ease. You felt a bit guilty and volunteered to do manual labor.\nThe Flying Stone Gang originally had quite a grudge against your Tang Sect, but none of it was directed at you personally. For the first few days, they mocked you sarcastically, but they weren't deep or scheming types. Doing the same hard labor as you, shouting daily while sweating, going to the tavern after work to buy cheap yellow wine and drink heartily, it didn't take long for them to warm up to you.

这一日，算来便是借予沧帮的大船即将到港靠岸的日子，江行老既紧张、又自豪，命手下众人两行排开迎接，岂料船上下来的，并不是沧帮弟子，亦非他船会的水手，二话不说提刀便砍，幸亏你及时出手，才及时救他性命。=On that day, which was supposed to be when the ship lent to the Cang Gang was due to dock, Guild Elder Jiang was both nervous and proud. He ordered his men to line up in two rows to welcome the arrival. However, those who disembarked were neither Cang Gang disciples nor sailors from his own shipping guild. Without a word, they drew their blades and attacked. Fortunately, you acted in time and managed to save his life.

那群劫船海盗不知嘴里念叨什么咒语，直念你心里发毛，幸亏飞石帮众及时赶至，与你并肩，与那群海盗厮杀成一片。=Those ship-raiding pirates kept muttering some kind of incantation, sending chills straight to your heart. Fortunately, the Flying Stone Gang members arrived just in time, standing by your side as you all plunged into a fierce battle with the pirates.

你与飞石帮众好不容易才击退了这群无法无天的劫船恶匪，只是自己也损伤惨重。=You and the Flying Stone Gang members barely managed to repel these lawless ship-raiding pirates, though not without suffering heavy losses yourselves.

那群劫船海盗不知嘴里念叨什么咒语，你一听登时恍然大悟，他们口中怪话，却不是白鲨语是啥？当即也用白鲨语自表身分，白鲨帮众认出是你，亦是大喜，一面与你假打，一面用白鲨语说明原委，原来他们误打误撞劫了沧帮的船，听说船上的米粮都是该给穷人的，哪还能忍，但凡能够扫官府颜面、给富人添乱的勾当，都必须干的轰轰烈烈。=Those ship-raiding pirates kept muttering some unintelligible chant, but the moment you heard it, it suddenly dawned on you—the strange words they were speaking were none other than the White Shark dialect!\nYou immediately identified yourself in the same language of the White Shark Gang. The White Shark Gang members recognized you and were overjoyed. While pretending to fight, they explained the situation in the White Shark dialect: they had accidentally hijacked the Cang Gang's ship and learned that the rice and supplies on board were meant for the poor. How could they stand for that? Any scheme that could embarrass the authorities and cause trouble for the wealthy was something they felt compelled to carry out with gusto.

你正听着白鲨帮朋友说明原委，却忽然狠下杀手，打倒了他。海盗同伙又惊又怒，提刀砍来，你未及说明，飞石帮也来助阵，两方人马顿时打成一团。=Just as you were listening to your White Shark Gang friend explain, you suddenly struck ruthlessly, knocking him down.\nHis pirate companions, shocked and furious, raised their blades to attack. 你劝退了白鲨帮众，他们与你相交日浅，却是一起吃过鱼脍的鱼脍伙伴。略一思忖，便决定将货物交你处理，趁着官兵未至，扬帆而去。=You persuaded the White Shark Gang members to retreat. Though your acquaintance was brief, you were partners who had shared sliced fish together.\nAfter brief consideration, they decided to leave the cargo for you to handle and set sail before the authorities arrived.

你试着劝白鲨帮众以自身性命为众，他们却拒绝了你，这可不是他们能够置生死于度外，而是因为他们帮主比阎王还可怕。阎王能令你投胎变畜牲，白鲨帮主能令你后悔出生，求生不得，求死不能。你无话可说，只能退让到一边，置身事外。=You tried to persuade the White Shark Gang to value their own lives, but they refused. This wasn't because they could disregard life and death, but because their Gang Leader was more terrifying than the King of Hell.\nThe King of Hell can make you reincarnate as an animal; the White Shark Leader can make you regret being born, unable to live or die.\nYou had nothing to say and could only step aside, removing yourself from the affair.

此后那群白鲨帮众在江陵城中瞎闯乱撞，跑给官兵追，百忙中往安济坊投了米粮，又得丐帮相助，终于逃出生天。=Afterward, those White Shark Gang members dashed recklessly through Jiangling City, fleeing from pursuing soldiers. In the midst of the chaos, they managed to deliver the rice and provisions to the Anji Clinic and, with the help of the Beggars' Sect, finally made their escape.

你惟恐天下不乱，把心一横，竟加入了白鲨帮行列，招摇过市，去叩安济坊的大门，闯将进去，将米粮、食物、药材一股脑儿都扔给这群鳏寡孤独的可怜人。你们这群横行无忌的狂徒是穷人的朋友，富人的仇敌，也是官府的眼中钉。虽办了这件大事，却不知下一步该怎么摆脱官兵追击，正发愁时，安济坊中的丐帮弟子便出来自白身份──谁也想不到，天下第一大帮的帮主，竟然便是司掌泥教畜牲道的法王。丐帮大仁分舵，亦即泥教畜牲道部众早在西门部属，刻意闹事招惹门卫注意，与你们里应外合，打得官兵们措手不及。=You threw caution to the wind and joined the ranks of the White Shark Gang, parading boldly through the streets. You marched up to the gates of the Anji Clinic, barged in, and tossed rice, food, and medicine to the widowed, orphaned, and destitute souls inside.\nYou and your band of lawless madmen became friends of the poor, enemies of the rich, and thorns in the side of the authorities.\nThough you accomplished this great deed, you had no idea how to escape the pursuing soldiers. Just as worry began to set in, a member of the Beggars' Sect within the Anji Clinic revealed his identity—who would have thought that the leader of the world's largest beggar organization was actually the Dharma King who commanded the Animal Realm of the Mud Sect?\nThe Beggars' Sect's Daren Branch, also the followers of the Mud Sect's Animal Realm, had long been stationed at the West Gate, deliberately causing trouble to draw the guards' attention. Working with you from inside and out, they caught the authorities off guard.

江行长欠钟家的货物失而复得，又不必面对沧帮刁难，真不知有多感谢你。=Guild Elder Jiang's goods owed to the Zhong family were recovered, and he didn't have to face the Cang Gang's harassment. He couldn't thank you enough.

你处世谦冲，把功劳往旁人身上分，既得飞石帮的人心，也顾全了南宫世家的脸面。=You handled things humbly, distributing the credit to others, winning the Flying Stone Gang's hearts while also preserving the Nangong Family's dignity.

江行长欠钟家的货物失而复得，又不必面对沧帮刁难，真不知有多感谢你。你处世谦冲，把功劳往旁人身上分，既得飞石帮的人心，也顾全了南宫世家的脸面。=Guild Elder Jiang's goods owed to the Zhong family were recovered, and he didn't have to face the Cang Gang's harassment. He couldn't thank you enough.\nYou handled things humbly, distributing the credit to others, winning the Flying Stone Gang's hearts while also preserving the Nangong Family's dignity.

江行长欠钟家的货物失而复得，又不必面对沧帮刁难，真不知有多感谢你。=Guild Elder Jiang having recovered the goods owed to the Zhong family and avoided any further trouble from the Cang Gang, couldn't express how grateful he was to you.

你为人豪爽，有功劳也不愿独揽，直言替飞石帮众邀功，那些帮众听了心头热热的，都觉得你这人虽丑，却是值得交往的朋友。=You're forthright and generous, unwilling to take all the credit yourself, and you openly asked for recognition for the Flying Stone Gang members. 江行长欠钟家的货物失而复得，又不必面对沧帮刁难，真不知有多感谢你。你为人豪爽，有功劳也不愿独揽，直言替飞石帮众邀功，那些帮众听了心头热热的，都觉得你这人虽丑，却是值得交往的朋友。=Guild Elder Jiang having recovered the goods owed to the Zhong family and avoided any further trouble from the Cang Gang, couldn't express how grateful he was to you.\nYou're forthright and generous, unwilling to take all the credit yourself, and you openly asked for recognition for the Flying Stone Gang members. Hearing this, their hearts warmed, and they all felt that although you're ugly, you're a friend worth having.

算来时日也快到南宫寿宴，四师兄遂租了一辆马车，雇了车夫，准备慢条斯理上路，以免风尘仆仆，反而失礼。=\nCounting the days, it was nearly time for the Nangong birthday banquet. Fourth Senior Brother rented a carriage and hired a coachman, planning to set off at a leisurely pace to avoid arriving travel-worn and seeming impolite.

至于大师兄、二师兄、三师兄则分头前往，相约江陵府会合。=As for First Senior Brother, Second Senior Brother, and Third Senior Brothers, they traveled separately, agreeing to meet in Jiangling Prefecture.

算来时日也快到南宫寿宴，四师兄遂租了一辆马车，雇了车夫，准备慢条斯理上路，以免风尘仆仆，反而失礼。至于大师兄、二师兄、三师兄则分头前往，相约江陵府会合。=\nCounting the days, it was nearly time for the Nangong birthday banquet. Fourth Senior Brother rented a carriage and hired a coachman, planning to set off at a leisurely pace to avoid arriving travel-worn and seeming impolite.\nAs for First Senior Brother, Second Senior Brother, and Third Senior Brothers, they traveled separately, agreeing to meet in Jiangling Prefecture.

小师妹和你都是生平第一次搭马车，对这趟旅行雀跃不已。=Little Junior Sister and you were both riding in a carriage for the first time in your lives, thrilled about this journey.

将行月余，终于到了江陵府南宫世家的地头。但见城市石子铺路，家家门户都漆得新亮，人来人往，热闹非凡，与唐门山下小镇的纯朴风光截然不同。先行探路的师兄们早到一步，三师兄一路上打点，边盯着大师兄防他脱序失踪，似乎被折腾的不轻。=After over a month of travel, you finally reached the Nangong Family's territory in Jiangling Prefecture.\nThe city streets were paved with cobblestones, every household's door was freshly painted, and the bustling crowds created a lively atmosphere, a stark contrast to the simple and rustic scenery of the town beneath Tang Sect's mountain.\nThe senior brothers who went ahead to scout the route arrived earlier. 小师妹闻言，便想回程将车子让给三师兄乘坐。你立马跳出来反对，让小师妹跟大师兄两人同行，那是天下最凶险的事情。倒不怕大师兄对小师妹不安好心，怕就怕他太安好心，万一他心血来潮想带小师妹去打劫山贼怎办？万一他临时起意想带小师妹去天山赏雪怎办？小师妹既乖巧又听话，浑没主见，若将她交付给大师兄，几年后人被丢包到东瀛去，不知怎么回家都非无稽之谈。=When Little Junior Sister heard this, she wanted to return and offer the carriage seat to Third Senior Brother.\nYou immediately jumped out to object—letting Little Junior Sister travel alone with First Senior Brother would be the most perilous thing in the world.\nIt wasn't that you feared the eldest senior brother would have ill intentions toward her, but rather that his intentions might be too good. What if he suddenly decided to take her to raid bandit mountains? 办妥事情，再行几日，终于到了江陵府南宫世家的地头。但见城市石子铺路，家家门户都漆得新亮，人来人往，热闹非凡，与唐门山下小镇的纯朴风光截然不同。=After handling matters and traveling a few more days, you finally reached the Nangong Family's territory in Jiangling Prefecture.\nThe city streets were paved with cobblestones, every household's door was freshly painted, and the bustling crowds created a lively atmosphere, a stark contrast to the simple and rustic scenery of the town beneath Tang Sect's mountain.

南宫世家不愧是武林三大世家之一，这一场寿宴，将武林中有脸面的人物十之八九都请了过来。不说南宫世家祖辈曾出过武状元、出过武林盟主，这上下两代人又是交游广阔，任它江湖风雨飘摇，依然屹立数百年不朽，武林中无人不知南宫大名。当下由家丁按帖唱名、收礼，当家在前相迎，宾客依序入内寒暄。终于轮到了你们唐门一行人。=The Nangong Family truly lived up to their reputation as one of the Three Great Martial Families. 要知耕阳读书斋的文人，心气之傲举世无双，斋中皆是才华冠绝当代的隐士。躬耕在野，不恋浮华，不慕功名，宰相史弥远派人延请，都被乱棍轰出书斋。斋主曾曰升平能歌舞，乱世不作诗。宁当治世无能辈，不作昏朝有用臣。要待世间再无冻死骨，方才出山，歌颂四海升平，否则宁死不食朝廷一石米俸禄，以彰显自己读书是为侍奉天地人三才，而非事一介人君。此书斋向来只写江湖快报，其它墨宝万金难求。南宫家主得此墨宝，惊喜若狂，当着宾客的面，对唐门贺礼大加赞赏，引来无数目光。宾客就算没有文采的，也看过江湖快报；没看过江湖快报的，也懂看南宫家主的脸色。都说唐门虽不如从前那般势大，结交的朋友却均非寻常人物，殊不可侮。=It must be understood that the scholars of Gengyang Study Hall possess pride unmatched in this world, each is a recluse of peerless talent in their generation.\nThey till the fields in seclusion, coveting neither luxury nor fame.
