席间各派门人吵吵嚷嚷，既没人看得起你前来客套一番，你索性便自得其乐，吃你自己的酒菜，不亦乐乎。=\nAmid the noisy chatter of disciples from various sects at the banquet, no one bothered to show you any courtesy or engage in small talk. So, you simply decided to enjoy yourself, savoring your own food and drink, finding your own joy in the moment.

席间各派门人吵吵嚷嚷，既没人看得起你前来客套一番，你索性便自得其乐，吃你自己的酒菜，不亦乐乎。怎料他们聊着聊着，忽然把矛头齐齐指向了与世无争的你，言语之间，甚至辱及师门。=\nAmid the noisy chatter of disciples from various sects at the banquet, no one bothered to show you any courtesy or engage in small talk. So, you simply decided to enjoy yourself, savoring your own food and drink, finding your own joy in the moment.\nYet, as they chatted on, they suddenly turned their focus entirely toward you, who had been minding your own business, and their words even began to slander your sect.

你读了这许多书，也不是白读的。当下也不发火，沉着性子，不亢不卑晓以大义，阐明道理，有古时圣人背书，无懈可击，这等江湖草莽，压根无言可对，想找麻烦反碰得一鼻子灰，听是没听进去，却对你这人生了几分敬畏之心。=You've read all those books, and it wasn't in vain.\nIn that moment, you didn't lose your temper but kept your composure, neither submissive nor arrogant, explaining the greater principles with clarity. Backed by the wisdom of ancient sages, your reasoning was flawless and unassailable.\nThese ruffians had no rebuttal, though they likely didn't truly grasp your words, they couldn't help but feel a sense of awe toward you.

他们肆无忌惮议论著江湖有名的女子，又将话头谈到唐门头上，你一气之下搬出了小师妹，反让小师妹被人讥嘲，说她从未下山走动，必是貌丑见不得人。辱你无妨，辱你师门者可恨，辱你小师妹者不共戴天。你当即拍案而起，将人摁到地上疯狂殴打。南宫族人连忙赶至，将你俩分开。两方各执一词，一时难分对错，又有众口铄金，你反被冤枉。除了大师兄之外，其他师兄都不免怨你冲动，有损师门名誉。=They brazenly gossiped about well-known women in the martial world, then turned their attention to the Tang Sect. In a fit of anger, you brought up Little Junior Sister, only to have her mocked—they sneered that since she had never ventured down the mountain, she must be too ugly to show her face.\nInsults against you were one thing, but slurs against your sect were detestable, and slander against your Little Junior Sister was unforgivable.\nYou immediately slammed the table, stood up, pinned the person to the ground, and pummeled them ruthlessly.\nNangong Family members rushed over to separate the two of you. With both sides sticking to their own stories, it was hard to determine right from wrong in the moment. Moreover, under the weight of public opinion, you were wrongly blamed. Aside from First Senior Brother, the other senior brothers couldn't help but resent your impulsiveness, feeling it had damaged the sect's reputation.

他们肆无忌惮议论著江湖有名的女子，又将话头谈到唐门头上，你一气之下搬出了小师妹，反让小师妹被人讥嘲，说她从未下山走动，必是貌丑见不得人。辱你无妨，辱你师门者可恨，辱你小师妹者不共戴天。你当即拍案而起，想和此敌同归于尽，小师妹却在此时飘然而至。那几人见了小师妹的容貌，登时无话可说，后悔不该贸然出言相讥，纷纷辩解，唐门对头点苍派的甚至起了歹心想博得美人青睐，背叛了方才新结交的朋友们，混乱厮斗起来。小师妹却自始至终不将他们几人言语放在心上，为你拍拍顺气，劝你不要生气，便回去了。=They brazenly gossiped about well-known women in the martial world, then turned their attention to the Tang Sect. 旋即，小师妹去而复返，原来是看你桌上菜色不如上宾席，心有不舍，便去拿了一碟栗子米糕给你，你还没入口，便觉得心头甜甜暖暖的，甚是受用。=Shortly after, Little Junior Sister returned. It turned out she had noticed the dishes at your table weren't as fine as those at the upper seats and couldn't bear to see it. So, she brought you a plate of chestnut rice cakes. Even before tasting them, you felt a sweet warmth spreading through your heart, deeply touched by her gesture.

你处世豪爽，懒得多费唇舌，开宗明义要就打，不打就闭嘴。一番抢白便令他们再也不敢言语，他们倒非真怕了你这个名不见经传的小人物，怕只怕闹大开罪南宫世家。当下悻悻然不再答话，却暗暗将你记下了，来日江湖再见，再找你算账不迟。=You carry yourself with bold forthrightness and have no patience for unnecessary words, making it clear from the start: either fight or shut up. Known as the "Ruthless Gentleman", his poison skills are top-tier, and his methods are even more ruthless. The martial artists at this table are no major figures—they're just talkative after drinking too much and feeling high-spirited. Today, on his birthday, he has invited friends from all corners, and it's safe to say that almost every notable figure still active in the martial world has attended, very few are absent.\nDespite his advanced age and esteemed reputation, Nangong Heng has a humorous and gentle disposition. Whenever he speaks, it's always with a touch of jest, leaving the guests in fits of laughter.

你虽不觉得好笑，跟着众人打个哈哈，虚应故事，也算顾全老人家颜面。=Although you didn't find it amusing, you went along with the crowd and let out a polite laugh, just going through the motions to save face for the elder.

你完全不给人面子，一个笑话不如你意，你便在人家寿宴上小声偷骂人家糟老头子。偏巧那老寿星老是老，却一点都不糟，目光如炬，一眼就在人群中发现你面无笑意，甚至他还能读唇语，你暗咒人家的心意，老寿星收到了。=You showed no regard for anyone's feelings. 那笑话不见得好笑，但你感觉此人为老不遵，倒是可爱，不禁莞尔。=The joke wasn't particularly funny, but you found his irreverent charm endearing and couldn't help but smile.

南宫横切入正题，说起距今约莫十几、二十年前，西域极乐教危祸武林的往事。虽说所谓魔教历朝历代皆有，从不缺席，但极乐教危害之大，却是空前绝后。当年正道各派形如一盘散沙，互相忌惮牵制，只能坐以待毙，被极乐教逐个击破。眼看极乐教声势浩大，大宣旗鼓招兵买马，有意逐鹿中原，作那九五至尊，奴役中原。嵩山派高僧怜悯众生，舍身取义，终于感召武林各派领袖，捐弃前嫌，在新任武林盟主的领导下，团结一心，围剿极乐教。最终华山顶上决战，万恶魁首「快活王」伏诛，左右护法一死一逃，剩下的极乐教众没了领袖，兵败如山倒，被彻底剿灭，这才瓦解江山易主的危机。盟主龙渊战后行踪不明；唐门掌门重伤落下隐疾终生难愈；青城高手败后，更是道心溃散，由心生魔，成了今日泥教六道法王之一。那一场决战，见证者稀，结局更令人不胜唏嘘。如今极乐教灭，泥教又起，南宫横在宴上提及泥教，顿时群情汹涌，欲趁燎原之火扼杀于未发之前。=Nangong Heng cut to the chase, speaking of events from about ten or twenty years ago, when the Western Regions' Blissful Sect plagued the martial world. 你着实看不惯此情此景，上前与二公子南宫浅打了声招呼，无视那二名恶仆，想帮忙南宫浅。他们哪肯答应，想来也是仗着南宫世家的势头嚣张惯了，明知你是外宾，还大胆动起手来，你本想息事宁人，被人欺负到这种地步，也不和他们客气，当场便大打出手。=You truly couldn't stand the sight of this situation. Stepping forward, you greeted the Second Young Master, Nangong Qian, ignoring the two malicious servants as you moved to help him. They, however, were unwilling to allow it—likely accustomed to throwing their weight around under the Nangong family's influence. Even knowing you were an external guest, they boldly resorted to violence. Initially, you had hoped to avoid conflict, but pushed to this extent, you saw no reason to hold back and immediately engaged them in a fierce fight.

着实看不惯此情此景，上前与二公子南宫浅打了声招呼，请他退一边去，对着那二名恶仆劈头便数落。=You truly couldn't stand the sight of this situation. Stepping forward, you greeted the Second Young Master, Nangong Qian, and asked him to step aside. Then, you turned to the two malicious servants and began reprimanding them sternly.

南宫浅在旁听你滔滔不绝，惊得目瞪口呆，他哪曾见过似你这般口若悬河之人？一席话骂得好不痛快。=Nangong Qian stood by, listening to your torrent of words, utterly stunned. He had never seen someone as eloquently sharp-tongued as you. Every word of your scolding was delivered with such satisfying force.

空前绝后。=Unprecedented and unmatched.

震古烁今。=Eclipsing past and present.

丧尽天良。=Utterly devoid of conscience.

古有张仪能以口舌之争，令战神孟子吐血三升；今有你唐门赵活能嘴动乾坤，化无形言语为杀人利剑，当场将首当其冲的恶徒气得呕血身亡。旁人还来不及惊慌，你又补上一脚踹活了他。=In ancient times, Zhang Yi could wage wars with his words, causing the war god Mengzi to vomit blood in fury; today, you, Zhao Huo of the Tang Sect, can move heaven and earth with your speech, turning intangible words into lethal blades. 你把人气成这样，一场恶斗自然在所难免。=Having provoked them to this extent, a fierce fight was inevitable.

你听南宫深有意在未婚妻面前大事化小，应付过去，当即出言解释。=Seeing that Nangong Shen intended to downplay the incident in front of his fiancée and smooth things over, you immediately spoke up to explain the situation.

上官萤却连使眼色，示意要你不要多话。=However, Shangguan Ying repeatedly signaled with her eyes, urging you to stay silent.

南宫深非但不追究此事，反而有意回护家仆，指责你越俎代庖。=Nangong Shen not only refused to investigate the matter but even went out of his way to defend the servants, accusing you of overstepping your boundaries.

上官萤见南宫浅窝囊的样子也没好气，见他还唯唯诺诺纠结于此，便疾言叱退了他。=Seeing Nangong Qian's timid and incompetent demeanor, Shangguan Ying grew even more displeased. Noticing that he was still hesitantly dwelling on the matter, she sharply rebuked him and sent him away.

你留下一句关心话语，上官萤笑啐不理，心底却倍感踏实。想起当日与你共患难的情谊，对你着实信赖。=You left behind a word of concern. Shangguan Ying laughed it off without responding, but deep down, she felt reassured. Remembering the bond you shared through adversity, she truly trusts you.

你们方才虽然打输了架，却打出了难能可贵的患难情谊。他没有依靠你，你也不值得依靠，但因此才能是对等的朋友关系。=Though you lost the fight just now, it forged a rare bond of friendship through adversity.\nHe didn't rely on you, nor were you someone he could depend on, but precisely because of that, you became equals as friends.

寿宴结束之后，你和同门被南宫世家挽留，在客房借宿一晚。今日事多，你也累得很了，盥洗之后便睡了，一夜无梦，睡得十分香甜。=After the birthday banquet concluded, you and your sect members were invited by the Nangong family to stay overnight in the guest rooms.\nThe day had been eventful, and you were thoroughly exhausted. 赋归时一路顺风，沿途游山玩水，不急不缓，将行一个月，便到了家。这是小师妹生平第一次离家那么远，有一点儿思念父亲，但更多的是新奇与雀跃。=The journey home was smooth, with stops to enjoy the mountains and rivers along the way. Taking your time, you arrived home after about a month.\nFor your Little Junior Sister, it was the first time she had ever been so far from home. Though she felt a touch of longing for her father, her heart was filled even more with novelty and excitement.

赋归时一路顺风，沿途游山玩水，不急不缓，将行一个月，便到了家。师兄们去向掌门请安汇报此行结果，只有小师妹来迎你。=The journey home was smooth, with stops to enjoy the mountains and rivers along the way. Taking your time, you arrived home after about a month.\nThe senior brothers went to pay their respects to the Sect Leader and report the outcome of their journey, leaving only Little Junior Sister to greet you.

这一日唐门会议，议及南宫横所提交换弟子一事，掌门已有定见。折衷授以粗末技艺，待遇对比外姓弟子相去不远。差别只在外派弟子除了负责整理自己起居，无须再服杂役。=\nOn the day of the Tang Sect meeting, when the matter of exchanging disciples proposed by Nangong Heng was discussed, the Sect Leader had already formed an opinion. 这一日天方鱼肚白，你便起床了，想着争取时间做完日常杂务，就躲到后山苦练武功，就算是外姓弟子，也有尊严，不想让新入门下的师侄看轻了你这师叔。岂料路经正心堂，却见清早人声哗然，凑近去看，却原来是新来的弟子正向掌门敬茶，在行拜师大礼。你霎时如遭雷亟，怔然无语，多年勤恳，终究徒劳。沉积的恶浊思绪涌出心口。=\nAt the break of dawn, you rose early, hoping to finish your daily chores quickly so you could retreat to the back mountain and practice martial arts diligently. Even as an outer-sect disciple, you had your pride and didn't want the newly arrived junior disciples to look down on you, their senior.\nHowever, as you passed by the Zhengxin Hall, you were startled by the clamor of voices in the early morning. Drawing closer, you saw new disciples presenting tea to the Sect Leader, performing the formal ceremony of apprenticeship.\nIn that moment, you felt as if struck by lightning, stunned into silence. Years of diligence had ultimately been in vain. A surge of bitter, murky thoughts welled up in your heart.

迎面碰上了大师兄，问你去向，怨火中烧，咬牙切齿，恨不得冲入弟子房中，一刀一个捅死所有比你先转正入室的同门师兄。=You ran right into First Senior Brother, who asked where you were headed. Burning with resentment and grinding your teeth, you felt an overwhelming urge to burst into the disciples' quarters and stab every fellow disciple who had been accepted as an inner-sect disciple before you.

你没法如愿以偿，起码要有公平。无奈碰着大师兄，你竟连行凶机会都被剥夺，未免太不公平了。=You couldn't have your way, but at the very least, there should be fairness.\nUnfortunately, running into the First Senior Brother has even stripped you of the chance to commit violence. How utterly unfair.

迎面碰上了大师兄，问你去向，怨火中烧，咬牙切齿，恨不得冲入弟子房中，一刀一个捅死所有比你先转正入室的同门师兄。你没法如愿以偿，起码要有公平。无奈碰着大师兄，你竟连行凶机会都被剥夺，未免太不公平了。=You ran right into First Senior Brother, who asked where you were headed. Burning with resentment and grinding your teeth, you felt an overwhelming urge to burst into the disciples' quarters and stab every fellow disciple who had been accepted as an inner-sect disciple before you.\nYou couldn't have your way, but at the very least, there should be fairness.\nUnfortunately, running into the First Senior Brother has even stripped you of the chance to commit violence. 迎面碰上了大师兄，你悲愤至极，你何尝不想成为大侠，想做好人，想当唐家人。但是人间偏不让，唐门偏不肯。至今依然不知自己哪里做得不对、何处做得不足，才始终不得师长垂青。难道真就因为生就这一付容貌，所以始终不得入室吗？那也未免太不公平了。=You came face to face with the First Senior Brother, overwhelmed with grief and indignation. Hadn't you also wanted to become a Great Hero, to be a good person, to truly belong to the Tang Clan?\nBut the world simply won't allow it, and the Tang Sect refuses to accept you.\nTo this day, you still don't know what you've done wrong or where you've fallen short, why you've never earned the favor of your masters. Could it really be because of your appearance that you were never accepted as an inner-sect disciple? That would be too unfair.

你近乎歇斯底里，冲着大师兄咆哮着。想起这些年的辛酸、委屈，想起叩入山门那一日，你感激涕零、踌躇满志；想起你从家乡一路赤脚，强忍饥饿，死命不吃家人给作拜师礼的四颗熟鸡蛋；想起离家那一年，农田歉收，父母说家里要减一双筷子，你记得他们饱含歉意的生硬笑脸，忘记了他们生作什么模样。想起离家以前，独自在幽暗灶下摸黑独食的剩饭，每一颗馒头都混着泪水的咸。你其实不姓唐，也不姓赵，你早就无家可归了。=You were nearly hysterical, screaming at your First Senior Brother.\nYou recalled the hardships and grievances of these years, the day you knocked on the sect's mountain gate; tearful, overwhelmed with gratitude and ambition;\nYou remembered walking barefoot from your hometown, enduring hunger, refusing to eat the four hard-boiled eggs your family had given you as a gift for your Master.\nYou remembered the year you left home, when the fields failed, and your parents said the household had to cut one mouth to feed. You remembered their stiff, apologetic smiles but forgot what they actually looked like.\nYou remembered before leaving home, eating leftover rice alone in the dark by the stove, every bite of steamed bun mixed with the salt of your tears.\nYou don't really bear the surname Tang, nor are you truly named Zhao. You've been without a home for a long time.

你全程几乎是跑着下山的，差点都忘了呼吸。到了山脚，见到早市川流不息的人潮才回过神来。离开唐门了，可是将来该往何处，却是一片茫然。=ou practically ran down the entire mountain, almost forgetting to breathe. It wasn't until you reached the foot of the mountain and saw the bustling crowds of the morning market that you finally snapped back to reality.\nYou've left the Tang Sect, but where to go from here? Your mind was a complete blank.

但你性情坚毅，反正回不了家，索性便将愁绪抛诸脑后，暂且不想了。好手好脚，总是饿不死的，没什么好怕的。从此天宽地广任你行，你已是自由之身了。=But you were resilient by nature. Since you couldn't return home anyway, you decided to cast your worries aside for now.\nWith able hands and feet, you wouldn't starve, there was nothing to fear.\nFrom now on, the world was wide and open for you to travel. You were free.

你不告而别，再也不算唐门弟子了。这身青衫，从此是不能再穿了。你低头看着被泪打湿了襟口的一身青衣，不知不觉变得既脏又破，缝了又破，破了又缝，远远看着似乎完好，细看才知千疮百孔。就像你一样。=You left without saying goodbye, no longer a Tang Sect disciple. This blue robe could never be worn again.\nYou look down at the blue garment, its collar soaked with tears, now tattered and stained, mended over and over, torn again and again. From a distance, it might seem intact, but up close, it's full of holess. Just like you.

听到早市各种热闹叫卖声，你这才想起自己连早饭都还没吃，便奔下山来了，此时饥肠辘辘，光是闻着香气都要滴唾沫。=Hearing the lively calls of the morning market, you remembered you hadn't even eaten breakfast before rushing down the mountain. Now your stomach growled, and just smelling the aromas made you drool.

正张望之际，三师兄赶上了你。你的辛苦他都看在眼里，也曾不只一次为你探问掌门口风，纵使对你的处境无能为力，但心下依然感激。你远行在即，他说是代表几个师兄赠你些碎银，让你旅途花用，其实这些钱都是他傍身多年的本命钱。=As you looked around, Third Senior Brother had caught up with you.\nHe had seen your hardships and had inquired with the Sect Leader on your behalf more than once. Though unable to change your situation, he was still grateful.\nWith your journey imminent, he said he represented several senior brothers in giving you some silver for travel expenses, but in truth, this money was his own long-saved life savings.

你拿十文铜钱，买了一把锅底捞出的碎油条渣和稀粥充饥，怕被人看见，所以站在巷子里面吃。=With ten copper coins, you bought some scraped-up fried dough bits from the pot bottom and thin porridge to fill your stomach. Afraid of being seen, you ate standing in an alley.

飞石帮与唐门素不对盘，可是看你如此落魄，也不禁感慨。同样是吃过苦的人，你不认得他，他却认得你，买了一个肉包子塞你手里，不容你推搪，放下话便走了。=The Flying Stone Gang and the Tang Sect have never seen eye to eye, but seeing you in such a wretched state, even they couldn't help but feel moved.\nHaving endured hardship themselves, they didn't know you, but they recognized your suffering. They bought a meat bun and shoved it into your hand, refusing to take no for an answer, then left after saying their piece.

你买了一颗肉包，一根油条配一碗豆浆果腹，孤零零坐着吃，乏人问津。=You bought a meat bun, a fried dough stick, and a bowl of soy milk to fill your stomach, eating alone at your table, unnoticed.

你大手笔，买了烧饼夹旋煎羊肠、炒蛋松、辣芥肉脯、四色凉菜、一壶用来解腻漱口的热茶、一壶香药熟水，还有几颗鲜剥的橙子。吃得好生满足，引得乡人纷纷侧目。听说唐门拮据，怎么你竟如此舍得花钱？登时便有人交头接耳猜是唐门发了横财，要重振家威了。=You splurged on a feast, buying baked pancakes stuffed with pan-fried lamb intestines, scrambled egg floss, spicy mustard pork jerky, an assortment of four cold dishes, a pot of hot tea to cleanse the palate, a jug of fragrant herbal infusion, and a few freshly peeled oranges.\nYou ate to your heart's content, drawing curious glances from the local villagers.\nHearing that the Tang Sect was struggling financially, how could you afford such extravagance? Immediately, people began whispering, speculating that the Tang Sect had come into sudden wealth and was poised to restore its former glory.

吃过了饭，你依然恋恋不舍，想在镇上多留几日，等你想好目标再动身。=After the meal, you lingered reluctantly, wanting to stay in town a few more days until you decided on a goal.

在此之前，盘缠还是得省着花，以策万全。所以你决定暂时委屈，栖身于村外十里的破庙。=Until then, you had to be frugal with your funds for safety.\nSo you decided to endure temporarily, staying at a dilapidated temple 10 li outside the village.

你在庙中四处张望，没见人影，丐帮大义分舵的人似乎倾巢而出，一人也不剩，更无老弱病残留守，地上积灰也厚，看起来有段时间没有人迹。=You looked around the temple but saw no one. It seemed as if everyone from the Dayi Branch of the Beggars' Sect had left. Not a single soul remained, not even the elderly, weak, sick, or disabled. A thick layer of dust covered the ground, indicating that the place had been deserted for some time.

你既忧虑又宽心，不见樊啸天的踪影，他豢养那些凶恶狗子也不在家。=You felt both worried and relieved. There was no sign of Fan Xiaotian, and the fierce dogs he kept were also nowhere to be seen.

你看了看盘缠，觉得也没必要太过委屈自己。于是下定决心住进客栈里。店小二是你熟面孔，这回见你有钱了，居然住店，对你说话都格外客气了几分，本来察言观色、见风使舵，就是店小二该有的基本素养。=You checked your travel funds and decided there was no need to be too hard on yourself.\nSo, you made up your mind to stay at an inn.\nThe waiter was a familiar face, and this time, seeing you with money and actually checking in, he spoke to you with unusual politeness. After all, reading people's moods and adapting to the situation are essential skills for a waiter.

你手里还有充足银钱，不急谋生，本来想在镇里客栈盘桓几日，再作打算，却不知何以名列黑名单，被客栈拒之于门外。一问店小二，这才恍然：你有今日这般待遇，皆拜你家混世魔王叶云裳所赐。她不止祸害唐门，到镇上照样兴风作浪，搅得家家户户鸡犬不宁。所谓鸡犬不宁，并非夸饰之词，那是真的不让鸡狗安生度日，鸡被拔毛编成羽衣重新穿上；犬的四足被裹着蕉皮。只消是活着、会动的生灵，免不了要遭她毒手。可是聪明如她，夜路走多了也难免失风被捕，她唯恐连累亲哥叶云舟的名声，于是欣然决定推你出去当祭品。举凡她犯过的案、造过的孽，一切罪过由你分担一半。甚至怕人不知你赵活生作什么模样，画了你的画像擅自贴在告示榜上，没细看内文的百姓还只道你被官府通缉。叶云舟知情以后，迅速处理，揪着叶云裳挨家挨户的道歉赔礼，才没酿成大祸。此事在你不知情的时候开始，在你不知情的时候落幕。幸好叶云裳犯行大多无伤大雅，又生得美貌，讨饶时梨花带雨，教人见了不免心生怜惜之情，好气又好笑。没几个人当真同她计较，然而你身为受害者却名声扫地，至少没地方睡这事已成定局。=You still had plenty of silver on hand and weren't in a hurry to find work. Originally, you planned to stay at the town inn for a few days while figuring out your next steps, but somehow you ended up blacklisted and were turned away at the door. 你又把今天的事，从前的事想过一遍，心中兀自愤愤难平。=You turned over today's events and the past in your mind once more, and indignation still simmered in your heart.

尽管忿忿不平，可是心底对掌门仍怀敬意，不敢不敬，怨归怨，到嘴边的「糟老头」、「老匹夫」还是硬生生吞回肚里。=Though resentment simmered within, you still held deep respect for the Sect Leader in your heart and dared not show disrespect. Despite your grievances, the words "old fool" and "wretched old man" that rose to your lips were forcibly swallowed back.

接着你想了想关于将来的事。=Then you began to think about the future.

昔日你死活不肯离开唐门，老是拿小师妹当借口，说是受了师娘的嘱托。然而小师妹早就长大、不需要你照顾了，你再清楚不过。=In the past, you stubbornly refused to leave the Tang Sect, always using Little Junior Sister as an excuse, claiming you had been entrusted by your Master's wife.\nHowever, you knew all too well that Little Junior Sister had long grown up and no longer needed your care.

昔日你死活不肯离开唐门，老是拿小师妹当借口，实则你心底早已不再牵挂她了。=In the past, you stubbornly refused to leave the Tang Sect, always using Little Junior Sister as an excuse, but in truth, you no longer cared for her.

你考虑过干脆落草为寇，你多少会点功夫，无论各个山寨应该都乐意收容。不过避着大师兄才行，有那人在，山贼的日子都不好过。或者当个独行大盗，似也不错。没有牵挂，又居无定所，谁也管不了你干啥。=You considered turning into a bandit. With your modest martial skills, any mountain stronghold would likely take you in.\nBut you'd have to steer clear of First Senior Brother; with him around, bandits had a hard time.\nOr perhaps becoming a lone outlaw would suit you better. Unburdened, rootless, and answerable to no one.

转念一想，甚至起意远赴东海，投靠泥教饿鬼道，从此当个叱咤海上的强盗。=The thought even crossed your mind to head far east to the sea and join the Hungry Ghost Realm of the Mud Sect, becoming a pirate who roams the seas from then on.

改投别门别派的念头，倒也不是没有。青城、峨嵋都近，但与唐门关系不算坏，也不知肯不肯收你这个唐门弃徒。=The thought of switching to another sect has crossed your mind too.\nQingcheng and Emei are both nearby, but their relations with the Tang Sect aren't exactly bad. It's hard to say whether they'd be willing to take in a disciple who's been cast out by the Tang Sect.

至于点苍，因为叶家兄妹那桩梁子，给得罪惨了，是一定不肯收你的，多半还会乱剑把你刺死，那是想都不必想了。=As for Diancang, because of that grudge with the Ye siblings, they've been thoroughly offended. They would definitely refuse to take you in. 点苍派远在大理，用走的起码要一个月。而且听说收徒必须考核，条件极为严苛，你自认天赋资质至多平均，半点信心也没有，索性绝了念想。=The Diancang Sect is all the way in Dali, it would take at least a month to get there on foot. 你考虑了崆峒，听说门坎较低，不排外，不过江湖传闻，崆峒掌派人大选将近，崆峒四门内斗得很厉害。你这去投靠，岂不是赶死吗？全真派各处都有道观，徒子徒孙遍布天下，可是入门容易学成难，江湖人都说全真派十有九个不济事。你就算去了，又如何能受重视呢？与其怀揣不切实际的梦想，还不如此刻就放弃执着，剃光头发，皈依嵩山派当和尚算了。=You've considered the Kongtong Sect, they say the entry barrier is low and they don't exclude outsiders. Even if you went, how could you stand out?\nRather than clinging to unrealistic dreams, it might be better to let go of your attachments now, shave your head, and become a monk at the Songshan Sect.

这几日镇上似乎颇不太平，你偶尔站在小丘上，便能看见劲装的江湖人策马出镇，向东疾行而去。这一日你进店一问，才知道出了大事。=\nThese past few days, the town has seemed rather unsettled. 这几日镇上似乎颇不太平，你睡客栈楼上，便能听见江湖人进来吆喝，要小二喂马又买干粮，结伙策马出镇，向东疾行而去。这一日你叫住店小二一问，才知道江湖出了大事。=These past few days, the town has seemed rather unsettled. As you slept upstairs in the inn, you could hear martial artists coming in, shouting for the waiter to feed their horses and buy dry provisions, then gathering to ride out of town, heading east at full speed.\nThat day, when you stopped the waiter to ask, you finally learned that a major event had shaken the martial world.

原来泥教畜牲道现世，正在围攻江陵城！听说阵仗大得骇人，连城郊驻军都吃了败仗，令人心惊者尚且不只于此，你道那畜牲道哪来这般天大能耐，人数多到足以围城，还能猝然发难？只因他们无处不在，其真身正是天下第一大帮丐帮！泥教蓄谋已久，不仅畜生道现世，连沈寂多时的修罗道也浮现水面，潜伏于宋军之中，里外策应，突然发难，教人防不胜防，厢军惨被分断隔离，马军司因此绝粮，不得已投向襄阳，各处官兵自危不敢出兵解危，使江陵孤立无缘，知府与指挥使固守城中，丐帮亦不强攻，情势就此僵持，唯有仰仗江湖侠士打破僵局。=The Mud Sect's Animal Realm had emerged and was besieging Jiangling!\nThe scale was terrifying, even the garrison troops outside the city had been defeated. What was shocking wasn't just that; how did the Animal Realm gained such immense power, with numbers enough to besiege a city and launch a sudden attack? It's because they are everywhere—their true identity is none other than the world's largest beggar organization, the Beggars' Sect!\nThe Mud Sect has long been plotting. Not only has the Animal Realm emerged, but the long-dormant Asura Realm has also surfaced, lurking within the Song army, coordinating from inside and out. They struck suddenly, catching everyone off guard. The local garrison forces were split and isolated, and the Cavalry Division, cut off from supplies, had no choice but to retreat to Xiangyang. Officers and soldiers everywhere are too fearful to send reinforcements, leaving Jiangling isolated and helpless. The prefect and commanding officer are holding firm inside the city, while the Beggars' Sect refrains from launching a strong assault, creating a stalemate. Now, only the Heroes of the martial world could break this deadlock.

你读完了江湖快报，结舌半晌说不出话来。怪不得官家不肯发兵，一笑置之。连你都不信乞丐能造反，他们穷得连甲冑兵刃都买不起。=You finished reading the news and were left speechless for a long moment.\nNo wonder the authorities refused to send troops and dismissed it with a laugh. Even you couldn't believe that beggars could rebel. They're too poor to even afford armor and weapons.

你颇有见识，略一心忖，胸中雪亮：各派人马齐赴江陵抗敌，这可不全是南宫世家的面子。若纵容丐帮胡来，令江陵不能善尽后援使命，导致抗金前线崩溃，可谓国难。一但天子震怒，将来必定派兵扫荡中原，管你什么名门正派，全都要倒大楣。是以驰援江陵，也是江湖人自清的最后机会。=You had considerable insight, and after a moment's reflection, the situation becomes crystal clear to you: the various sects rushing to Jiangling to resist the enemy isn't solely out of respect for the Nangong family.\n If the Beggars' Sect was allowed to run rampant, preventing Jiangling from fulfilling its role as a support base and causing the anti-Jin front to collapse, it would spell national disaster.\nIf the Emperor is enraged, he will inevitably dispatch troops to sweep through the Central Plains, and regardless of whether you belong to a renowned orthodox sect, everyone will face severe consequences.\nSo aiding Jiangling was the martial world's last chance to prove itself.

你惊讶之余，也不禁暗叫好险，好在丐帮愚蠢，围的是江陵。江陵是什么地方？那可是南宫世家坐镇的大城市，招惹南宫世家，等于同时得罪八成武林人。丐帮再横也不过凭着人多，待武林豪杰齐聚江陵，他们就该知道厉害了。=While you were shocked, you couldn't help but secretly feel relieved. 机会难得，玩命也不肯放过，你自告奋勇加入战局，与前任武林盟主同一阵线，对抗传奇杀手千面人魔。=A rare opportunity, even at the risk of your life, you wouldn't let it pass. You volunteered to join the battle, standing alongside the former Martial Alliance Leader against the legendary assassin, the Thousand-Faced Demon.

机会难得，玩命也不肯放过，你自告奋勇加入战局，与千面人魔同一阵线，对抗传奇侠客龙渊。=A rare opportunity, even at the risk of your life, you wouldn't let it pass. You volunteered to join the battle, standing alongside the Thousand-Faced Demon against the Legendary Great Hero Long Yuan.

人家都已经明示说饿了，你还兀自问个没完，云裳和小师妹都不禁有气，云裳索性把发上一根珠花取下，叫来小二，请他帮忙典卖，又吩咐上茶上菜，连甜品、水果、香饮子也不可少。招呼小师妹一起吃饭，把你冷落在外，吃了足有一个时辰，心满意足气也消了，才回来和你说话。=\nShe had already made it clear that she was hungry, yet you keep asking questions endlessly. 回到唐门，天色已黑。叶云裳已打起盹儿来，下了轿子路都不肯好好走，懒洋洋的挨在小师妹身上撒娇，你见了不禁苦笑，目送她们将要远去，你怅然若失。=Returning to the Tang Sect, the sky had already darkened.\nYe Yunshang was dozing off and, after getting out of the sedan chair, refused to walk properly, lazily clinging to Little Junior Sister while acting spoiled. The four schools are locked in a power struggle, refusing to yield to one another, making this a turbulent time.\nThat you have arrived at the Kongtong Sect at such a moment could indeed be seen as a twist of fate.

负责接引的崆峒弟子草草说明了情况，便将你们留在无色广场，说是要去通报，请师长过来见面，等了半日，来的却又是一位年纪轻轻的文秀姑娘。当下便有人不乐意了，你们一行好歹也是各派选出，足以代表本派颜面的江湖新秀，就算崆峒掌门自重身份，不亲自出迎，好歹也该请一位说话有份量的年劭前辈来见面客套，方始显得出诚意。于是纷纷抗议了起来。=The Kongtong disciple responsible for receiving you gave a hurried explanation of the situation before leaving you at the Colorless Plaza, saying they needed to inform their elders and arrange a meeting. After all, your delegation consisted of promising talents carefully selected by various sects to represent their prestige. Even if the Kongtong leader valued their own status too highly to greet you in person, they could have at least sent a respected senior with some authority to exchange pleasantries, that would have shown basic sincerity.\nAnd so, protests began to arise among you.

你为了师门颜面着想，也附和各派弟子的说法，不论如何，要请这位黄衣小娘子门中的师长来见才行，否则你个人丢脸事小，师门从此给江湖人笑话说你唐门好容易敷衍，那就大大不妥了。=For the sake of your sect's reputation, you echoed the sentiments of the disciples from other schools. No matter what, an elder from the sect of this young lady in yellow must come to meet you. Otherwise, while your personal embarrassment might be minor, if word spread in the martial world that the Tang Sect could be easily dismissed, it would be highly inappropriate.

你对各派弟子所言不以为然，不愿与之为伍，当即被大家嘲笑了一番，说你不识大体，将来传到江湖上，都说你唐门恁地好欺负，崆峒只来了年轻的女弟子便将你打发了。=You disagreed with the disciples from the various sects and refused to align with them, only to be ridiculed by everyone. 孰知那黄衣姑娘此时才说，她姓魏名菊，身份乃是崆峒玄功门现任掌门。在场无人不傻了眼，瞠目结舌，恨不得把方才的牢骚都吞回肚子里去。=Only then did the young lady in yellow reveal that her surname was Wei, her given name Ju, and that she was the current leader of the Kongtong Mystic Art Sect.\nEveryone present was stunned, wide-eyed and speechless, wishing they could swallow every complaint they had just uttered.

魏掌门有意偏袒你，直接出言邀请你入她玄功门见习。=Sect Leader Wei, intentionally showing you favor, directly invited you to join her Mystic Art Sect for training.

你一口答应了，只恨得剩余三人牙都痒了，偏生有魏掌门在此，不敢造次，只得乖乖抽签。=You agreed without hesitation, leaving the remaining three grinding their teeth in frustration. Yet, with Sect Leader Wei present, they didn't dare act out and had no choice but to obediently draw lots.

你不愿受人闲话，还是自愿抽签。魏掌门有些诧异，却对你的骨气颇为欣赏。=You were unwilling to attract gossip and chose to draw lots voluntarily. Sect Leader Wei was somewhat surprised but quite admired your integrity.

你抽中了铁拳门。=You drew the Iron Fist Gate.

兜了一圈，你还是抽中了玄功门。=After everything, you still drew the Mystic Art Gate.

你抽中了夺魄门。=You drew the Soul-Snatching Gate.

乍听之下没甚么，你却知道这处世的功夫着实不简单。=At first glance, it might not seem like much, but you understood that this kind of skill in navigating the world was truly remarkable.

江湖人多半豪爽成性，你纵然只是外姓弟子，也不例外，从来不喜附庸风雅，茶来便饮，觉得好喝便说好茶。虽不是撒谎，但在行家眼中，却不免觉得这样饮茶形如喝水，流于粗俗，有失风雅，不是雅士所乐见。=Most people in the martial world are naturally straightforward and unpretentious. 饮罢说起正事，魏掌门向你说明了玄功门里的功夫，都不是朝夕可成的外功，你留学半年，根本杯水车薪，不过徒劳。作为替代，她可以动用玄功门司书的职权，为你借得其他三门的武功秘籍。=After finishing the tea, the conversation turned to serious matters. 你听了这番暴言虽也觉得很是气氛，跟着齐来学艺的别派弟子一齐抗议，一提到南宫世家的金援，铁拳门就被瞬间引爆，抄起家伙恶狠狠的袭击过来。=You found the harsh words infuriating and joined the other visiting disciples in protest. 与小梅分别，你挣想洗把脸去吃早饭，却在招待所碰见三名来意不善的崆峒弟子。通常崆峒四门相互之间都没好脸色，却为了你和小梅散步一事同仇敌忾，相约来找你麻烦，说崆峒四姝乃是未来掌派人的未婚妻子，就连崆峒中人心生爱慕的，也只能往肚里吞，岂容你这区区留学弟子染指？=After parting ways with Xiaomei, you were just thinking of washing up and heading for breakfast when you ran into three Kongtong disciples with ill intentions at the guesthouse.\nUsually, the four schools of Kongtong don't get along, but this time, they united over your stroll with Xiaomei and came together to cause trouble for you. They claimed that the "Four Beauties of Kongtong" are betrothed to the future Sect Leader. Even those within Kongtong who admire them can only bury their feelings inside. How could an exchange student like you dare to overstep?

你好生委屈，早在房里应小梅声时，心中便有不祥预感。只是一来推辞不了，二来你心中实也乐意，便顺势应邀了。此刻的麻烦，该说是果不其然吧。=You felt deeply wronged. Even when you responded to Xiaomei's call from your room, you had a foreboding sense of trouble.\nBut on one hand, you couldn't refuse, and on the other, you were genuinely willing, so you accepted the invitation.\nThe trouble you're facing now was, in a way, inevitable.

你可不记得自己作过什么踰矩之事，应该被人咄咄相逼，立时反唇相讥，与对方斗了起来。=You don't recall having overstepped any boundaries to warrant such aggressive confrontation. Immediately, you retorted sharply and engaged in a heated argument with them.

那三人明显小看了你的本领，本以为你一副好欺负的短命样，殊不知手底这般硬，那三人的阵型就算缺了一个玄功门的位置，好歹也是三打一，你竟能三拳两脚便收拾掉了。论武功，今时今日的你早已不是谁都能欺负的唐门外姓弟子了──你是只有高手能欺负的唐门外姓弟子。=Those three clearly underestimated your skills. Thinking you looked like an easy target with your frail appearance, they never expected you to be so formidable. Even with their formation missing a position from the Mystic Art Gate, it was still three against one; you managed to take them down with just a few swift moves.\nIn terms of martial prowess, you are no longer the Tang Sect outer-sect disciple anyone can bully; you are now the Tang Sect outer-sect disciple only experts can bully.

那三人的阵型就算缺了一个玄功门的位置，毕竟还是三打一，你应接不暇，苦苦支撑数个回合，忽有一名缟衣剑少见不惯人多欺负人少，便跃入场中助你，那三人一见他面目生得俊美，顿时调转枪头，六拳六脚都指向他招呼过去。好在那人武功颇高，只守不攻，让你腾出手来拾夺了他们。其后互道姓名，才知道这路见不平的少年是来自名不见经传的小门派，名叫瑞笙。他怕你下回又不明不白给人打了，便好心提醒你崆峒掌派人迎娶四姝的典故。他性情坦率可亲，又是初出茅庐的武林新人，你见他这时，只觉与他说谈无甚压力，殊不知这一会，便是你与一代江湖传说命运交错的瞬间。=Even though the trio's formation was missing the Mystic Art Gate's position, it was still three against one. You struggled to hold your own, barely managing to endure several exchanges, when suddenly a young swordsman in plain white robes, unable to stand the unfairness of many bullying the few, leaped into the fray to aid you. The moment the three saw his strikingly handsome face, they immediately shifted their focus, directing all six fists and six feet toward him.\nFortunately, the young man was highly skilled and focused solely on defense, allowing you the opening to subdue them.\nAfterward, you exchanged names and learned that this chivalrous youth was named Ruisheng, from an obscure and little-known sect.\nWorried you might be ambushed again without warning, he kindly reminded you of the Kongtong tradition where the Sect Leader marries the Four Beauties.\nHe was straightforward and amiable, a fresh face in the martial world, and talking with him felt effortless. Little did you know, this encounter would become the moment your fate intertwined with a legend in the making.

魏掌门将你强留下来，是有苦衷的。只是她不便直说，要等亲信的弟子过来，再请她向你交代。=Sect Leader Wei had no choice but to keep you here—there were reasons she couldn't explain directly.\nShe had to wait for her trusted disciple to arrive and then ask her to clarify the situation to you.

在此之前，她考较了你的功夫进展。你本就是为了学艺而来，机缘到手，自然不敢懈怠。一招一式照本宣科，魏掌门见了很是满意的样子，毫不吝言将你夸奖了一番，你在唐门不是被骂丑便是被骂蠢，再要不然就是被骂懒或者骂妖怪，或者骂──总之从来也没一人似魏掌门这样温言鼓励，你不禁心花怒放，萌生了些许信心。=Before that, she assessed your progress in martial arts.\nYou had come precisely to learn, and now that the opportunity was in your hands, you naturally didn't dare slack off.\nFollowing the manuals move by move, Sect Leader Wei seemed quite satisfied with what she saw. She praised you generously, something entirely new to you. At the Tang Sect, you were either scolded for being ugly, foolish, lazy, or even called a monster. Never once had anyone encouraged you with such gentle words like Sect Leader Wei. You couldn't help but feel overjoyed, and a flicker of confidence began to grow within you.

在此之前，她考较了你的功夫进展。你虽是为了学艺才来，但基于种种情由，她上回所赠的秘籍你练得并不熟练，特别是后半部分压根没记全，只有随兴发挥，感觉该怎么接，便怎么接，勉强演完了整套武功。本以为要挨骂了，岂知魏掌门仍是笑容可掬，丝毫不以为意，还夸你进步快，建议你旁征博引。=Before that, she assessed your progress in martial arts.\nAlthough you came here to learn, due to various reasons, you hadn't practiced the manual she gave you last time very thoroughly, especially the latter half, which you barely remembered. You simply improvised, following your instincts on how to connect the moves, and barely managed to complete the entire set. \nYou expected to be scolded, but to your surprise, Sect Leader Wei remained all smiles, completely unbothered. She even praised your rapid progress and suggested you draw insights from a wider range of sources.

在此之前，魏掌门为你泡了一壶餐前淡茶垫胃，这样容易饱，便吃不胖，是维持体态的诀窍。=Before that, Sect Leader Wei brewed you a pot of light tea to settle your stomach before the meal. That way, you'd feel full more easily and avoid gaining weight, a little secret to maintaining your figure.

论起喝茶的雅俗，你说了自己从前的见闻经历，无意间竟给魏掌门上了一课，令她想起多年前老师的教诲，茅塞顿开，对你多了几分感激、多了几分敬意。=When discussing the refinement of tea drinking, you shared your past experiences and insights, unintentionally giving Sect Leader Wei a valuable lesson. It reminded her of her teacher's teachings from years ago, suddenly clarifying things she hadn't fully grasped before. She felt both grateful and respectful toward you.

这是你第二次喝魏掌门亲手点的茶，她的茶浓时有如泼墨挥毫厚，淡时又似江上烟雨薄。茶中有四季，有山水，亦有岁月无忧。不言不语，才气横溢，多好的人儿。=This was the second time you've tasted tea brewed by Sect Leader Wei herself. Her tea, when strong, is like bold ink strokes—rich and intense; when light, it resembles the misty drizzle over a river, subtle and delicate.\nIn her tea, you felt the the four seasons, mountains and waters, and even a sense of timeless serenity.\nWithout saying a word, her talent radiates brilliantly. What an extraordinary person she is.

魏掌门又赠了你一本秘籍，你大喜过望，连连称谢。起初听魏掌门说你不适合修炼玄功门内家气功时的那股沮丧气，早已烟消云散了。你打心坎儿里感动，觉得玄功门最棒了。=Sect Leader Wei gifted you another secret manual, and you were overjoyed, repeatedly expressing your gratitude.\nThe disappointment you initially felt when she said you weren't suited to practice the Mystic Art Gate's internal energy techniques had long since vanished.\nDeeply moved, you now feel that the Mystic Art Gate is truly the best.

待到魏掌门亲信的玄功门女弟子过来请掌门早安，魏掌门才请她代自己向你解释。那玄功弟子也是苦口婆心，拐着弯子教你认清了现实。崆峒梅兰竹菊四姝，那都是预定要嫁给将来新掌派人的，无论是小梅或者魏掌门皆然。她们的婚嫁并非自己一个人的事，也关系着师门的兴衰，这是崆峒山数百年传承的习俗，不容外人置喙。你听着老大不是滋味，饭菜也不香了，心中诸多感慨。人在江湖身不由己，其实人间何处不江湖呢。=When the trusted female disciple of the Mystic Art Gate came to greet Sect Leader Wei in the morning, Sect Leader Wei asked her to explain the situation to you on her behalf.\nThe Mystic Art disciple spoke earnestly, though indirectly, helping you face reality: the "Four Beauties" of Kongtong—Mei, Lan, Zhu, and Ju were all destined to marry the future Sect Leader.\nThis applies to both Xiaomei and Sect Leader Wei herself. Their marriages are not merely personal matters but are tied to the rise and fall of their sect; a tradition upheld on Kongtong Mountain for centuries, one that leaves no room for outsiders to question.\nListening to this, you felt deeply unsettled; even the food lost its flavor. Your heart was filled with complex emotions.\nIn the martial world, one often has no control over their own fate, but then, isn't the entire world its own kind of martial world?

你作二师兄助手，忙了整夜才替师兄弟们缝好伤口，上药包扎。几位师兄欲言又止，终于决定去见掌门，二师兄也催你同往。刚出炼丹房，就看见许多师兄弟从正心堂出来，下山离去。=\nYou worked as Second Senior Brother's assistant all night, stitching up your fellow disciples' wounds, applying medicine, and bandaging them.\nSeveral senior brothers seemed to hesitate, wanting to say something, but in the end, they decided to go see the sect leader. Second Senior Brother urged you to come along as well.\nJust as you stepped out of the alchemy room, you saw many of your fellow disciples leaving the Zhengxin Hall and heading down the mountain.

翌日一早，你应掌门召唤前往正心堂，还没踏进去就见到许多师兄弟大包小包下山而去。=Early the next morning, you were summoned by the sect leader to the Zhengxin. Before you even stepped inside, you saw many of your fellow disciples heading down the mountain, carrying large and small bundles with them.

你进去才知道，原来许多师兄弟经此一役，都被吓怕了，纷纷向掌门辞行，奉还唐姓下山，从此不算唐门中人。你上回一怒之下不告而别，算不上是正式辞行，这回若随众人离开，便是真正与唐门恩断义绝了。=Only after you entered did you realize that many of your fellow disciples, terrified by the recent battle, had come to bid farewell to the Sect Leader. They returned the Tang surname and left the mountain, cutting ties with the Tang Sect for good.\nYour previous departure in anger wasn't a formal farewell, but if you left with the others now, it would mean truly severing all ties with the Tang Sect.

你离开唐门，落拓江湖，一路漫无目的。浪迹天涯之远，走过山，看过海，起初想落地生根的念头也渐渐淡了。你曾在金国住过，也到过蒙古。每处都住过一段时光，可是到头哪儿也不是你的家。某一年旅途中，你身染难症逝于道中，结束了你潇洒又孤独的一生。=You left the Tang Sect and wandered the martial world, drifting without a clear purpose.\nYou traveled to the far ends of the earth, crossed mountains, and gazed upon the sea. At first, the idea of settling down lingered in your mind, but it gradually faded.\nYou once lived in the Jin territory and even journeyed to Mongolia, spending time in each place.\nYet, in the end, none of them felt like home.\nOne year, during your travels, you fell gravely ill and passed away on the road, bringing an end to your free yet lonely life.

你试着改投峨嵋派，但以峨嵋你资质平庸，温言婉拒。=You tried to join the Emei Sect, but they gently declined, citing your average aptitude.

你离开唐门，封剑退隐，一生不再与人动武，活到天命之年。=You left the Tang Sect, sheathed your sword, and retired from the martial world, never again engaging in combat for the rest of your life, living peacefully into your destined years.

你一时没回过神来，错过了拜别而去的时机。=You were momentarily dazed and missed the chance to bid your farewells.

这些人多是趁着留学热闹，慕名而来，加入唐门日浅，信心未成，经此夜袭受了惊吓受了伤，才意识到江湖并非只有逞威风、快意恩仇，更多的是暗涛汹涌，稍有不慎便会一命呜呼，从美梦惊醒，纷纷前来辞行。良久，无人发出声响，寂静笼罩了空荡正心堂。小师妹悄没声息地来了，掌门见到爱女无恙，脸色才稍微和缓，提起正事。小师妹已平安回家，三师兄也点清并没遗失重要典籍，那两拨人马还真就是专程欺入别人家门，打他们的架，唐门倒像是无辜被波及的。仅就线索来看，似是泥教调虎离山，明着包围江陵，暗中突袭唐门，不知怎的却被正派人士看破了手脚，闯入阻止魔教行凶，这还不奇，奇的是他们打完既不邀功，也不客套，马不停蹄就下山去了。要知正派人士行侠仗义，视钱财如粪土的义士多不胜数，无非求名而已。知礼的沉得住气或许能不邀功，但事了拂衣而去，连客套也不客套的却如凤毛麟角。如此一来，简简单单一件事，顿时就变得可疑起来了。掌门问询罢了，遣退座下弟子，留下下来，口头嘉勉一番，谢你领小师妹上山，免他忧虑。你忐忑不安，一颗心活跃起来，还道这次误打误撞立了大功，说不定真能改宗入姓，正式拜师学艺。没想到掌门给了你一个木匣子，就此打发了你。你怅然若失，还道里边是钱，魂不守舍回到弟子房中，多日不见你人影的师兄弟早已积怨多时，将你包围又推又骂，抢过木匣一打开，登时全场寂静，呆若木鸡，将木匣子恭恭敬敬的还你。=These people mostly joined the Tang Sect amid the excitement of the exchange program, drawn by its reputation. Their time in the sect had been short, and their loyalty had not yet solidified. This Tang Sect small sword was inherited by the Sect Leader from his predecessor, a weapon he used to roam the martial world.\nIts forging method is lost, peerless and unmatched, the only one in the world. Though not the Sect Leader's token, it has always been passed down to the new Sect Leader alongside the command token and the Jade of Crimson Blood, through several dynasties; a hundred times more valuable than your life.\nAll the grief and despair in your heart vanished; it turned out you weren't unimportant. 随后你到青城山拜师，掌门打量你相貌，惊为天人，当即应允。你欣喜若狂，还道从此改运，可以学成一身高强武功，行侠仗义。殊不知人家说你根骨上佳，可不是看中你武学资质。身是苦本，学道者唯有忘弃红尘，宠辱不惊，方能了断烦恼。观你面貌，注定尘世缘薄，试问天底还有谁比你更适合学道呢？若干年后，你依然武艺低微，可是道学底蕴已足睥睨当世。你开坛讲道，天下道家门徒无论派别，都来洗耳恭听。你下山云游以后，世上再也无人见过你的踪影。=You then went to Qingcheng Mountain to seek apprenticeship. 你到青城山拜师，但你心慕荣利，为俗世所染已深，不是学道的料子，因此遭到婉拒。=You went to Qingcheng Mountain to seek apprenticeship, but your heart yearned for fame and wealth, deeply stained by worldly desires. You were not cut out for the path of Dao, and thus were politely declined.

你最终被崆峒铁拳门收留，为了餬口饭吃，日夜忙碌。习武的梦想渐渐就淡忘了。某日崆峒新掌派人金乌上人看你不顺眼，随手一掌打死了扔山沟里，也没人发觉。=You were finally taken in by the Kongtong Iron Fist Sect, working day and night to make ends meet.\nYour dream of learning martial arts gradually faded. In his eyes, you were just cowards who feared death, treacherous and ungrateful villains. He recalled how the Nangong Family had supported the Tang Clan in its decline, and this was how you repaid them today? It infuriated him to the point where he wished he could fling open the city gates and expel you from Jiangling.

你们来助阵，反而给丐帮打得落花流水，大公子流露出鄙夷眼色，连客套话都懒得与你们这群无能之辈多说，便拂袖而去。=You came to lend support, but were instead beaten to a pulp by the Beggars' Sect. The Eldest Young Master cast a look of disdain your way, not even bothering with polite words for a group of incompetents like you, before turning and leaving in a huff.

总算在旁随侍的家丁尚算知礼，替大公子分辩几句，安抚你们，才领到院中赴宴洗尘。=Fortunately, the attending servants were still courteous enough to offer a few words on the behalf of the Young Master, soothing your feelings before leading you to the courtyard for the welcoming banquet.

你们一行人退到临镇，只见镇上一片萧飒寂寥，人烟稀少，地上到处都有落下的事物，显是唯恐江陵战火延烧至此，才仓皇避难。万幸镇上客栈还有开张，乃是掌柜的爱惜性命丢下店不要，小二才冒险接了店铺。你们也没心思吃酒喝肉，只叫了茶水，愣愣发呆，正愁不知江陵后续如何，南宫世家家丁模样的人便进了店，原来唐门前脚一走，全真、峨嵋两派强援后脚便到，堪堪将丐帮打退，才解了眼下之危。南宫家丁见了你们狼狈的表情，也没好气，冷言冷语讥嘲，向店小二豪掷重金，要他整顿房间，准备接待江湖侠士，又补充了一句所谓江湖侠士并不包含唐门。下人敢如此放肆，恐怕是他主人已对唐门心灰意冷了吧。那家丁交代完事情，也不急着就走，他有心显摆、刺激唐门，不料这一停留，丐帮就进了店中讨茶水喝。唐门、南宫家丁、丐帮三方一怔，都汗毛直竖，虽还没动上手，但情势剑拔弩张，只要有一方动静稍大，只怕瞬间就会演变成激战，谁也不敢轻举妄动，那南宫家丁方才冷嘲热讽，这当儿立刻又巴望唐门大侠出手救他小命了。=\nYour group retreated to the neighboring town, only to find it desolate and sparsely populated. Belongings were scattered everywhere on the ground, clearly indicating that the residents had fled in panic, fearing the flames of war in Jiangling would spread here.\nFortunately, the local inn was still open; the owner had valued his life too much to stay, but the waiter had taken the risk to keep the shop running.\nHaving no heart for wine or meat, you only ordered tea, sitting in a daze, worried about what would happen next in Jiangling. Then someone dressed as a Nangong Family servant entered the shop. It turned out that shortly after the Tang Sect had left, strong reinforcements from the Quanzhen and Emei sects arrived, just barely repelling the Beggars' Sect and resolving the immediate crisis.\nThe Nangong servant saw your disheveled state and was also in a bad mood, sneering with cold sarcastic remarks. He extravagantly tossed a large sum of money to the waiter, demanding rooms be prepared to receive the Heroes of the martial world, adding that said heroes did *not* include the Tang Sect. For a servant to be so bold likely meant his Master had already given up on the Tang Sect.\nfter giving his orders, the servant lingered, clearly intending to show off and provoke the Tang Sect. But this delay proved costly; just then, members of the Beggars' Sect entered the inn to beg for tea.\nThe Tang Sect, the Nangong servant, and the Beggars' Sect members froze in mutual recognition, their hair standing on end. Though no blows had been exchanged yet, the atmosphere grew tense as drawn swords. The slightest provocation from any side could instantly escalate into a fierce battle, and no one dared act rashly. The Nangong servant, who had been so scornful moments earlier, now desperately hoped the Heroes of the Tang Sect would step in to save his wretched life.

唐门与丐帮各据客栈一角，彼此不相交谈，可是空气中却弥漫着肃杀之气，你唯恐待会就要打起架来，先提一提大师兄，让对方心有忌惮也好。你谎称大师兄就在左近，只是寻友去了，丐帮弟子听了嗤之以鼻，他哪里不知你是想借飞侠的名声压他们气焰？反嘴就提起不久之前正道侠士惨遭饿鬼道法王当众折辱的糗事损你士气，那侠士不是别人，还正是与飞侠齐名的风神解无尘。殊不知大师兄在附近虽然是你胡诌的谎话，可那解无尘竟然当真就在左近，听了这话飘然现身，以为大师兄真在找他，不由得喜出外望，满腔热血，自顾自替你们出头，你们无法可想，唯有硬着头皮跟上。所幸解无尘败给刘颚不假，一身本领却也是货真价实，寻常丐帮弟子根本不是对手，被飞腿踢得东倒西歪，落荒而逃。解无尘为人最好名声，本想吹嘘一下，又想起自己败给刘颚之时，堂堂「风雷神脚」被强迫改名「很是用力踢」，登觉脸上无关，将你叫到跟前，强行用一千文价格把《很是用力踢》祖传秘籍卖断给你，便悻悻然而去了。=The Tang Sect and the Beggars' Sect occupied different corners of the inn, not speaking to each other, but the air was thick with murderous intent. Fearful that a fight might break out at any moment, you decided to bring up the name of the First Senior Brother, hoping to instill some caution in the opposing side.\nYou falsely claimed that the First Senior Brother was nearby, merely visiting a friend. The Beggars' Sect disciples snorted in contempt; how could they not see through your attempt to intimidate them with the reputation of the Flying Hero? They immediately retaliated by bringing up the recent humiliation of a Great Hero publicly disgraced by the Dharma King of the Hungry Ghosts Realm, aiming to dampen your morale. That Hero was none other than Xie Wuchen, the Wind God, as famous as the Flying Hero.\nLittle did you know, while your claim about the First Senior Brother being nearby was a lie, Xie Wuchen actually was in the vicinity. Hearing the commotion, he gracefully made his appearance, overjoyed at the thought that the First Senior Brother might truly be looking for him. Filled with passion, he took it upon himself to stand up for you. Left with no other choice, you had no choice but to brace yourselves and follow his lead.\nFortunately, while it was true that Xie Wuchen had lost to Liu E, his skills were still genuine. The ordinary Beggars' Sect disciples were no match for him; they were sent stumbling and fleeing by his flying kicks.\nXie Wuchen cared deeply for his reputation. He initially wanted to boast, but then remembered his defeat by Liu E, where his esteemed「Divine Wind and Thunder Kick」technique was forcibly renamed to《Kicking Really Hard》. Feeling his face had no place, he called you over and forcibly sold you his ancestral secret manual,《Kicking Really Hard》, for a fixed price of a thousand coins, then left in a huff.

一度避战，这时再入江陵，你们一行人都有点儿心虚，所幸那家丁蒙你们所救，心怀感激，将唐门大力夸奖了一番，大公子闻言，立时换了好脸色，前来见礼，前倨后恭，难免牵强。你们一行人只道大公子势利，非得有点功劳才能得他正眼相看，不由得都看轻了这位贵公子，以为他是个纨绔草包。殊不知南宫深的心思远比你们所想更深，他态度傲慢，并非轻视唐门，而是打从心底怀疑唐门是魔教奸细。由着四师兄出言相稽也不着恼，是为了他自己心理平衡。=Having once avoided the battle and now re-entering Jiangling, your group felt somewhat uneasy. Fortunately, the servant you had saved was grateful and praised the Tang Sect lavishly. This led all of you to look down on this noble Young Master, dismissing him as a frivolous and incompetent fop. Little did you know that Nangong Shen's thoughts ran far deeper than you imagined. His arrogant attitude did not stem from disdain for the Tang Sect but from a deep-seated suspicion that the Tang Sect might be spies for the Demon Cult.\nHe allowed Fourth Senior Brother's taunts without getting angry to maintain his own psychological balance.

一度避战，这时再入江陵，你们一行人都有点儿心虚，南宫大公子见了你们，亦没好脸色，原来他老早就掌握唐门的行踪，疑心你们消极作战，似有魔教党羽之嫌，即令不是，如此背信忘义的行径，也不配与南宫世家论交。你们怯战是事实，登时语塞，话说到这步田地，等如决裂，正心寒时，南宫老太爷便得了消息，持杖打了过来，往孙子头上抡，只是南宫深成见已深，这一杖未能收当头棒喝之效，好在被你和四师兄劝住了，否则他若不将孙子捶死，自己也会气死。及后四师兄饱含歉意地说明了原委，老太爷年逾百岁，却老而不朽，心灵通透的很，丝毫不以为意。言道：人皆有畏死之心，你等远道而来，已足感盛情，一时使不上力，也不算什么罪过──说到底，又不是你唐门围的江陵。这一席话只把你们小伙子都感动坏了。=Having once avoided the battle and now re-entering Jiangling, your group felt somewhat uneasy. Matters had reached the point of rupture. Just as despair set in, Old Master Nangong received word and came over, staff in hand, swinging it at his grandson's head. However, Nangong Shen's prejudices had already taken deep root, and the blow failed to serve as a wake-up call. Fortunately, you and the Fourth Senior Brother managed to intervene and calm the situation; otherwise, the old master might have beaten his grandson to death or died of rage himself.\nLater, the Fourth Senior Brother sincerely explained the circumstances. Though over a hundred years old, the Old Master was sharp-minded, wise and far from senile. He understood completely and was not the least bit bothered. He said: "All men fear death. You came from afar, which is kindness enough. Being unable to help momentarily is no crime—after all, it wasn't the Tang Sect that besieged Jiangling".\nHis words moved all you young ones deeply.

在无人街道一番激战过后，终于凭着硬功夫弥平了人数劣势，将丐帮击退。南宫家丁此时已换了一张嘴脸，一口一个大侠，马屁连发，哄得众人心胸舒坦。=After a fierce battle on the deserted streets, you finally overcame the numerical disadvantage through sheer skill and drove back the Beggars' Sect.\nThe Nangong family servant had completely changed his tune, now addressing you repeatedly as "Great Hero" and showering you with flattery, which put everyone in a comfortable and pleased mood.

南宫家丁看你们一来二去，动个不停，怕心溅去，反觉好笑，以为你们是在跳舞，忍不住想掺一脚，也卖弄起随性舞姿，殊不知你们双方早就陷入僵局，谁也不服谁，正愁无法下台，不约而同便将怒火转向那家丁，痛扁一顿撒气以后，丐帮等的茶水也来了，总算没和唐门动起手来，和平落幕。只有南宫家丁受伤的世界完成了。=The Nangong servant, watching your back-and-forth movements, initially found it amusing and thought you were dancing. 你默不作声，却和带头的丐帮弟子互相打量对方，用眼神较劲，靠着微小的肢体线索，揣测对方心态，不断相互刺探，在思想中进行了一场殊死决战。=You remained silent, but you and the leading Beggars' Sect disciple were sizing each other up, engaging in a battle of wills through eye contact. Relying on subtle physical cues, you gauged each other's mindset, constantly probing and testing, waging a fierce life and death battle of wits in the realm of thought.

你和对方思想战中转瞬拆了十几二十招，暗暗心惊，均觉对方武功高强，起了相敬之心，你有意点到为止，故意卖了一个小小空子，对方会意，也不趁胜追击，也退了一步，放下手中杖碗，对你拱手作揖。丐帮等的茶水也来了，总算没和唐门动起手来，和平落幕。=In an instant, you exchanged over a dozen moves in this mental duel, both inwardly astonished by the other's martial prowess, and a mutual respect began to form. You intentionally left a small opening, signaling your willingness to end the contest. The other understood and did not press the advantage, instead taking a step back, setting down his staff and bowl, and saluting you with clasped fists.\nJust then, the tea the Beggars' Sect had been waiting for arrived. In the end, no physical clash broke out with the Tang Sect, and the situation concluded peacefully.

万万没想到你目光凶光乍现，趁他放下兵器接连摆了几个全无退路的进手架式，招招都是致人于死地的狠招。=Unexpectedly, a fierce glint flashed in your eyes. Seizing the moment he set down his weapon, you launched into a series of aggressive stances, each move leaving no room for retreat; every strike aimed to kill.

那带队的丐帮弟子又惊又怒，霎时被你骇出一身冷汗，心知倘若你有意伤人，真的动起手来，他早已没命，就算不是真把刀子捅到他肉身上，他过于投注的精神仍受了重创，惊怒交加之下，一口鲜血吐了出来。你使阴招得胜，得罪了人兀自得意洋洋，那人自知今日已讨不了好，取了水便悻悻然离去，满拟下回再见，定要报今日之仇。=The leading Beggars' Sect disciple was both shocked and enraged, instantly breaking into a cold sweat from your intimidation. He realized that if you had truly intended to harm him and had launched a real attack, he would already be dead. Even though no physical blade had pierced his flesh, his overly focused spirit suffered a severe blow. Overwhelmed by shock and fury, he coughed up a mouthful of blood.\nYou, having won through underhanded moves, felt smug despite having offended him. Knowing he could gain nothing more today, the disciple took the water and left in resentment, fully resolved to seek revenge the next time you met.

万万没想到你目光凶光乍现，趁他放下兵器接连摆了几个全无退路的进手架式，招招都是致人于死地的狠招。那带队的丐帮弟子又惊又怒，霎时被你骇出一身冷汗，心知倘若你有意伤人，真的动起手来，他早已没命，就算不是真把刀子捅到他肉身上，他过于投注的精神仍受了重创，惊怒交加之下，一口鲜血吐了出来。你使阴招得胜，得罪了人兀自得意洋洋，那人自知今日已讨不了好，取了水便悻悻然离去，满拟下回再见，定要报今日之仇。=Unexpectedly, a fierce glint flashed in your eyes. Seizing the moment he set down his weapon, you launched into a series of aggressive stances, each move leaving no room for retreat; every strike aimed to kill.\nThe leading Beggars' Sect disciple was both shocked and enraged, instantly breaking into a cold sweat from your intimidation. Even though no physical blade had pierced his flesh, his overly focused spirit suffered a severe blow. 你们三人武学见识均不相同，即使起初几招可以见微知着，演变到后来，势不可免便会出现分歧误解，早已面目全非，但凭心证而已。十余招后，恐惧的心情充斥着你们三人的心，特别是那丐帮弟子，回家以后接连作了好几天噩梦，对唐门的邪门手段多年无法释怀。虽然不知道他在想什么，不过你吓退了敌人。在那之后，关于你的奇怪传闻也在江湖不胫而走。=The three of you had different understandings of martial arts. Even if the first few moves allowed for subtle understanding, as the exchange progressed, divergence and misinterpretation became inevitable. What remained was no longer a true reflection of the original intent, but merely subjective interpretation.\nAfter over a dozen exchanges, a sense of dread filled the hearts of all three of you—especially the Beggars' Sect disciple. After returning home, he suffered from nightmares for several days and was unable to shake off the memory of the Tang Sect's unorthodox methods for years.\nThough you had no idea what he was thinking, you had successfully intimidated the enemy. After that incident, strange rumors about you began to spread throughout the martial world.

武林各派齐聚江陵，大公子意气风发，居中指挥，调度各派人马潜伏，只待明日丐帮自投罗网，届时各派便可响应官兵，从四面八方断其后路，将丐帮人马一网打尽。这一次动手，再也不是从前那般互相忌惮，小打小闹，捉了人又放，放了又捉，始终留有底线。而是明刀明枪上沙场拚生死的。在座侠士均摩拳擦掌，热血沸腾跃跃欲试，料来以双方觉悟之差，又打他个措手不及，届时定能将那泥教畜牲道杀个措手不及，扫荡群邪，还中原武林一片清明气象。=\nMartial arts factions from across the land gathered in Jiangling. The Eldest Young Master, high-spirited and confident, took command, deploying forces from various sects to lie in ambush. This time, it was a clear-cut, life-and-death struggle on the battlefield.\nThe Heroes present rubbed their hands in anticipation, their blood boiling with eagerness. 你却对诸侠激昂情绪不以为然，丐帮势强时不曾强攻夺城，如今正道集结，便不留余地，高嚷着要赶尽杀绝，未免有违你心中所认定的侠义。=Yet you did not share the fervor of the other heroes. When the Beggars' Sect was at the peak of its power, they did not launch a forceful assault to seize the city. Now that the orthodox factions had gathered, there was no room for mercy, and the cries for total annihilation felt contrary to the chivalric principles you held in your heart.

你和众位师兄弟也都受群情鼓噪，斗志昂扬，恨不得此刻就上战场，弄死那群没人爱的臭乞丐。=You and your fellow disciples were also stirred by the crowd's excitement, filled with fighting spirit, wishing you could go to the battlefield right now and kill those unloved stinking beggars.

商议既定，各自人马便纷纷告辞，枕戈待旦。=The plans settled; the various groups said their goodbyes, ready to rest with their weapons, awaiting dawn.

Fan Xiaotian admired you even more.

老太爷说要散步出门，找一晚辈叙话，邀你同游。这位老人家乃是武林耆老，寻常人等闲巴结不到，竟然亲自邀你，你忙不迭满口答应了，就是跟在身边帮忙打杂，也是天大的面子。=The Old Master said he wanted to take a stroll out to meet a junior for a chat and invited you to join him.\nThis old man was a senior figure in the martial world, someone ordinary people could hardly curry favor with. He actually invited you personally! You hastily agreed wholeheartedly. Even if it meant just helping out with minor tasks by his side, it was an immense honor.

老太爷说要散步出门，找一晚辈叙话，邀你同游。这位老人家乃是武林耆老，寻常人等闲巴结不到，竟然亲自邀你，你竟还推拖不去。南宫横微微一怔，也不着脑，笑笑摆手便走了。你其实没事来着，你就是不想去而已。=The Old Master said he wanted to take a stroll out to meet a junior for a chat and invited you to join him.\nThis old man was a senior figure in the martial world, someone ordinary people could hardly curry favor with. He actually invited you personally, and you actually declined and didn't go. Nangong Heng was slightly taken aback but didn't get angry; he just smiled, waved, and left.\nYou actually had nothing else to do; you just didn't want to go.

Otherwise, after hearing your words, if she didn't slap you dead, she wouldn't know how to face herself.\nSliding down from the roof, you landed shaking off a cold sweat, your limbs weak.\nYou sat dazed in the courtyard for a long while before returning to sleep. By then, the incense had long dissipated, but you remained in a daze.

你笑了笑，师父千里迢迢，只为再见自己一面。这份情于你已是无与伦比的宝物，足以夸耀一生。夏侯兰淡淡一笑，收起了伞，难得想让你看清她的容颜，记得清楚一点。她依然不劝你，只是说了自己的心愿，如果可以，希望你能活着。即使残疾，也好过没命，反正你天生就脸残。被新奇的字眼侮辱了也不生气，反而满心欢喜，这还是生平头一遭。=You smiled. Your master had traveled a thousand miles just to see you one more time. This sentiment was, to you, an incomparable treasure, something to boast about for a lifetime.\nXiahou Lan smiled faintly, put away her umbrella, unusually wanting you to see her face clearly and remember it well.\nShe still didn't try to dissuade you, only shared her wish: if possible, she hoped you would live. Even if disabled, it would be better than dead; after all, you were born with a ruined face.\nBeing insulted with such novel words didn't anger you. Instead, you felt an overwhelming joy; this was the first time in your life something like this had happened.

你万万没想到，老太爷所说的访友，却访到丐帮阵地里去了。=\nYou never expected that the Old Master "visiting a friend" would lead you right into the Beggars' Sect's encampment.

被凶神恶煞的众盖包围，你只道此番必定没命，差点生生吓死。=Surrounded by fierce and menacing beggars, you were certain that this time your life was over, nearly scared to death on the spot.

获释的樊啸天一回丐帮，将他拉拔大的阿叔便赶忙出来迎接，对你们眼含敌意，也不上前客套，拉了樊啸天便走。=The moment the released Fan Xiaotian returned to the Beggars' Sect, the uncle who raised him hurried out to greet him. He eyed your group with hostility, didn't bother with pleasantries, and pulled Fan Xiaotian away.

南宫横乃是百岁老人，又乐善好施，广结善缘，江湖上哪个不是他晚辈？走到哪儿都有脸面。丐帮从前还没今日这等气象之前，便一直得他老人家照拂，即令两军势如水火，对待老太爷依旧客客气气的，不敢丝毫冒犯。尤其丐帮旧派长老之中，无人不受过他恩惠，南宫横三言两语，便使对方拉下脸来，为你一行人去请帮主大驾，即便王帮主不肯亲至，也答应与你们见面亲谈。=Nangong Heng, a centenarian, was known for his benevolence and generosity, having forged countless bonds of goodwill throughout the martial world. Who wasn't a junior in his eyes? Wherever he went, he commanded respect. Even before the Beggars' Sect had risen to its current prominence, it had long received his care and support. It turned out that the reason he hadn't bothered to come in person was simply because he was preoccupied with fishing.\nNangong Qian, seeing him so presumptuous; polite in speech but rude in action; couldn't help but feel angry. Chief Wang raised an eyebrow, intrigued, and went to ask his subordinates for fishing rods; even you two juniors received one.\nYou initially thought the two men were old acquaintances, but upon asking, you learned they had never met before. 南宫浅手握钓竿，紧张得浑身发颤，不时偷眼回望王二壮，心想这名动天下的魔教法王之一，此刻便坐在身后，又是丐帮帮主，想必武功深不可测，自己和你是后辈，武功不值一哂，爷爷又老迈，见识虽深，要与人动武却万万不能。只消王法王一怒，弹指间便能将自己三人尽数拍死，自身都命悬一线，还钓甚么鱼？=Nangong Qian held the fishing rod, trembling with nervousness. He kept stealing glances back at Wang Erzhuang and thought thought: this man, one of the famed Demon Cult Dharma Kings, now sat behind them as the Leader of the Beggars' Sect. His martial arts must be unfathomable. He and you were juniors with negligible skills; Grandfather was wise and experienced but he was far too old for combat.\nIf the Dharma King Wang lost his temper, he could annihilate all three of them in an instant. With their lives hanging by a thread, what was the point of fishing?

你却泰然自若，不是不怕死，是心知既然到此，提防也没用。既有豁达，也有城府，你知道此行前来，为的不是钓鱼，却也是钓鱼。钓的不是江中游鱼，而是丐帮帮主，你等三人自身就是饵。=You, however, remained composed. Not that you weren't afraid to die, but because you understood that since you were already here, being on guard was useless.\nBoth open-minded and shrewd, you knew this trip wasn't for fishing, yet it was. You weren't fishing for the fish in the river, but for the leader of the Beggars' Sect. The three of you were the bait yourselves.

你也惊吓得不行，和胆识甚么的无关，再蛮勇的豪士见了狗头铡也不会无端把脖子伸长，拿命相试。为今之计，只有将命运交付给老太爷与老天爷了。=You too were terrified beyond measure. It had nothing to do with courage; even the bravest hero wouldn't unnecessarily stretch his neck under an executioner's blade to test fate.\nThe only plan now was to entrust your fate to the old Master and Heaven.

南宫子弟身带书卷香，亦有江湖气。南宫横百岁高龄，世间什么事情都体验过一遭，何况又是江陵人家，钓过的鱼只怕比你吃过的还多。他说要秀一手，果真是技惊王帮主，坐下不久，便有大鱼上钩，还要王帮主帮忙收线，当面传授遛鱼技巧，耗尽了那条大鱼的体力，才将它收拾上岸。南宫横旋即便将此鱼作为见面礼，送给王帮主。他料定从江陵城中携来的礼物，既遭疑心又惹争议，王帮主必定婉拒，这鱼却是在他面前一块儿钓的，赠的是鱼，也将功劳尽数归他，果然投其所好，令得王帮主喜笑颜开，兴匆匆将鱼拿去烤了。=The disciples of Nangong carried a scholarly air but also martial spirit. Nangong Heng, at a hundred years old, had experienced everything the world had to offer. Besides, as a native of Jiangling, he had likely caught more fish than you had ever eaten.\nHe said he'd show off his skills, and indeed amazed Chief Wang. Soon after sitting down, a large fish took the bait. He even had Cheif Wang help reel it in, teaching him fish-fighting techniques, exhausting the fish out right before his eyes, only bringing it ashore once it was exhausted.\nNangong Heng immediately gifted the fish to Chief Wang as a token of their meeting. He figured gifts brought from Jiangling city would be met with suspicion and dispute, which Chief Wang would surely decline. But this fish was caught right before his eyes. Gifting the fish also credited the achievement entirely to him. It indeed pleased Chief Wang, who happily took the fish to grill.

王帮主去烤鱼的时候，老太爷得意扬扬转头问起你们收获。你心乱如麻，无心钓鱼，一条鱼都没钓到。南宫横笑了笑，顺势借题，将他处世学问、武学见解道出。此理虽然浅白，可你如非身临其境，必不能体会此言真谛，只将这席话当作老人家的唠叨。此时身在敌阵中心，心脏跳得有如擂鼓一般，闻得此话，豁然开朗，不单学问修养，就连武学之道，亦有所悟。=While Chief Wang was grilling the fish, the old Master turned to you得意扬扬 and asked about your catch.\nYour mind was in turmoil while fishing; you hadn't caught a single fish. Nangong Heng smiled, took the opportunity to expound his philosophy of life and martial insights. Though the principle was simple, unless you were in this very situation, you could never truly grasp its meaning; you would have merely dismissed it as an old man's ramblings. \nNow, in the heart of the enemy camp, your heart was pounding like a war drum. Upon hearing these words, you suddenly saw the light, gaining wisdom in character and cultivation, but you also experienced a breakthrough in your understanding of martial arts.

因为小师妹爱吃鱼，你便时时为难山上的溪鱼，钓鱼技巧熟练得很，换了别处，照样使得，一连钓上了三条，虽不及老太爷先前那条，却也相当肥美。老太爷听你提起唐门之事，回忆涌上心头，说起他小时候是如何与你派前前前任掌门结为至交，一起在唐门山上裸奔、跳下水沟拿肩甲刺鱼、故意恶作剧泼水打湿唐门师姐的衣衫，言下无限缅怀。你二人听着这些趣事，都不禁莞尔，笑而忘机，将身在险地的事情尽数抛诸脑后。丐帮众弟子远远听见你们笑声，暗暗佩服你们豪爽气魄，死到临头还笑得出来。=Because Little Junior Sister loved fish, you often troubled the mountain stream fish, becoming very skilled at fishing. Even in a different place, the techniques still worked; you reeled in three fish in a row. Though not as large as the Old Master's earlier catch, they were still quite plump.\nWhen the Old Master heard you mention Tang Sect affairs, memories flooded back. He began recounting how, as a child, he became close friends with your sect's leader from three generations prior; running naked on Tang Sect's mountain, jumping into ditches to spear fish with shoulder guards, and deliberately playing pranks like splashing water to soak the robes of Tang Sect senior sisters. His words overflowed with nostalgia.\nListening to these amusing stories, both of you couldn't help but smile, forgetting all caution and disregarding the danger you were in. The Beggars' Sect disciples heard your laughter from afar and secretly admired your bold spirit, laughing even with death at your doorstep.

老太爷一见你鱼篓里的收获，得意洋洋的脸色顿时化为震惊，不敢置信。你们才坐下来不到半个时辰，你就钓到这么多鱼，还都又肥又大！忙不迭纡尊向你请教，你也不藏私，当即披露你的卑鄙伎俩，乃是先将饵料撒在江面上，引得鱼儿争相抢食，浮上水面，再射出绑了钓线的暗器将鱼射死，才收线扯回岸上。那爷孙俩哪曾见过人这样捕鱼，都惊呆了。老太爷向你买鱼，提去分赠给丐帮弟子，就算明日要厮杀，今天也未必不能好好相处。=As soon as the Old Master saw the catch in your fishing basket, his proud expression turned to shock and disbelief. You had been sitting there for less than half an hour, yet you had already caught so many fish. Each one was plump and large!\nHe hastily condescended to ask for your advice. You didn't hold back, immediately disclosing your cunning trick: first you scattered the bait on the river surface luring the fish into a frenzy as they surfaced to feed. Then you shot them dead with projectiles attached to fishing lines before reeling them in.\nThe grandfather and grandson had never seen anyone fish like this and were stunned.\nThe Old Master bought the fish from you and distributed them among the Beggars' Sect disciples. Even if they were to clash in battle tomorrow, it didn't mean they couldn't get along well today.

他左右开弓，分心二用，一手应付你，一手接连在南宫浅身上拍了好几掌。你情急之下全力施为，令泥教法王亦为之动容，被逼退半步，念及明日要事，不宜消耗过剧，干脆便收手罢斗了。=\nHe fought with both hands, dividing his attention—one hand dealing with you, the other striking Nangong Qian with several palm strikes in quick succession.\nIn your desperation, you unleashed your full strength, which even impressed the Mud Sect Dharma King, forcing him back half a step. Considering the important matters tomorrow, it wasn't wise to expend too much energy, so he simply withdrew and ceased fighting.

他左右开弓，分心二用，一手痛打南宫浅，一手应付你。虽只单手，每一掌却都威力万钧，挟带凌厉风声，你勉力招架自保犹可，却难护南宫浅周全，眼睁睁看着他一掌接一掌被拍得东倒西歪。=He fought with both hands, dividing his attention, one hand fiercely beating Nangong Qian, the other dealing with you. Even with only one hand, each palm strike carried immense force, accompanied by sharp, whistling wind. You struggled just to defend yourself and barely managed to hold your ground, but you couldn't protect Nangong Shen. You watched helplessly as he was struck again and again, thrown off balance and reeling with each hit.

他左右开弓，分心二用，一手痛打南宫浅，一手应付你，饶是如此，浑厚内力依然非你能敌，拆不几招，便被一掌震退，腾腾几步，退到丈许之外，才化消势道，惊得是吃了这一掌，你竟只痛不伤。王帮主逼退了你，更不打话，一甩钓竿，将南宫浅拉到身前，两掌纷飞，拍得他腾空飞起。=He fought with both hands, dividing his attention, one hand fiercely beating Nangong Qian, the other dealing with you. Even so, his profound internal energy was more than you could handle. After just a few exchanges, you were forced back by a palm strike, stumbling several steps until you were over ten feet away before dissipating the force. Astonishingly, after taking that palm, you only felt pain but were unharmed.\nLeader Wang, having forced you back, didn't say another word. With a flick of his fishing rod, he pulled Nangong Qian before him and unleashed a flurry of palms, sending him flying through the air.
王二壮再回来时，便不再拐弯抹角，言道既然收了礼物，便上钩一回，听听老太爷说法。听那二人你一言、我一语，话里试探、恫吓、讥嘲纷呈，无愧是江湖耆老与丐帮之主，这席对谈，便显出二人底蕴深厚，都不是一味逞凶斗狠的莽夫，直听得你和南宫浅都汗湿衣衫。说到老太爷带你二人同行的理由，王帮主猜的入理，却不意老太爷为的是入情。他带这庶出不得疼爱的孙儿到此，乃是借此行锤炼孙儿胆气，又为他博得好名声。待南宫浅安然无恙回家，江湖上人人都会夸他胆识非凡，就连龙潭虎穴也敢闯，难得的是毫发无伤，全身而退──原来南宫世家不只大公子出众，就连二公子也不容小觑。=\nWhen Wang Erzhuang returned, he stopped beating around the bush, stating that since he had accepted the gift, he'd taken the bait and would listen to the old Master's proposal.\nListening to the two of them exchange words filled with probing, intimidation, and sarcasm, it was worthy of a martial world elder and the Beggars' Sect Leader. This conversation revealed both had deep reserves, neither being mere brutes relying on violence. It made you and Nangong Qian sweat through your clothes.\nWhen discussing the old Master's reason for bringing you two along, Leader Wang guessed logically, but unexpectedly, the old Master's motive was emotional. He brought this less-favored, illegitimate grandson to temper his courage and win him a good reputation. Once Nangong Qian returned home safely, everyone in the martial world would praise his extraordinary daring for daring to venture into the dragon's den and tiger's lair, remarkably emerging unscathed—turns out the Nangong Family not only had an outstanding Eldest Young Master but also a Second Young Master not to be underestimated.
至于你，既能让阿浅喊一声大哥，说宽了点，也是南宫深的孙子，一看你就是到哪都不受人待见的面相，当爷爷的，怎能不为你着想？王二壮哑然失笑，自问胸襟不如南宫横，对这位老太爷，那是当真敬佩至极。=As for you, since you could make A'Qian call you 'big brother,' broadly speaking, you were also a grandson of Nangong Shen. You clearly had the face of someone unwelcome everywhere. As a grandfather, how could he not think of you?\nWang Erzhuang chuckled wryly, admitting his magnanimity was less than Nangong Heng's. He truly held the utmost respect for this old Master.
至于你，唐门最后一个外姓弟子的传奇事迹，他老人家亦早有耳闻。南宫横阅人无数，见惯了有家世、有才貌的后起之秀，反观你，一看就是到哪都不受人待见的面相，不由得心底唏嘘，打定主意，就是偏要拉拔一个不受人待见的，向世间表示抗议。=As for you, the legendary tales of the Tang Sect's last outer-sect disciple had also reached his ears.\nNangong Heng had seen countless people, witnessed many promising youths with family backgrounds, talent, and looks. In contrast, you clearly had the face of someone unwelcome everywhere. He couldn't help but sigh inwardly, determined precisely to promote someone unpopular as a protest to the world.
南宫横坦诚相告，也开门见山问王二壮，究竟率众围攻江陵亦欲为何？倘若只为夺城，至今丐帮已不知纵放多少良机。丐帮帮主若是愚昧无知之辈也索罢了，这位王帮主腹有韬略，颇具大将之风，断不能误判军机。原来王帮主心忧家国，亦深知江湖、朝廷昔日恩怨，犹如冰封三尺，非一日之寒，算来，还是几代官家欠江湖人的多。除非知晓旧事的江湖人悉数死绝，抑或改朝换代，江山易主，否则朝廷、江湖永远势如水火，不能冀望江湖能再出一个为国为民的大侠南宫智、亦不能再有辅佐岳元帅的文盟主、武霸王。虽说南宫世家上与官府为睦，下亦不拒和草莽结交，假以时日，南宫横老太爷天下大同的理念，或能逆转此局，然则凡事都求两全其美，那便得从长计议，千万急就不得。可是国难当前，金人可不会等你团结一心再来侵略。与此同时，边疆每天都有将士捐躯赴死。为今之计，只有当头棒喝，敲醒警钟，攻击江陵驻军，再借南宫世家的脸面，招来武林各大派门援手。以既成事实，令朝廷不得不借重江湖力量，否则江陵城破，襄阳顿失所倚，江山社稷危矣。听完王二壮所言，南宫横心中敬佩交加，深感相逢恨晚，恨不得为他分说，雪洗污名，好教天下侠士都来认识这位大英雄、大豪杰。然则王二壮却不惜名，只以大局为重，此战必须较真，要藉江湖草莽之手，解江陵之围，官府才会知恩，再创朝野一心，更抗外侮的道路。南宫横喟然长叹，知其心意已决，便不再多言，临行忽然想起一事，便随口问了出来，说是前些日子有个黑衣人夜访南宫大宅，想对南宫浅下手，正巧被家主撞见逐走，问他有无头绪。王帮主当即承认，那黑衣夜行的不速之客，就是他本人。言下分毫没有愧疚感。经老太爷一提，这才想到了那日夜行功败垂成的未完之事，便唤南宫浅到跟前来，冷不防一掌将他拍得口吐鲜血，如此剧变，始料未及，无论你和老太爷都不及出手相护，骇怒交加。=Nangong Heng spoke frankly and directly asked Wang Erzhuang: what was the true purpose of besieging Jiangling with his followers?\nIf it was just to capture the city, the Beggars' Sect had already let slip numerous opportunities. If the Beggars' Sect Leader were a fool, that would be one thing, but this Leader Wang had strategies and a General's bearing; he definitely wouldn't misjudge military matters.\nIt turned out Leader Wang worried about the nation. He also deeply understood the historical grievances between the martial world and the court, like three feet of ice—not formed in a day. Actually, several generations of officials owed more to the martial world.\nUnless all martial artists who knew the old affairs died out, or the dynasty changed and the land changed hands, the court and the martial world would forever be like fire and water. One couldn't hope for another chivalrous hero like Nangong Zhi who served the nation and people, nor another Civil Alliance Leader or Martial Tyrant who assisted Marshal Yue.\nAlthough the Nangong Family had good relations with the government above and didn't refuse association with ruffians below, given time, Old Master Nangong Heng's理念 of universal harmony might reverse this situation. Meanwhile, soldiers died at the border every day.\nThe only plan now was a shocking wake-up call: attack the Jiangling garrison, then use the Nangong Family's influence to summon help from major martial sects. Using accomplished facts to force the court to rely on martial world strength. Otherwise, if Jiangling fell, Xiangyang would lose its support, and the nation would be in peril.\nAfter hearing Wang Erzhuang's words, Nangong Heng felt both respect and regret for having met so late, wishing he could explain and clear his name, so all heroes would know this Great Hero and champion.\nHowever, Wang Erzhuang cared not for fame, only the greater good. This battle had to be taken seriously. Using the hands of the martial world to lift the siege of Jiangling would make the government grateful, creating a path for court and commoners to unite against foreign aggression.\nNangong Heng sighed deeply, knowing his mind was made up, and said no more. As they were leaving, he suddenly remembered something and casually asked: some days ago, a black-clad figure visited the Nangong mansion at night, intending to harm Nangong Qian, but was spotted by the Family Head and driven away. Did he have any idea?\nLeader Wang immediately admitted that the uninvited nightly visitor in black was himself. He showed not a trace of guilt.\nReminded by the old Master, he recalled that night's unfinished business. Although he saw through her intentions, he didn't oppose her in the slightest but instead secretly admired her.\nHearing her provoke him into exchanging three palm strikes, he played along, using only thirty percent of his power to probe while keeping seventy percent for defense, not letting his guard down because she was a seemingly weak woman. Sure enough, there was a trick. The moment their palms touched, Wang Erzhuang suddenly understood: this woman was fearless because her internal energy cultivation was astonishing, harmonizing Yin and Yang, incredibly profound, not inferior to his own at all. But she simply didn't know how to use it properly. His seventy percent defensive force caught it and effortlessly sent it back.\nWei Ju had no intention of harming anyone; she only wanted to take advantage of Leader Wang's potential underestimation and pity for the weak to use the Kongtong Iron Pipa Technique to awe him, so he wouldn't look down on the heroes of the world and to give the righteous Heroes an advantage.\nBut she had never encountered such an internal energy Master before. Suddenly shaken by her own internal energy, she retreated several steps. Although not internally injured, she was terrified, her face pale. Fortunately, she was kind-hearted and hadn't intended to seriously harm him; otherwise, that rebound might have cost her her life. Leader Wang said he wouldn't show mercy to beauties, but in reality, the thirty percent energy he pushed out was used to protect his opponent.\nHe kindly advised her to stop, suggesting they forget the agreement for three palm strikes. Even though her face was ashen, Wei Ju refused to break her word and steeled herself to receive two more palm strikes.

二师兄顾不得自己伤重，行色匆匆疾步踏入殿中，推你一把推开，去搭掌门脉象，悚然色变，你和三师兄还盼他妙手回春，却不料二师兄忽然没头没脑，问起掌门信物一事，一得掌门答复，便毫不留情，将一粒丹药强行塞入掌门口中，摀嘴迫他服下。三师兄认出那丹药来历，欲加制止已然不及，又惊又急、又悲又怒，喝问二师兄究竟是何居心？原来那丹药正是二十年前，极乐教为祸武林之际，用以支配江湖人士的活毒『尸心丹』。此毒遇血化开蜡封，便破茧而出，窜入人体，随即伪装成人身血肉，医术再高明的大夫，亦难驱逐，若被毒虫钻入脑中，不得施术者允可，纵想自我了断也是痴人说梦，可谓穷凶极恶。三师兄曾见过无数硬朗豪杰被此毒折辱得人不像人、鬼不像鬼，就是当年师娘也是身中此毒，受制于人，才肇生无穷憾事。极乐教覆灭以后，还道此毒已付之一炬，岂料多年以后，却被施加在自家掌门身上，如何能不教他惊怒交加？=\nSecond Senior Brother, ignoring his own severe injuries, hurried into the hall, pushed you aside, and felt the Sect Leader's pulse. His expression changed dramatically. You and Third Senior Brother had hoped for his miraculous healing touch, but instead, Second Senior Brother suddenly and inexplicably asked about the Sect Leader's token. Upon getting an answer, he ruthlessly forced a pill into the Sect Leader's mouth, covering it to make him swallow.\nThird Senior Brother recognized the pill—it was the living poison 'Corpse Heart Pill' used by the Blissful Cult two decades ago to control martial artists during their reign of terror.\nUpon contact with blood, the wax seal dissolves, and the poison emerges, burrowing into the body, disguising itself as flesh. Even the most skilled physician cannot expel it. If the poison insect钻入 the brain, one cannot even commit suicide without the poisoner's permission—it was utterly vicious.\nThird Senior Brother had seen countless robust heroes reduced to less than human by this poison. Even your Master's wife had been poisoned and controlled, leading to endless regrets.\nAfter the Blissful Cult's destruction, everyone thought this poison had been destroyed. Who could have imagined it would be used on their own Sect Leader years later? How could he not be shocked and furious?
唐门之中，便属你挨二师兄骂得最多，交情深了，隐约也能窥其铁面之后的医者仁心，你对他的信赖，丝毫不亚于大师兄。=In the Tang Sect, you were the one scolded most by Second Senior Brother. But with deep acquaintance, you could vaguely see the healer's benevolence behind his stern facade. Your trust in him was no less than that in First Senior Brother.
及至此刻惨遭背叛，亲眼见他毒害掌门、夺取师门宝物、得意洋洋的自曝，依然不敢相信这是现实。昔日有多少敬仰，今天便有多少心寒，不顾运功抗毒，只想追上前去给他几拳，逼他亲口说出「我是有苦衷的」这些话来，但你今日连番力战，早已精疲力尽，闻知身世，心相震荡，又受二师兄麻毒所害，再也无力追击，只能将满腔怒火化作咆哮，震撼山林。唐家大院之中，诸人闻声骇然，就是小师妹听了也心脏剧跳。唐铮闻得你的吼声，依然面不改色，与接应他的同谋一道扬长而去。=Facing such brutal betrayal, witnessing him poison the Sect Leader, steal the sect treasure, and boast triumphantly, you still couldn't believe it was real.\nThe admiration of the past turned to heartbreak in equal measure. Ignoring the need to resist the poison with your energy, you只想 chase him down and punch him until he admitted "I had no choice". But after today's successive battles, you were exhausted. Learning about your origins had shaken you, and affected by Second Senior Brother's paralyzing poison, you had no strength to pursue. You could only channel your fury into a roar that shook the mountain forests.\nEveryone in the Tang compound was terrified by the sound; even Little Junior Sister's heart raced. Tang Zheng heard your roar but remained expressionless, leaving swiftly with his accomplice.

三师兄持掌门交托的令牌，号令弟子下山追击，却都无功而返。小师妹狼狈不堪赶回家中，却赶不上和父亲说上一句话，怔怔伏在床边，小手轻轻拍打掌门身驱，无声的眼泪扑簌簌落在襟前。没了掌门，众弟子顿失倚仗，兼而大师兄失踪，二师兄叛逃。唐门内忧外患实多，就是驱散强敌，亦无半分可喜，无一人不是忧心忡忡，神情肃穆。那一天夜里，许多弟子不告而别。=Third Senior Brother, holding the token entrusted by the Sect Leader, ordered disciples to pursue下山, but they all returned empty-handed.\nLittle Junior Sister rushed home in disarray but arrived too late to say a word to her father. With First Senior Brother missing and Second Senior Brother叛逃, the Tang Sect faced numerous internal and external troubles. 你悠悠醒转，已是隔日。同门师兄弟前来召唤，你还道掌门复苏，喜不自胜，随即才知道一切你所畏惧的，都是现实。美好的昨日已离你远去，人间一夕色变，纵使我们竭力抵抗也勒不住缰绳，只能身不由己，任由巨大洪流将你冲垮，载浮载沉，口里尝到的泪水，既苦且咸，如今才恍然大悟，这便是江湖的真貌。=You woke up slowly the next day.\nFellow disciples came to summon you. You thought the Sect Leader had revived and were overjoyed, only to learn that everything you feared was reality.\nThe beautiful yesterday was gone. The world had changed overnight. No matter how hard we resisted, we couldn't hold the reins, swept away helplessly by a巨大 torrent, floating and sinking. The tears tasted bitter and salty. Only now did you realize: this was the true face of the martial world.
你来到正心堂中，参见代掌门。师兄弟昨日才见，今朝碰面，却觉不胜唏嘘。唐门内战，到处狼藉，血污满地，便只正心堂中，依旧轻烟袅袅，悠然隔世，只是人事已非。明明击退了强敌，却胜得凄惨，形如丧家之犬。被那释明禅师逃逸而去，四处散播谣言，颠倒黑白，一边是慈眉善目的方外高人，一边是亦正亦邪的武林世家，任谁都会偏信前者。一夕之间唐门罔顾恩义、滥杀同门的流言便广为流传，唐门乃是魔教党羽的传闻亦夹杂在此中，不胫而走。都说唐家掌门戾气太重，释明禅师纵有佛法箴言，亦度化不得。最终导致自食恶果，走火入魔，一代怪杰从此卧病在床，沦为废人。值此强敌环伺之际，三师兄倘若惩罚了这群上门滋事的冒牌唐门，便如坐实谣言，自曝其短，将来嵩山派、南宫世家上门来劝解，又该怎生交代？三师兄左右为难，唯有凡事留一点余地，也收回了搜寻大师兄的号令，令弟子回守山门，以免遭敌人趁虚而入。=You went to the Zhengxin Hall to see the acting Sect Leader. 上官萤虽临阵决意，倒戈向唐门，但充其量也是她一己之见。乱战之际，她所带来的沧帮弟子皆奉家主之命，袖手旁观，就算两不相帮，亦足表明态度。那日带领广州唐门前来闹事的弃徒唐守鸿，以及释明禅师都是阅历深厚的老江湖，与飞石帮主那等初生之犊截然不同，他们见过如日中天的唐门，见过全盛时期的唐中翎。那时的唐家掌门比鬼神更凶，他与正道同一阵线时，群邪辟易；他与正道为敌时，连六大派高手都得请出南宫世家调停。就因唐中翎坐镇掌门之位，几十年来，那二人连蜀中地界都不敢接近。今日若非上官世家撑腰，怎有胆识欺上门来滋事？追根究柢，上官世家责无旁贷。上官萤使唤不动下人，又不能罔顾世家威信，示弱于人，强忍唐门弟子的指指点点，听闻你醒来了，喜不自胜，匆匆踏进正心堂，却马上被逐客令请了出去。上官萤下令不让下人近身，与你并肩而行，一言不发，心怀惴惴，隐约知道事已无可挽回，与你诀别的时刻到了。你何尝不想与她携手同游，一直纵情欢笑，可是人并非总为自己一人活着，你的身后有唐门，她的身后有上官世家。与她诀别，划清界线，便是你保护她的方法，这样好的人儿，还是离江湖纷扰越远越好。=Although Shangguan Ying decided to switch sides to the Tang Sect during the battle, it was ultimately her personal opinion. 临去以前，上官萤蓦地回头，自顾自说起自己的事。她曾有过一个随身丫环，情同姊妹，名叫书蓉。虽然万般不舍，可是她终究不能违抗家主命令，只能眼睁睁看着随身丫鬟被送让旁人，在那之后，再多再好的人，也填不了书蓉的缺。南宫大公子不要她，可是上官萤依然念念不忘；魏菊魏掌门是她认定的至交，无可取代。与你的缘份，也是她千金不换的宝藏。即使你不领情，她也一定要帮你，谁还没叛逆过，跟爹娘顶嘴呢？上官萤与你分别后第一件事，便是去寻唐门债主吕翁，以沧帮船会总筹名义，允诺让利，以此免除唐门部分债务。吕翁闻知掌门重病一事，感慨万千，也慷慨解囊，免去了唐门上代借款买米，赈济荒年的那笔陈年旧债。=Before leaving, Shangguan Ying suddenly turned back and spoke of her own accord.\nShe once had a personal maid, close as a sister, named Shu Rong.\nThough deeply reluctant, she ultimately couldn't defy the Family Head's order and could only watch as her maid was given to someone else. 自大师兄身影自江陵消失以后，偌大中原武林，便再也不曾听人讲起飞侠事迹，就像这人凭空消失了似的。这一来，可急坏了你三师兄，那飞石帮主石公远，曾与大师兄约好决斗，石公远定日期，大师兄定地点，你大师兄从来不是怯战之人，孰料竟尔爽约。寻常武林人士约好决斗，有一方不到，那公证人便会判定敌手怯战，不战而败，传出去，比打输了还丢人。若能就此平息事端，虽然丢脸，亦未尝不可。可无奈的是大师兄将人家夫人请去，至今下落不明。夫人一日未归，那石帮主焉能赢了面子便善罢干休，再三写战书寄唐门，大师兄都不曾屡约，不由得气急败坏，这次信中省去江湖客套，挑明若再不应战，那便举飞石帮全帮之众，攻上唐门，血洗唐家大院。纵令你们武艺高强，无惧飞石帮，也要用人海战术，堆尸压垮你们山头，两败俱伤亦再所不惜。=\nSince First Senior Brother vanished from Jiangling, the vast Central Plains martial world had heard no more of the Flying Hero's deeds, as if he had disappeared into thin air.\nThis worried your Third Senior Brother greatly. The Flying Stone Gang Leader, Shi Gongyuan, had agreed to a duel with First Senior Brother: Shi set the date, First Senior Brother set the location.
