Even if you were skilled and unafraid of them, they would use human wave tactics, piling corpses to overwhelm your mountain, even at the cost of mutual destruction.
你和三师兄何曾没有试图息事宁人，可惜好说歹说，人家夫人就是不知所踪，你再有诚意，也形同空谈。=You and Third Senior Brother had tried to appease them, but no matter how much you talked, the man's wife was simply missing. Your sincerity was like empty talk.
你几度欲言又止，虽知大师兄去向，可是念及掌门有意不令门人知晓，即使是三师兄、四师兄，你也说不出口，唯恐流言四起，门人自乱阵脚。=You hesitated several times. 三师兄、四师兄都是方今唐门中硕果仅存的资深师兄，他们伴随着唐门由盛转衰，又起死回生，挨至今日，江湖阅历丰富，深知本门与飞石帮之争，绝非大师兄劣行肇致，那充其量不过是个由头，真正的原因，说穿了还是名利二字。要知本门在蜀中生根，信用、人望都是几代累积下来的，凡我地界之内，乡里村人代代均受唐门恩泽，当代年轻人或许还不清楚，老一辈的都知道，唐门盛时那威风，遇有天灾、人祸，不先问官府，反去求唐门。衙门里官官相卫求不得的公道，到了唐门，沉冤必定昭雪，三大世家，也只有唐门敢和朝廷正面对垒。而今飞石帮要想得人心，拓展地盘、成为武林一流大帮，那蜀中唐门便是头号劲敌。即便唐门无心相争，飞石帮亦决计不能见容，一待窥见良机，便会寻衅发难，击败唐门，取而代之。=Third and Fourth Senior Brothers were the only remaining senior disciples in the Tang Sect today. They深知 the conflict with the Flying Stone Gang wasn't truly caused by First Senior Brother's misdeeds; that was just an excuse. Within our territory, villagers for generations received the Tang Sect's beneficence. While contemporary youth might not know, the older generation remembered the Tang Sect's majesty at its peak. When disasters struck, people sought the Tang Sect before the authorities.\nJustice unattainable in the corrupt government could always be found at the Tang Sect. Among the Three Great Martial Families, only the Tang Sect dared confront the court head-on.\nNow, if the Flying Stone Gang wanted to win hearts, expand territory, and become a top martial gang, the Shu-based Tang Sect was their primary rival. 倒不如该谢大师兄洞烛机先，拐了人家帮主夫人藏匿起来，令飞石帮主投鼠忌器，不敢轻易取人性命，局势才能维稳至今。只可惜你无从得知那位石夫人的藏身之处，否则将人拿来施毒用刑，看那石帮主还敢不敢再咄咄逼人。=If anything, we should thank First Senior Brother for his foresight in abducting and hiding the gang Leader's wife, making the Flying Stone Gang Leader hesitate to kill easily, thus stabilizing the situation until now.\nIt's a pity you had no way of knowing where Madam Shi was hidden. 小梅煎熬多年，才敢来见你。她因生就一副美人胚子而遭难，被千灯楼劫去，从小当作杀手培养，心中还藏有一只尸心蛊，每次发作都生不如死。为了活命，不得不抹煞良心，总是巧笑倩兮招人喜欢，却很少发自真心。生平最后悔的事，莫过于小看了你，让你的蠢样逗乐了自己，让你在心底占了一席之地，心血来潮去了唐门，却又不得不恩将仇报。是以送别你之后那些岁月，都苦涩又难熬，煎熬几十年，无一日不想：「啊，要是我当时没那么听话就好了。」位高权重的千灯楼主一当几十年，还不如短短几月在唐门的旧日时光温暖。她带来了唐门小剑，双膝落地，盼你处死了她，就别再记恨了。=Xiaomei endured years of煎熬 (suffering) before daring to see you.\nBorn beautiful, she was kidnapped by the Thousand Lanterns Tower, raised as an assassin. A Corpse Heart蛊 (gu worm) in her heart made each发作 (attack) unbearable. On a whim, she went to the Tang Sect, yet had to repay kindness with betrayal.\nThus, the years after sending you away were bitter and hard. Decades of煎熬 (torment), not a day without thinking: "Ah, if only I hadn't been so obedient then."\nDecades as the powerful Thousand Lanterns Tower Leader were less warm than the few short months at the Tang Sect.\nShe brought a Tang Sect small sword, knelt, hoping you would execute her and let go of hatred.
你处死了小梅，村中无一人敢言，只是昔日热情消失无踪。你的妻子、小孩都视你如同陌生人一般。=You executed Xiaomei. No one in the village dared speak, but the past warmth vanished.\nYour wife and children regarded you as a stranger.
这些年来，你无一日不想对她报复，唐门覆灭，她脱离不了干系，但她囚你在此，未始非用苦心，小剑挥下，死去的人亦不会活来，是以你始终没有下手。=Over the years, you thought of revenge daily. The Tang Sect's fall involved her. But imprisoning you here wasn't without苦心 (good intention). The small sword swung, the dead wouldn't return, so you never acted.
你并没如她所愿，这可不是慈悲，你深知世上最苦的不是死别，而是生离家人。你要她留在这座岛上，换她来受相思凌迟，等到十几二十年后，想见的人再也见不到，才许回中原。无论她是否听从，这一生都求不得你原谅。=You didn't grant her wish. 你独自一人启程回返中原，路途遥远，你不慎感染了风寒，把所有钱财都给了一个年轻力壮的飞石帮众，请他背你上山，如愿以偿病逝于唐门旧址。=You alone set off for the Central Plains. The journey was long; you caught a cold. Giving all your money to a strong Flying Stone Gang member, you asked him to carry you up the mountain. As wished, you died of illness at the old Tang Sect site.
卧云岗决斗，与飞石帮的恩怨战且告一段落，你和大师兄、龙湘三人下山回到村中歇宿。=\nThe Wo Yun Ridge duel, the feud with the Flying Stone Gang, was temporarily over. You, Elder Brother, and Long Xiang went down the mountain and rested in the village.

你见龙湘和大师兄嬉笑打骂，感情甚笃的模样，不由得暗喜。虽说不免艳羡大师兄福气，能有如此佳人追着他跑，但这二人之间的事倘若成了，那大师兄八成便不能再娶小师妹，毕竟小师妹可是掌门独生爱女，总不能让她做小、做平妻，而这位龙姑娘也不像是甘居于人下的软性子，何况她还有锦香宫作靠山呢。如此一来，大师兄只能舍了小师妹，即使小师妹最终仍然要嫁旁人，好歹你也能多陪她几年，以此回忆告慰生平。=Seeing Long Xiang and Elder Brother joking and fighting, so close, you secretly rejoiced.\nThough envying Elder Brother's luck having such a beauty chase him, if these two got together, Elder Brother probably couldn't marry Little Junior Sister. 还道小师妹心地善良，不食人间烟火，一点儿脾气也没，也不会以貌取人，谅人不会拒绝，可是云裳终究低估你惹人生气的本事。小师妹秀眉轻蹙，一句不要，径去不理。=She thought Little Junior Sister was kind-hearted, ethereal, without a trace of temper, and never judged by appearances, assuming she wouldn't refuse. 叶云裳没法可想，只得自己上阵拍拍，她的拍拍可一点都没有安慰人的意思，呼的一下就甩在你脸上，打了你一脸懵，转身就跑，还不忘恶人先告状。=Ye Yunshang had no other ideas, so she had to step in and pat you herself. 你修养功夫了得，没计较她的暴行，只付之于苦笑。经她一闹，心中悲伤郁结却似消散了几分。=Your self-restraint was remarkable; you didn't hold her outrageous behavior against her, only responded with a bitter smile.\nAfter her antics, the sorrow and pent-up emotions in your heart seemed to dissipate a little.
叶云裳见着小师妹替你拍拍，而你一副如释重负，逐渐释然的表情，蓦地心头火起，扬言也要拍拍，笑着上前赏了你几巴掌，又找借口逃去。她见你和小师妹好，可谓百感交集。她自知命不久矣，既怕默铃受她之外的人欺负，也不想你去疼她之外的人。等她离开人世以后，在意的人都聚在一块，偶尔说起她的事，那就心满意足了。虽作如此想，这爱热闹的小姑娘，又怎甘心从此孤伶伶的呢？分明是她存心安排的，却又为此后悔，寂寞得落下泪来。心绪牵动病情，冥冥之中，毒已侵蚀髓海，令她记忆错乱，彷佛梦回点苍，还道他哥哥依然在外闯荡，亲哥、义兄不在，师兄弟姊妹忙着练剑，无暇理会她，于是云裳一个人抹着眼泪，回到屋里，孤独作祟，令她病得更深了。=Ye Yunshang saw Little Junior Sister patting you and your expression of relief and gradual release, and suddenly felt a surge of anger. She was afraid Mo Ling would be bullied by others after she was gone, and she didn't want you to care for anyone else but her.\nAfter she passed away, she would be content if the people she cared about gathered together and occasionally spoke of her.\nEven so, how could this lively young girl bear to be lonely from then on?\nClearly, she had arranged this herself, yet she regretted it, shedding tears of loneliness.\nHer emotions affected her condition, and as if destined, the poison had eroded her marrow, causing her memory to become confused, as if dreaming of returning to Diancang. 叶云裳没法可想，只得将她珍藏的珠宝借你玩赏，盼你心情快些恢复过来。你倒不是清高不爱钱财，只是钱攒着还是要吃好穿暖，对珠宝一类珍品却没多大奢想，遑论她只是借你赏玩，又不是送你。正想婉拒，叶云裳就凑近过来，一反常态的温顺，拉你并肩在床沿坐下，更将柔软的小手塞你掌心，让你牵着她柔若无骨的小手。原来她口中所说的珠宝，便是她自己，珍贵又易碎，你得看紧她、带好她，无时不刻着急她、时常拿出来欣赏一下，喜欢得不能自已。明明没甚么用处，却令你爱不释手才行。你哑然失笑，可是手握紧了紧，心中爱念无极，明知她调皮爱闹不安好心，就是怜她怜得无法自拔，自己蹦进了她的圈套，甘愿受她颐指气使。=\nYe Yunshang had no other ideas, so she could only lend you her treasured jewelry to enjoy, hoping your mood would recover quickly.\nIt wasn't that you were above worldly desires or disliked wealth, but money was for eating well and dressing warmly—you had little desire for precious items like jewelry, especially since she was only lending it to you, not giving it.\nJust as you were about to decline, Ye Yunshang moved close, unusually gentle, pulling you to sit side by side on the edge of the bed, and placed her soft little hand in your palm, letting you hold her delicate, boneless hand.\nIt turned out the "jewelry" she spoke of was herself—precious and fragile. 你却不知她给你牵着手时，也是心头小鹿乱撞。曾经大言不惭要结识天下英俊侠士才子，不知不觉眼里却只剩你。对你的依恋渐深，已非区区皮相所能拦阻。=But you didn't know that when she let you hold her hand, her heart was also racing.\nOnce, she had bragged about wanting to meet all the handsome heroes and talents under heaven, but unknowingly, her eyes held only you.\nHer attachment to you had grown so deep that mere appearances could no hinder it.
她把每一天都当最后一天过，要你记住她闪闪发亮的样子，那怕你一无所有，还能看看她，莞尔一笑，别终日哭丧着脸过日子，缘份难得，稍纵即逝，何况薄命如她。=She lived each day as if it were her last, wanting you to remember her shining self. 她不舍你伤心，要伤也只能由她来伤，等你失去她的时候，再哭得死去活来不迟。=She couldn't bear to see you hurt; if anyone were to cause pain, it should be her. When you lost her, then would be the time to cry your heart out.
能容许你绷着一张脸的期限，到明日破晓为止。你又好气，又好笑，心中郁结消散，找回几分继续生活的勇气。=The deadline for you to keep a straight face was until dawn tomorrow.\nYou were both annoyed and amused, the knots in your heart loosening, reclaiming some courage to continue living.
三师兄将小梅所托付的匕首，交到你手里。这件兵器名唤玉霄神，是小梅爱不释手的兵器。=\nThird Brother handed you the dagger that Xiaomei had entrusted to him.\nThis weapon, named Yuxiao Shen, was Xiaomei's cherished possession.
你心意已决，迟早要上崆峒，把小梅捉回唐门，天王老子也拦不住你。=Your mind was made up: sooner or later, you would go to Kongtong, capture Xiaomei, and bring her back to the Tang Sect. Not even the heavens could stop you.
你心意已决，迟早要上崆峒，就算是埋伏在草堆里，趁小梅晨跑时冲出来打晕绑架，也要带她回唐门。=Your mind was made up: sooner or later, you would go to Kongtong. Even if it meant ambushing her in the grass, rushing out to knock her out and kidnap her during her morning run, you would bring her back to the Tang Sect.
不为其他，只为她是唐门入室弟子。若是她真心想走，也索罢了，倘若口是心非，那又另当别论了。既是本门弟子，赏罚皆由掌门和掌刑使说了才算，可不能容崆峒派、千灯楼随意处置。不论如何，你是一定要把她接回来的。=For no other reason than that she is an inner disciple of the Tang Sect.\nIf she truly wanted to leave, that would be one thing, but if her words didn't match her heart, then it was a different matter.\nAs a disciple of this sect, rewards and punishments are determined by the Sect Leader and the Punishment Enforcer. 月会刚完，代掌门又临时传召，瞧三师兄脸色果决，似乎下了重大决心，你等尽皆惴惴，而他今日临时召集所议之事，确实兹事体大，于公于私，都是重中之重，说攸关唐门命脉亦不为过。那便是掌门嘱托三师兄，关于小师妹的终生大事了。掌门本来属意大师兄继承衣钵，接任掌门，当小师妹归宿，如今此愿已然不能实现。故此，他打算昭告江湖，广邀各派优秀年轻才俊，齐上唐门比试。既比武功才干，亦比学问家世，还要能合小师妹眼缘，说白了，就是招亲不招赘。这话出自三师兄之口，实可谓不可思议，要知三师兄读圣贤书，最是讲究礼节，近乎顽固，三书六礼缺一不可，如今却因江湖情势，唯恐有误掌门所托，断送唐门最后血脉，所以迫而从权，欲将小师妹嫁出门去避祸。=\nThe monthly meeting had just ended when the acting Sect Leader summoned everyone again. Seeing Third Brother's resolute expression, it seemed he had made a major decision. 你闻言不禁大怒，将要发作，对上三师兄的视线，隐约看见他眼底的无奈，终于强行咽下，你也知道，这是无可奈何的事。你也希望小师妹往后余生，平安顺遂。=Hearing this, you couldn't help but feel furious, about to erupt, but meeting Third Brother's gaze, you faintly saw the helplessness in his eyes and finally forced it down. 小师妹不知所措，目光飘向你，不禁暗暗沮丧，为何你什么话都不说呢？=Little Junior Sister was at a loss, her gaze drifting toward you. She couldn't help but feel secretly disheartened: why weren't you saying anything?
你内心深处也明白，唯有让小师妹出嫁，以后从夫家，那么本门祸事，从此与她无关。=Deep down, you also understood that only by letting Little Junior Sister marry, henceforth following her husband's family, would the sect's troubles no longer concern her.
此情越深，越难割舍，越难割舍，越须放手。只愿她能邂逅良人，一生被捧在掌心里呵护，在四季如春、风光明媚的地方，如花一般绽放笑颜。=The deeper this affection, the harder it is to let go, and the harder it is to let go, the more one must release.\nYou only wished she would meet a good man, be cherished and protected like in the palm of his hand her whole life, in a place where it's always spring and the scenery is beautiful, blooming with smiles like a flower.

小师妹从小受你呵护长大，对你的容貌浑无半分反感，不晓得你何以自怨自艾。她心地无瑕，你却因遍体鳞伤，连她也不信，料她不是瞎了眼，就是学会撒谎了。=Little Junior Sister grew up under your care and had not the slightest aversion to your appearance, not understanding why you belittled yourself. 小师妹从小受你呵护长大，对你的容貌浑无半分反感，不晓得你何以自怨自自艾。她心地无瑕，你却因遍体鳞伤，连她也不信，料她不是瞎了眼，就是学会撒谎了。=Little Junior Sister grew up under your care and had not the slightest aversion to your appearance, not understanding why you belittled yourself. Third Senior Brother posed questions to test their literary talent, speech, and insight.
你和师兄弟们站在厅旁，也品头论足一番。一个上午过去，见了许多奇人异士，招亲既不限于武林人士，慕名而来争睹小师妹芳容的才子、富绅公子亦在所多有，不乏有才貌双全令人惊艳之辈，但也有令人哑然失笑的奇葩。举凡谈吐傲慢者、举止粗鲁者、轻浮戏谑者、浮夸矫揉者、炫富者，不问贵贱，一律请出堂去。今日来求亲的少侠、公子之中，当属南宫世家大公子南宫深，最被看好，无论家世、财富、名声、武功、才学皆属上乘，便是与他齐来的媒人，也是江湖名宿，与三师兄算得上故交，端的是无可挑剔的人选。惟南宫深与上官千金曾有婚姻之约，颇受争议而已。=You and your sect brothers stood by the hall, commenting on each suitor.\nThe morning passed, and you saw many extraordinary individuals. The contest wasn't limited to martial artists; scholars and young masters from wealthy families, drawn by Little Junior Sister's reputation, also came to catch a glimpse of her beauty. There were quite a few with both talent and looks who were impressive, but also some laughably eccentric characters.\nAnyone who was arrogant in speech, crude in manner, frivolous and joking, pretentious and affected, or showing off their wealth—regardless of status—was promptly shown out.\nAmong today's suitors and young masters, the most highly regarded was the Eldest Young Master of the Nangong Family, Nangong Shen. His family background, wealth, reputation, martial skills, and scholarship were all top-notch. Even the matchmaker accompanying him was a renowned veteran of the martial world, an old acquaintance of Third Senior Brother. He was, by all accounts, an impeccable candidate.\nThe only point of controversy was that Nangong Shen had once been engaged to the young lady of the Shangguan Family.
小师妹与大公子会一回见面，是在南宫寿宴。大公子一番美言夸奖小师妹，表露心迹，自言片面之缘，就令他念念不忘。小师妹那时光顾着品味佳肴，对大公子印象十分稀薄，反倒是他那位未婚妻子上官萤明艳绝伦，令她身为女子也暗生钦慕之心，一时都忘了吃饭。=Little Junior Sister's first meeting with the Eldest Young Master was at a birthday banquet for the Nangong Family.\nThe young Master praised Little Junior Sister lavishly, baring his heart and saying that even their brief encounter had left him unable to forget her.\nAt that time, Little Junior Sister was too busy savoring the delicacies to pay him much mind, and her impression of him was quite faint. In contrast, his then-fiancée, Shangguan Ying, was dazzlingly beautiful, evoking even in Little Junior Sister, a girl herself, a secret admiration that made her forget to eat for a moment.
南宫世家既是武林世家，也是书香门第，大公子作为次任家主接班人，自小浸淫，武功学术皆不在话下，江陵一役，还曾领袖群侠共抗畜生道侵攻，功绩更不待言。三师兄再出经史子集相试，也无甚意义，倒显得出题的人肤浅。=The Nangong Family was both a martial arts family and a scholarly one. The Eldest Young Master, as the successor to the family leadership, had been immersed in this environment since childhood. His martial skills and academic knowledge were beyond reproach, and during the Battle of Jiangling, he had led a group of heroes to resist the invasion of the Animal Path—his achievements spoke for themselves.\nFor Third Senior Brother to test him further with classics, histories, and philosophical texts seemed pointless and would only make the questioner appear shallow.
三师兄心念一转，遂出了一道难题。题为『农夫耕耘种稻以养天下，樵夫伐木造纸以利学问，夫武人学成而不以之事国，何用于民生？儒能以文乱法，侠则以武犯禁，如何见容于云衢？』这道题一出，当堂一片寂静。读书不多的，题目都没听明白，听懂了的，也是倒抽一口凉气。还道这位儒侠唐三爷对大公子和颜悦色，必定有意放水，没想到却出了这一道难题。这题问的是：农夫种稻能养活百姓，樵夫伐木可以生火煮饭，造纸以利学问传播，而我辈江湖中人苦苦修得一身武艺，却不报效国家，只为自己争名逐利，于苍生有何益？莫说行侠，国有国法，家有家规，儒生以仁爱、人情为号召，尚且会妨碍朝廷以法治国，遑论侠客一身武功，能够挑战当局禁制，朝廷又凭何对江湖纵容至今？答案很简单，但是谁都不愿宣之于口而已，一个说得不好，就得得罪天下武林人。南宫深略一思忖，已有计较，引礼记大学论述，侃侃而谈，言道无论文武，必先格物致知，明大义，知荣辱，意诚心正，以心从文、习武，皆为修身，成宗成派，则是齐家，唯有家齐，方能再论治国。苟利于国者，匹夫有责。将士攘外，侠客安内。所以我论江湖中人，无一不是为国为民。这一席话，把所有武林人都捧成了为国为民的英雄，往人脸上添金，博得满堂喝采，掌声雷动。=Third Senior Brother had a change of thought and posed a difficult question.\nThe topic was: 'Farmers plow and plant rice to feed the world; woodcutters fell trees and make paper to benefit knowledge. But if we martial artists, having mastered our skills, do not use them to serve the state, what use are we to the people's welfare? Scholars can use words to disrupt the law, and knights-errant use martial arts to violate prohibitions. How are they tolerated in the highest circles?'\nAs soon as this question was posed, the hall fell silent.\nThose with little learning didn't even understand the question; those who did gasped in shock.\nThey had thought this scholarly knight, Third Master Tang, was being kind to the young Master and would go easy on him, never expecting such a challenging question.\nThe question asked: Farmers grow rice to feed the people, woodcutters fell trees for firewood and paper to spread knowledge, but we of the martial world, having painstakingly cultivated our skills, do not serve the state, only seeking fame and profit for ourselves—what benefit is that to the common people? Let alone chivalry; the state has its laws, families their rules. Scholars, advocating benevolence and human feeling, can still hinder the court's rule by law. How much more so knights-errant with their martial skills, capable of challenging the authorities' prohibitions? By what right does the court tolerate the martial world to this day?\nThe answer was simple, but no one wished to voice it. A poorly worded response would offend the entire martial world.\nNangong Shen pondered briefly, then had a plan. Quoting from the Book of Rites and the Great Learning, he spoke eloquently, saying that whether in civil or martial matters, one must first investigate things to extend knowledge, understand great righteousness, know honor and disgrace, and have sincere intentions and a righteous heart. Applying oneself to literature or martial arts is for self-cultivation; establishing a sect or school is for regulating the family. Only with a well-regulated family can one then discuss governing the state.\nIf it benefits the state, every common man has a responsibility. Generals secure the borders; knights-errant maintain internal peace. Therefore, I argue that everyone in the martial world serves the state and the people.\nThis speech elevated all martial artists to heroes serving the state and people, adding luster to their faces, and won full applause and thunderous clapping.
你在旁听着，暗暗冷笑。你这人虽然心术不正，但是肚中却有墨水，不会轻易被人摆弄。江湖人争名夺利，何尝不想做官飞黄腾达，只是做不了而已。又没领朝廷俸禄，没吃官家一粒米粮，还要为别人的江山送死？=Listening nearby, you sneered inwardly.\nThough your own motives might not be pure, you were well-read and not easily manipulated.\nThose in the martial world fought for fame and gain; hadn't they also wanted to become officials and rise high? They just couldn't. They didn't receive a court salary nor eat a single grain of official rice—why should they die for someone else's empire?
你从旁听着，颇不以为然。想他胸怀磊落，或许真作如是想也说不定。然而事实又是如何呢？江湖之中，只考虑自己的人，十有八九啊。论策应以事实为本，而非夸夸其谈，否则难免有矫饰之嫌。这番话能令江湖人抬头挺胸，走路有风，却对现况一点帮助也没有，自私的人依然自私，朝廷依然忌惮江湖草莽，若不能容于天子，则那梁山好汉的下场，就是未远殷鉴。=Listening from the side, you rather disapproved.\nYou thought that perhaps, with his open and upright heart, he truly believed this.\nBut what was the reality? In the martial world, eight or nine out of ten people only considered themselves.\nDiscussions of strategy should be based on facts, not empty boasts, otherwise they risked being pretentious. These words might make martial artists hold their heads high and walk with pride, but they did nothing to help the actual situation. Selfish people remained selfish, the court still feared the martial world's ruffians, and if they couldn't gain the Emperor's tolerance, the fate of the Liangshan heroes was a recent warning.
你在旁听着，似也觉得与有荣焉，飘飘然想要上天。=Listening nearby, you also felt a sense of shared glory, becoming elated and feeling as if you could float to the heavens.
旋即又醒觉过来，你是什么样的货色，自己清楚，连你都能夸，只能说这位大公子当真是口若悬河，好生了得。=But then you caught yourself. You knew what kind of person you were. If even you could be praised, it only showed that this Eldest Young Master was truly silver-tongued and remarkably skilled.
三师兄听了这席高论，不置可否，却不深究，照样请他入内用茶，等到饭后再武试。南宫深察言观色，已知自己这话避重就轻，瞒不过儒侠法眼，却也不以为意，今日他这番说法，已经收买了无数人心，于世家所益颇深。=Third Senior Brother listened to this lofty discourse without comment and did not probe further, instead inviting him inside for tea, with the martial test to follow after the meal.\nNangong Shen, reading the situation, knew that his words had glossed over the key points and couldn't deceive the scholarly knight's discerning eye, but he didn't mind. Today, his speech had won over countless hearts, greatly benefiting his family.
上官萤在唐门期间，极端溺爱小师妹，就是亲姊妹，也很少有这么宠的。小师妹感念于心，实在无法忍受萤姊姊为这薄情郎伤心落泪，当堂便问他为何不要上官萤，却想娶她？江陵大战以来，南宫悔婚一事众说纷纭，但谁也不敢去打听别人家事。此话一出，厅中众人登时热议起来。=During her time at the Tang Sect, Shangguan Ying had doted on Little Junior Sister excessively; even real sisters were rarely so indulgent.\nLittle Junior Sister was deeply grateful and simply couldn't bear to see Sister Ying heartbroken and in tears over this fickle man. Right there in the hall, she asked him why he had rejected Shangguan Ying but now wanted to marry her?\nSince the Battle of Jiangling, there had been much speculation about Nangong's broken engagement, but no one dared pry into another family's affairs.\nAs soon as these words were spoken, the hall erupted in heated discussion.
你心系上官萤，何尝不为此义愤填膺，听了恨不得大叫一声好。倒要看看大公子害得萤姑娘伤心落泪，还能如何诡辩，他要是说不出个所以然来，你就是把命舍了，也要讨回公道。=Your heart was with Shangguan Ying; how could you not be outraged? Hearing this, you nearly cheered aloud.\nYou wanted to see how the Eldest Young Master, who had caused Miss Ying such heartache and tears, could possibly quibble. If he couldn't give a proper explanation, you were ready to risk your life to seek justice.
大公子自知此事终究绕不过去，只得开诚布公。出乎意料的不讲私情，而是着眼于大处，分说道是两家虽有娃娃亲，上官萤也确无半分不好，只是事过境迁，上官家退隐江湖，投效朝廷，而南宫世家虽与官府交好，却始终不忘初衷，心系武林。反问在场众人，倘若两家成亲，江湖同道还能认为南宫刚正不阿，不偏不倚吗？至于那乐伎与他，更是清白知音，沉迷女色而罔顾婚约云云，皆是穿凿附会而已。听他这一席话，在场众人方始恍然大悟，也唯有如此，方能成全南宫世家武林之心的令名，他南宫大公子能够为了大节割舍私情，非但无过，甚至堪称侠义楷模。唯独小师妹依旧愀然不乐。她听懂了，可是并不觉得这话说得通，为了武林公义，就得委屈家人一般的未婚妻子？她一生也不愿认同，淡淡微愠的俏脸之下，唐门之血正在沸腾。大公子只道她不太满意，殊不知自己已经踩到她底线，随时会被怒战娘亲。=The Eldest Young Master knew this matter couldn't be avoided and had to be frank.\nUnexpectedly, he didn't appeal to personal feelings but focused on the bigger picture. He explained that although the two families had an arranged marriage from childhood and Shangguan Ying was indeed without fault, circumstances had changed. The Shangguan Family had withdrawn from the martial world and entered court service, while the Nangong Family, though friendly with the authorities, had never forgotten their original intent and remained devoted to the martial world. He反问ed the audience: if the two families married, could their martial peers still consider Nangong upright and impartial?\nAs for the courtesan and him, they were merely pure-minded confidants. Claims that he was沉迷ed with women and disregarded his engagement were nothing but forced interpretations.\nHearing this, the audience suddenly understood. Only in this way could the Nangong Family's reputation for devotion to the martial world be preserved. That Eldest Young Master Nangong could forsake personal feelings for greater righteousness was not only without fault but even made him a model of chivalry.\nOnly Little Junior Sister remained displeased.\nShe understood, but she didn't find this reasoning acceptable. For the sake of martial justice, must one wrong a fiancée who was like family?\nShe would never agree to this in her lifetime. Beneath her faintly angry, lovely face, Tang Sect blood was boiling. The young Master only thought she was somewhat dissatisfied, unaware that he had crossed her bottom line and was随时 facing the wrath of a battle-ready maiden.
面试完一干求亲者，小师妹也没一个中意的人选，彷佛谁都可以，谁都不行。三师兄既不舍又为难，可惜唐门危如累卵，唯有狠着心肠把她嫁了，才对得起掌门嘱托。正要离席用膳，负责唱名的唐门弟子匆匆来报，又有一名求亲者前来，来的正是与大师兄齐名，互许为毕生劲敌的峨嵋「风神」解无尘。三师兄端的是喜出望外，言下好生敬畏，连忙请进。解无尘一表人才，五官端正，身长挺拔，眉宇之间颇有豪气，而且成名多年，从来只听闻他行侠仗义，不曾听他有红粉知己，洁身自爱，再说峨嵋名列中原六大派之一，离唐门又近，原是小师妹良配。然而三师兄错估了解无尘的意图。他虽是为了小师妹而来，却非求亲，比起女色，这位武痴心中只有劲敌，身为唐布衣好敌手，两人较劲不下百回，内心深处早已互相钦服，他怎能容许原来该许唐布衣为妻的小师妹，被世俗庸人所惦记？是以他此行前来，是自作主张要代替大师兄，为小师妹把关的。=After interviewing all the suitors, Little Junior Sister hadn't found a single satisfactory candidate—it seemed anyone would do, yet no one was suitable.\nThird Senior Brother was both reluctant and troubled. Unfortunately, the Tang Sect was in precarious danger; only by hardening his heart and marrying her off could he fulfill the Sect Leader's instructions.\nJust as he was about to leave for the meal, the Tang disciple responsible for calling names hurried in to report another suitor had arrived: the Emei「Wind God」Xie Wuchen, who was equally famous as First Senior Brother and acknowledged as his lifelong rival.\nThird Senior Brother was overjoyed and spoke with great respect, promptly inviting him in.\nXie Wuchen was a man of impressive appearance, with regular features, a tall and straight stature, and a heroic air between his brows. Moreover, he had been famous for years, always heard to be chivalrous and righteous, never with a romantic partner—a man of self-respect. Additionally, Emei was one of the Six Major Sects of the Central Plains, close to the Tang Sect, and should have been an excellent match for Little Junior Sister.\nHowever, Third Senior Brother misjudged Xie Wuchen's intentions. Though he had come for Little Junior Sister, it wasn't to seek marriage. Compared to feminine charms, this martial arts fanatic only had rivals in his heart. As a worthy opponent of Tang Buyi, the two had competed over a hundred times and deep down admired each other. How could he allow Little Junior Sister, who should have been Tang Buyi's wife, to be coveted by worldly mediocrities?\nThus, he had come on his own initiative to stand in for First Senior Brother and vet the suitors for Little Junior Sister.
你也上前劝解，反而被说服了，恨不得跟他一起下场去，当小师妹的左右护法。三师兄就是为了防止你失控伤人，才安排求亲者两两相斗，把你排除在外的，谁知道斜刺里又冲出了一个解无尘，看他摩拳擦掌，恨不得把求亲者全都赶回老家的模样，胃就隐隐作痛。=You also stepped forward to dissuade him, but ended up persuaded yourself, wishing you could join him on the field as Little Junior Sister's left and right guardians. Third Senior Brother had arranged for suitors to fight each other in pairs precisely to prevent you from losing control and harming anyone, keeping you out of it. Who could have guessed that Xie Wuchen would come charging in from the side? Watching him roll up his sleeves, eager to drive all the suitors back to where they came from, made your stomach ache faintly.
你上前劝解，试图说之以理，问他倘若害得小师妹嫁不出去，难道还能负责？解无尘才不负责，但他还是要打架的。看他摩拳擦掌，恨不得把求亲者全都赶回老家的模样，三师兄的胃就隐隐作痛，不敢相信这浑人竟然是传说中的峨嵋风神。=You stepped forward to reason with him, asking if he could take responsibility if Little Junior Sister ended up unable to marry. Xie Wuchen wouldn't take responsibility, but he still wanted to fight.\nWatching him roll up his sleeves, eager to send all the suitors packing, Third Senior Brother's stomach ached faintly. He couldn't believe this ruffian was the legendary Emei Wind God.
之后，三师兄费了九牛二虎之力，才把人姑且劝住，劝他饭后小憩再行切磋。许多前来凑热闹、试想碰运气的人见解无尘都来角逐，连饭也不吃，灰溜溜的下山去了。=Afterward, Third Senior Brother expended tremendous effort to temporarily dissuade him, persuading him to rest after the meal before sparring.\nMany who had come for the spectacle or to try their luck, seeing that even Xie Wuchen was competing, left without eating and sheepishly went down the mountain.
中午你在弟子房和同门挤在一块，榻上地下随意坐着。与外边宾客相较，吃得也很随意，人手一颗饭团而已，饶是如此，这饭团却似别有一番滋味，大家都吃得津津有味。也许这样聚在一起的时光不多了，所有人都心照不宣罢了。=At noon, you squeezed into the disciples' quarters with your sect brothers, sitting随意ly on beds and the floor.\nCompared to the guests outside, the meal was also casual—just a rice ball each. Even so, these rice balls seemed to have a unique flavor, and everyone ate with relish.\nPerhaps it was because time spent together like this was running out, a fact everyone understood but left unspoken.
你下山去外堡，访问南宫深，一去就见到南宫家丁送来饭菜，那担任媒人的南宫老侠一脸难堪，又不能明说防人之心不可无，他着实是忌惮唐门。=You went down the mountain to the outer fort to visit Nangong Shen. Upon arrival, you saw Nangong servants bringing food. The old Nangong hero acting as matchmaker looked embarrassed but couldn't openly say that caution was necessary—he was truly wary of the Tang Sect.
你丝毫不留情面，一语道破，不单说得对方老脸一红，一众宾客也面露惭色，要知唐门以毒药暗器闻名，谁敢不留心眼儿，在唐门地盘大快朵颐？满桌菜色没几人动筷，吃的都是自带的饮食。=You showed no mercy, pointing it out bluntly. Not only did it make the old man blush, but the other guests also looked ashamed. After all, the Tang Sect was famous for poisons and hidden weapons; who would dare let their guard down and feast heartily on Tang territory? Few touched the dishes on the table; most ate their own provisions.
你一笑置之，顺他话头给了下台阶，转身又向各路英雄致歉，请他们吃不习惯的也多海涵，众人松了一口气之余，也觉自己小人之心度君子之腹，不由得纷纷脸红，见你应对如此得体，更有好感。=You laughed it off, following his lead to give him a way out, then turned to apologize to the various heroes, asking for their understanding if the food wasn't to their taste. They breathed a sigh of relief, feeling they had misjudged your generosity, and couldn't help but blush. Seeing you handle it so gracefully, they regarded you even more favorably.
你有话要说，先礼后兵，敬大公子一杯，大公子以袖掩嘴，脖颈一仰，乍看豪爽，实则将酒都收进袖中。你看破却不说破，饮尽杯中酒水。=You had something to say. Adhering to courtesy before force, you toasted the Eldest Young Master. He covered his mouth with his sleeve, tilted his head back, appearing hearty but actually draining the wine into his sleeve.\nYou saw through it but didn't expose him, drinking your own cup dry.
你有话要说，先礼后兵，敬大公子一杯，大公子脖颈一仰，倒扣酒杯，以示磊落。你暗道一声好气魄，也跟着饮尽杯中酒水。=You had something to say. Adhering to courtesy before force, you toasted the Eldest Young Master. He tilted his head back and overturned his cup to show forthrightness. You silently praised his spirit and likewise drank your cup dry.
大公子对唐门的看法姑且不论，对你的轻蔑态度却丝毫不加掩饰。=Regardless of his views on the Tang Sect, the Eldest Young Master didn't conceal his contempt for you.
你也不甘示弱，当场反唇相讥。=Not to be outdone, you retorted on the spot.
你无非是因江陵大战之后，老太爷仙逝，唐门因此见疑于大公子，他当时俨然不共戴天，怎么今日又来求亲？=It was simply because after the Battle of Jiangling, the old Master passed away, and the Tang Sect fell under suspicion by the Eldest Young Master. Back then, he acted as if you were sworn enemies, so why was he here today seeking marriage?
南宫深心下有气，瞧你不起，但此事不能不答，江陵战后，他多方探查，想逮到唐门狐狸尾巴，皇天不负苦心人，要不了多久，便真的找到了唐门作案的证据，问题是证据多不胜数，都经不起推敲，背后真凶嫁祸之意昭然若揭。他虽暂时不再疑心唐门，却也不肯尽信，虽不能尽信，却还是要顾念武林气数，不能以私害公，罔顾天下正气。前来结亲，正是为集结两大世家之力，登高呼吁正道，共抗魔教。=Nangong Shen was angry and looked down on you, but he had to answer. They are confidantes and admire each other. They have already made a vow beforehand to have her leave the low-class registry, restore her commoner status, and then take her into his household. Therefore, even if she must enter as a concubine, he must welcome her in. He cannot marry only one wife in his lifetime.
你闻言也不禁佩服，大公子身为名门之后，浑不惧世人讥讽他伤风败俗，对那乐妓不离不弃。而你虽非贱籍，但也同样身份低微，给人看清惯了，大公子却能折节与你结交，如此气度，殊为难得。=Hearing this, you can't help but admire him. As the scion of a prestigious family, he utterly fears no worldly ridicule for corrupting public morals and does not abandon that courtesan. Although you are not of low registry, your status is also lowly, and you're used to being looked down upon. Yet the young Master can condescend to befriend you. Such magnanimity is truly rare.
你闻言大不以为然，话虽说得好听，这岂不就是得了熊掌又想要鱼吗？眼下小师妹都还没进家门，就盘算着要娶二房了，岂有此理。=You greatly disapprove upon hearing this. Though his words sound nice, isn't this just wanting both the bear's paw and the fish?\nYour junior sister isn't even through the door yet, and he's already planning to take a second wife? Preposterous.
南宫深前来求亲，诚意十足，却不执着，若有幸能迎小师妹进家门，必将相敬如宾，竭尽所能保她衣食无虞，平安喜乐。就算落花有意，流水无情，也不能以此分毫有损两家情义。至于结盟一事，虽然至关重大，却不必急着便下结论，遂请你转献仙丹，再与唐三侠、唐四侠商议不迟。=Nangong Shen came to propose with utmost sincerity but is not obsessive. If fortunate enough to welcome your junior sister, he will treat her with respect, do his utmost to ensure her well-being, and keep her safe and happy. Even if the flower has intent but the stream is无情, it should not harm the friendship between the families.\nAs for the alliance, though crucial, it need not be concluded hastily. He asks you to present the elixir and discuss with Third Hero Tang and Fourth Hero Tang.
你趁着太阳还没下山，独行来到后山，拉开架势，拳打脚踢。没人敦促的日子，你向来如此。不知不觉天已黑了，你正要回去，忽见一个白衣人影从崖边窜上来，定睛一看，却是你们好不容易才请下山去的解无尘。他一被劝离，行至山腰，又绕道而行，溯溪而上，取出攀登峭壁用的勾绳，仗着轻功了得，不走栈道，飞身闯进了你唐门后山。=\nYou take advantage of the sun not having set yet and go alone to the back mountain. You assume a stance, punching and kicking. On days when no one urges you on, you are always like this.\nBefore you know it, it's already dark. Just as you are about to return, you suddenly see a figure in white clothes dart up from the cliff edge. Looking closely, it is actually Xie Wuchen, whom you had such difficulty persuading to leave the mountain.\nOnce persuaded to leave, he had reached the mountainside, then detoured, followed a stream upwards, took out grappling hooks for climbing cliffs, and relying on his exceptional lightness skill, bypassed the plank path and flew into your Tang Sect's back mountain.
解无尘醉心武学几成痴，意外撞见你在练功，简直心痒难搔，把原本来意抛诸脑后，忘得一干二净。=Xie Wuchen is nearly obsessed with martial arts. Accidentally coming across you practicing, he was simply itching to join, completely forgetting his original purpose for coming.
解无尘不惜冒险，擅闯唐门后山，原来只是携了酒水，想来拜祭大师兄而已。你哑然半晌，带领他到了大师兄坟前，解无尘呆立半晌，一言不发。良久才开口说话，一开口就是怀疑大师兄装死，意图刨开坟头开棺检查，经你一番善劝，才打消念头，接受毕生劲敌已逝，安眠于九泉的事实。拔开酒葫芦栓，不爱喝酒，也陪大师兄喝了一口，又将酒交你也喝。酒虽香醇，你们却无心品尝，将酒水浇于土下，留给故人享用。=Xie Wuchen risked danger and trespassed into the Tang Sect's back mountain simply because he had brought wine and wanted to pay respects to your eldest brother.\nYou are speechless for a moment, then lead him to your eldest brother's grave. Xie Wuchen stands there dumbly for a long time, not saying a word.\nAfter a long while, he finally speaks. The moment he opens his mouth, he suspects your eldest brother is pretending to be dead and intends to dig open the grave to check the coffin. After your earnest persuasion, he gives up the idea and accepts the fact that his lifelong rival has passed away, resting peacefully in the Nine Springs.\nHe pulls the stopper from the gourd. Though not a drinker, he takes a sip with your eldest brother, then hands the wine to you to drink as well.\nThough the wine is fragrant and mellow, you have no heart to savor it. You pour the wine onto the soil below, leaving it for the departed to enjoy.
解无尘想起过往十年交道，与你大师兄都是初出茅庐的毛头小子，那唐布衣就处处压自己一头，也不知是否冥冥之中自有定数，走那儿都能碰上，两人都是少年心性，针锋相对，互不相让，几乎每回碰面都要分个高下，不比武的时候，也要比拚别的。武林中著名的绵阳泊事件就是他们二人所为，为了比拚输赢，抢在官兵前面把人家整座水贼寨子给挑了，兀自难分胜负，后来解无尘加入官兵阵营，你大师兄顺手使唤起水贼，据守水寨，顽抗十日，打到后来，二位掌门和南宫家主亲临，才瓦解危机，又在南宫家主穿针引线下，抚恤官兵，又将水贼全数招安，人人都得善果。只有大师兄和解无尘被揍成破烂，各自领回山中反省。解无尘一直对此事难以释怀，他加入的是官兵阵营，怎么还错了？诸如此类的事多不胜数，讲到你大师兄，就气不打一处来。虽然这俩死对头见面不是吵架就是打架，但也曾有一起结伴行走江湖过。唐门唐布衣、峨嵋解无尘、崆峒夏侯兰，以及某两位隐姓埋名，事了拂衣去，关外牧羊的侠侣五人同行，路见不平，行侠仗义，从不打不相识，到力挫金朝力士、击退高丽魔教、将岭南派打得东倒西歪，旅途的最后，五人合力摧毁了旧魔教余孽的野心。这些都像昨天才发生的事，彷佛才与朋友们挥手道别，各奔东西，眨个眼，就来到现在，青山依旧，人事全非。人生匆匆，倏忽如白驹过隙，来的来，走的走，聚散如萍，令人不胜唏嘘。=Xie Wuchen recalls their dealings over the past ten years. Both he and your eldest brother were greenhorns back then. That Tang Buyi always managed to best him everywhere. Whether it was fate or not, they kept running into each other. Both had youthful spirits, were diametrically opposed, and neither would yield. Almost every time they met, they had to compete to see who was better. When not competing in martial arts, they competed in other things.\nThe famous Mianyang Bo incident in the martial world was their doing. To compete and win, they raided the entire water bandit stronghold ahead of the government troops, yet still couldn't determine a winner. Later, Xie Wuchen joined the government troops' side, while your eldest brother conveniently mobilized the water bandits, occupied the stronghold, and stubbornly resisted for ten days. The fight continued until two Sect Leaders and the Head of the Nangong Family personally arrived to resolve the crisis. Then, with the Head of the Nangong Family acting as intermediary, compensation was given to the troops, and all the water bandits were pardoned and recruited—everyone got a good outcome.\nOnly your eldest brother and Xie Wuchen were beaten to a pulp and each taken back to their mountains to reflect.\nXie Wuchen had always found this hard to accept. He joined the government troops' side, so how was he wrong?\nThere are countless incidents like this. Just talking about your eldest brother makes him furious.\nAlthough these two arch-rivals either quarreled or fought when they met, they had also traveled the martial world together before.\nTang Sect's Tang Buyi, Emei's Xie Wuchen, Kongtong's Xiahou Lan, and a certain anonymous couple who withdrew after the deed was done to herd sheep beyond the frontier—these five traveled together, righting wrongs and upholding justice wherever they went. From starting as adversaries to becoming friends, to defeating Jin Dynasty warriors, repelling the Korean demon cult, and battering the Lingnan Sect, at the end of their journey, the five joined forces to destroy the ambitions of the old demon cult remnants.\nAll these feel like they happened just yesterday, as if they had just waved goodbye to friends and gone their separate ways. In the blink of an eye, they arrived at the present. The green mountains remain, but the people are all gone.\nLife is fleeting, swift as a white steed's shadow passing a crack. People come and go, gatherings and separations are like duckweed, making one sigh endlessly.
你蓦地从他口里，听见了夏侯兰的名字，还怕他不信，使了一招夏侯兰直传的雪山剑法。解无尘呆愣一阵，随即惊喜若狂，想不到世间缘法，如此奥妙，你既是他毕生劲敌的师弟，又是他故友的徒弟，与他也算渊源匪浅。=Suddenly, you hear Xiahou Lan's name from his mouth. Afraid he might not believe it, you execute a move from the Snow Mountain Sword Art directly passed down by Xiahou Lan.\nXie Wuchen is stunned for a moment, then overjoyed and ecstatic. He never imagined the connections in the world could be so marvelous. You are both the junior brother of his lifelong rival and the disciple of his old friend—you share a deep connection with him.
他将独门秘籍馈赠于你，虽说他与泥教法王刘颚对赌而败，强迫他将独门武功易名为「很是用力踢」，令他从此再也无颜施展，但如此绝技，因此埋没未免可惜，以此书赠你，既表情谊，也盼你能恃之扬名江湖，替它平反名声。=He gifts his unique secret manual to you. Although he lost a bet to the Mud Sect's Dharma King Liu E and was forced to rename his unique skill "Kicking Really Hard", making him too ashamed to ever use it again, such a superb technique being buried is a pity. Giving you this book expresses friendship and also hopes you can rely on it to make a name for yourself in the martial world and clear its reputation.
你心血来潮，为了显示你人脉很广，立刻又说你认识刘颚，还跟人家关系不错。那刘颚也与解无尘孽缘匪浅，他不单当众打败了解无尘，还强迫人家将独门绝招「风雷神脚」易名为「很是用力踢」，极尽羞辱之能事。为此解无尘再也无颜使用独门武功，你还哪壶不开专提哪壶，他愣了愣，当即改变心意与你绝交，本来想送你点什么礼物，也打消了主意。你这么讨人厌，被人讨厌不是理所当然的事吗？=On a whim, to show off your extensive connections, you immediately say that you know Liu E and are on good terms with him.\nThat Liu E also has a deep karmic entanglement with Xie Wuchen. Not only did he publicly defeat Xie Wuchen, but he also forced him to rename his unique ultimate move "Divine Wind and Thunder Kick" to "Kicking Really Hard" going to extreme lengths to humiliate him.\nBecause of this, Xie Wuchen could no longer face using his unique skill. And you specifically bring up this sore point. He is taken aback, immediately changes his mind about you, and severs ties. He originally intended to give you a gift but abandons the idea.\nAren't you so annoying that being disliked is only natural?
解无尘摸出怀里的秘籍《蛇兔鹰猿搏》赠你，这可不是寻常武功，乃是峨嵋派数一数二厉害的绝学，更是天下最高明的形意拳之一。得到如此贵重的秘籍，你固然欢喜。但也正因为它是一派绝学，所以非同小可，不像其他武功，练了个似是而非，别人尚能睁一只眼、闭一只眼。=Xie Wuchen takes out the secret manual "Snake, Rabbit, Eagle, Ape Combat" from his robe and gifts it to you. This is no ordinary martial art; it is one of Emei Sect's top powerful techniques and one of the world's most advanced Xingyiquan fist techniques.\nNaturally, you are delighted to receive such a valuable manual. But precisely because it is a sect's ultimate technique, it is no trivial matter. Unlike other martial arts where practicing a rough approximation might be tolerated, this is not the case.
你实在不敢贸然收下，又再向他询问一次，才知解无尘也是恨不得快快将这秘籍脱手，他醉心武学，不想收徒耽误自己进境，可是梦里祖师爷画像却夜夜骂他不肖，只在意自己，却罔顾峨嵋传承，令解无尘时时夜半惊醒，疑心这本秘籍有鬼魂寄宿，想要烧掉，始终不敢，偏生又找不到合适传人。这不，你是他故友的徒弟，也等如是他晚辈，既然你都能到崆峒留学了，想来也不介意把名字借他往峨嵋山上一挂，虚应故事。这秘籍有了传人，他也算是尽了对师门的义务，岂不皆大欢喜？还不等你抗议，他咻的一下就跑了。=You really don't dare accept it rashly and ask him again. Only then do you learn that Xie Wuchen is also eager to get rid of this manual quickly. He is obsessed with martial arts and doesn't want to take disciples and delay his own progress. But in his dreams, the portrait of the sect's founder scolds him every night for being unfilial, caring only for himself and neglecting Emei's legacy. This makes Xie Wuchen often wake up in the middle of the night, suspecting the manual is haunted by a ghost. He wants to burn it but never dares. On top of that, he can't find a suitable successor.\nWell now, you are his old friend's disciple, which is like being his junior. Since you could even study abroad at Kongtong, presumably you wouldn't mind lending your name to be listed on Emei Mountain, just going through the motions.\nWith the manual having a successor, he can consider his duty to the sect fulfilled. Isn't that happy for everyone?\nBefore you can even protest, he whooshes away.
你虽不知他究竟在想甚么，但这秘籍却是货真价实的宝物，唯恐他反悔，连忙道谢收进怀里。=Although you don't know what exactly he is thinking, this manual is a genuine treasure. Fearing he might change his mind, you quickly thank him and tuck it into your robe.
一阵激战以后，你惨败于解无尘狂风暴雨般的攻势之下。=After a fierce battle, you are utterly defeated by Xie Wuchen's storm-like offensive.
他与你拆招之时，隐约感觉你内劲跟不上招数，按说应有后劲的招，全都后继无力，却不知是何缘故？一问才知你是被吞天魔功所害，一身内力，悉数报废。最怕这一生都无法还原如初。=While exchanging moves with you, he faintly sensed that your internal energy couldn't keep up with your techniques. Moves that should have follow-up power all ended weakly. He didn't know why.\nOnly upon asking did he learn you were harmed by the Devouring Heaven Demonic Art. All your internal strength was ruined. He fears most that you may never recover to your original state in this lifetime.
解无尘乃是武痴，闻言勃然大怒，此事他早有耳闻，中原诸大派门皆不以为然，只道唐门胡编杜撰，冤枉好人，居心叵测。解无尘却独排众议，他迟早要打上青城，找申屠龙一决高下，为大师兄平反，顺便也替你报仇。=Xie Wuchen is a martial arts fanatic. Hearing this, he flies into a rage. He had heard about this before. The major Central Plains sects all dismissed it, thinking the Tang Sect fabricated it, wronged good people, and had ulterior motives.\nBut Xie Wuchen stands alone against the consensus. Sooner or later, he will storm Qingcheng, find Shentu Long to settle the score, clear your eldest brother's name, and by the way, get revenge for you.
解无尘似有深意，刻意容情由你发挥，看清你的本领，才将你击败。教不了你功夫，但他有意锤炼你的心，使你坚实茁壮，心念一转，命运或许就大不相同。一席话后，解无尘飞天遁去，你望着夜色，依然想不通他究竟来作什么的。=Xie Wuchen seemed to have a deeper meaning, intentionally holding back to let you show your skills,看清 (seeing clearly) your capabilities before defeating you.\nHe can't teach you kung fu, but he intends to temper your heart, make you firm and strong. A change of heart might greatly alter your destiny.\nAfter this speech, Xie Wuchen flies away and vanishes. You gaze into the night, still unable to figure out what exactly he came to do.
解无尘拉你过招，似有深意，他刻意容情由你发挥，你也没让他失望，打得有来有往，你抓到他招数中算不上破绽的薄弱之处，奋起强攻得胜。解无尘欣然收招一笑。=Xie Wuchen drew you into a spar, seemingly with deeper intent. He deliberately held back to let you showcase your skills, and you didn't disappoint him, exchanging blows in a lively back-and-forth. You seized upon a minor weakness in his technique—not quite a flaw—and pressed the advantage fiercely to secure victory.\nXie Wuchen withdrew his move with a pleased smile.
看你的眼光里充满期待，且待来日你武功大成，江湖雨过天青、风平浪静时，再来切磋。=His gaze toward you is full of anticipation, waiting for the day when your martial arts reach mastery, and the martial world is calm and peaceful once more, to spar again.
你乐意之至，与他击掌为誓。=You are more than willing and seal the promise with a high-five.
然而你拒绝。你固然想成名当大侠，但是并不想挨揍，何况是和解无尘这种出了名好战的武痴扯上关系，一定烦不胜烦，大师兄就是前车之鉴。「决斗不下百次」这事听起来稀松寻常，然而仔细一想，正常人会如此纠缠不清吗？也难怪大师兄提起解无尘总是一脸不痛快。=Yet you refuse.\nWhile you do want to become famous and be a Great Hero, you have no desire to get beaten up, especially by someone like Xie Wuchen, who is notoriously combative and obsessed with martial arts. Associating with him would undoubtedly be endlessly troublesome—your senior brother is a prime example.\n「Over a hundred duels」might sound ordinary at first, but upon closer thought, would a normal person be so persistently entangled? No wonder senior brother always looks displeased when mentioning Xie Wuchen.
一席话后，解无尘飞天遁去，你望着夜色，依然想不通他究竟来作什么的。=After this exchange, Xie Wuchen soared away into the sky. You gaze into the night, still unable to figure out what exactly he came for.
练武场上搭了棚架，各派求亲侠士依序到场中过招，既比武功，也比武品、武德，谁不想在小师妹面前大显身手，留下深刻印象，以博佳人芳心？=A canopy has been set up on the training grounds, and suitors from various sects take turns sparring in the arena, competing not only in martial skill but also in character and virtue. Who wouldn't want to showcase their abilities in front of junior sister, leaving a deep impression to win the beauty's heart?
你云裳妹子就像理所当然一样出现在小师妹身旁，帮着点评。基本上能从她口中吐出的评语都没好话，不是吹毛求疵，就是落井下石，连自己同门的点苍师兄也毫不容情。在云裳眼中，天下间就没一个男子配得上默铃，就怕她冰魂素魄，天真无邪，看谁都似乎挺好，导致错付终身。恨只恨自己不是男儿身，要不然老早就把这妞儿给拐了，还至于此刻为她忧心忡忡吗。=Your sworn sister Yunshang appears by junior sister's side as if it's the most natural thing, offering commentary.\nBasically, no praise ever leaves her lips—she either nitpicks or kicks others when they're down, showing no mercy even to her fellow Diancang sect brother.\nIn Yunshang's eyes, no man in the world is worthy of Moling. She fears that Moling, with her pure and innocent soul, naive and guileless, might see everyone as seemingly good and end up entrusting her life to the wrong person.\nShe bitterly regrets not being born male—otherwise, she would have whisked this girl away long ago, rather than worrying about her now.
三师兄陪着小师妹，一边点评场中侠士，一边偷眼观察她的脸色，可是小师妹始终面无表情，丝毫看不出端倪来。=Third Senior Brother accompanies junior sister, commenting on the martial artists in the arena while secretly observing her expression. But junior sister remains expressionless throughout, giving nothing away.
接连几组年轻侠士上场下场，各显神通，收于小师妹眼下，均觉乏善可陈。她不到江湖走动，更少与人过招，临阵经验浅薄，可是心无旁骛专注多年，已窥唐门武学之奥义，眼界之高，还胜三师兄一筹。三师兄赞不绝口的这些侠士，在小师妹眼中看来，行径都古怪得很。彷佛只顾招数能否使得气势磅礡，全然不管劲道使老会否露出破绽，这些人连自己都胜不了，为何还能如此自豪？=Several groups of young martial artists take turns on the stage, each showcasing their skills, but in junior sister's eyes, they all seem mediocre.\nShe rarely ventures into the martial world and seldom spars with others, so her practical experience is limited. Seeing these beggars acting fiercely and threatening violence, they all frowned. The image the Beggars' Sect was desperate to restore had been torn open.
你以掌派人之尊，去崆峒派面前露了脸，还怕被不服你的人捅刀子，可是以丹霞子为首，人人恭敬有礼，浑然看不出半分不逊之色，你才心下稍安。可是被问及将来崆峒方针，你却支支吾吾说不出话来。=\nAs the esteemed Sect Leader, you showed your face before the Kongtong Sect, fearing knives in the back from those who opposed you. However, led by Danxiazi, everyone was respectful and courteous, showing not the slightest hint of defiance, which put your mind somewhat at ease.\nBut when asked about Kongtong's future policies, you hemmed and hawed, unable to articulate a response.
你之所以答不上来，和肚里有多少墨水没关系，实在是你对崆峒情况了解太过浅薄，不能妄下决议。=Your inability to answer wasn't due to a lack of knowledge; it was simply that your understanding of Kongtong's situation was too superficial to make rash decisions.
幸得魏菊从旁接话，她早已安排妥当，考虑周全，调度从容，有条不紊，更将功劳悉数归在你身上，崆峒众人一听是掌派人授意，无不凛遵。=Fortunately, Wei Ju stepped in to speak. She had already made thorough arrangements, considered everything, managed things calmly and methodically, and she credited all the success to you. Upon hearing it was the Sect Leader's directive, the Kongtong members complied without exception.
妻贤至此，夫复何求？小菊闻言嫣然一笑，毫不希罕手里的权柄。今日给你一夸，足以雪洗当年以堂堂状元之身，被赐诏下嫁给武夫的耻辱。于她而言你便是君王。=With a wife so virtuous, what more could a husband ask for?\nXiao Ju heard this and gave a radiant smile, placing no value on the authority in her hands.\nYour praise today was enough to wash away the shame of being bestowed by imperial decree to marry a martial artist despite her prestigious status as the top scholar.\nTo her, you are her sovereign.
你去拜见全真派尹道长，他正独立崖边，眺望洞庭。=\nYou went to pay respects to Daoist Master Yin of the Quanzhen Sect. He was standing alone by the cliff, gazing at Lake Dongting.
你一听便知他口中吟咏乃是纯阳祖师吕洞宾的绝句。尹志平眼放异采，颇有嘉许之意。=You recognized immediately that the verses he was reciting were the masterpiece of the Pure Yang Patriarch, Lü Dongbin.\nYin Zhiping's eyes shone with admiration and approval.
你还道他口中所吟，是即兴创作的诗，正想出口夸赞，被小菊及时拦住，悄声告知这是纯阳祖师吕洞宾的绝句，你才没脱口而出闹笑话。=You had thought the poem he recited was an impromptu composition and were about to praise him when Xiao Ju stopped you just in time, whispering that it was the masterpiece of the Pure Yang Patriarch, Lü Dongbin, preventing you from uttering a foolish remark.
尹志平正等你自己送上门来，他方才的吟诗不是有感而发，而是有意试探你与全真的道缘是否足深。此行南来以前，他曾与恩师丘处机品茗闲话，谈论到当世英雄，尹道长特别提到了你。长江后浪推前浪，江山代有人杰出，每过一段时间，江湖总有天赋异禀的后学崭露头角，活得够久，那便见怪不怪。可是这些鹤立鸡群的英雄少年之中，没一个是凡人，只有你特别诡异。资质平庸，不得唐门真传，更没啥惊世奇缘可言，处境似你的俗人多如过江之鲫，不是放弃抵抗任川流冲走，就是沦为刀俎鱼肉，默默消失然后被人遗忘，谁也不记得姓名。怎么偏就你冒出头来了？=Yin Zhiping had been waiting for you to come to him. His earlier recitation wasn't spontaneous but a deliberate test to see if your connection with the Quanzhen Dao was deep enough.\nBefore his journey south, he had been drinking tea and chatting with his Master, Qiu Chuji, about contemporary heroes, and Daoist Master Yin had specifically mentioned you.\nThe waves behind drive on those ahead, and each generation has its own talents. Every so often, the martial world sees exceptionally gifted newcomers emerge. If one lives long enough, it ceases to be surprising.\nBut among these outstanding young heroes, none are ordinary, yet you are particularly peculiar.\nWith mediocre aptitude, lacking the true teachings of the Tang Sect, and without any astonishing serendipity to speak of, countless commoners in situations like yours either give up resisting and let the current sweep them away or become meat on the chopping block, vanishing silently and being forgotten, their names remembered by no one.\nHow is it that you, specifically, managed to rise to prominence?
当初大漠一行，丘真人便记住了有你这人，毕竟你的脸太令人难忘，表现亦不俗，那时还不甚了解你的为人，乃至听尹志平笑说你如何一路跌跌撞撞，不屈不挠，兴味才越发盎然，欣赏你不屈不挠的意志，以及逆风而行的骨气。=Back from the desert journey, Master Qiu had remembered you—after all, your face was quite unforgettable, and your performance was notable. At that time, he didn't know much about your character. It was only upon hearing Yin Zhiping laugh about how you stumbled along yet remained unyielding that his interest grew, admiring your indomitable will and the courage to go against the wind.
越是听说你跌跌撞撞，丘真人越是兴味盎然，欣赏你不屈不挠的意志，以及逆风而行的骨气。=The more he heard about your stumbling journey, the more fascinated Master Qiu became, appreciating your tenacious will and your courage to march against the wind.
心血来潮，便嘱咐弟子试探于你，你若不来，也索罢了，说明没有缘分，不必强求。你若到他跟前，既有道缘，又无师承，心地纯良，仍怀坚忍不拔之志，蓬门未尝不可为君开，破例收你作关门弟子。=On a whim, he instructed his disciple to test you. If you didn't come, so be it—it meant there was no fate, and no need to force it.\nBut if you came before him, possessing a connection to the Dao yet no Master, pure-hearted and still harboring an indomitable will, then his humble gate might open for you exceptionally, accepting you as his last disciple.
这虽是天大的好事，可你小师妹一听就急了，怕你心动，真去当了道士，可是天下第一人破例收你为徒，这是何等造化，唐门凭何留住你呢？尹志平连忙说明，并非让你出家当道士，只是记名让你自己在家修行罢了。小师妹这才终于松了一口气，有种失而复得的庆幸，下意识揪住了你衣摆，内心深处总觉得人人都想要抢走你。她着实是想多了。=Although this was tremendous good fortune, your junior sister became anxious upon hearing it, afraid you might be tempted and really become a Daoist priest. But for the world's number one to exceptionally take you as a disciple—what incredible luck! How could the Tang Sect possibly keep you?\nYin Zhiping quickly clarified that it didn't mean you had to become a daoist priest, just that you'd be registered to practice at home.\nOnly then did your Little junior sister finally breathe a sigh of relief, feeling the joy of having regained what was almost lost, and she subconsciously grabbed your sleeve, deeply feeling as though everyone wanted to snatch you away.\nShe was truly overthinking it.
这虽是天大的好事，可云裳一听就怒了，就地找了一根树枝就想跟尹志平拚命。 尹志平连忙说明，并非让你出家当道士，只是记名让你自己在家修行罢了。她这才终于松了一口气，打消殴杀尹志平的念头。=Although this was tremendous good fortune, Yunshang became furious upon hearing it, immediately finding a branch on the spot and wanting to fight Yin Zhiping to the death.\nYin Zhiping hurriedly explained that it didn't mean you had to become a Daoist Priest, just that you'd be registered to practice at home.\nOnly then did she finally relax, abandoning her intention to beat Yin Zhiping to death.
你只觉如梦似幻，好不真实，总怨机缘从不属于你，真的轮到你了，又疑神疑鬼，患得患失，一会儿觉得自己又在作梦，一会儿又怀疑其中有诈。尹志平可没心思苦口婆心劝你，只受师命传话而已，至于你信不信、能否把握机缘，决议如何，全凭你自己。=It all felt like a dream, utterly unreal. You had always complained that opportunities never belonged to you, and now that it was truly your turn, you became suspicious and hesitant, torn between gain and loss, one moment thinking you were dreaming again, the next suspecting a trick.\nYin Zhiping had no patience to persuade you earnestly; he was merely conveying his Master's message. Whether you believed it, could seize the opportunity, and what you decided was entirely up to you.
你去拜访锦香宫人的时候，一群白衣娘子正说说笑笑，一派轻松，浑没有参与武林大会的严肃感，旁人不知情的都笑她们不谙世事，把江湖当儿戏，殊不知于宫人而言，今日便是江湖生涯的毕业典礼。=\nWhen you visited the Jinxiang Palace members, a group of women in white were chatting and laughing, completely relaxed, without any of the solemnity of participating in a Wulin Assembly. Those unaware laughed at them for being naive, treating the martial world as a game. Little did they know, for the Palace members, today was the graduation ceremony of their martial world生涯.
龙湘见你过来，欢颜迎将上来，手里还拿着小贩卖的鸡腿，你不禁好笑，这人有时人比剑锋更冷，有时又娇憨明媚如春日郊游的少女。不过话说回来，吃得下总比吃不下好。=Long Xiang saw you approaching and came forward with a joyful expression, still holding a chicken leg bought from a vendor. You couldn't help but find it amusing—this person could be colder than her sword at times, yet at other times as charming and bright as a girl on a spring outing. But then again, having an appetite is better than not.
你如今知道温夫人是泥教人间道法王，竟然还敢带宫人赴武林大会，胆气不可说不豪。万一你说溜了嘴，她们一行只怕难以生离此地。温夫人却料定你不会说，她识人何其多，什么样的人可以信赖，她自心中有数，干冒奇险让你知情，用意也不是让你揭发她，而是寄予深深的期许。=Now knowing that Madam Wen is the Mud Sect's Dharma King of the Human Realm, you dared to bring the Palace members to the Wulin Assembly—your courage is undeniable.\nIf you were to slip up, they might not leave this place alive.\nBut Madam Wen was certain you wouldn't speak. Having judged countless people, she knew well whom to trust. She took the great risk of letting you know, not intending for you to expose her, but placing deep expectations in you.
小菊上前施礼，江湖以才名著称的两大奇女子今始有缘结识，你一言我一语，都是引经据典，言下互相赞许，颇有惺惺相惜、相逢恨晚之意。你虽然知道小菊素有才女之名，也倾慕她才学，可也不曾见她如今日碰上知音这么兴奋，侃侃而谈，妙语如珠，往昔心气上头，差点儿破了她不作诗词的誓言。=Xiao Ju stepped forward to pay respects. The two remarkable women famed in the martial world for their talent finally had the chance to meet. They exchanged words, quoting classics, each praising the other implicitly, with a strong sense of mutual admiration and regret for not meeting sooner.\nAlthough you knew of Xiao Ju's reputation as a talented woman and admired her scholarship, you had never seen her as excited as she was today upon meeting a kindred spirit. She spoke eloquently and wittily, her past resolve nearly causing her to break her vow of not composing poetry.
小梅上前问候，她在豪爽人面前表现得活泼明媚，在斯文人面前表现得端庄得体，笑容完美无缺，无论男女人见人爱，偏生这招在温夫人跟前不大管用，这可是一位遍阅人心的老江湖，焉能不知小梅谄媚之意？更知她是千灯楼的杀手，身世不清白，小梅越是讨好，温夫人越是戒慎不苟言笑。小梅也并不在意，转头扑进画中仙怀里，一声姑姑喊得好不亲热，温夫人登时一愣，她与画中仙是亲姊妹，小梅喊自己妹妹为姑姑，那她是自己的谁？脑中飞速把亲戚关系理了一遍，沉声把小梅唤到跟前。画中仙大急，还道她的谎言要被当场揭穿，不想温夫人一改先前冷峻容色，当场认了亲，还说要将毕生所学倾囊相授作为弥补。小梅从小被千灯楼掳去当作杀手栽培，又到飞天门耳濡目染，近朱者赤，难免沾染了阴狠偏执的恶质，但她其实天性纯良，爱骗人也容易受骗，当即真以为自己又找到了亲人，霎时热泪盈眶，一时没计较那些武功、学问有多珍贵，只是欢喜自己原来有依有靠。=Xiaomei stepped forward to greet them. She acted lively and bright before straightforward people, and dignified and proper before refined people, her smile flawless, winning everyone's affection regardless of gender. However, this tactic didn't work well with Madam Wen, a seasoned veteran who had seen through countless hearts—how could she not detect Xiaomei's flattery? Moreover, she knew Xiaomei was an assassin from the Thousand Lanterns Tower with a dubious background. The more Xiaomei tried to please, the more guarded and stern Madam Wen became.\nXiaomei didn't seem to mind. She turned and threw herself into The Fairy in the Painting's arms, calling her "Auntie" with great affection. Madam Wen was taken aback. She and The Fairy in the Painting were biological sisters. If Xiaomei called her sister "Auntie", what did that make her? She quickly sorted through the family relations in her mind and called Xiaomei over sternly.\nThe Fairy in the Painting was terribly anxious, thinking her lie was about to be exposed. Unexpectedly, Madam Wen dropped her previously cold demeanor, acknowledged the relation on the spot, and even said she would impart all her lifetime knowledge to Xiaomei as compensation.\nXiaomei, who had been kidnapped as a child and raised as an assassin by the Thousand Lanterns Tower, and later exposed to the Flying Heaven Gate, was inevitably tainted by their sinister and obsessive traits due to association. But in truth, she was inherently pure-hearted, fond of deceiving others yet easily deceived herself. Immediately believing she had found family again, she was moved to tears, not considering at that moment how precious those martial skills and knowledge were, simply overjoyed that she had someone to rely on.
温夫人先前忙着替宫人着想，无暇考虑自己的事，今日过后才得逍遥，见到小竹，才想起崆峒裂骨魔的匠艺天下闻名，火炎山剑阁专打兵刃，她却什么都会造，也算一代奇女子。遂向小竹订制车子，有盖能遮风挡雨，有窗能观览沿途风景。外边不必雕饰，里边却要舒适宽敞，结实牢靠，能耐颠簸。她想去长白山，听说那里终年积雪不化，是故友魂归之乡，反正退隐江湖以后无所事事，不如载着满车暗香远游，拜祭故人，也好告诉他们：南宫远终于当上武林盟主了，大家的梦想将会延续下去。=Madam Wen had previously been too busy considering the Palace members' welfare to think of her own affairs. Only after today could she be free. Upon seeing Xiao Zhu, she remembered that the craftsmanship of Kongtong's Bone-Splitting Demon was world-renowned. While the Flame Mountain Sword Pavilion specialized in weapons, she could make anything, truly a remarkable woman of her generation.\nThus, she commissioned a carriage from Xiao Zhu: covered to shelter from wind and rain, with windows to view the scenery along the way.\nThe exterior needed no decoration, but the interior had to be comfortable, spacious, sturdy, reliable, and able to withstand bumps.\nShe wanted to go to Changbai Mountain, heard it was perpetually snow-covered, the homeland of departed old friends. Since she had nothing to do after retiring from the martial world, why not travel far with a carriage full of subtle fragrance to pay respects to old friends? She could also tell them: Nangong Yuan has finally become the Wulin Alliance Leader; everyone's dream will live on.
有意拜会峨嵋掌门向无忧，可是与你一般心思的武林人何曾少了？都争相献殷勤，想要结识这位一鸣惊人的武林高手。你眼看挤是挤不进去了，索性放弃，向掌门望见你的背影，反而留上了心。天下武功至理殊途同归，他忘却红尘闭关多年，穷就形意拳所悟的「无形拳」，几乎臻至无招无式，此时此刻看你闪避人群的步态体姿，却似颇有异曲同工之妙，不由得暗暗心惊，好奇你一个善使暗器毒药的唐门弟子，练的是什么武功。殊不知你练的确实是唐门武功，开宗明义却无人解得真髓的「忘形篇」。=\nYou intended to pay a visit to Emei Sect Leader Xiang Wuyou, but how many martial artists shared the same thought? All vied to curry favor, wanting to get to know this astonishingly skilled Master.\nSeeing that pushing through the crowd was impossible, you simply gave up. Sect Leader Xiang noticed your retreating figure and became intrigued.\nThe ultimate principles of all martial arts converge despite different paths. 连一家子人都能为一点鸡毛蒜皮的小事起争执，何况国与国之间。瑞笙感慨万千，想想天下大同的宏愿，真不是普通的难办，最怕苦心孤诣到头仍是徒劳无功。小菊却不以为然，知其不可为而为之，不亦圣乎？笨拙也无妨，毕竟世人不是谁都有才能，正是应该踏实，一步一脚印，用平凡的办法做所有人都可能办到的事，后人才能效仿。瑞笙听了大为钦佩，赞她见识超卓，你也脸上有光。=Even family members can argue over trivial matters, let alone countries.\nRui Sheng sighed deeply, thinking the great aspiration for a unified world was extraordinarily difficult to achieve. Is it not sage-like to persist in doing what seems impossible?\nClumsiness is fine; after all, not everyone is talented. It's precisely necessary to be steadfast, step by step, using ordinary methods to accomplish what everyone can potentially do, so that future generations can follow.\nRui Sheng was greatly impressed, praising her exceptional insight, and you felt honored too.

你来到伙房，这处说来还是你能从外堡被拔擢进入大院的契机之一。从前唐门人多，伙房要供应吃食，忙起来的时候，恨不得人人都有三条手臂。又有道是君子远庖厨，虽说原意是指君子应怀仁心，不忍杀生，但礼记原话便说得委婉，后遭人曲解当作不下厨的借口，也是理所当然的发展。于是你这不必练功、看着也没啥天赋的外姓弟子，就终于被人盯上，拔到大院中当伙房供人使唤。起初你笨手笨脚，经常挨揍。就算挑不出你的毛病，也得骂几句，否则师兄们会觉得心底不大痛快。不知不觉，骂你的声音越来越小，旧人走光，竟轮到你来掌勺。今后唐门散了，你再也不必贪黑起床，洗米生火煮饭。=\nYou came to the kitchen, which was one of the chances for you to be promoted from the outer fort to the main compound.\nIn the past, the Tang Sect had many people, and the kitchen had to supply food. During busy times, you wished everyone had three arms. There's a saying that gentlemen stay away from the kitchen, though the original meaning was that gentlemen should have compassion and avoid killing, the Book of Rites phrased it subtly, and later it was twisted into an excuse not to cook—a natural development.\nSo you, an outer disciple who didn't need to train and seemed untalented, were finally noticed and promoted to the main compound to work in the kitchen.\nAt first, you were clumsy and often beaten.\nEven if no fault could be found, you'd still be scolded, or else the senior brothers would feel displeased.\nUnconsciously, the scolding grew quieter. As the old members left, it fell to you to take charge.\nNow that the Tang Sect is disbanded, you'll never have to rise in the dark to wash rice, light fires, or cook again.
弟子房中，师兄弟们都面带彷徨之色，今日起不必练功了，反而茫然若失。商量起今后去处，有些人还恋栈江湖，不死心想投别派；有些人厌倦了，想回家再作打算；有些人本就有家可归，拜师唐门对自己的青春有了交代，如今自然要走回爹娘为他铺好的康庄大道。那么你呢？你无家可归，梦想已经不能实现，接下来的事想好了吗？=\nIn the disciples' quarters, brothers wore lost expressions. From today, there was no need to train, yet they felt adrift.\nDiscussing future plans, some were still attached to the martial world,不死心想投别派; some were weary and wanted to go home to reconsider; some had homes to return to—joining the Tang Sect had been their youth's commitment, and now they naturally returned to the broad road laid by their parents.\nAnd you? You have no home, your dreams unfulfilled. Have you thought about what comes next?
你听见锻冶场依然叮叮当当，循声去看，只见小竹此刻依然敲敲打打。她想造有轮的椅车，想让将来三师兄可以偶尔推掌门出去晒晒太阳、吹吹风。见你过来，铁也不打了，笨拙如她，胸无韬略，连安慰人的话都组织不好，身为第一掌派夫人，却一点忙也帮不上，时时惭愧自责。只能把矮小身子挨你身上，试图支撑你。=\nYou heard the clanging from the forge and followed the sound to find Xiao Zhu still hammering away.\nShe wanted to build a wheeled chair so that in the future, Third Senior Brother could occasionally take the Sect Leader out to bask in the sun and feel the breeze.\nSeeing you approach, she stopped smithing. Clumsy as she is, with no strategies in mind, she couldn't even organize words of comfort. As the First Leader's Wife, she felt she couldn't help at all, often ashamed and self-blaming.\nShe could only press her small body against yours, trying to support you.
你到锻冶场中，感慨万千。此处造出无数兵刃、木甲，有些造福乡梓，有些为祸人间，可是器物本来无分善恶，端看人如何使用。人若失了心，一味盲从，那么和器物也没多大区别了不是吗？武林盟甚至不是唐门的仇家，只是一件大型兵器而已，挥剑的人是当朝官家。谁说他昏庸的？这一手岂不是挺狠辣的吗。=\nYou went to the forge, filled with emotion. Countless weapons and wooden armor were made here—some benefited the village, some brought harm to the world. But objects themselves have no inherent good or evil; it depends on how people use them.\nIf people lose their hearts and blindly follow, aren't they little different from objects?\nThe Wulin Alliance isn't even the Tang Clan's enemy—it's just a large weapon, and the one wielding it is the current ruler.\nWho says he's foolish? Isn't this move quite ruthless?
你信步在大院闲游，伫足于女弟子房前，感慨万千。师娘撒手人寰之前，托你照顾小师妹，别让她寂寞。头几年小师妹思念娘亲，夜夜啼哭，都是你在窗下守护，即便是女弟子房中空无一人的时候，也永远有你在畔。直到她修练天地无声势有成，把心冰镇，收住了哭声，从此面无表情，你才敢渐渐离远。=\nYou strolled leisurely through the compound, pausing before the female disciples' quarters, filled with emotion.\nBefore the mistress passed away, she entrusted you with caring for Little Junior Sister, not letting her feel lonely.\nIn the first few years, Little Junior Sister missed her mother and cried nightly. You guarded under her window, and even when the female disciples' quarters were empty, you were always by her side.\nOnly after she mastered the Heaven and Earth Silent Stance, freezing her heart and stopping her tears, becoming expressionless, did you dare gradually distance yourself.
正缅怀过往，小师妹本人就推门出来，她可能是世上最念旧的人，虽然不说，却记着你从前的耐心陪伴，也曾目睹你多次被抓包毒打，当时不曾细想，如今才体悟你的苦心，对你既有纯洁无垢的倾慕之情，亦有无穷感激。=Just as I was lost in memories, Little Junior Sister herself pushed the door open and came out. She might be the most nostalgic person in the world. Though she never says it, she remembers your patient companionship in the past and has also witnessed you being caught and beaten multiple times. Back then, she didn't overthink it, but now she finally understands your good intentions, feeling both pure, untainted admiration and endless gratitude toward you.
她回首一生除了至亲，最重的宝物莫过于你，和云裳的遗赠而已。想要紧紧抓在小小手心，其他的什么都不要了。=Looking back on her life, aside from her closest family, the most precious treasures are none other than you and Yunshang's legacy.\nShe wants to clutch them tightly in her small palm and desires nothing else.
正缅怀过往，云裳就推门出来见你，指责你眼神不正派。=Just as I was lost in memories, Yunshang pushed the door open and came out to see you, accusing you of having improper intentions in your eyes.
你变心对别的女子示好，她看在眼里，怀恨于心，想狠狠报复，又始终不忍心，有时释怀，有时越想越气，对你自然没啥好脸色。=Your change of heart and showing favor to other women—she sees it all, harboring resentment in her heart. She wants to retaliate fiercely but can never bring herself to do it. Sometimes she lets it go, other times the more she thinks about it, the angrier she gets, so naturally, she doesn't give you a friendly look.
你答应要带她去寻叶云舟的踪迹，余生不知还有多久，总之从今与你相依为命。=You promised to take her to search for Ye Yunzhou's traces. Who knows how much time is left in this life? In any case, from now on, she will rely on you for survival.
云裳本就无所谓江湖斗争，成不成名、威不威风都不当回事，只要你有法子挣钱给她花用便行。你可得争气点，从前她亲哥给的那些，你都得无缝接着宠，必须小心翼翼呵护，不能让她跟了你吃苦。=Yunshang never cared about Jianghu conflicts—fame, reputation, or prestige meant nothing to her. As long as you have a way to earn money for her to spend, that's enough.\nYou'd better step up your game. Everything her biological brother once provided for her, you must seamlessly continue to lavish upon her. You must care for her meticulously and never let her suffer hardship with you.
也不知小师妹如今远嫁他乡，日子舒不舒心，有没吃饱、穿暖？你们这些家伙任性妄为搞砸了一切，万幸没有连累她。如今想来，足证三师兄大有先见之明。=You wondered if Little Junior Sister, now married far away, was comfortable—if she had enough to eat and wear?\nYou reckless fools messed everything up, but fortunately didn't implicate her.\nThinking back, it proved Third Senior Brother's great foresight.
空旷练武场上，风萧瑟，人寂寥，往昔笑语依稀可闻，只是往事不堪回首。=\nOn the vast training ground, the wind blew bleakly and the atmosphere was desolate. Faint echoes of past laughter could almost be heard, yet those bygone days were too painful to look back upon.
好梦常留不住，独你踟蹰。人生如逆旅，汝亦是行人，该走了，该走了。=Good dreams often cannot be kept, leaving you alone to linger.\nLife is like a journey against the current, and you too are but a traveler. It's time to go, it's time to go.
那些美好的事，一晃眼就已经好远好远。=Those beautiful things, in the blink of an eye, have already become so very distant.
夏侯兰有事吩咐，正要开口，就见你在哭，不禁哑然。=Xiahou Lan had something to instruct and was about to speak when she noticed you crying, leaving her momentarily speechless.
你连忙收泪，怕受师父责罚，你师父却温声细语安慰，因为眷恋家人而落的泪，不算窝囊。=You hurriedly wiped away your tears, fearing your Master's punishment, but your Master instead comforted you in a gentle voice, saying that tears shed out of longing for family are not a sign of weakness.
你连忙收泪，怕被妻子看轻，你爱妻却温声细语安慰。在她看来，孺慕之情，人皆有之，不必以为耻。反是道别故里、与家人分别，都能嘻皮笑脸的冷血之辈，才欠搧耳光。=You hurriedly wiped your tears, afraid your wife would look down on you, but your beloved wife安慰 gently.\nIn her view, filial affection is common to all—no need to feel ashamed.\nOn the contrary, those cold-blooded who can grin when bidding farewell to homeland and family deserve a slap.
她是淋过雨的人，如今来为你撑伞。谁让你是她心爱的弟子呢。=She is one who has been rained on, now holding an umbrella for you.\nWho told you you're her beloved disciple?
你来到后山拜祭大师兄，收拾事物。忽然仰天长啸，也不管从前点拨你忘形篇那位前辈真身是谁、能否听见，你尽了心力，总要道别。山谷回荡你的啸声，良久方绝。可是一片寂静，无人应答，也许当年那人早已不在了。=You came to the back mountain to pay respects to the First Senior Brother and tidy up his belongings.\nSuddenly, you let out a long cry to the heavens, regardless of who the elder who once instructed you in the Forgetfulness Chapter truly was or whether they could hear—you had done your best, and now it was time to say goodbye.\nThe valley echoed with your cry, lingering for a long time before fading.\nBut there was only silence, with no response. Perhaps that person from back then was already gone.
你来到后山，龙湘听见脚步声，连忙抹去眼泪，执剑挥舞了几下。你见她靴底泥泞，便知她去拜祭过大师兄了。唐门要散了，此地再无故人，你俩今朝分道扬镳，从此音讯断绝，今生能否再见都难断言。=You arrived at the back mountain, and Long Xiang, hearing footsteps, quickly wiped away her tears and swung her sword a few times.\nSeeing the mud on her boots, you knew she had been to pay respects to the First Senior Brother.\nThe Tang Sect was about to disband, and there would be no more old friends here. Today, the two of you would go your separate ways, cutting off all contact from now on. It was hard to say if you would ever meet again in this lifetime.
你怕她漫无目的，怕她钱包被偷、怕她流落街头，想着就觉得种种不安，心念一动，便出声邀她结伴同行，她未来将去何方，可以慢慢再想。=You feared she would wander aimlessly, worried her purse would be stolen, afraid she would end up homeless. The thought filled you with unease, and on impulse, you invited her to travel together. Where she would go in the future could be decided slowly later.
你知道她八成倾慕着大师兄。可是这说不定便是今生最后一面了，难道你的心意就这样默默藏着，带到坟墓里去吗？=You knew she likely admired the First Senior Brother.\nBut this might be the last time you would see each other in this lifetime. Could you really keep your feelings hidden, carrying them silently to the grave?
你鼓起勇气，向龙湘表明心迹，听你突然告白，龙湘吃了一大惊。=You mustered your courage and confessed your feelings to Long Xiang. Hearing your sudden告白, Long Xiang was greatly shocked.
龙湘闻言色变，刷地拔出剑来。锦香宫无不是孤苦可怜的女子，其中逾半是因为遇人不淑。三妻四妾于法能容，锦香宫却不许人薄幸，你身边既有了知心人，却又说出这番话语，越是深情口吻越显得令人作呕。你可是忘了龙湘出宫游历是为了什么？糟蹋人心的玩意，都须在惜花令上留名。=Long Xiang's expression changed upon hearing this, and she swiftly drew her sword.\nThe Jinxiang Palace is filled with lonely and pitiable women, more than half of whom suffered due to meeting the wrong men. While having multiple wives and concubines is legally tolerated, the Jinxiang Palace does not permit fickleness in love. Since you already have a beloved by your side, yet utter such words, the more深情 your tone, the more nauseating it becomes.\nHave you forgotten why Long Xiang left the palace to wander? Those who trample on hearts must be named on the Flower Cherishing Decree.
还将信将疑，道你是不放心自己，为了找名目带上她罢了。然而你对她从来不是什么姊弟之情，而是爱慕之心，之所以一口一个湘姊，还不是受她武力胁迫？你自知远远比不上大师兄，话出口，便料到自己要被拒绝，说不定还要挨巴掌，但龙湘却出乎意料的一脸欣慰，笑容苦涩而甘甜。她自幼受恩师教诲，崇拜仁侠义士，比起相貌更重人品，与你结交以来，从没看轻过你，更没把你跟大师兄并论。那是她憧憬过的人，像父亲、王帮主一样，与生俱来要作英雄，是天上的星星。而今知晓了挫折，沾染一身尘土，才知你自泥潭里一步一步独行，走到足与天下英雄论长短，有多么高洁勇敢。她远比你以为的还要更敬佩你，是你煽动了她倔强不放弃，天再黑也要勇敢前进。=She was still skeptical, saying you were just worried about her and finding an excuse to bring her along.\nBut your feelings for her were never sisterly—they were admiration. The only reason you kept calling her "Sister Xiang" was because you were coerced by her武力?\nYou knew well you were far inferior to the First Senior Brother. As soon as the words left your mouth, you expected to be rejected, perhaps even slapped. But to your surprise, Long Xiang looked欣慰, her smile bittersweet yet sweet.\nSince childhood, she had been taught by her Master to admire righteous warriors, valuing character over appearance. Since befriending you, she had never looked down on you, nor compared you to the First Senior Brother.\nHe was someone she had once admired, like her father or Leader Wang—born to be heroes, stars in the sky.\nNow, having experienced setbacks and been covered in dust, she realized how noble and brave you were to have climbed step by step from the mud, reaching a point where you could rival heroes of the world.\nShe admired you far more than you realized. It was you who inspired her stubborn refusal to give up, to brave forward even in the darkest times.
你几度欲言又止，始终不敢跨出那一步，因为你猜到了结局。龙湘见你吞吞吐吐，还道是你中了无形暗器被点哑穴。你收回了嘴边将诉的心意，只邀她同行，互相好有照应，就算不能结为伴侣，再走一程多看几眼也好，就怕再也没有如此美好的人。=Several times you hesitated to speak, never daring to take that step because you anticipated the outcome.\nLong Xiang, seeing your hesitation, thought you had been hit by an invisible hidden weapon that sealed your哑穴.\nYou withdrew the confession on the tip of your tongue and simply invited her to travel together for mutual support. Even if you couldn't be partners, walking together a while longer and seeing her a few more times would be enough—you feared there would never be someone as wonderful as her again.
她奉行宫规说的话虽冷，出的剑却有余温，绕指柔剑割得你皮开肉绽，却不忍伤你性命。乍看之下伤势触目惊心，实则没一处伤及要害，全是妙到颠毫浅浅一划、轻轻一割，你所以无力再战，折的是心。龙湘这一去，那是与你恩断义绝，再也不见了。=Though her words, following palace rules, were cold, her sword held residual warmth. Her Finger-wrapping Soft Sword left you cut and bleeding, but she could not bear to take your life.\nAt first glance, the injuries seemed horrifying, but in reality, none were fatal—each was a masterful, shallow cut or gentle slice. What left you unable to fight was a broken heart.\nWith Long Xiang's departure, it meant severing all ties with you, never to meet again.
龙湘心魔未除，而你今非昔比，终于败在你手里。她认输，可是依然不肯屈服，你想收回那些轻率的话话已然迟了，当不成伴侣，也回不到从前。=Long Xiang's inner demons remained, and you were no longer the same person. Finally, she was defeated by you.\nShe admitted defeat but still refused to yield. It was too late to take back those rash words—you could neither become partners nor return to how things were.
你悔不当初，心知不能强留，于是默默让出道来。见你黯然，龙湘不禁心肠一软，想好声劝慰，恩师教诲又在耳畔萦绕：「剪不断，理还乱。」她没想过害你伤心，亦不愿愧对别人，于是硬起心肠，生生把话吞回肚里。至于欠你的恩情，也只有欠着，你将来若有难处，她必然赴汤蹈火，可是这一生一世是决计不能再对你假以辞色了，以免误人自误。龙湘走得毫不犹豫，白衣身影消逝，风吹过，她的一缕残香也不复存，就像她从没来过。=You regretted your actions, knowing you couldn't force her to stay, so you silently stepped aside.\nSeeing your despondency, Long Xiang's heart softened, and she wanted to comfort you kindly, but her Master's teachings echoed in her ears: "What cannot be cut remains tangled".\nShe never intended to hurt you, nor did she want to wrong others, so she hardened her heart and swallowed her words.\nAs for the debt of gratitude she owed you, it would remain unpaid. If you ever faced difficulties in the future, she would brave any danger for you, but in this lifetime, she could never again show you kindness, lest she lead others astray or harm herself.\nLong Xiang left without hesitation, her white figure vanishing. The wind blew, and even the last trace of her fragrance disappeared, as if she had never been there.
你硬是拦住去路，不让龙湘离开。然而你于她而言已非朋友，而是摇身变成恃强凌弱之辈，与武林盟何异？曾经有多么信赖你，如今就有多么失望，她向来很认真，固然恋生畏死，更不愿屈服于强权。你失魂落魄，几番垂绳下去探索，都一无所获。彷佛化作一缕随风散去，不愿留在有你的地方。宁可粉身碎骨，也要清白的走，人间再有什么好，也全不希罕。=You stubbornly blocked the path, refusing to let Long Xiang leave.\nBut to her, you were no longer a friend—you had become someone who bullied the weak, no different from the Wulin Alliance.\nThe trust she once had in you was now matched by disappointment. She had always been earnest; while she cherished life and feared death, she refused to yield to tyranny.\nYou were distraught, lowering ropes multiple times to search, but found nothing.\nIt was as if she had vanished into the wind, unwilling to remain anywhere you were.\nShe would rather be shattered to pieces than leave without her integrity. No matter what joys the world held, she wanted none of them.
龙湘拒绝，并非不愿与你归隐山林，只是她在江湖尚有未了之事，未解之谜、未报之仇、未赴之约。嘴里喊着怕，剑都握不稳，可是一旦逃开，信仰就会崩塌，所以不得不去。=Long Xiang refused not because she was unwilling to retreat to the mountains with you, but because she had unfinished business in the Jianghu—unsolved mysteries, unavenged grievances, and unfulfilled promises.\nThough she claimed fear and could barely hold her sword steady, if she ran away, her beliefs would crumble. So she had to go.
所以与你相约三年之期，在唐门旧址重逢。=Thus, she made a three-year promise with you to reunite at the old site of the Tang Sect.
你在空旷的唐家大院怔然站了半晌，低头看看一袭青衫，破烂不堪，渍满你们的汗迹、血迹，还有泪痕，已经变得太过沉重了。今夕晚照，分外寂寥。=You stood dazed for a long while in the empty Tang Clan courtyard, looking down at your blue robe—tattered, stained with sweat, blood, and tears—now grown too heavy.\nThe evening glow tonight felt exceptionally lonely.
你到炼丹房中，想起从前给二师兄使唤、斥责的日子，那样严厉的人，偶尔也有耐心的时候。他背叛唐门确实罪无可赦，可是如今再想，都似过眼烟云，恩也好、怨也好，都将随梦散了。=You went to the alchemy room, recalling the days when you were ordered around and scolded by the Second Senior Brother. Such a stern man occasionally had moments of patience.\nHis betrayal of the Tang Sect was indeed unforgivable, but now, looking back, it all seemed like passing clouds—kindness and resentment alike would fade with dreams.
你呕心沥血，完成了二师兄的研究，令主炉中的万寿尸心丹得以现世，但是到头来谁也救不了。=You poured your heart and soul into completing the Second Senior Brother's research, bringing the Elixir of Eternal Life from the main furnace into the world, but in the end, it could save no one.
主炉的火终年不辍，始终等不到出炉之日。纵有起死回生之灵效，也救不了唐门。=The fire in the main furnace never ceased year-round, yet the day of completion never came.\nEven with the power to revive the dead, it could not save the Tang Sect.
这话叶云裳可不能当作没听见。炼丹房里的丹药救不了唐门，但是千锤百炼成就的你，却救了她。你听了又悲又喜，你救了云裳，而她没有死去这件事也保护了你的心。=Ye Yunshang could not ignore these words.\nThe elixirs in the alchemy room couldn't save the Tang Sect, but you, tempered through countless trials, saved her.\nHearing this, you felt both sorrow and joy—you had saved Yunshang, and her survival had also protected your heart.
三师兄沐浴焚香，斋戒三日，上祷唐家列祖列宗。他要干一件大事，堪比当年唐家祖宗据外堡以抗玄宗皇帝，接着史书将记你们唐门一笔，不是名垂千朽，就是遗臭万年。这一日烈日当空，三师兄召集唐门弟子、门客，开诚布公言明唐门决心。武林盟既受朝廷挟制，亦得支持。若由他们歼灭泥教，则今后江湖一盟独大，谁是正派、谁能活只由他们说了算，武林寂默，再无异声，侠义永不复存。你们这回叛逆不是反对武林盟，亦非反对朝廷，是发出声响，召集心怀不忿而又无力施为的势孤之人，结成西武林盟共抗武林盟！=The Third Senior Brother bathed, burned incense, and fasted for three days, praying to the Tang ancestors.\nHe was about to undertake a great deed, comparable to the Tang ancestors' defense of the outer fortress against Emperor Xuanzong. History would record the Tang Sect's role—either earning eternal glory or eternal infamy.\nOn this day, under the blazing sun, the Third Senior Brother gathered Tang Sect disciples and retainers, openly declaring the sect's resolve.\nThe Wulin Alliance was both constrained by the court and supported by it. If they were to eradicate the Mud Sect, the Jianghu would be dominated by a single alliance, with them deciding who was righteous and who could live.\nThe martial world would fall silent, with no dissenting voices, and righteousness would vanish forever.\nThis rebellion was not against the Wulin Alliance or the court—it was a cry to gather those who were discontented yet powerless, the isolated and weak, to form the Western Wulin Alliance and resist the Wulin Alliance together!
在你的建议下，四师兄决定出使崆峒派，游说四掌门。=At your suggestion, the Fourth Senior Brother decided to envoy to the Kongtong Sect to persuade its four leaders.
你试图怂恿四师兄去青城派送死，他记恨了。=You tried to incite the Fourth Senior Brother to go to the Qingcheng Sect and get himself killed, and he held a grudge.
在你的建议下，四师兄决定出使青城派，游说邹掌门。=At your suggestion, the Fourth Senior Brother decided to envoy to the Qingcheng Sect to persuade Leader Zou.
在你的建议下，四师兄决定出使丐帮大义分舵，游说那群混蛋乞丐。=At your suggestion, the Fourth Senior Brother decided to envoy to the Righteous Branch of the Beggars' Sect to persuade those damned beggars.
在你的建议下，四师兄决定出使蜀中各地中小门派。=At your suggestion, the Fourth Senior Brother decided to envoy to various small and medium-sized sects throughout Shu.
在你的建议下，四师兄心安理得在家呆着，为了表示感激，他送了一根甘蔗给你。=At your suggestion, the Fourth Senior Brother stayed home with a clear conscience. To show gratitude, he gave you a sugarcane.
你明知青城有唐门仇敌申屠龙，可谓凶险万分，依然向三师兄请命前往游说。=You knew well that the Qingcheng Sect housed the Tang Sect's enemy, Shentu Long, making it extremely dangerous, yet you still requested permission from the Third Senior Brother to go and persuade them.
不是你不怕，而是心知不能放任不管。=It wasn't that you weren't afraid, but you knew in your heart that you couldn't just stand by and do nothing.
可是被三师兄阻止了，唐门已经没有冒险的余裕，若你在青城有何闪失，西武林盟之策势将破局。=But the Third Senior Brother stopped you. The Tang Sect no longer had the luxury to take risks. If anything happened to you in Qingcheng, the strategy of the Western Wulin Alliance would likely collapse.
三师兄雅不愿你以身涉险，可是这个重任舍你其谁？犹豫良久，最终还是松口答应。=The Third Senior Brother was reluctant to let you risk your life, but who else could shoulder this heavy responsibility? After hesitating for a long time, he finally relented and agreed.
你进正心堂中，上官萤正和四师兄商议如何弄钱收买沧帮弟子。要知沧帮弟子习武是为了对抗海盗滋扰，究竟算不算武林人士，实在难说。许多帮众都是上官萤出面延揽的，她虽是上官贵女，御下颇为严厉，但也同样仗义。她为了拉拢人心，没少下过苦功，数百帮众每个都喊得出姓名，甚至家眷也会不时关心，逢年过节就送菜送礼，在帮众眼中，地位却比帮主更高，都相信跟随大小姐，余生不愁吃穿，为此不惜赴汤蹈火，随她走南闯北，就为了能够挣钱安家。但是上官萤一朝自身难保，往昔种种承诺全都变成虚言，再也不能兑现，更因上官世家的缘故，要被卷入江湖斗争，当中不知有多少人要客死异乡，更不能指望抚恤，教她如何不惭愧？所以处心积虑想要弥补，与其跟沧帮弟子讲什么江湖道义，不如直接给钱劝离沧帮，想来他们有钱了可以安家，也不会千里迢迢从东海过来与唐门为难，算来也是两全其美之事。但上官世家暗害唐门一事，上官萤责无旁贷，至今只是看在你的脸面上姑且信她洗心革面，唐门自己都穷，她却想开口问代掌门请款，好去挣钱为她沧帮弟兄安家，这教众人如何不勃然色变？幸好还有四师兄，一听有利可图便两眼放光，反之也可说他最是理性，没有成见，向上官萤请教经商之道，而这位上官千金为了争取投资，亦不厌其烦的讲解，从理论到实证办法巨细靡遗，你也凑过去听她上课，想要长点见识。=You entered the Zhengxin Hall, where Shangguan Ying was discussing with the Fourth Senior Brother how to raise money to buy off the Cang Gang disciples.\nIt should be known that the Cang Gang disciples practiced martial arts to resist pirate harassment.
