Though she was a noble lady of the Shangguan Family, she was quite strict with her subordinates but also fiercely righteous. His eyes lit up at the prospect of profit, or conversely, he was the most rational and unprejudiced. 一个时辰后，你睁着眼恍惚睡着，被上官萤生生揍醒，拖出去毒打了一顿。=After an hour, you were dozing off with your eyes open, and Shangguan Ying beat you awake, then dragged you out for a thorough thrashing.
两个时辰后，你听得昏昏欲睡，口水都流了下来，上官萤抡起拳头又放了下去。想你为唐门操心劳力，也没睡过一顿饱觉，明明是不感兴趣的话题，还能耐心奉陪偌久，她再捶你就未免不近人情了。你虽有听没懂，四师兄却对上官萤所述方针大感兴趣，平时一毛不拔，这回却一反常态出了大钱投资。=After two hours, you were drowsy, even drooling. 江陵大战大义灭亲的戏码，原是王帮主计策一环，集天下罪孽，作万众公敌，假义子李富贵之手长辞。于公令军民一心，消融朝野隔阂，共赴国难。于私还债，成全李富贵为父报仇的孝心，送他一件伟业，助他成名，顺理成章身登丐帮之巅，再以老派领袖遗孤和新派领袖义子的双重身份，稳住丐帮新旧两派。否则老派若没了侠义约束，又干回采生折割那些缺德勾当，流窜中原各地，根本无从抓起，不知要祸害多少可怜人。而今风云变化，局势已朝着王帮主始料未及的方向演变，李富贵虽然口吃，人却不蠢，跟随义父日久，亦有几分智计，既要帮唐门，又得管束老乞丐，一定力有未逮，索性反手将老派甩给武林盟约束，想来他们凭着武林盟得了势，从此更得装得道貌岸然，从此这群祸害就不是丐帮的责任了，这时的丐帮才是真正洗白。=The "righteous killing of kin" in the Battle of Jiangling was part of Leader Wang's plan: to accumulate all sins, become the public enemy, and die by his adoptive son Li Fugui's hand.\nPublicly, it united military and civilian hearts, bridging court and Jianghu gaps to face national crisis together.\nPrivately, it repaid debts, fulfilling Li Fugui's filial duty to avenge his father, gifting him a great deed to fame, and naturally elevating him to the Beggars' Sect's peak. His dual identity as the Old Faction Leader's orphan and New Faction Leader's son would stabilize both factions.\nOtherwise, without righteous constraints, the Old Faction would revert to heinous acts like kidnapping and mutilation, roaming the central plains unchecked, harming countless innocents.\nNow, the situation had evolved beyond Leader Wang's expectations. Though stuttering, Li Fugui was no fool. Having followed his adoptive father for long, he had some wisdom. Helping the Tang Sect while managing old beggars was too much, so he handed the Old Faction to the Wulin Alliance. With Wulin Alliance backing, they'd have to maintain hypocrisy, and the burden of these scoundrels would no longer fall on the Beggars' Sect—thus truly cleansing it.
李富贵每日下山听亲信帮众汇报丐帮情势，帮主失踪，果不其然丐帮新旧两派立时便起矛盾，大仁、大智、大义、大信、大勇分舵或为老派所用，或随新派揭竿，大打出手，都急着想扳倒对方，届时就算帮主现身，也已经尘埃落定，无话可说。他所图的正是如此，有一方得势，必有一方沦为败家之犬，那且败的多半是丐帮新派弟子。因为新派弟子多是昔日追随王帮主的畜生道余孽，江陵大战以来备受老派欺压，更无脸面行走于江湖，虽然年轻力壮者众，却不似老派都是人精老狐狸，一肚坏水，满嘴仁义，行走江湖几十年，与中原各派都有交情。一旦武林盟发声，情势必将对新派弟子不利，被逼到走投无路的地步也只是早晚问题。此时他再现身，收服新派弟子便是水到渠成之事。李富贵娓娓道来，你才知道王帮主不单是李富贵的义父，也是杀他生父千金叟的仇人。江陵大战大义灭亲的戏码，原是王帮主计策一环，集天下罪孽，作万众公敌，假义子李富贵之手长辞。于公令军民一心，消融朝野隔阂，共赴国难。于私还债，成全李富贵为父报仇的孝心，送他一件伟业，助他成名，顺理成章身登丐帮之巅，再以老派领袖遗孤和新派领袖义子的双重身份，稳住丐帮新旧两派。否则老派若没了侠义约束，又干回采生折割那些缺德勾当，流窜中原各地，根本无从抓起，不知要祸害多少可怜人。而今风云变化，局势已朝着王帮主始料未及的方向演变，李富贵虽然口吃，人却不蠢，跟随义父日久，亦有几分智计，既要帮唐门，又得管束老乞丐，一定力有未逮，索性反手将老派甩给武林盟约束，想来他们凭着武林盟得了势，从此更得装得道貌岸然，从此这群祸害就不是丐帮的责任了，这时的丐帮才是真正洗白。=Li Fugui went downhill daily to hear reports from trusted followers about the Beggars' Sect's situation. 唐衫出使峨嵋，却被拒之于山门之外，连向掌门的面都没能见到。皆因那释明先下手为强，早对向掌门一番挑拨教唆，穿凿附会，将唐门种种劣迹皆与泥教挂勾，将唐门种种善行都曲解成假仁假义。他是嵩山福建分院老住持，舍了安逸外出云游说法，亦不只一次挂单峨嵋，开坛说法，峨嵋上下无不敬他佛学精深，大师说的话，哪有不对的。反观唐衫欺师灭祖，弃明投暗，甘与唐门同流合污，恶行难容，向掌门自命清高，见都不屑一见。=Tang Shan's mission to Emei ended with rejection at the gate—he never even met Leader Xiang.\nBecause Shi Ming preemptively sowed discord, linking the Tang Sect's misdeeds to the Mud Sect and twisting their good deeds into hypocrisy.\nAs the old abbot of Songshan's Fujian branch, he gave up comfort to travel and preach, often staying at Emei to hold lectures. All at Emei revered his profound Buddhism—how could the Master be wrong?\nWhereas Tang Shan betrayed his teacher and sect, joining the Tang Sect's corruption—his evils intolerable. Leader Xiang, self-righteous, disdained even meeting him.
任凭唐衫绞尽脑汁，想方设法，也无缘见到一面。正当此时，忽闻山中钟鸣之声，峨嵋知客弟子齐声诵念佛号。他忽然心生感悟，索性什么也不想了，盘腿便在山门坐下。自知从前种种无法挽回，并非不愧，之所以不跪，是不敢堕师门威风，虽然不跪，但要表示虔诚，还有别的方法。于是他开始不吃不喝、不眠不休读诵佛经，将熟读在心的经文都背过一遍，诵完了又重诵一遍，日夜不辍，直至终于透支体力，晕倒过去，醒来就在峨嵋山上了。向掌门感其心诚，终于接见，听他娓娓道尽经纬，才从另一侧面了解，对唐门的敌意消散了大半。只是他虽痛心武林同道相互攻伐，有违南宫大侠遗志，却也不愿公然和武林盟撕破脸，让峨嵋弟子因为一己之见，陷身水火煎熬，故此决定两不相帮。=Despite all efforts, Tang Shan couldn't get an audience.\nJust then, mountain bells rang, and Emei disciples chanted Buddhist prayers.\nHe had an epiphany, stopped overthinking, and sat cross-legged at the gate.\nHe knew his past was irredeemable but refused to kneel to avoid disgracing his sect. 任凭唐衫绞尽脑汁，想方设法，也无缘见到一面。正当此时，与他同行的唐娇娇突然出手伤人，一拳打扁了知客弟子的脸，强闯上山，唐衫惊慌失措，却又不能不管，只得跟上，陪她一路打到峨嵋大殿之前，拦不住她出口伤人，也不知她从前在峨嵋究竟什么位份，那群峨嵋弟子见了唐娇娇居然都面有畏怖之色，便是向掌门在她跟前，也没有掌门架子，解无尘更是把人推出来就躲得老远。可是唐娇娇竟不领情，好不容易见着了向掌门却不让人说话，乱拳砰砰轰在向无忧身上，唐衫直骇得魂飞天外，以为那日便是自己死期。=Despite all efforts, Tang Shan couldn't get an audience.\nJust then, Tang Jiaojiao, travelling with him, suddenly attacked, punching a reception disciple in the face and forcing her way up. 最后唐娇娇因为殴打掌门，被罚在峨嵋剑狱面壁思过，以此为代价，峨嵋派将与唐门共进退，在武林盟东来讨伐之日，成为屏障阻挡点苍北征。=Finally, for assaulting the Leader, Tang Jiaojiao was punished with meditation in Emei's Sword Prison. As代价, Emei will stand with the Tang Sect, blocking Diancang's northern advance when the Wulin Alliance attacks.

武学奥义，本来人人自秘，不说各派严防他人偷师，便是师父传授弟子，藏招留一手也屡见不鲜。防人之心不可无，你推托敷衍，不肯泄漏，倒也不算心黑。他不怪你，只是心下长叹，告辞而去。=Martial secrets are closely guarded—sects prevent stealing, and teachers often hold back from students.\nCaution is wise. Your evasion wasn't malice.\nHe didn't blame you, just sighed inwardly and left.
武学奥义，本来人人自秘，不说各派严防他人偷师，便是师父传授弟子，藏招留一手也屡见不鲜。若在平时，你也未必肯说，但为师门故，你迟疑片刻，就将毕生所悟倾囊相授，那日在后山得自蒙面前辈的恩惠，又传承旁人。唐衫只听得热泪盈眶，浑身打战，想向你下跪磕头，却被拦住。他亦投桃报李，将难能可贵的机缘分赠予你，得自峨嵋剑狱的神功《心剑・雷神脚》他虽还练不成，但你说不定有缘练成，以此捍卫唐门。你俩相识一笑，此际才算真正尽弃前嫌。=Martial secrets are closely guarded—sects prevent stealing, and teachers often hold back from students.\nNormally, you might not share, but for the sect, you hesitated then impart all your insights, passing on the grace from the masked elder at the back mountain.\nTang Shan listened with tearful eyes, trembling, wanting to kneel and kowtow, but you stopped him.\nHe reciprocated, gifting you a rare opportunity: the divine technique "Heart Sword・Divine Thunder Kick" from Emei's Sword Prison. 江湖毕竟不是许愿池，不是所有梦想都能开花结果，不是问心无愧就能善始善终。唐门弟子一个个倒下，你们的斗争，终究以失败收场。=After all, the martial world is not a wishing well. Not all dreams blossom and bear fruit; a clear conscience does not guarantee a good beginning and end.\nOne by one, Tang Sect disciples fell. Your struggle ultimately ended in failure.

大院之上，众志一心。武林盟派人上山取你唐门弟子的性命，可惜命硬取不成，你们合该尽一尽地主之谊，亲自给他们送去，让他们见识见识蜀中唐门的待客之道。=Above the main courtyard, united in purpose.\nThe Wulin Alliance sent people up the mountain to take the lives of you, the Tang Sect disciples. 便是苍松剑客叶云舟，也不敌人海攻势，锋芒被鲜血掩没，斩倒了十人，又来二十人，气力耗竭、真气用尽，身受大大小小十几处伤，得天独厚如他，到头难逃一死。=Even the Azure Pine Swordsman, Ye Yunzhou, could not withstand the human wave tactics. His sharp edge was drowned in blood. 龙湘与你背靠背、心连心，默契无间，所向披靡。任他武林群侠前仆后继而来，悉数命殒剑下，一战震撼江湖。只是命有穷尽，饶她身上流淌英雄之血，始终不过血肉之躯，与你凡夫俗子一般无异，时候到了，贩夫走卒、王侯将相都得认命。残阳如血，你和龙湘始终屹立不倒，立身在晚照与星夜分野，影子越拉越长。=Long Xiang stood back-to-back with you, heart linked to heart, in seamless默契, invincible.\nNo matter how many martial heroes charged forward one after another, all met their end beneath your swords, a battle that shook the martial world.\nBut life has its limits. Though hero's blood flows in her veins, she is still merely flesh and blood, no different from you, a mortal. When the time comes, peddlers and laborers, kings and generals alike must accept their fate.\nThe setting sun was as blood. You and Long Xiang remained standing unyielding, positioned at the divide between twilight and starlight, your shadows stretching longer and longer.
大势已去，唐门弟子死伤殆尽，你亦身负重伤，全凭一口气吊着。上官萤又悲又怒，任她拳打脚踢，披头散发，喊得撕心裂肺，依旧叫天天不应，叫地地不灵，养尊处优的时候听说世间有疾苦，此际方知个中滋味，万念俱灰。=The situation was lost. Tang Sect disciples were nearly all dead or wounded. 小竹空有力气，武功却连三流也够不上，而世人只要冠以大义，老弱妇孺也下得去手，哪会怜香惜玉？拼着一身伤将你拦腰抱起，突围下山，撞入森林。其时她失血过多，两眼早已盲了，伏在你胸膛上，呼吸越来越低，她似乎说了很多话，其实只是垂死梦呓。=Xiao Zhu had strength but her martial skills weren't even third-rate. 你心上悬着别人，最看重的已不再是从小宠腻到大的小师妹。想她已经长大，总会照顾自己，不如把握时间调息养伤。小师妹怅然若失，她没躲着你，只要再对她耐心一点，她就会让你找到的。谁料得到人的心会变得那么快呢，稍一不注意，就会变得陌生。=Your heart now hung on others, and your foremost concern was no longer the younger junior sister you had doted on since childhood.\nThinking she had grown up and could take care of herself, you might as well use the time to meditate and heal.\nThe younger junior sister felt a sense of loss. She wasn't hiding from you; with just a little more patience, she would have let you find her.\nWho could have predicted hearts could change so quickly? With the slightest inattention, they become strangers.
大师兄归来，免不了要被你们揪住衣领仔细盘问。他命中有此一劫，之所以能够死而复生，是重重缘法交迭，引导出的奇迹。隐忍至今，全是为了在关键时刻痛击幕后黑手。可惜你们这群师弟妹太不争气，不忍见你们努力至今，功亏一篑，才终于现身出来，解唐门之患。=\nWith the First Senior Brother's return, it was inevitable you'd grab him by the collar and interrogate him thoroughly.\nIt was a destined trial for him. His ability to return from death was a miracle born from the convergence of countless karmic ties.\nHe had endured in secrecy solely to strike at the mastermind at the critical moment.\nUnfortunately, you juniors were too unreliable. Unable to bear watching your efforts until now go to waste, he finally revealed himself to resolve the Tang Sect's crisis.
决战之前那晚，你梦见了以前的事。乡下农村，除非有钱供孩子读书，还能梦想考取功名，余下的便是向往江湖故事。那时常有说书人来，一回一回的讲，最是脍炙人口的，莫过于剑侠龙渊率领武林群侠，大战魔教教主的传奇事迹，村里镇上，无不敬仰，便是当朝官家也没那般人望。每每听完说书，村里孩子都会心潮澎湃，折树枝作刀剑，轮番扮演大侠与恶棍。你从小就不得人疼，吃尽了苦，如何不想学那些大侠，学成一身武功，仗义行侠、威风八面？可事实是，没人看得起你，就算硬着头皮挤进人群，你连坏人都难有几回机会当，十有八九你要当树，负责被震断。你醒转过来的时候，才终于下定决心。洗了一把脸，照镜整肃衣襟，将老旧护腕扣上，小剑插在后腰带上。走进正心堂，向病卧在床的掌门请命出战、拜别辞行。=\nThe night before the decisive battle, you dreamed of the past.\nIn rural villages, unless families had money to educate their children with dreams of imperial exams, the rest yearned for tales of the jianghu.\nStorytellers often came, recounting tales chapter by chapter. The most beloved was the legend of Sword Hero Long Yuan leading Wulin heroes in a great battle against the Demon Cult Leader. Everyone in villages and towns revered him—even court officials didn't command such respect.\nAfter each storytelling session, the village children would be thrilled, breaking branches as swords, taking turns playing heroes and villains.\nSince childhood, you were unloved and suffered greatly. How could you not want to emulate those heroes, Master martial arts, uphold justice, and command awe?\nBut the truth was, no one looked up to you. Even if you forced your way into the crowd, you rarely got to play the villain—nine times out of ten, you were the tree, meant to be shattered.\nWhen you woke, you finally resolved yourself.\nYou washed your face, straightened your clothes before the mirror, fastened your old wrist guards, and tucked your short sword into your back belt.\nYou entered the Zhengxin Hall, requesting permission from the bedridden Sect Leader to join the battle, bidding farewell.
你在那碰见了大师兄，他早料到你会来。你若迟迟下定不了决心，就该他去了，他倒也不是不能与盟主一拚，只是特别把主演的机会让你。=There you met the First Senior Brother, who had anticipated your arrival.\nIf you hesitated too long in making your decision, he would have gone instead. 你姓赵，不姓唐，熬到了今天还是外姓弟子，但掌门说过，唐门就是你的家。=Your surname is Zhao, not Tang. Despite enduring until now, you remained an outer-sect disciple, but the Sect Leader had said: the Tang Sect is your home.
所以就算贪生怕死，你也会挺身而出，保卫家园。=So even if you feared death, you would step forward to protect your home.

也许武林盟言之有理，也许此战没有正邪之别，但你等西武林盟坚信自己，听凭心意，要为弱者鸣声。=Perhaps the Wulin Alliance had a point; perhaps this battle wasn't about good versus evil. But you of the Western Wulin Alliance believed in yourselves, followed your hearts, and spoke for the weak.

清晨练武场，唐门弟子齐齐夹道场中，他们心照不宣，西武林盟舍你其谁？就算拦着，你也会去。所以躬身拱手，以至高的敬意为你送行。你背负众望，大步踏出门去。=At the training ground at dawn, Tang Sect disciples lined the path. Even if stopped, you would go.\nSo they bowed and cupped their hands, seeing you off with the highest respect.\nBearing everyone's hopes, you strode out the gate.
小师妹在道中等着你，小手塞你掌心，陪你散步往赴决战之地。其实她心慌得很，几度想要开口，求你别去，始终不忍开口而已。她也知道不去不行，毕竟那是你的梦想、心之所向。=The younger junior sister waited for you on the path, slipping her small hand into yours, walking with you to the decisive battle.\nIn truth, she was anxious,多次 wanting to beg you not to go, but she couldn't bring herself to speak.\nShe also knew you had to go—it was your dream, where your heart lay.
夏侯兰难得早起，在道中等着你，陪你散步往赴决战之地。一路有说有笑，今天的师父似乎特别温柔，挨得很近。=Xiahou Lan, unusually awake early, waited for you on the path, walking with you to the decisive battle.\nLaughing and talking along the way, today your Master seemed especially gentle, staying close.

西武林群侠在道中相候，你每一颔首，群侠便拱手致意，走你走过的路，无声追随你的背影。=Western Wulin heroes waited on the path. With each nod of yours, they cupped their hands in respect, walking the path you took, silently following your figure.
两雄并立眉山之巅，清晨曙光映耀，万众瞩目。他亦坦率，十日以前趁人之危，今日才论真英雄，对此时此刻来到此地的你，致以崇高敬意。天底多的是比眉山更高耸的山，但是山不在高，你我际会于此，便是武林最高峰。你们各自代表着东西武林盟，千言万语不以剑鸣，撼不动人心，故而有此一战！=Two heroes stood side by side atop Meishan Peak, bathed in the dawn's glow, under the watchful eyes of all.\nHe was candid: ten days ago, he took advantage of your weakness; today, true heroes would be decided. 叶云裳大约有一百种手段，可以阻止你登上眉山之巅。但是她比谁都要理解你，理解你的骄傲与尊严，明白你为什么视死如归。所以不忍心劝你，就如你明知死路一条，仍不愿离弃，而今换她在道中等着你，地狱尽头，也愿与你同行。=Ye Yunshang probably had a hundred ways to stop you from ascending Meishan Peak.\nBut she understood you better than anyone—your pride and dignity, why you faced death unflinchingly.\nSo she couldn't bear to dissuade you. 这一切，有意义。你不言不语，那刀剑交斫的铿锵，便是你赵活响彻云霄的喊声，要令天下人竖耳倾听。清澈的意志透过剑锋震荡，渗透进你心底。厚重的意志透过剑锋震荡，渗透进他心底。=\nAll of this had meaning.\nWordless, the clash of swords was your cry, Zhao Huo, echoing through the skies, demanding the world listen.\nA clear will vibrated through the blade, seeping into your heart.\nA profound will vibrated through the blade, seeping into his heart.
此战结局，没有奇迹。你鼓足勇气也违抗不了天命，人生老是如此不公平。你战败身亡以后，西武林盟心气散尽，为武林盟所吞并，动乱弭平，武林阵线终于统一，唯独唐门例外。但你奋战的英姿令天下侠士动容，千言万语也说服不得的人，纷纷向你致敬。无人记得你相貌丑恶，出身粗鄙，只记得当年眉山之巅，以手中小剑与盟主争鸣的少年英雄。你一如你少年所想，轰轰烈烈的活过，成为传说，受万人敬仰。=\nThe outcome of this battle held no miracle.\nEven with mustered courage, you couldn't defy fate. Life was often so unfair.\nAfter your defeat and death, the Western Wulin Alliance's spirit shattered, absorbed by the Wulin Alliance. The turmoil平息, and the Wulin front finally unified, with the Tang Sect as the sole exception.\nBut your heroic struggle moved knights across the land. Those whom words couldn't persuade now paid homage to you.\nNone remembered your ugly face or humble origins—only the Young Hero who once clashed with the Alliance Leader atop Meishan Peak with a short sword.\nJust as you dreamed in youth, you lived tumultuously, became a legend, and earned the admiration of thousands.
刀光剑影交错，各出看家本领，他孤云山剑潇洒如意，你忘形博纳天下武学。时而岩如山岳，兆机凝结，时而又猛若霹雳弦惊，轰雷闪电。招数使完，随手便创，剑出胜流星，掌风能拨云，扫腿作鞭，呼气成箭。恰似名家挥毫书就狂草，看似写意，实则一撇一捺，无不是心血凝炼！如非亲眼所见，怎信当世有如此惊世骇俗的武功？=\nBlades and shadows crossed as you both unleashed your signature skills. His Lone Cloud Mountain Sword was free and effortless; you, lost in form, embraced all martial arts under heaven.\nAt times, steady as a mountain, aura concentrated; at others, fierce as a thunderclap, like lightning striking.\nWhen moves were exhausted, you created new ones on the spot. Swords faster than meteors, palm winds that parted clouds, sweeping legs like whips, exhales becoming arrows.\nLike a Master's wild cursive calligraphy—seemingly freehand, yet every stroke was condensed effort!\nWho could believe such breathtaking skills existed without seeing them firsthand?

武林盟主又怎了？不还是个血肉之躯，和你一样会流血、要吃饭、会大便。你的小剑被格飞，心剑未折，反手一拳砸在瑞笙手背，打裂掌骨，逼他宝剑脱手。他亦不甘示弱，立刻冲你丑脸还以颜色。拳脚交错，初时还讲体面，后来全然不成章法，变成市井流氓厮斗，根本不择手段。你好生歹毒，专门瞄准他脸，而堂堂盟主为了保护脸，只得使出擒抱，气急败坏之下，竟还张口咬你。东西两忙观战侠士无不汗颜。终于你俩都鼻青脸肿、面目全非，最后一击全都软绵绵，双双倒地犹不服输，继续吵嘴，他不忘出脚踢你小腿，你捉沙当暗器洒他脸，意图把他呛死。不知为何，突然都觉莫名愚蠢，忍俊不禁，不约而同放声大笑。=\nSo what if he's the Wulin Alliance Leader? Fortunately, in the end, he fell under your swift blade.\nThe heroes of the Wulin Alliance, now realizing they had misjudged their leader, were overcome with shame. Some donated their wealth, others voluntarily abandoned their martial arts and retired from the jianghu.
时人说起东西武林之战，无不津津乐道。无人记得你相貌丑恶、出身粗鄙，因为那根本无关紧要。只知眉山之巅，天下第一的英雄少年。之后北方传来战报，极乐教引西夏入侵。东西武林侠士临危皆奉你号令，齐心抗敌，挫败极乐教野心。中原武林终于恢复和平。耕阳读书斋将你的事迹编撰成书，发行于市，书名为《活侠传》。唐门活侠的大名一朝传遍中原，无人不知、无人不晓。甚至远至西夏兴庆、大宋临安、金国燕京、蒙古大漠军帐。四国皇帝都知道世上有你这号人物，敬者敬，忧者忧，畏者畏，愁者愁。你的名字，从今往后便是传说。=When people speak of the war between the Eastern and Western Wulin Alliances, they never fail to recount it with relish.\nNo one remembers your ugly appearance or humble origins, for those things have long ceased to matter.\nThey only know that atop Mount Mei stood the number one Young Hero under Heaven.\nLater, battle reports arrived from the north, the Blissful Sect had led Western Xia in an invasion.\nIn the face of crisis, martial Heroes from both East and West followed your commands, united in resisting the enemy and thwarting the ambitions of the Blissful Sect.\nThe Central Plains martial world was finally restored to peace.\nThe Gengyang Study Hall compiled your deeds into a book, published and distributed in the market, titled Legend of the Living Hero.\nThe name of the Tang Sect's Living Hero spread throughout the Central Plains in a single day, known to all, recognized by everyone.\nEven as far as Western Xia's Xingqing, the Song Dynasty's Lin'an, the Jin Kingdom's Yanjing, and the military tents of the Mongolian deserts.\nThe emperors of all four nations knew of your existence. Some respected you, some worried, some feared, and some were troubled.\nFrom this day forward, your name has become a legend.
耕阳读书斋将你的事迹编撰成书，发行于市，书名为《活侠传》。唐门活侠的大名一朝传遍中原，无人不知、无人不晓。甚至远至西夏兴庆、大宋临安、金国燕京、蒙古大漠军帐。四国皇帝都知道世上有你这号人物，敬者敬，忧者忧，畏者畏，愁者愁。你的名字，从今往后便是传说。=The Gengyang Study Hall compiled your deeds into a book, published and distributed in the market, titled Legend of the Living Hero.\nThe name of the Tang Sect's Living Hero spread throughout the Central Plains in a single day, known to all, recognized by everyone.\nEven as far as Western Xia's Xingqing, the Song Dynasty's Lin'an, the Jin Kingdom's Yanjing, and the military tents of the Mongolian deserts.\nThe emperors of all four nations knew of your existence. Some respected you, some worried, some feared, and some were troubled.\nFrom this day forward, your name has become a legend.
这一日又到了每月评鉴之时，大师兄却忽然出现，扬言要带你去正心堂。=\nOn the day of the monthly evaluation, the First Senior Brother suddenly appeared, declaring he would take you to the Zhengxin Hall.
你一走他们就拿出骰子和酒食，欢快得不得了。=The moment you left, they brought out dice and drinks, overjoyed.
可正在评鉴你贡献的当下，为了脱身，你斗胆睁眼说瞎话，夸大功劳。大师兄虽然不在意，其他弟子却很恼你。=But during the evaluation of your contributions,\nto escape, you boldly lied and exaggerated your merits.\nThough the First Senior Brother didn't mind, the other disciples were furious with you.
正在评鉴你贡献的当下，你明明忙坏了，却还嫌不够似的露出了支支吾吾的神情，这下没人能对你不服气了，你与三师兄简直是唐门的精神典范。=During the evaluation of your contributions,\nyou looked hesitant as if still not satisfied despite being overwhelmed with work.\nNow no one could不服 you; you and the Third Senior Brother were practically the moral exemplars of the Tang Sect.
正在评鉴你贡献的当下，你实在有点儿心虚，支支吾吾了半晌也说不出所以然来，大师兄有意包庇，将你带离现场，还是惹得同门师兄弟们各自忿忿难平。=During the evaluation of your contributions,\nyou felt somewhat guilty,\nstammering for a long time without making sense. The First Senior Brother intentionally shielded you and took you away,\nbut it still left your fellow disciples resentful and upset.
你得掌门授意，得以列席唐门会议。虽说是为了参详你一介外姓弟子的视角所以破格提拔，可也是唐门创派以来第一个有席位的外姓弟子。=With the Sect Leader's approval, you were allowed to attend Tang Sect meetings.\nThough it was an exceptional promotion to gain your perspective as an outer-sect disciple,\nyou became the first outer-sect disciple in the clan's history to have a seat.
在你的建言下，唐门上下动员，修缮了唐家大院，家宅焕然一新，人人与有荣焉。=On your suggestion, the entire Tang Sect mobilized to renovate the Tang Clan compound. The residence was焕然一新, and everyone shared a sense of pride.
在你的建言下，赎回了唐门外堡，舒缓居住压力，不住通铺，门中弟子亦得隐私，对你暗暗感激。=On your suggestion, the Tang Sect's outer fortress was redeemed, easing living pressures. Disciples no longer slept in dormitories and gained privacy, silently grateful to you.
你心知江湖正逢多事之秋，唐门飘摇如江上孤舟，仍在唐门会议提出雪山决行，辞别唐门。三师兄并没阻拦，不因你从前身份低微、一无是处而看轻你，不因你今日武功高强，备受倚重而挽留你，唐门外姓弟子，到底并非姓唐的人家，不必死守在唐家大院，而是另有重任。凡受过唐门恩惠可以立身者，皆当背负唐门意志，决行他乡，一如当日唐门敢犯天颜那般，不畏人言，毋忘铮铮傲骨，活好自己，总有一天还济困乏之人。肉身可以毁坏，香火可以被扑灭，唐门的意志，却必须永远传承。唐门最后一个外姓弟子发起决行，展翅离家之日已至，你终于道别了唐门。=\nKnowing the jianghu was in turbulent times and the Tang Sect was adrift like a lone boat, you still proposed the "Snow Mountain Resolution" at the clan meeting and bid farewell to the Tang Sect.\nThe Third Senior Brother didn't stop you. He didn't look down on you for your formerly low status and uselessness, nor did he retain you for your current martial prowess and importance. Outer-sect disciples of Tang were, after all, not of the Tang bloodline and didn't need to die guarding the Tang compound—they had other重任.\nAll who had received the Tang Sect's grace and could stand on their own should carry the Tang will,决行 to distant lands. Like the Tang Sect of old daring to defy heaven, fear no gossip, never forget their unyielding pride, live well, and one day aid those in need.\nFlesh may decay, lineage may be extinguished, but the will of Tang must be eternal.\nThe last outer-sect disciple of Tang initiated the resolution. The day to spread your wings and leave home had come; you finally said goodbye to the Tang Sect.

你鼓起勇气，于唐门家议时向掌门提出了去别派留学的请求。念你在派中多年，没有功劳亦有苦劳，掌门二话不说欣然便应允了。=\nMustering courage, you requested to study abroad at another sect during the Tang Sect meeting.\nConsidering your years of service, without merit there was still hard work, the Sect Leader agreed without hesitation.
二师兄对此不太赞同，不用想也知道，以你这品貌武功代表本门出去，一定会遭人笑话，但掌门既然发话，也只有遵从。=The Second Senior Brother disapproved. Needless to say, with your appearance and skills representing the clan, you'd be laughed at, but since the Sect Leader had spoken, he had to comply.
大师兄一听你要出门留学，立即闯入正心堂请命，非但没如他所愿，反而被指派接替你的工作，可谓是报应不爽，大快人心。=Hearing you were going abroad, the First Senior Brother burst into the Zhengxin Hall to volunteer. Instead of getting his wish, he was assigned to take over your duties—poetic justice, much to everyone's delight.
岂止你不舍小师妹，一听说你此去将有半年之久不回，小师妹心中也是说不清的不踏实，只是她明白父亲绝不放心她离家留学的。=It wasn't just you who was reluctant to part with the younger junior sister. Upon hearing you'd be gone for half a year, she also felt an indescribable unease, though she understood her father would never allow her to study away from home.
掌门特意为你修书四封，致崆峒派。这是由于崆峒派掌派人从缺，分由四位掌门分别领导的缘故。唐门与崆峒派交情说好不好，说坏不坏，平时也无交集。只是唐掌门以江湖地位而言，该与崆峒掌派人齐平，而崆峒四门掌门则稍矮一级，自然难以推辞唐门此请。待你收拾得当，便告辞师门下山，向崆峒山发进。此去路途遥远，四师兄怕你耽误日期，便替你张罗了一匹便宜瘦马，令你能加速赶路，有马代步，将行数日，你终于到了秦州崆峒派地界。=The Sect Leader specially wrote four letters for you to the Kongtong Sect.\nThis was because the Kongtong Sect lacked a sole Leader and was instead led by four separate heads.\nThe Tang Sect's relationship with Kongtong was neither good nor bad, with little usual interaction.\nBut given Sect Leader Tang's jianghu status, he should be equal to Kongtong's overall Leader, while the four Kongtong heads were slightly lower rank, making it hard to refuse this request.\nOnce packed, you bid farewell and headed for Mount Kongtong.\nThe journey was long. The Fourth Senior Brother, fearing delays, arranged a cheap skinny horse for you to speed up. Riding for days, you finally reached Kongtong territory in Qinzhou.
这一日你正在擦地，与练功场地板污渍苦战，四师兄急匆匆揪住了你，便往手里塞钱，要你替他下山，去田氏乡人家收购老牛，宰了转手卖掉，再提些上山加餐。=\nOne day, while scrubbing floors and battling stains in the training ground, the Fourth Senior Brother urgently grabbed you, shoved money into your hand, and tasked you with going down the mountain to the Tian family's farm to buy an old ox, slaughter it, resell it, and bring some back for meals.
孰料你携着钱财下山，找到田家，他们却又不肯卖了。卖牛云云，不过是家人吵架时说的气话罢了，那牛跟了跟他们一辈子，辛勤耕耘，养活一家老小，田氏小儿子嘴上不饶人的主儿，却也不忍鸟尽弓藏。=Unexpectedly, after going down with money, the Tian family refused to sell.\nSelling the ox was just angry words from a family argument. The ox had been with them for life, laboring hard to feed the family. Though the youngest Tian son had a sharp tongue, he couldn't bear to discard it after use.
你白跑一趟，怒上心头，当即便和人家起了口角。=Having made a wasted trip, anger rose, and you immediately got into a quarrel.
那田氏嘴力了得，可终究一介匹夫，对上三师兄那样满口仁义道德的君子，可以一通胡言强词夺理，对上你这缺德货色，却不管用了，被你几句抢白，气得回家抱着牛气到哭了。=The Tians were eloquent, but mere commoners. Against someone like the third senior brother—a moral gentleman—they could talk nonsense and argue, but against a unscrupulous person like you, it didn't work. A few retorts from you made him so angry he went home and cried while hugging the ox.
你闻言哑然，旋即付之一笑，对此结果喜闻乐见。那田氏小儿子见你笑了，心上过意不去，请你吃了一碗汤面，聊表歉意。你们坐田埂间，并肩吃面，就是升斗小民，也有人情。=Hearing this, you were speechless, then laughed, pleased with the outcome.\nSeeing you laugh, the youngest Tian son felt bad and treated you to a bowl of noodle soup as apology.\nSitting on the ridge eating noodles together—even commoners had their人情.
你下山一趟，不想空手而归，四处闲逛之时，碰上一处人群聚集，一问才知是李大夫门前来了一名求药的斗笠客，跪了一日一夜都不肯起来，犹如泥塑般，任打任骂亦分毫不动。李大夫亦非铁石心肠，只是他一路走来，见过的坏人太多，再也不肯轻信于人，何况他所求的丹药，乃是李大夫老年所倚，倘若轻易送让，他膝下无子女，将来谁又来奉养他？那斗笠客既然拿不出钱财，自然没有情面商量。=Not wanting to return empty-handed, while wandering, you encountered a crowd. Asking around, you learned a hat-wearing guest had been kneeling at Dr. Li's door for a day and night begging for medicine, unmoving like clay, enduring hits and insults.\nDr. Li wasn't heartless, but having seen too many bad people, he refused to trust easily. Moreover, the pill sought was his reliance in old age. If given away, with no children, who would support him? Since the guest had no money, there was no room for negotiation.
几度犹豫，最终毅然下定了决心。=After several hesitations, you finally resolved firmly.
你越众而出，介入此局。=You stepped forward from the crowd and intervened.
你与李大夫素来相熟，是商业伙伴。自唐门医馆收掉以后，二师兄所炼制的药物，便都放在李大夫医馆里托售，他是知道你唐门真本领的人，既有你出面，态度登时便软化了。取药出来，又嘱咐一番才算。=You were familiar with Dr. Li as business partners.\nAfter the Tang Clinic closed, the Second Senior Brother's medicines were sold on consignment at Dr. Li's clinic. He knew the Tang Sect's true skills, so with your involvement, his attitude softened immediately.\nHe retrieved the medicine and gave some instructions before concluding.
李大夫本就气急败坏，见了你这抢生意的唐门混蛋冒出头来充好人，更是气不打一处来，可是看在钱的份上，还是收了你的钱财作为订金。取药出来，又嘱咐一番才算。=Dr. Li was already furious; seeing you, a Tang Sect rival, playing the好人 made him even angrier. But for money's sake, he accepted your payment as deposit.\nHe retrieved the medicine and gave some instructions before concluding.
那斗笠客对你深深鞠躬，问了姓名便急着要走，见你毫不阻拦，又停住脚步，除下斗笠，自曝姓名。=The hat-wearing guest bowed deeply, asked your name, and was eager to leave. Seeing you didn't stop him, he paused, removed his hat, and revealed his name.
你默默退出人群，决定不去插手此事，本来与你无关，何必多管闲事。=You silently withdrew from the crowd, deciding not to get involved—it was none of your business anyway.
为了消磨时间，等待叶云舟归来，你决定找零工赚点快钱。=To pass time waiting for Ye Yunzhou's return, you decided to find odd jobs for quick cash.
正逢飞石帮急缺临时工，你便腆着脸上前搭话，差点没被人打。好在你做事尚算勤快，整日下来，也没偷懒，教飞石帮众对你唐门中人稍微改观了一点。=The Flying Stone Gang urgently needed temp workers. You厚着脸皮 approached, almost getting beaten.\nFortunately, you worked diligently without slacking all day, slightly improving the gang's opinion of Tang Sect members.
你毛遂自荐，加入了街头卖艺行列之中，露了一手轻功暗器，街坊邻居都争先来看，只因你未得师长传授，施展的武功似是而非，故而不受家法所限，许多乡人都是第一次见唐门中人显露武功，都大感惊奇，你虽是为了赚快钱，却无意间让师门名声传播开了。=You volunteered to join street performances, showcasing light footwork and hidden weapons. Neighbors rushed to watch. Since your skills were self-taught and not official teachings, they weren't bound by clan rules. Many villagers saw Tang skills for the first time and were amazed. Though for quick cash, you inadvertently spread your clan's reputation.
你毛遂自荐，加入了街头卖艺行列之中，心想自己好歹在唐门待了几年，就算不得传授，手法不精，好歹体魄也算过得去才是，便自告奋勇体验了胸口碎大石的把戏。一槌子下去，你当场口吐鲜血，乡人见状大惊失色，纷纷走避。那卖艺武师唯恐你有个三长两短，多塞了点钱给你，倘若你回家一命呜呼，念着他够仗义的份上，想必冤魂也不至于缠到他身上。=You volunteered to join street performances, thinking your years at Tang Sect meant decent physique despite lacking skill. You volunteered for chest-smashing.\nOne hammer strike made you spit blood on the spot. Villagers panicked and fled.\nThe performer, fearing for your life, gave you extra money, hoping that if you died, your ghost wouldn't haunt him out of gratitude for his righteousness.
为了消磨时间，等待叶云舟归来，你决定──什么也不干。难得无所事事，你度过了悠哉的一天。=To pass time waiting for Ye Yunzhou's return, you decided—to do nothing.\nRarely idle, you had a leisurely day.
夕阳西下，行人归家，眼看街上人烟逐渐寂寥，你怅然若失，唯恐自己是受人欺骗了。正当你心渐凉时，叶云舟便归来了。言道已喂他妹子服药，此刻药已见效，妹妹已不再发烧，这才放心回来寻你，备了几色小菜与酒水，邀你去他舟中共酌。你一口答应，齐赴船舟。黄汤入肚，驱散了寂夜寒江的冷清，意气相投，更平添几分豪情。交浅不必言深，且推杯换盏，你与叶云舟不深究彼此故事，只说论当今江湖事，诸般惆怅都抛诸脑后，于心细品江湖的醍醐味，心怀大畅。他文质彬彬，却酒量颇豪，一杯接一杯，直叫你不胜酒力，才蓦地想起一味敬酒，却忘了下酒的小菜，未免怠慢。于是便匆匆离席，取他日间打了晒制的野味去了。=As the sun set and people went home, the streets grew quiet. You felt a sense of loss, fearing you'd been deceived.\nJust as your heart cooled, Ye Yunzhou returned.\nHe said he'd fed his sister the medicine, which had taken effect—her fever broke—so he returned to find you, preparing dishes and wine, inviting you to his boat.\nYou agreed and went together. Wine warmed you against the cold river night; shared spirits added boldness. Without probing each other's pasts, you discussed jianghu affairs, casting aside sorrows, savoring the essence of the jianghu with joyful hearts.\nHe was refined but a heavy drinker, toasting repeatedly until you were overwhelmed. Suddenly remembering he'd forgotten snacks, he excused himself to fetch game he'd prepared earlier.
你出舱去吹风，隐约见到寂静岸边出现几点不寻常火光。与你一个照面，不速之客便跃上了船头，自称阎关三煞，将你当作叶云舟，客客气气的见礼。=Stepping out for air, you vaguely saw unusual lights on the quiet shore.\nUpon meeting you, the intruders leaped onto the boat, introducing themselves as the Three Yan Pass Killers, mistaking you for Ye Yunzhou, and greeting politely.
这三人乃是在地有名的恶霸，绝非好相与的，你听了心头一怵，已暗暗提防。=These three were local infamous bullies, not to be trifled with. Your heart trembled, and you grew wary.
你虽不知这三人是何来历，但看他们三人形貌剽悍，目露凶光，绝非善类，不禁心下惴惴。=Though unsure of their origins, their fierce looks and menacing eyes marked them as villains, making you uneasy.

原来当期快报特刊，刊的乃是武穆王宝藏重现江湖的消息。当年高宗皇帝听信奸臣秦桧所言，一心向金求和，连下十二道金牌召回岳飞，岳王爷心知大势已去，仍抗命违旨，五日之后，才从朱仙镇撤军，带了当地百姓随军南迁，安置在南方，才回京面圣。岳家军刚退兵，千辛万苦收复的河南州县，转眼又沦丧于宿敌金兀朮之手。然而，那违旨抗令的五日，究竟是为何呢？当真只是为了要『让朱仙镇百姓收拾家当』，随军南迁吗？江湖野史，与史官记述不同。=It turned out the special issue of the current Express published news of the reappearance of King Wumu's (Yue Fei's) treasure in the martial world.\nBack then, Emperor Gaozong, believing the words of the treacherous official Qin Hui, was一心向金求和 (intent on seeking peace with the Jin), issuing twelve gold medals in a row to recall Yue Fei.\nLord Yue knew the situation was hopeless but still disobeyed the order and decree. Five days later, he finally withdrew his troops from Zhuxian Town, taking local civilians with the army south, settling them in the south, before returning to the capital to see the Emperor.\nAs soon as the Yue Army retreated, the hard-won recovered prefectures and counties of Henan fell back into the hands of their old enemy, Wanyan Zongbi (Jin Wuzhu).\nHowever, what was the reason for those five days of disobeying the order and decree?\nWas it really only to 'let the people of Zhuxian Town pack their belongings' and migrate south with the army?\nThe martial world's unofficial histories differ from the official historians' records.
传说中，岳王爷自知必死，却没放弃，而是将反击的希望寄托于传人。五日之中，重铸阴符。命红篷王、曾文先生、张宪、岳云、徐庆等五人，将岳家军主力一分为五，易为百姓，随军南迁，散诸武林为侠为寇。那朱仙镇中的壮丁百姓，皆感召于大义，自请为替身。赤胆将士潜伏在野，只待贤臣清君侧，拨云见日，还朝廷一片清明气象，岳云再手持阴符，登高一呼，号召旧部，收复大好河山！然而，绝地反攻那一日始终没有到来。绍兴和议之后，金兀朮派遣使者密会秦桧，将岳飞与岳云害命于风波亭。宋终究亡了。而阴符失佚于江湖，五路部众及其后人有如孤魂野鬼，英魂至今徘徊。岳家宝藏，再也无人知晓下落。=Legend says Lord Yue knew he would die but did not give up. Instead, he placed his hope for a counterattack on his successors.\nWithin those five days, he recast the Yin Tallies. He ordered Red Sail King, Master Zeng Wen, Zhang Xian, Yue Yun, and Xu Qing—five men—to split the main force of the Yue Army into five parts, disguise them as civilians, migrate south with the army, and scatter them into the martial world to become knights or bandits.\nThe able-bodied men and civilians in Zhuxian Town were all moved by righteousness and volunteered to be substitutes.\nThe loyal soldiers lay hidden in the wild, waiting only for a virtuous minister to clear the court of evil, dispel the clouds to see the sun, and restore clarity to the imperial court. Then Yue Yun, holding the Yin Tallies, would stand high and call out, summoning the old troops to recover the great rivers and mountains!\nHowever, the day for the last stand counterattack never came.\nAfter the Shaoxing Peace Accord, Wanyan Zongbi (Jin Wuzhu) sent an envoy to secretly meet Qin Hui, resulting in the deaths of Yue Fei and Yue Yun at the Fengbo Pavilion.\nThe Song Dynasty ultimately fell.\nAnd the Yin Tallies were lost in the martial world. The five route troops and their descendants became like lonely ghosts, their heroic spirits wandering to this day.\nThe Yue family treasure's whereabouts became unknown to anyone.
而今悠悠八十载光阴流去，这江湖传说竟又死灰复燃。此刻江湖沸沸扬扬，都说点苍叶家兄妹的曾祖，乃是岳云旧部，临危受命，保管阴符与藏宝图。听云剑为证，至于藏宝图，则纹在其妹叶云裳身上，得之富可敌国。=Now, eighty long years have passed, and this martial world legend has actually been revived.\nCurrently, the martial world is abuzz, saying that the great-grandfather of the Ye siblings from Diancang was an old subordinate of Yue Yun, entrusted in a crisis to safeguard the Yin Tallies and the treasure map.\nThe Tingyun Sword is the proof, and as for the treasure map, it is tattooed on the body of his younger sister, Ye Yunshang. Obtaining it would bring wealth rivaling that of a state.
你此刻方始恍然大悟，为何叶云舟行走江湖要戴斗笠，低头掩人耳目，原来便是为此。=Only now did it dawn on you why Ye Yunzhou traveled the martial world wearing a bamboo hat, keeping his head down to avoid attention—it was precisely for this reason.
那日阎关三煞低声下气，欲窥叶姑娘胴体，并非单纯好色，而是为了确认藏宝图的传闻究竟真实与否。=That day, the Three Evils of Yanguan were so humble and meek, wanting to peek at Miss Ye's body, not simply out of lust, but to confirm whether the rumors about the treasure map were true or not.
这传闻虽然有趣，但你和三师兄却只当作是穿凿附会的故事看待，付之一笑。=Although this rumor was interesting, you and your Third Senior Brother only regarded it as a far-fetched story and laughed it off.
你将信将疑，三师兄不禁哑然失笑，细细剖析给你听，那朱仙镇除去老少女子，壮丁几何？只怕搬空了朱仙镇，也未必能够填充五路部将的空额。何况八十年过去，就算真有宝藏，也早被岳家后人取走。你听了，这才释然。=You were half-believing, half-doubting. Third Senior Brother couldn't help but chuckle wryly and analyzed it for you in detail: How many able-bodied men were in Zhuxian Town, excluding the old, young, and women? Even if they emptied Zhuxian Town, it might not fill the vacancies of the five route generals.\nBesides, eighty years have passed. Even if there really was a treasure, it would have long been taken by Yue's descendants.\nHearing this, you were finally relieved.
四师兄碰巧回来，听见你们在说这事，也凑了过来。那叶家兄妹人在蜀中的消息，不知怎的走漏了。四师兄这一趟下山走商，到处都听人谈论武穆王宝藏。四师兄贪财，却没把这事放心上，因为压根就不信。旁人却不见得清醒，人皆爱财，一听闻叶云舟带着自家小妹逃离点苍，本来不信的，也都纷纷起了疑心。道听途说、穿凿附会者众，真金虽不怕火炼，却怕三人成虎，金子也给吞落肚。子虚乌有的传闻都被传得煞有其事，霎时掀起一波江湖风雨。提刀明抢者有之，捅窗暗窥者有之，还有人盯上了叶云裳，一派正气凛然的模样，假意主持公道，实则是想博得美人芳心，把人给娶了，到时不是鱼与熊掌兼得，爱怎看就怎看吗？=Fourth Senior Brother happened to return and, hearing you discussing this, also came over.\nThe news that the Ye siblings were in Shu (Sichuan) had somehow leaked. On this trip down the mountain for business, Fourth Senior Brother heard people everywhere discussing King Wumu's treasure.\nFourth senior brother is greedy for wealth but didn't take this matter to heart because he simply didn't believe it. Others, however, weren't necessarily so clear-headed. Everyone loves wealth. Upon hearing that Ye Yunzhou had taken his younger sister and fled Diancang, even those who originally didn't believe it began to grow suspicious.\nThere were many who heard rumors and made far-fetched connections. While true gold isn't afraid of fire, it fears 'three men make a tiger'—even gold can be swallowed. Baseless rumors were spread as if they were real, instantly stirring up a storm in the martial world.\nSome came with drawn swords to openly rob, others stabbed windows to secretly peek. There were even those who targeted Ye Yunshang, putting on a righteous and awe-inspiring act, pretending to uphold justice, but actually wanting to win the beauty's favor and marry her. Wouldn't that be like having both fish and bear's paw? Then they could look as they pleased.
你听了眉头一皱，那软软糯糯的叶小妹子可是娇声喊过你哥哥的。如今给旁人惦记上了，还想算计她，总觉得心里不大痛快。=Hearing this, you frowned. That soft and sweet little sister Ye had cutely called you 'brother'.\nNow that others were eyeing her and even trying to算计 (scheme against) her, you felt rather displeased.
这一日你下山到镇上，到了食时，便如往常一般转进客栈里，想叫一碗面充饥，没想到这间小小客栈居然高朋满座，不仅坐无虚席，甚至有人盘坐在地上喝酒。=This day, you went down the mountain to the town. At meal time, you turned into the inn as usual, wanting to order a bowl of noodles to satisfy your hunger. To your surprise, this small inn was packed with distinguished guests. Not only was there not an empty seat, some people were even sitting cross-legged on the floor drinking.
你还道是有什么新奇菜式，没忘了小师妹，想着反正山下事情都办完了，正要回去，若是价钱不贵，又都是邻居，不妨借个食盒打包上山献献殷勤。却没想到这些人都是醉翁之意不在酒，没人冲着吃饭来的。=You thought there might be some novel dishes. Not forgetting your junior sister, and thinking that since your business downhill was done anyway and you were about to return, if the price wasn't high and they were neighbors, you might as well borrow a food box to pack something and take it up the mountain to殷勤 (show attentiveness).\nLittle did you expect these people were all 'the drinker's heart is not in the cup'—no one was here for the food.
地上一名乞丐听见小二与你说话，主动过来接过话茬儿，你自不知他是为了报答那好心小二，不单没驱赶，还斟上一壶热茶。=A beggar on the floor heard the waiter talking to you and主动 (initiatively) came over to pick up the conversation. You didn't know he was repaying the kind waiter, who not only didn't drive him away but also poured him a pot of hot tea.
你定睛一看，登时便认出来人。可不就是大义分舵的姓花的叫化子吗？旁人认不出他来，就像旁人认不出你来同样的道理，一看就不是什么值得用心记住的脸。至于你认出他来，也像他认出你来，那是抢菜打架打出的交情，非比寻常。=You looked closely and immediately recognized the person.\nWasn't it that beggar named Hua from the Dayi Branch?\nOthers couldn't recognize him, just like others couldn't recognize you—the same principle. At first glance, it wasn't a face worth remembering carefully.\nAs for you recognizing him, it was like him recognizing you—a friendship forged from fighting over food,非同寻常 (out of the ordinary).
问明了事情，才知道这许多人把小小地方客栈挤得水泄不通，都是为了那叶家兄妹来的。风声传开，越来越多人围聚，叶家兄妹东躲西藏也摆脱不了跟踪，索性不走了，一口气结了几日房钱，就此住下，以逸待劳，让这些贪图宝藏的人互相牵制，只有迫不得已碰见莽夫意图强闯，才会拔剑退敌，据悉已住了好一阵子，每天都有人献殷勤抑或威逼利诱。=After asking and clarifying the matter, you realized so many people crowding this small local inn were all here for the Ye siblings. News had spread, and more and more people gathered. The Ye siblings, hiding east and west, couldn't shake off the tracking, so they simply stopped leaving. They paid for several days' lodging in one go and settled in, resting while the enemy labored, letting these treasure-coveting people check each other. Only when absolutely necessary, encountering rash men trying to force their way in, would they draw their swords to repel the enemy. It's said they had been staying for quite a while, with people every day either献殷勤 (showing attentiveness) or威逼利诱 (using threats and inducements).
又和姓花的乞丐吵嘴几句，他们才自承来意，大义分舵确实是受命于帮主，为了宝藏来的，但他们帮主压根不信有宝藏存在，只怕这谣言害了忠良之后，才派人来暗中盯着，轻易不出手，只在夺宝客们商议之际，冷言冷语挑拨离间，令他们各自心怀鬼胎不能团结而已。必要时也替叶家兄妹把贼人打退，虽然没宝藏，讨些普通赏钱却是可以。=After bickering a few more words with the beggar named Hua, they finally admitted their purpose. The Dayi Branch was indeed ordered by the帮主 (gang Leader) to come for the treasure, but their gang Leader simply didn't believe the treasure existed. He was only afraid the rumor would harm the descendants of loyal officials, so he sent people to secretly keep an eye out. They wouldn't act轻易 (easily), only when treasure hunters were discussing, they would make cold, sarcastic remarks to sow discord, making them each harbor evil designs and unable to unite.\nWhen necessary, they would also help the Ye siblings fight off thieves. Although there was no treasure, they could ask for some ordinary reward money.
正说话间，又有个不长眼的上楼挑战，被踢下楼来。=Right in the middle of talking, another fool who didn't know better came upstairs to challenge and was kicked back down.
你料你那叶兄弟武功高强，犯不着你来强出头。你在店门口挨着，静观其变，且听周遭众人如何议论。=You figured your Brother Ye had high martial skills; there was no need for you to force yourself to step forward.\nYou lingered by the shop entrance, watching calmly and waiting to see how things developed, listening to how the people around were discussing.
山中岁月十年如一日，不出点乱子可说乏味得很，这种热闹可不常有，哪能错过。你在店门口挨着不走，且听周遭众人如何议论。=Days in the mountains are all the same; without some trouble, it's quite dull. This kind of excitement isn't common, how could you miss it?\nYou lingered by the shop entrance, not leaving, listening to how the people around were discussing.
你心中颇不以为然，若你所向无敌，当然要插手管一管。可惜你很脆弱，所向皆敌，路边野狗壮一点、凶一点的多来几条，你都未必能赢。这么多人，等下万一打起来，刀剑无眼，你是铁定要没命的。反正无论宝藏是真是假，都没你的份，无端赔命才是真的。这种热闹还是不凑为妙，避远些，早点回家才是正经。=You rather disapproved in your heart. If you were invincible, of course you would intervene. Unfortunately, you are very fragile; everywhere you go, you encounter enemies. If a few more strong, fierce stray dogs came at you on the roadside, you might not win.\nWith so many people, if a fight breaks out later, blades and swords have no eyes; you would definitely lose your life.\nAnyway, whether the treasure is real or fake, you have no share in it. Dying for no reason is the real deal. It's better not to join this kind of excitement. Keep your distance and go home early is the proper thing to do.
有人毫不讳言，提着兵刃上楼，明抢来着。叶云舟也不是孤军奋战，昔日闯荡江湖结交的朋友们都自告奋勇守卫叶家小妹，只是异常热切，讨好谄媚之意表露无遗，唯恐落于人后，从前一口一个兄弟的，如今都互相攻讦，不肯让人专美于前。叶云舟何尝不知他们的主意，无话可说，惟有心寒而已。话都还没说开，又有人结伙上楼挑战，那两个江湖少侠见猎心喜，表现机会来了，登时就替叶云舟接了阵。来挑战的还有一人，他听叶云舟江湖名声很好，都赞他宛如山上松树苍劲，不畏冰霜凄惨，终岁常端正，不骄不躁，谦冲自牧。是以吃软怕硬，嚣张得很，想凶几句来个下马威。殊不知叶云舟连日所见所闻，皆是贪婪嘴脸、满口子兄弟的腻耳谄媚声，心寒至极，对熟人尚且还能客套，对这等不相熟却不怀好意欺上门的，更无半分耐性。听云剑出鞘入鞘，转身进房，那人还兀自不知自己已经死了，说了几句话都没异样，直到他动身想跟随进房，脑袋才搬家，咕噜噜滚下楼梯。叶云舟杀了人，不愿再给店家添麻烦，背着妹妹，跳窗从窗户走了。店中武林人争先恐后涌出店去，你也身不由己被冲到街上。=Some people spoke without any concealment, carrying weapons upstairs to openly rob.\nYe Yunzhou wasn't fighting alone either. Friends he made in his past travels through the martial world all volunteered to guard his younger sister. They were just excessively eager, their intention to flatter and curry favor completely exposed, afraid of falling behind others. Those who used to call each other 'brother' now attacked each other, unwilling to let others steal the spotlight.\nHow could Ye Yunzhou not know their intentions? He had nothing to say, only a heart grown cold.\nBefore things could even be discussed, another group came upstairs to challenge. Those two young martial heroes, seeing prey and feeling joy, their chance to perform had come, immediately accepted the challenge on Ye Yunzhou's behalf.\nThere was another person coming to challenge. He had heard Ye Yunzhou had a great reputation in the martial world, praised as being like a sturdy pine on the mountain, unafraid of bitter frost, upright all year round, neither arrogant nor impatient, modest and self-possessed. So, bullying the weak and fearing the strong, he acted quite arrogantly, wanting to say a few fierce words to assert dominance.\nLittle did he know, what Ye Yunzhou had seen and heard these past days were all greedy faces and the cloying, flattering sounds of 'brother' this and 'brother' that. His heart was extremely cold. He could still be polite to acquaintances, but towards this kind of unfamiliar person with ill intentions coming to his door, he had not an ounce of patience. The Tingyun Sword left and returned to its sheath. He turned and entered the room. That person still didn't know he was already dead. He said a few words without any issue, until he moved to follow into the room, then his head parted from his body, tumbling down the stairs.\nYe Yunzhou killed someone and, unwilling to cause more trouble for the innkeeper, carried his sister on his back and jumped out the window, leaving through the window.\nThe martial artists in the inn争先恐后 (vied with each other) to rush out of the inn. You were also swept involuntarily onto the street.
本来这些人都提防彼此，剑拔弩张，随时都有可能动上手，只因利之所趋，处于绝妙平衡，如今出门不见叶云舟踪影，气急败坏，登时便内哄起来，大打出手，你也被卷如其中。=Originally, these people were wary of each other, tensions high, ready to fight at any moment. 你与叶家兄妹虽是萍水相逢，但也一度迫不得已舍命相陪，如今也不能冷眼旁观，让他孤军奋战。殊不料叶云舟根本不是孤军奋战，昔日闯荡江湖结交的朋友们都自告奋勇守卫叶家小妹，只是异常热切，讨好谄媚之意表露无遗，唯恐落于人后，从前一口一个兄弟的，如今都互相攻讦，不肯让人专美于前。听说叶云舟欠着你钱，更不打话，硬是往你手里塞了一把铜钱，还道自己大方。叶云舟何尝不知他们的主意，无话可说，惟有心寒而已。话都还没说开，又有人结伙上楼挑战，一把将你推开，那两个江湖少侠见猎心喜，表现机会来了，登时就替叶云舟接了阵。来挑战的还有一人，来时嚣张得很，一见叶云舟冷冽眼色，登时心怯，眼珠子咕噜一转，居然向你攻去，想着先打死你个喽啰下马威，为自己壮壮胆也好。=Although your meeting with the Ye siblings was brief, you once had no choice but to risk your life with them. Friends he made in his past travels through the martial world all volunteered to guard his younger sister. 你大战一番，赶走敌人，回头才发现房门虚掩，叶家兄妹已经不知所踪，听人呼喊，才知道叶云舟背着妹妹，跳窗从窗户走了。=After a big fight, driving away the enemy, you turned back to find the room door ajar. The Ye siblings were already gone. 你找到机会脱困，总算没在兵荒马乱中丢了小命。=You found a chance to escape and finally didn't lose your life in the chaos of battle.
给卷入乱斗也不能说完全没有好处，你恶向胆边生，别人在打架，你在抢钱，也不知是谁带了满满一袋钱财，全给你夺了过来，这当儿多半都还没发现钱不见了。=Being卷入 (swept into) the chaotic fight couldn't be said to have no benefits at all. Your恶向胆边生 (evil thoughts arose). 一听三师兄说，才知道是外堡出了乱子，吕翁上山求助。一如大多数的江湖案件，起因都小得令人发指，偏生江湖人血器旺盛，一口气不顺，越争越着恼，恼起来就能提刀杀人，便是道人、和尚亦难免俗。何况这回还是僧人和丐帮弟子争夺布施，争的还不止一口气，还有一口饭呢。=Hearing from the Third Senior Brother, you learned that there was trouble at the outer fort, and Elder Lü came up the mountain to seek help.\nLike most Jianghu incidents, the cause was shockingly trivial. Yet Jianghu folk are hot-blooded; a single grievance can escalate into fury, and in their anger, they'll draw blades and kill—even Daoists and monks were no exception.\nEspecially since this time it was monks and Beggars' Sect disciples fighting over alms; they weren't just fighting over pride, but over a meal.

一听三师兄说，才知道是外堡出了乱子，吕翁上山求助。一如大多数的江湖案件，起因都小得令人发指，偏生江湖人血气旺盛，一口气不顺，越争越着恼，恼起来就能提刀杀人，便是道人、和尚亦难免俗。何况这回还是僧人和丐帮弟子争夺布施，争的还不止一口气，还有一口饭呢。=Hearing from the Third Senior Brother, you learned that there was trouble at the outer fort, and Elder Lü came up the mountain to seek help.\nLike most Jianghu incidents, the cause was shockingly trivial. 劝架、和事佬，这是南宫世家的本职，吕翁却找上唐门，你怎么想都觉得不安。=Mediating disputes and peacemaking—that's the specialty of the Nangong Family. Yet Old Man Lü came to the Tang Sect. However you thought about it, it felt unsettling.
和事佬是南宫世家的本职，吕翁却找上唐门，那敢情好，你唐门也有唐门劝架的手段。=Peacemaking is the Nangong Family's job, but if Old Man Lü came to the Tang Sect, well then—your Tang Sect has its own ways of settling disputes.
你唐门的手段就是战他娘亲。人与人一旦吃饱太闲就会内讧，但是面对天灾反会团结。要让丐帮弟子和嵩山僧人和好，最容易的方法莫过于转移矛盾，为此唐门义不容辞化身天灾。=The Tang Sect's method is to fight their mother.\nWhen people are well-fed and idle, they tend to infight, but when facing a natural disaster, they unite.\nTo reconcile the Beggars' Sect disciples and the Songshan monks, the easiest method is to redirect the conflict. For this, the Tang Sect unhesitatingly化身 (transforms into) a natural disaster.
三师兄什么的根本控制不住情况。=The Third Senior Brother and others simply couldn't control the situation.
只得托你去劝住自己人，他则去和肇事根源理论。=He had no choice but to ask you to restrain your own people while he went to reason with the source of the trouble.
然而你把他说的话当耳边风，转头就和师兄弟们同仇敌慨。=Yet you treated his words as wind past your ears and immediately joined your fellow disciples in united hatred.
你只得硬着头皮，冒着被同门打死的风险，站到对立面去。=You had no choice but to grit your teeth, risk being beaten to death by your comrades, and stand on the opposing side.
你们擅自介入，人家真就把恩怨抛诸脑后，同仇敌慨战你唐门。三师兄正愁不知如何收场，忽闻有人放火，更是惊慌失措。好在三方人马都是侠义中人，一见百姓有难，立时就化干戈为玉帛，齐心协力救火。=You intervened without authorization, and the others truly set aside their grudges, uniting in hatred to fight your Tang Sect.\nThe Third Senior Brother was already worried about how to end the situation when he suddenly heard someone had set a fire, panicking even more.\nFortunately, all three groups were righteous people. Seeing the common folk in danger, they immediately turned their weapons into tools of peace and worked together to put out the fire.
你在混战之中丧命，成为唯一牺牲者。=You lost your life in the chaotic battle, becoming the sole casualty.
你们擅自介入，人家真就把恩怨抛诸脑后，同仇敌慨战你唐门。三师兄正愁不知如何收场，忽闻有人放火，更是惊慌失措。好在三方人马都是侠义中人，一见百姓有难，立时就化干戈为玉帛，齐心协力救火。=You intervened without authorization, and the others truly set aside their grudges, uniting in hatred to fight your Tang Sect.\nThe Third Senior Brother was already worried about how to end the situation when he suddenly heard someone had set a fire, panicking even more.\nFortunately, all three groups were righteous people. Seeing the common folk in danger, they immediately turned their weapons into tools of peace and worked together to put out the fire.
追究起当时肇事责任，元凶二人都面露苦色，一时不知从何说起。当时一僧一丐抢饼属实，但福韫和尚抢李富贵的饼却颇有深意。并非霸凌，反是藉此为丐帮洗刷污名，好让街坊邻居都来看看：丐帮的豪杰便是饿肚子，依然严守侠义，断然不肯恃强欺民。本来堪为一桩美谈，但被有心人士借题发挥，故意挑拨。经那晁和走动，在嵩山僧人面前痛斥丐帮恶行；向丐帮人马诬告嵩山子弟。终于酿成大祸。那人遇事窝囊，没他的事就会立马变得嚣张。其实他挑唆两方争斗，完全没考虑后果，动机着实肤浅，纯粹只是看你不爽，想害你名声扫地而已。为此无论死多少人他都不痛不痒，反正到时追究起来也是你顶罪，便到了阎王座前，他也会抵死否认这些人命与他无关，都要怪你。=When追究 (investigating) the responsibility for the incident, the two main culprits looked pained, unsure where to begin.\nIt was true that a monk and a beggar fought over a flatbread, but Monk Fu Yun's snatching of Li Fugui's bread had deeper meaning.\nIt wasn't bullying; rather, it was an attempt to cleanse the Beggars' Sect's reputation, letting the neighbors see: even when starving, the heroes of the Beggars' Sect strictly uphold righteousness and absolutely refuse to bully the common people with their strength.\nIt could have been a fine story, but someone with ulterior motives seized on it and deliberately stirred up trouble.\nThrough Chao He's machinations—denouncing the Beggars' Sect's evils to the Songshan monks and falsely accusing Songshan disciples to the Beggars' Sect members—a disaster was finally brewed.\nThat guy is cowardly when trouble hits, but becomes arrogant instantly when he's not involved. Actually, he instigated the conflict between the two sides without any consideration for the consequences. His motive was utterly shallow, purely because he disliked you and wanted to ruin your reputation.\nNo matter how many died because of it, he felt nothing. After all, when追究 (investigation) came, you would take the blame. Even before the King of Hell, he would stubbornly deny any connection to those deaths—all blame would fall on you.
矛头指向你，你简直说不出的委屈，要是你干的也索罢了，可你没捞到一点好处还受冤枉，这怎么行？=With the finger pointed at you, you felt indescribably wronged. If you had done it, fine, but you gained no benefit and were still falsely accused—how could this be?
矛头指向你，你简直说不出的委屈，身受诸般苦，始终想做好人，结果就是这种报应？=With the finger pointed at you, you felt indescribably wronged. Having endured all kinds of hardships, always trying to be a good person, and this is the repayment you get?
幸好三师兄明理，一想就觉得事有蹊跷，犯案还刻意留名，这手法听着有点熟悉，莫不是那惯犯忘了自己人在蜀中，又想故技重施，栽赃于你？=Fortunately, the Third Senior Brother was reasonable. Upon reflection, he found the matter suspicious. Committing a crime and deliberately leaving a name—this method sounded familiar. Could it be that repeat offender forgot he was in Shu (Sichuan) and tried to use his old trick again, framing you?

因为无人伤亡，其实此事可大可小，被冤枉的还是无足轻重的你。晁和料定没人会为你出头，等他先躲几天避避风头，等事过境迁大家气都消了再若无其事的出现就好，就算非有人追究，他大不了就哭一场、自搧巴掌，难道还能要他性命不成？他所料其实大差不差，大伙都怕麻烦，只要抵死不认，唐门总不能屈打成招。唐门按门规，确实是不能将人屈打成招，若无铁证，掌刑使也拿他没辄。好在他自己作死，自以为聪明无视号令，无故三度传唤不到，等若蔑视掌门，犯了不敬之罪，二师兄才得名正言顺出手将他捉拿回山。那晁和以为大隐隐于市，唐门若想用强，他就滚地上哭闹让街坊邻居都来指指点点，殊不知辣手相公绝非浪得虚名，这招对二师兄来说丁点屁用也无，当街将他双手双脚以分筋错骨手法折断，又花铜钱雇人将他绑缚提回山上。晁和认的干娘唐小楼听闻噩耗，丢下自家生意，匆匆阻拦，可任凭她怎么说，二师兄就是软硬不吃，由着她一路跟到山上，闯进正心堂，向掌门告状。她声泪俱下，控诉你和二师兄如何凶残霸道，污蔑她的干儿子，求掌门作主，将你和二师兄废去武功，逐出师门。可如是诳言，掌门又不昏聩，如何能信？破格将晁和收入门墙，已是顾念同门之情，断不能容她放肆颠倒是非。只是他太重情义，想起旧年种种，终究狠不下心肠。唯有自身代犯人晁和受过，以掌门之尊向掌行使请罚。唐小楼向来对人不对事，最是徇私，膝下无子，认了这个嘴甜的干儿，盼他将来替自己养老送终，才会宠在心尖上，可是掌门又如何不是她旧年一同学艺、一同长大的亲人呢。别人说什么正理相劝，她也只当放屁，直到掌门为她任性而伤，才终于清醒一点。出正心堂门，又见晁和一把鼻涕一把泪，刚把手脚接回去，就问她有没有把你和二师兄都赶出唐门？顿时气不打一处来，一巴掌搧到脸上。她对自己人心软得很，见他又哭了起来，也不禁心疼，好声好气的哄着，带下山去，可也暗下决心，这是最后一回。那晁和身为始作俑者最终全身而退，反是丐帮李富贵、嵩山福韫二人于心有愧，在外堡住了下来，协助修复外堡一切打砸、烧毁的器物。=Since no one was killed or injured, this matter could have been big or small, and the one being wronged was ultimately you; someone of little consequence.\nChao He was certain that no one would stand up for you. His plan was simple: lie low for a few days, let the storm pass, and once everyone had cooled down, reappear as if nothing had happened.Even if someone insisted on holding him accountable, at worst he would throw a crying fit and slap himself a few times; surely they wouldn't go so far as to demand his life?\nHis prediction was mostly accurate. Everyone dreaded trouble, and as long as he adamantly denied everything, the Tang Sect couldn't exactly force a confession under torture. According to the sect's rules, indeed, they could not extract confessions by coercion. Without irrefutable evidence, even the Punishment Enforcer could do nothing to him.\nFortunately for justice, his own arrogance proved his undoing. Thinking himself clever, he ignored orders and failed to appear when summoned. Failing to appear three times without reason was tantamount to contempt for the Sect Leader, an offense of disrespect. Only then did Second Senior Brother have legitimate grounds to act, apprehending him and bringing him back to the mountain.\nChao He had thought that hiding in plain sight was his best strategy. If the Tang Sect tried to use force, he would throw himself on the ground, wailing and crying, making a scene for the neighbors to gossip about. But no matter what she said, Second Senior Brother remained unmoved, neither swayed by soft words nor intimidated by harsh ones. Recalling the bonds of years past, he ultimately could not harden his heart. And so, he chose to bear the punishment on behalf of the offender Chao He, humbling himself before the Punishment Enforcer despite his status as the Sect Leader.\nTang Xiaolou had always been one to judge people rather than principles, the most biased of souls. Having no children of her own, she had adopted this sweet-tongued boy in hopes he would care for her in her old age and tend to her funeral rites; thus she doted on him endlessly. But wasn't the Sect Leader also her family, someone who trained and grew up with her since childhood?\nNo matter how others tried to reason with her, she dismissed their words as fart. Only when the Sect Leader was hurt by her willfulness did she finally regain some clarity.\nLeaving the Zhengxin Hall, she saw Chao He, a mess of tears and snot, just after his limbs were reset, asking if she had managed to expel you and the Second Senior Brother from the Tang Sect. A surge of anger welled up within her, and she slapped him across the face.\nSoft-hearted as she was toward those she cared about, seeing him cry again made her heart ache despite everything. She coaxed him with gentle words and took him down the mountain—but in her heart, she silently resolved that this would be the last time.\nThat Chao He, the instigator, ultimately escaped unscathed. Instead, the Beggars' Sect's Li Fugui and Songshan's Fu Yun, feeling guilty, chose to stay at the outer fort to help repair all the smashed and burned fixtures.

The Flying Hero travels a thousand miles.

At the height of the battle, with one kick each, you knock all the thieves down.\nAt that moment, a deafening roar suddenly echoes, shaking the dust off the beams. The thieves seize the chaos to escape and regroup on the training ground.
师兄的用心良苦，你未必不知，只是路太远、夜太深、心太凉，走不动了。于是默默借了一盏灯，独行下山。师兄姊们见着灯火远去，掩在树影之后消失无踪，均只暗暗叹了一口气，不再阻拦。=You are not necessarily unaware of Senior Brother's good intentions; it's just that the road is too long, the night too deep, and your heart too cold—you can't walk anymore.\nSo you silently borrow a lantern and descend the mountain alone.\nYour senior brothers and sisters watch the lantern light fade into the distance, disappearing behind the shadows of trees. They all just sigh softly to themselves and no longer try to stop you.
你一路小心翼翼远离唐门，还不忘回去割山猪肉，抹赤炼砂盐腌防腐，远游路上还能充饥，在无人茶肆将就着对付了一晚上，打算天明再起行。=You carefully make your way far from the Tang Sect, even remembering to go back and cut some wild boar meat, rubbing it with red refined sand salt to preserve it. It can stave off hunger on your long journey. You make do for the night at an unmanned tea stall, planning to set off again at dawn.
你一路小心翼翼远离唐门，在无人茶肆将就着对付了一晚上，打算天明再起行。=You carefully make your way far from the Tang Sect, make do for the night at an unmanned tea stall, and plan to set off again at dawn.
你早已习惯餐风露宿，何况操劳一夜，身心俱疲，睡得老沉。小师妹和叶云裳欺近身边，你都没分毫知觉，又给叶云裳拿棍子无情戳醒。叶云裳和小师妹见你勃然大怒跳将起来，反而面露喜色。昨夜唐门一场恶战，唐门有所防备，宵小未能占得先机，功败垂成，四处流窜，小师妹不假思索飞身追击，一路放倒数人，回头却是一愕，已经认不得来路。当时出门太急，连一盏灯笼也没带，在家也不会无端把火折子揣在怀里，眼看山林一片漆黑，似有鬼影幢幢，不由得心下害怕。正无措之际，就听见叶云裳微弱的哭声，连忙循声过去会合，两人相见喜极而泣。原来叶云裳一见小师妹出门，就料到她一定又要迷路，连忙出门去寻，不料一跤扑倒，滚下矮坡，灯笼熄灭了，自己也迷失了方向。两人找不到路回家，相依偎着熬了一夜，天亮了辨明道路，走到中途，就见你死在地上，一时两人又骇又悲，还道你英勇追击，命丧于贼人之手，浑没想到你只是睡着了。你虽去意已决，但又不能丢下两个小妹子不管，只好一手牵一个，带她们回家。=You are long accustomed to weathering the wind and dew, and after toiling all night, both body and mind are exhausted, so you sleep deeply.\nLittle Junior Sister and Ye Yunshang approach your side, yet you have no awareness at all, and are once again ruthlessly poked awake by Ye Yunshang with a stick.\nSeeing you leap up in a rage, Ye Yunshang and Little Junior Sister instead show joyful expressions.\nLast night, the Tang Sect had a fierce battle. Prepared, the Sect prevented the villains from gaining the initiative. Thwarted, they fled in all directions. Little Junior Sister, without a second thought, flew into pursuit, taking down several people along the way. But when she looked back, she was startled—she no longer recognized the way back. She had left in too much of a hurry, without even bringing a lantern, and at home, she wouldn't normally carry a fire starter in her bosom. Seeing the mountain forest pitch black, seemingly filled with ghostly shadows, she couldn't help but feel afraid.\nJust as she was at a loss, she heard Ye Yunshang's faint crying. 你早已习惯餐风露宿，何况操劳一夜，身心俱疲，睡得老沉。小师妹悄无声息来到你身畔，盯了半晌，你都毫无知觉。原来昨夜唐门一场恶战，唐门有所防备，宵小未能占得先机，功败垂成，四处流窜，小师妹不假思索飞身追击，一路放倒数人，回头却是一愕，已经认不得来路。当时出门太急，连一盏灯笼也没带，在家也不会无端把火折子揣在怀里，眼看山林一片漆黑，似有鬼影幢幢，不由得心下害怕，就着稀薄月光在山里到处游荡，为了认路做记号，把树都刨秃了依然辨不清方向，最后只得学大师兄飞身上树，抱着粗枝小睡一会儿，直到天亮才下地行走。走到中途，就见你躺在地上，一时又惊又喜，不禁暗叹命运之奇，好似她每一次彷徨无措，都会有你走进黑暗里，牵她回家。你虽去意已决，但又不能丢下她不管，只好又再食言一回。=You are long accustomed to weathering the wind and dew, and after toiling all night, both body and mind are exhausted, so you sleep deeply.\nLittle Junior Sister comes silently to your side and stares for a long while, yet you remain completely unaware.\nIt turns out that last night, the Tang Sect had a fierce battle. 你提心吊胆，唯恐迎面和贼人碰上，可惜屋漏偏逢连夜雨，当真是怕什么来什么，那行人看到山林之中隐有火光，上前察探，把你逮个正着。=You proceed with trepidation, fearing nothing more than running into the thieves head-on. 问你何以不告而别、人马何在？你又拙于言词，支支吾吾说不出所以然来，如何能教他们不心生疑窦？这可是赌命的勾当，容不得半点差池，于是众人互相一使眼色，同时出手将你制住，严刑拷打。你禁受不住折磨，已为师门虚掷十年光阴，如今还来报讯，已经仁至义尽。如今即将远行不甘再为无情的唐门枉送性命，当下便将事情经过，连同自己的际遇也一并供出，比起求饶，其实更似满腔牢骚不吐不快。那干人等出身绿林，干的都是没本钱买卖，可是胸有血性，听说你这般不容易，心有戚戚焉，饶是不能轻饶你的，但也不想赶尽杀绝，于是打断了你双脚，令你自生自灭。你强忍剧痛，下毒麻痹伤处，又折树枝绑缚断腿，几度痛晕痛醒，匍匐下山求救，唯恐唐门追究，顾不得伤势沉重，逃亡也似的雇车远远逃开，一生躲躲藏藏，终日惶惶。后来伤腿养好，可你的骨气打从骨头断掉的那一刻，就烟消云散了。=They ask why you left without saying goodbye and where your men are.\nYou are inarticulate, hemming and hawing without giving a clear reason, which inevitably makes them suspicious. 问你何以不告而别、人马何在？你想不出妥善说词，好在脸皮够厚，吹起牛皮来连你自己都信，扬言自己一人足矣。众人面面相觑，倒也不是不知你自信何来，谁没年轻过呢？混江湖的，谁都有三分血性，几多少侠初出茅庐，自以为无所不能，动辄夸口以一当百，然而江湖从来不是儿戏，越是猖狂的，往往死的越快，偶尔会有几个得天独厚的幸存下来，一战成名，而且那些人大多长得帅。观你面相，似是个极端短命的款，长得难看还没有自觉，明年今天八成是你忌日。想到这里，众人不约而同面露同情之色，不再相劝，只在心底默默尊重祝福。=They ask why you left without saying goodbye and where your men are.\nYou can't think of a proper explanation, but fortunately, your skin is thick enough. You boast so extravagantly that you even believe it yourself, declaring that you alone are sufficient.\nEveryone looks at each other, not entirely unaware of the source of your confidence—who hasn't been young?\nEveryone in the Jianghu has a bit of fiery spirit. 问你何以不告而别、人马何在？你武功不行，可是擅长狡辩，心念电闪之间，已有计较。坦言相告，你的人全都在唐门，既然都要冒充名门正派，为何不能是唐门？反正唐门广收门徒，你不妨把手底下的弟兄全都派去拜师，光明正大学他唐门的武功、吃他唐门的米饭。待到行动之日，便是倒戈之时！众人闻言色变，想破庙相见之初，就觉得你这人敢在蜀中乔扮唐门弟子，未免大胆。万万没想到，你竟还脸皮厚到把人派去拜师，如此心机、胆识，令这群聚啸山林的悍匪不约而同心生敬畏之情。=They ask why you left without saying goodbye and where your men are.\nYour martial arts are poor, but you excel at sophistry. That servant, A Ji, stubbornly refused to accept defeat, but the facts were before his eyes: surrounded by enemies on all sides, the situation was hopeless. 吉时一至，上官家主命人擂鼓，自往中间一站，大义凛然，侃侃而谈。想方今之世，内忧外患交煎，外有金贼虎视眈眈，内有魔教居心叵测，江湖之危，等若中原之危，是大宋之危，更是江山社稷之危。我辈中人以侠义自居，安忍坐视黎民百姓身陷水火？为了博采众议，未雨绸缪，才召开武林大会，广邀天下豪杰云集在此。纵使知道上官家主言之有理，可是冰冻三尺，非一日之寒，朝野离心已久，如今官家下旨召开的武林大会，究竟还说不说得上是武林人的大会呢？所有人都感到如坐针毡，难以尽信上官隼所言，幸得宋神捕从旁助言，这位大人虽然也是朝廷命官，可是清正廉明，身居高位而奔走于江湖，又通情达理，名声极佳，江湖莫不以神捕尊称，一样道理的话，由他来说自然动听。何况众人心知肚明，再继续坐视泥教壮大绝非上策，今日能有朝廷撑腰，一举铲除祸胎，未尝不是一件好事，心思动得快的人，更已想到藉此机会建功投诚，将来运气好能谋个一官半职亦未可知。一有人发声赞同，旁人也争先恐后附和起来。=At the appointed hour, Family Head Shangguan ordered the drums beaten, stood in the center, and spoke with righteous indignation and eloquence.\n"In today's world, beset by internal troubles and external threats, with the Jin invaders eyeing us greedily from without and the Devil Cult scheming within, the danger to the martial world is tantamount to danger to the Central Plains, to the Great Song, and even to our entire nation".\n"We who pride ourselves on chivalry and righteousness—how can we bear to sit idly by while the common people suffer in misery?"\n"To gather collective wisdom and prepare for rainy days, we have convened this Wulin Assembly, widely inviting heroes from across the land to gather here. \nEven knowing Shangguan's words held truth, "ice three feet thick isn't formed in one day"—the rift between court and martial world had long been deepening. 你从头到尾不发一言，忧心忡忡，大会的狂热没一点星火沾到你身上，你闯荡江湖以来，固然不是没有见过泥教教徒行恶，可是行恶之人，岂止泥教？各门各派都有好人，亦有坏人，不应以偏盖全。今日泥教被冠以魔教之名，而武林盟则受朝廷驱使聚而歼之，万一下回朝廷又说唐门是魔教呢？万一下回朝廷说全真是魔教呢？无论你说什么，武林中人都不会听的，他们要的正义未必真的公平。=From beginning to end, you didn't utter a single word, your heart heavy with worry. 这场特训直打到黄昏方始决出胜负。输赢两方都是精疲力尽，但感悟也着实不少。=This special training session lasted until dusk before a winner was decided.\nBoth the winning and losing sides were exhausted, but they had gained quite a few insights.
